text: Gin-ako sang traffic aide nga nagamanihar sang Ungka Flyover nga wala matalupangdan sang wing van ang vertical clearance rason nga nasab-it ini.
english: The traffic aide in charge of the Ungka Flyover admitted that the wing van did not notice the vertical clearance and got stuck.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: PCOL.
english: PCOL.

text: Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU), iya ginpahayag nga sa ila bahin, nag-issue sila sang traffic citation ticket sa wing van bangud sa pagbayolar sini sa flyover ordinance sang syudad nga 2023-260.
english: Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU), said that on their part, they issued a traffic citation ticket to the wing van for violating the city's flyover ordinance 2023-260.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, nakadependi naman sa kapulisan ang ila mangin disposisyon sa van kasunod man sa ila ginpatuman nga imbestigasyon.
english: Garbanzos said it is up to the police to disposition the van following their investigation.

text: Nag-request naman ang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) 6 sang pila ka mga rekisitos antes nga buy-an ang driver sang van nga nakasab-it sa vertical clearance.
english: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) 6 requested several requirements before releasing the driver of the van who was hanging on the vertical clearance.

text: Una na nga natabo ang kaangay nga insidente sa isa ka modernized bus antes pa man ginbuksan ini sa iya full capacity.
english: A similar incident had earlier occurred in a modernized bus before it was opened to its full capacity.

text: ANG finding sang mga siyentipiko, nga suportado sang World Health Organization (WHO), nagasiling nga ang COVID-19 virus pwede ma-transmit sa tawo kag sa tanan nga lugar – sa  malamig (cold) man ukon mainit (hot) kag magin-ut (humid) nga mga lugar.
english: THE findings of scientists, supported by the World Health Organization (WHO), say that the COVID-19 virus can be transmitted to humans and in all places – whether in cold or hot and humid places.

text: Tungod sini, ginapanugyan nila nga indi gid magsalig nga indi kita malab-ut sining virus sa bisan diin man kita nagaluntad sa subong.
english: Therefore, they advise us not to trust that this virus will not reach us wherever we are now.

text: Gani, sundon gihapon  ang mga protective health measure, labi na gid sa mga lugar nga may report sang COVID-19.
english: Therefore, protective health measures should be followed, especially in areas with reports of COVID-19.

text: Sa matuod, madugay na nahibal-an sang scientific community nga ang silak sang adlaw (sunlight), sa dala sini nga ultraviolet light (UV), may sterilizing effect, ukon maka-“patay” ukon maka-eliminar sang mikrobyo katulad sang mga bacteria,  toxins, fungi kag mga virus lakip na ang COVID-19 virus.
english: In fact, the scientific community has long known that sunlight, with its ultraviolet light (UV), has a sterilizing effect, or can “kill” or eliminate microbes such as bacteria, toxins, fungi and viruses including the COVID-19 virus.

text: Sunu kay William Bryan, science and technology advisor sa US Department of Homeland Security secretary, sa interview sang mga reporter sadtong Abril 24, 2020 sa White House,  napamatud-an ini mismo sa ila experimento.
english: According to William Bryan, science and technology advisor to the US Department of Homeland Security secretary, in an interview with reporters on April 24, 2020 at the White House, this was proven in their experiment.

text: Ining ila experimento ginhiwat sa mga “surfaces” sang mga bagay, katulad sang door knob ukon handle, kag sa hangin kon diin sa aerosol nagaluntad man ang COVID-19 virus.
english: Their experiment was conducted on the surfaces of objects, such as door knobs or handles, and in the air where the COVID-19 virus also exists in aerosols.

text: Nagpaandam ugaling si Bryan nga indi buot silingon sini nga ang ining virus nga “napatay” sing lubos, kag sa madali lang, sa ila experimento “mapatay” man sing lubos sa gwa sini sa natural environment.
english: Bryan cautioned, however, that this does not mean that the virus that “died” completely, and soon, in their experiment will also “die” completely outside of it in the natural environment.

text:
***

By the way, wala ginagamit sang mga siyentipiko ang tinaga nga “patay” para sa COVID-19 virus, kundi ma-eliminar ukon ma-destroy lang kay wala ini sang indikasyon sang kabuhi.
english:
***

By the way, scientists do not use the word “dead” for the COVID-19 virus, but simply eliminate or destroy it because it has no indication of life.

text: Kon “daw may kabuhi”ini, ina lang kon maka-replicate sang iya kaugalingon sa masudlan nga host cell kag, sa paggwa, makahalit na sa baga (lungs), kidney, dugo kag iban pa nga bahin sang lawas sang tawo.
english: If it “appears to be alive,” it is only if it can replicate itself in the host cell and, upon release, damage the lungs, kidneys, blood and other parts of the human body.

text:
***

“Iresponsable ang magsiling nga ang panahon sang tag-ilinit (summertime) maka-eliminar sing lubos sang COVID-19 sa natural environment tungod sa resulta sining experimento,” paathag niya.
english:
***

“It is irresponsible to say that summertime can completely eliminate COVID-19 in the natural environment because of the results of this experiment,” he explained.

text: Lain ang kahimtangan sa experimento sangsa aktwal nga hitabo sa natural environment, dugang niya.
english: The situation in the experiment is different than the actual phenomenon in the natural environment, he added.

text: “Kinahanglan ta pa hibaluon kon ano ang ‘intensity and wavelength’ sang UV sa sunlight sa amon experimento ikumparar sa natural environment,” ang nasiling pa sini.
english: “We still need to know what the intensity and wavelength of UV in sunlight in our experiment is compared to the natural environment,” it said.

text: On average, sunu sa isa pa naton nga source, ang sunlight makahatag sing kasanag sa palibut sang kalibutan sa intensity lang nga 164 watts of energy per square meter sa sulod sang isa ka adlaw nga 24 oras.
english: On average, according to another source, sunlight can illuminate the earth's surroundings at an intensity of only 164 watts of energy per square meter during a 24-hour day.

text: Sa ina nga kahimtangan sang natural environment sa kalibutan,  sa pag-obserba man nanday  Bryan, indi gali lubos ma-destroy sang solar radiation (sunlight) ang COVID-19 virus sa sina nga natural environment.
english: In that state of the natural environment in the world, according to Bryan's observation, solar radiation (sunlight) cannot completely destroy the COVID-19 virus in that natural environment.

text: Wala ugaling nagsiling si Bryan kon tubtub lang sa ano ang ikasarang sa natural environment sang sunlight sa pagtapna sa mga mikrobyo (pathogen), lakip na ang COVID-19.
english: However, Bryan did not say to what extent the natural environment of sunlight can prevent pathogens, including COVID-19.

text: Ang hangop ta sini amo nga ma-eliminar man seguro sang sunlight sa natural environment ang COVID-19 pero indi sing dayon katulad sangsa nagakatabo sa ila experimento.
english: Our understanding of this is that sunlight in the natural environment can probably eliminate COVID-19 but not permanently like what happens in their experiment.

text: Sa nahibal-an na gani sang mga researcher sa COVID-19 virus madula man lang ini, ukon mag-inactive, sa pila ka adlaw nga pagtener sa gwa.
english: As researchers already know about the COVID-19 virus, it can disappear, or become inactive, within a few days of staying outside.

text: However, nasiling man ni Bryan nga pwede magsaka ang kaso sang COVID-19 sa panahon sang taglamig kag tagmala (cold and dry) nga klima (weather) kasubong sa nagakatabo sa kaso sang flu.
english: However, Bryan also said that cases of COVID-19 can increase during cold and dry weather such as what happens in cases of flu.

text: Ini man, dugang niya, ang kabangdanan kon ngaa mas madamo, generally, ang mga kaso sang COVID-19 sa mga pungsod nga malamig.
english: This is also, he added, why there are more, generally, cases of COVID-19 in cold countries.

text:
***

Samtang, sa isa ka pagtuon sa bio-oxygen process, napamatud-an nga lubos ma-eliminar ang COVID-19 paagi sa pag-magnetize sang oxygen sa pressurized electron shower nga ginapaandar sang 250 watts.
english:
***

Meanwhile, in a study on the bio-oxygen process, it was proven that COVID-19 can be completely eliminated by magnetizing oxygen in a pressurized electron shower powered by 250 watts.

text: Ini nga process gina-commercialize na sa Australia kag Germany sa mga ospital nga luyag magpasanyog sang  ila infection control system./PN
english: This process is already being commercialized in Australia and Germany to hospitals that want to improve their infection control system./PN

text: Siling nila, makibot ka gid sang mga bagay nga sarang mahimo sang gugma.
english: They say you’ll be surprised by the things love can do.

text: Amo gani nga halos daw indi makapati ang tanan sang isa ka love story sang isa ka lalaki nga na-in love sa iya nga ugangan!
english: That's why almost everyone can't believe a love story of a man who falls in love with his mother-in-law!

text: Ini amo si Sikandar Yadav, 45, nga may duha ka mga kabataan, kag residente sang Bihar sa India.
english: This is Sikandar Yadav, 45, who has two children, and is a resident of Bihar in India.

text: Ini nga istorya ang nagsugod sa isa ka trahedya sa ila nga pamilya sang napatay ang iya nga asawa.
english: This story began with a tragedy in their family when his wife died.

text: Agud mabuligan siya sa pagtatap sa iya kabataan, nagsaylo si Sikandar sa balay sang iya mga ugangan sa Heer Moti village sa Bihar.
english: To help her take care of her children, Sikandar moved to her in-laws’ house in Heer Moti village in Bihar.

text: Sa dalayon sini nga pagtinir didto, nahulog ang iya nga buot sa iya nga 55-anyos nga ugangan nga babaye.
english: During his stay there, he fell in love with his 55-year-old mother-in-law.

text: Amat-amat nga naglapta ang tsismis nga ini, kag isa ka adlaw, nakalab-ot na ini sa ihibalo sang ugangan nga lalaki nga si Dileshwar.
english: Gradually this gossip spread, and one day, it had reached the knowledge of father-in-law Dileshwar.

text: Nakumpirma ini sang nagpauli si Dileshwar sa ila nga balay kag naabtan sini ang lovebirds nga nagahaksanay.
english: This was confirmed when Dileshwar returned home and found the lovebirds hugging each other.

text: Didto kag nakaakig ini kag ginpalab-ot ang reklamo sa Panchayat ukon sa ila nga barangay council agud nga masolbar.
english: He then became angry and forwarded the complaint to the Panchayat or their barangay council for resolution.

text: Ginpatawag ang umagad, kag halos nakibot ang tanan bangud sa baylo nga manginwala, maisog sini nga gin-ako nga may relasyon siya sa iya ugangan nga babaye bangud nahulog ang iya buot diri.
english: The son-in-law was summoned, and almost surprised everyone because instead of denying it, he bravely admitted that he had an affair with his mother-in-law because he fell in love with her.

text: Mangin ang ugangan nga babaye ang nagsabat man nga ginahigugma sini si Sikandar.
english: Even the mother-in-law replied that she loved Sikandar.

text: Malawig pa nga drama ang natabo sa atubang sang council tubtub nga natabo pa gid ang isa ka imposible nga butang: NAGPASUGOT ang ugangan nga lalaki nga ihatag ang iya nga blessing kag nagbulig pa ini agud i-organisar ang kasal sang iya asawa kag umagad!
english: A long drama ensued in front of the council until another impossible thing happened: The father-in-law agreed to give his blessing and even helped organize the wedding of his wife and daughter-in-law!

text: Wala na sang madamo pa nga uyang sa tyempo bangud nagtipon ang magkasilingan kag gintambungan ang kasal sang duha samtang nga saksi mismo ang una nga bana.
english: There was not much waste of time because the neighbors gathered and attended the wedding of the two while the first husband was a witness.

text: Indi pa maathag kun magapadayon gihapon ini sa pagpuyo kaupod sa iya asawa nga subong may bag-o na nga bana sa persona sang ila umagad.
english: It is not clear whether he will continue to live with his wife who now has a new husband in the person of their son-in-law.

text: Kasado na ang former child star nga si Bugoy Cariño sa iya long-time partner nga si EJ Laure.
english: Former child star Bugoy Cariño is married to his long-time partner EJ Laure.

text: Ginpatigayon ang church wedding sa Tagaytay, kahapon, Marso 9, matapos ang ila engagement sadtong Septyembre 2023.
english: The church wedding was held in Tagaytay, yesterday, March 9, after their engagement in September 2023.

text: Lakip sa mga nagtambong sa selebrasyon amo ang teammates ni EJ halin sa Nxled Chameleons.
english: Among those in attendance at the celebration were EJ’s teammates from the Nxled Chameleons.

text: Matandaan nga 2018 sang nagbiya sa limelight si Bugoy sa tunga sang mga espekulasyon nga napabusong sini ang iya girlfriend.
english: It can be recalled that Bugoy left the limelight in 2018 amid speculation that he got his girlfriend pregnant.

text: Sang amo nga tion, naga-edad ini sang 16-anyos samtang 21 anyos naman si EJ.
english: At the time, she was 16-years-old while EJ was 21 years old.

text: Pila ka tuig sini nga gin-enjoy ang kabuhi sa guwa sang entertainment industry, tubtub nga sang nag-edad na si Bugoy sang 18-anyos sang 2020, ginpakilala na ang ila bata nga si Scarlet.
english: For several years, she enjoyed life outside the entertainment industry, until when Bugoy turned 18 in 2020, they introduced their daughter, Scarlet.

text: Nag-umpisa man ang couple sang YouTube channel kag nagsulod sa online selling business.
english: The couple also started a YouTube channel and ventured into the online selling business.

text: Kilala naman si EJ nga former University of Santo Tomas star nga nagsaylo halin sa Chery Tiggo pakadto sa Nxled.
english: EJ is known as the former University of Santo Tomas star who moved from Chery Tiggo to Nxled.

text: Nagapati ang House prosecution team nga indi dapat magpahilabot ang Korte Suprema sa impeachment trial batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The House prosecution team believes that the Supreme Court should not interfere in the impeachment trial against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang pag-file sang petition sa Korte Suprema sang mga abogado halin sa Mindanao agud pauntaton ang impeachment proceedings batok kay Duterte.
english: This follows the filing of a petition in the Supreme Court by lawyers from Mindanao to stop the impeachment proceedings against Duterte.

text: Ini ang ginpangunahan ni Atty. Israelito Torreon, legal counsel ni Pastor Apollo Quiboloy kag anay Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) Chairman Atty. Martin Delgra III.
english: This was led by Atty. Israelito Torreon, legal counsel of Pastor Apollo Quiboloy and former Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) Chairman Atty. Martin Delgra III.

text: Magluwas sa ila, nagpirma man sa petisyon sanday Atty. James Reserva kag Atty. Hillary Olga Reserva kag iban pa nga mga abogado halin sa Davao kag mga suppporters ni Duterte.
english: Besides them, the petition was also signed by Atty. James Reserva and Atty. Hillary Olga Reserva and other lawyers from Davao and Duterte supporters.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay House Deputy Majority Leader Iloilo 3rd District Representative Lorenz Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga indi maapektuhan ang preparasyon sang 11-man prosecution team sang Kamarapara sa impeachment trial batok kay Duterte sa pihak sang gin-file nga petisyon sa Korte Suprema.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, House Deputy Majority Leader Iloilo 3rd District Representative Lorenz Defensor said the preparation of the 11-man prosecution team of the House of Representatives for the impeachment trial against Duterte will not be affected despite the petition filed in the Supreme Court.

text: Suno kay Defensor nga isa sa prosecutors, legal ang impeachment process kag sakop ini sang constitutional bounds.
english: Defensor, one of the prosecutors, said the impeachment process is legal and within constitutional bounds.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga ang impeachment batok sa bise presidente ang dapat nga desisyunan sang publiko kag sang Kongreso.
english: He said the impeachment against the vice president should be decided by the public and Congress.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Defensor nga 100 sila nga kumpyansa sila sa validity sang proseso.
english: Defensor also said they are 100 confident in the validity of the process.

text: Ginpanindugan naman sini nga ang impeachment ang isa ka congressional function, kadungan sang pag-welcome sa judicial review.
english: He insisted that impeachment is a congressional function, while welcoming judicial review.

text: ILOILO – Ginpainan sang inisyal nga P55 million nga pondo ang pagatukuron nga Sports Complex sa Santa Barbara, Iloilo.
english: ILOILO – An initial P55 million fund has been allocated for the construction of the Sports Complex in Santa Barbara, Iloilo.

text: Disyembre 23, 2024 sang ginpatigayon ang Groundbreaking Ceremony kaupod si Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., 2nd District Cong.
english: December 23, 2024 when the Groundbreaking Ceremony was held with Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., 2nd District Cong.

text: Michael Gorriceta, Mayor Dennis Superficial kag USWAG Ilonggo Partylist Rep.
english: Michael Gorriceta, Mayor Dennis Superficial and USWAG Ilonggo Partylist Rep.

text: James Ang.
english: James Ang.

text: Ang nasambit nga sports complec ang may yara sang grandstand kag track oval nga standard olymnpic size nga 400 meters.
english: The sports complex has a grandstand and a track oval of standard olymnpic size of 400 meters.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Governor Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga tipigan kag halongan sang maayo ang mga proyekto nga ginahatag bangud ini ang makabenepisyo gid sa mga pumuluyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Governor Defensor said the projects being given will be well preserved and protected because they will benefit the people.

text: Ang sports complex ang mahimo man magamit indi lang sang mga residente sang Santa Barbara kundi mangin sang iban pa nga mga banwa sa Segundo distrito.
english: The sports complex can also be used not only by the residents of Santa Barbara but also by other towns in the Second District.

text: Samtang, recipient naman ang Santa Barbara Central School sang 3 units 2 storey classroom building.
english: Meanwhile, Santa Barbara Central School is the recipient of a 3 units 2 storey classroom building.

text: Ginpat-ud sang Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 nga indi na liwat pagsiraduhan pa ang Ungka Flyover.
english: The Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 has confirmed that the Ungka Flyover will not be closed again.

text: Kasunod ini sang liwat na nga pagbukas sang flyover para sa mga motorista sa subong nga adlaw kun sa diin isa ka program ang ginpatigayon.
english: This follows the reopening of the flyover for motorists today where a program was conducted.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Jose Al Fruto, Assistant Regional Director sang ahensya, iya ginpahayag nga apisar may yara pa sang construction activities, padayon ang operasyon sang flyover sa full capacity.
english: Jose Al Fruto, Assistant Regional Director of the agency, said that although there are still construction activities, the flyover continues to operate at full capacity.

text: Nahibaluan nga apisar bukas na, may mga salakyan nga indi mahimo maglabay sa flyover nga ginalakipan sang dumptrucks, transit mixers, wingvans, trailer trucks, motorsiklo, tricycles, kag bisekleta.
english: It is known that although it is open, there are vehicles that cannot pass through the flyover including dumptrucks, transit mixers, wingvans, trailer trucks, motorcycles, tricycles, and bicycles.

text: Dakop ang duha ka indibidwal sa ginpatigayon nga buy bust operation sang Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 6 sa Zone 10, Brgy.
english: Two individuals were arrested in a buy bust operation conducted by the Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 6 in Zone 10, Brgy.

text: Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City.
english: Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang subject amo kanday Alyas Pong Chow High-Value Individual (HVI), 35-anyos, kag residente sang Land Heights Subd.
english: The subjects were identified as Pong Chow High-Value Individual (HVI), 35 years old, and resident of Land Heights Subd.

text: Brgy.
english: Brgy.

text: Guzman Jecena, Manduriao , Iloilo City kag anay priso sa kapareho nga kaso nga magbayular sa RA 9165, tuig 2016 sang ICPS 5, kag, Alyas Boy, Street-Level Individual (SLI), 39-anyos 15, kag residente sang Brgy.
english: Guzman Jecena, Manduriao, Iloilo City and former inmate in the same case of violating RA 9165, year 2016 of ICPS 5, and, Alyas Boy, Street-Level Individual (SLI), 39-year-old 15, and resident of Brgy.

text: Fuentez, Banate, Iloilo apang temporaryo nga nagatinir sa Delgado st.
english: Fuentez, Banate, Iloilo but temporarily staying at Delgado st.

text: Iloilo City.
english: Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCapt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCapt.

text: Benjie Dicen, Officer-In-Charge sang ICPS 6, iya ginpahayag nga naglab-ot sa duha ka semana ang close monitoring.
english: Benjie Dicen, Officer-In-Charge of ICPS 6, said the close monitoring lasted for two weeks.

text: Base naman sa imbestigasyon, nagakuha ini sila sang ila supply sa Metro Manila, samtang sa syudad kag pila ka kabanwahanan naga-operate.
english: Based on the investigation, they get their supply from Metro Manila, while operating in the city and some towns.

text: Natigayon nga makumpiskar ang 65 ka gramo sang ginapasuni illegal nga droga nga may standard drug price nga P442, 000.
english: Seized were 65 grams of suspected illegal drugs with a standard drug price of P442,000.

text: Maka-gwa na si Pope Francis sa ospital sa Roma, Italya sa labing madali nga tion.
english: Pope Francis will be discharged from a hospital in Rome, Italy as soon as possible.

text: Suno sa Vatican, nagapadayon pa subong ang treatment and rehabilitation sa 84 anyos nga Santo Papa 10 ka adlaw matapos nagpaidalom sa intestinal surgery.
english: According to the Vatican, the 84-year-old Pope is still undergoing treatment and rehabilitation 10 days after undergoing intestinal surgery.

text: Ginpahayag man sang Vatican nga samtang yara si Pope Francis sa ospital, madamo na siya sang pasyente nga nakaupod kag nangin suod siya sa mga bedridden kag mga pasyente nga indi na makapauli sa ila nga balay.
english: The Vatican also said that while Pope Francis was in the hospital, he had many patients and became close to bedridden and homeless patients.

text: Wala na sang dugang nga detalye nga ginhatag may kaangtanan sa kondisyon sang Santo Papa.
english: No further details were given regarding the Pope's condition.

text: Wala na sang iban pa nga hilimuon si Pope Francis subong nga bulan magluwas sa iya Sunday blessing.
english: Pope Francis has nothing else to do this month except his Sunday blessing.

text: Nag-ginuwa ang mga videos nga nagapakita sang brutal nga pagpatay sang Taliban fighters sa 22 ka indi armado nga mga soldado sa Afghanistan.
english: Videos have emerged showing Taliban fighters brutally killing 22 unarmed Afghan soldiers.

text: Sa videos nakit-an ang mga Afghan Soldiers nga naga-gwa sa isa ka building apang sunod nga ginpangluthang-patay.
english: The videos showed Afghan soldiers coming out of a building but were subsequently shot dead.

text: Ang summary killings ang ginapahayag natabo sang Hunyo 16 sa Dawlat Abad sa Faryab sa Afghanistan.
english: The summary killings allegedly took place on June 16 in Dawlat Abad in Faryab in Afghanistan.

text: Sunod man nga ginkumpirma sang Red Cross nga naretrieve na ang lawas sang 22 ka mga commandos.
english: The Red Cross later confirmed that the bodies of the 22 commandos have been retrieved.

text: Ginpanginwala sang Taliban ang mga video kag ginpahayag nga propaganda lamang ini sang gobyerno agud nga indi magsungka ang tawo.
english: The Taliban denied the videos and said they were just government propaganda to keep the man from surrendering.

text: Suno sa isa ka Taliban spokesman, ginauyatan pa nila subong ang 24 ka commandos apang wala man sang ginpakita nga ebidensya.
english: A Taliban spokesman said they are still holding 24 commandos but have not shown any evidence.

text: Suno naman sa Afghan Ministry of Defense, ginpangpatay sang mga Taliban ang mga commandos kag indi matuod nga ginahold nila ini gihapon.
english: According to the Afghan Ministry of Defense, the Taliban killed the commandos and it is not true that they are still holding them.

text: Ang amo nga summary killings ang baliskad sa mga pahayag sang Taliban nga ginabaton nila ang mga nagasungka nga mga soldado kag ginabayaran ang iban agud nga magpauli agud nga malikawan na ang territorial gains sa amo nga pungsod.
english: The summary killings are contrary to the Taliban's claims that they accept surrendered soldiers and pay others to return home in order to avoid territorial gains in the country.

text: Pilason ang magpakaduha nga naglabu-anay sa Brgy.
english: Two people were injured in a stabbing incident in Brgy.

text: Quipot Janiuay, Iloilo.
english: Quipot Janiuay, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Romy Casquete Ganancial, 48-anyos, kasado, samtang ang suspek amo si Alex Lavaro Armada, 44-anyos, lunsay mangunguma kag residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Romy Casquete Ganancial, 48, married, while the suspect was identified as Alex Lavaro Armada, 44, both farmers and residents of the said area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PSsg.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PSsg.

text: Sanny Boone Deala, Imbestigador sang Janiuay Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nag inom-inom ini sila pagkatapos sang ila ubra upod ang duha pa nila ka pakaduha.
english: Sanny Boone Deala, Investigator of the Janiuay Municipal Police Station, said they were drinking after work with two other couples.

text: Nagbaisay ang suspek kag ang isa pa nila ka upod kag ginsaway ini sang biktima, sang nagwa ini sa balay, hinali ini nga ginlabo sang suspek.
english: The suspect and another of their companions had an argument and the victim reprimanded him, when he left the house, the suspect suddenly stabbed him.

text: Nakaagum ini sang pilas sa iya agtang, sa kamot, kag iya dughan.
english: He sustained injuries to his forehead, hand, and chest.

text: Nagbalos man ang biktima sa suspek kag nakaagum man ini sang pilas, apang nautod ang iya nga tudlo.
english: The victim retaliated against the suspect and sustained injuries, but his finger was cut off.

text: Lunsay nagapaayo sa Western Visayas Medical Center ang magpakaduha, kag nag desisyon nga indi nalang magpasaka sang kaso.
english: The couple are both undergoing treatment at the Western Visayas Medical Center, and decided not to file a case.

text: JAPAN – Kapin duha ka semana na lang antes ang pormal nga pag-umpisa sang Tokyo Olympics apang may mga diskumpyado gihapon sa COVID-19 situation sa Tokyo sa Japan.
english: JAPAN – More than two weeks before the formal start of the Tokyo Olympics, there are still disappointments in the COVID-19 situation in Tokyo, Japan.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang pag-anunsyo ni Japanese Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga nga may nakit-an nga pagtimbuok sa kaso sang Delta variant sang coronavirus – isa ka sitwasyon nga gintawag sang isa ka government adviser nga “very, very worrying”.
english: This follows the announcement by Japanese Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga that there has been an increase in cases of the Delta variant of the coronavirus – a situation that a government adviser called “very, very worrying”.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma direkta sa Japan, nagpasalig man si Suga nga may hugot nga mga pagsulundan nga ipatuman agud nga malikawan nga ang mga atleta halin sa iban nga mga pungsod ang makadala sang amo nga virus sa Japan.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma directly in Japan, Suga also assured that there are strict rules to be implemented to prevent athletes from other countries from bringing the virus to Japan.

text: Apisar sini, madamo sang mga researchers nga nakabase sa Japan nga nagapanindugan nga mangin dominante pa ang Delta variant antes mag-umpisa ang Olympics sa Hulyo 23.
english: Despite this, many researchers based in Japan insist that the Delta variant will still be dominant before the Olympics begin on July 23.

text: Nagpaandam ini nga mga researchers nga ang mataas nga numero sang international visitors ang makaresulta sa mas madamo nga exposures kag makapataas sang tyansa nga maglapta ang ini nga mas makalalaton nga variant.
english: These researchers warned that the high number of international visitors could result in more exposures and increase the chances of spreading this more contagious variant.

text: Indi kumbinsido ang mga reseachers sa COVID-19 measures nga ginapatigayon bangud kalabanan sang populasyon sa Japan ang indi pa vaccinated.
english: Researchers are not convinced of the COVID-19 measures being implemented because most of the population in Japan is not yet vaccinated.

text: 25% pa lang sang kabug-usan nga populasyon ang nakabaton sang first dose sang bakuna.
english: Only 25% of the total population has received the first dose of the vaccine.

text: Magabukas sa Hulyo 23 ang Olympics Games kag isunod naman ang Paralympics nga posible matabo sa tunga tunga sang Agusto 25 kag Septyembre 6.
english: The Olympic Games will open on July 23 followed by the Paralympics, which are likely to take place between August 25 and September 6.

text: Nagdepensa ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) kasunod sang pagpakamalaot nga nabaton halin sa publiko matapos gin-anunsyo nga may gintukod nga technical committee sa Filipino dishes nga magadevelop sang national standards sa pagluto sang adobo kag iban pa nga bantog nga mga pagkaon.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) has defended itself following condemnation from the public after it announced the establishment of a technical committee on Filipino dishes to develop national standards for cooking adobo and other popular dishes.

text: Suno sa DTI, ang ila tuyo nga idevelop ang standards sa pagluto sang adobo ang nagatuyo lamang nga maka-come up sa mga recipes nga pwede mapromote sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: According to the DTI, their intention to develop standards for cooking adobo is only to come up with recipes that can be promoted abroad.

text: Gin-athag man sang DTI nga wala sini gina-redefine kun ano man ang paglantaw sang mga tawo subong sa adobo.
english: The DTI also clarified that it is not redefining how people view adobo today.

text: Suno pa sa ahensya, wala sang dapat nga kahangaw-an bangud kabahin lamang ini sang pagdevelop sang mas creative nga industry exports ukon “international promotions” sa mga pagkaon.
english: According to the agency, there is nothing to worry about as this is part of the development of more creative industry exports or “international promotions” on food.

text: Ginpahayag man nga kun ano man ang mahimo nga standard sang ila committee, indi ini mangin mandatory standard bangud nahangpan man nila nga may linibo ka paagi ang mga Pinoy sa pagluto sang adobo.
english: He also said that whatever the standard of their committee, it will not be a mandatory standard because they understand that Filipinos have thousands of ways to cook adobo.

text: Gin-ako sang tigpamaba ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga naintindihan sang alkalde ang nangin explanation sang Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) sa ila temporaryo nga pagpasirado sang Iloilo International Airport sang aga sang Disyembre 22.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas' spokesperson acknowledged that the mayor understood the explanation of the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) for their temporary closure of the Iloilo International Airport on the morning of December 22.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ms. Joy Fatilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ang gin-eksplekar sa ila sang bahin sang CAAP amo ang safety sang mga pasahero bangud man sa nakita nga potholes sa runway sa airport rason nga temporaryo nila ginsirado ang airport.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ms. Joy Fatilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said that the CAAP explained to them the safety of the passengers due to the potholes found on the runway at the airport which is why they temporarily closed the airport.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, nagpahayag ang alkalde nga kinahanglan na gid iduso ang modernization sang Iloilo International Airport agud nga malikawan na ang amo nga hitabo.
english: According to Fantilaga, the mayor said that it is necessary to push for the modernization of the Iloilo International Airport in order to avoid such an incident.

text: Nagpasalig man ang alkalde nga madayon na ang modernisasyon sang paluparan sa masunog first quarter sang 2025.
english: The mayor also assured that the modernization of the airport will be completed in the first quarter of 2025.

text: Nagapati man si Treñas nga importante nga mapaathag sa publiko ang ila mangin safety kon makompleto ang modernization sang airport.
english: Treñas also believes that it is important to explain to the public their safety when the modernization of the airport is completed.

text: Arestado ang tag-iya sang factory kag pito ka iban pa matapos napatay ang 52 ka mga tawo bangud sa sunog sa Bangladesh.
english: A factory owner and seven others have been arrested after a fire in Bangladesh killed 52 people.

text: Apat sa mga kabataan sang tag-iya ang nalakip sa ginpreso kag ginpasakaan sang kaso nga murder.
english: Four of the owner’s children were among those jailed and charged with murder.

text: Ginapahayag nga may mga kabataan pa nga nagatrabaho sa amo nga factory kag ini subong ang separado nga gina-imbestigahan.
english: There are reportedly still children working in the factory and this is now being investigated separately.

text: Suno sa Emergency services, 49 ka mga lawas sang tawo ang narecover sa Hashem Food and Beverage factory samtang tatlo naman ka tawo ang napatay matapos naglumpat sa building.
english: According to emergency services, 49 human bodies were recovered from the Hashem Food and Beverage factory while three people died after jumping from the building.

text: Suno kay Jayedul Alam, police chief sa Narayanganj district kun sa diin nahamtang ang factory, ang entrance ang naka-padlocked sang tion sang sunog kag madamo ang mga nalapas nga fire kag safety regulations ang nasambit nga factory.
english: Jayedul Alam, police chief in Narayanganj district where the factory is located, said the entrance was padlocked at the time of the fire and the factory had violated many fire and safety regulations.

text: Mangin ang exit door sang factory ang naka-padlocked man.
english: Even the exit door of the factory is padlocked.

text: Madamo sang mga highly flammable chemicals kag plastics ang nakabutang sa building nga nangin tunaan man sang tuman nga pag-igrab sang kalayo.
english: Many highly flammable chemicals and plastics were placed in the building which also caused the fire to spread.

text: Natigayon naman nga marescue ang 25 ka mga tawo apang madamo pa ang nagapabilin nga missing.
english: Twenty-five people were rescued but many more remain missing.

text: Pito ang kumpirmado nga napatay sa aksidente nga natabo sa Magsangyaw, Tupi, South Cotabato subong nga hapon sang Lunes, Disyembre 23,2024.
english: Seven people were confirmed dead in an accident that occurred in Magsangyaw, Tupi, South Cotabato this afternoon, Monday, December 23, 2024.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon gikan sa mga otoridad, nagsaka ang mga himata sa Magsangyaw Land of Praise tourist spot sakay sa L300 Van agud maghimo sang pictorial para sa ila mga himata nga magpakasal.
english: According to initial information from the authorities, the relatives went to the Magsangyaw Land of Praise tourist spot in an L300 Van to take a pictorial for their relatives to get married.

text: Sang natapos na ang photo shoot kag papuli na sila, nadulaan sang preno ang ila salakyan samtang nagapanaog halin sa mataas nga bahin sang lugar kag nadulaan naman sang kontrol ang driver.
english: When the photo shoot was over and they were on their way home, their car lost its brakes while descending from a high point and the driver lost control.

text: Bangud sa kabaskugon sang impact, halos maguba ang pila ka parte sang salakyan, sa diin, nagkalatabog ang mga sakay sini.
english: Due to the force of the impact, some parts of the vehicle were almost destroyed, where, the occupants were thrown away.

text: Gilayon naman nga ginpatigayon ang rescue operation sa mga pasahero, apang pito gid ang wala nakaluwas.
english: A rescue operation was immediately conducted for the passengers, but seven of them did not survive.

text:
Yari ang mga pangalan sang mga biktima:

Annabelle Maglente – 52 anyos, Joan Maglente – 28 anyos, Joel Maglente, Duke Maglente kag Ike Maglente nga lunsay taga Cagayan de Oro City nga bag-o lang nagbakasyon sa banwa sang Polomolok, samtang ang duha ka menor de edad nga sanday Marga, 7 anyos kag Yuna , 8 anyos kag taga Polomolok, South Cotabato nga himata man sang mga Maglente’s.

Buhi naman ang driver sang van nga amo si Oliver Maglente apang may pilas sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang iya lawas.
english:
Here are the names of the victims:

Annabelle Maglente – 52 years old, Joan Maglente – 28 years old, Joel Maglente, Duke Maglente and Ike Maglente all from Cagayan de Oro City who recently vacationed in Polomolok town, while the two minors Marga, 7 years old and Yuna , 8 years old and relatives of Polomolok South Cotabato Maglente’s.

The driver of the van, Oliver Maglente, was alive but sustained injuries in various parts of his body.

text: Sa subong, gindala na sa morgue sang Tupi Municipal Hospital ang bangkay sang mga biktima.
english: The bodies of the victims were taken to the morgue of the Tupi Municipal Hospital.

text: Nagtinir pa sang masobra isa ka bulan ang pila ka mga Colombians sa Dominican Republic, nga nangin kabahin sang armado nga grupo nga nagpatay kay Haitian President Jovenel Moise.
english: Some Colombians stayed in the Dominican Republic for more than a month, becoming part of the armed group that killed Haitian President Jovenel Moise.

text: Si Moise, 53, ang ginluthang-patay sa iya mismo nga balay.
english: Moise, 53, was shot dead in his own home.

text: Ang pagpatay sa Presidente, ang nagbutang pa sa Haiti sa mas magamo sa tunga sang political divisions, kagutom kag lapnagon nga gang violence.
english: The assassination of the President has thrown Haiti into further turmoil amid political divisions, hunger and widespread gang violence.

text: Suno sa otoridad, ang mga armado nga grupo ang ginalakipan sang 26 ka mga Colombians kag duha ka Haitian Americans.
english: According to authorities, the armed groups include 26 Colombians and two Haitian Americans.

text: 17 ka mga lalaki ang na-engkwentro pa sang mga kapulisan sa Petionville samtang tatlo ang napatay kag walo pa ang “at large”.
english: 17 men were still encountered by the police in Petionville while three were killed and eight are still “at large”.

text: Wala naman nagpaguwa sang dugang nga detalye ang kapulisan sa nangin motibo sang armado nga grupo sa ila pagpatay sa Presidente.
english: Police did not release further details on the motive of the armed group in their killing of the President.

text: Base sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, pila sa mga suspek ang lunsay retired members sang armed forces sang Colombia.
english: Based on initial investigation, some of the suspects are all retired members of the armed forces of Colombia.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa pagpungko ni Moise sang 2017 sa pagka-presidente, madamo na nga mga alegasyon sang kurapsyon ang iya ginpangatubang sa diin lapnagon man nga hublag protesta ang ginpatigayon batuk sa iya.
english: It is known that since Moise took office in 2017, he has faced many allegations of corruption and widespread protests have been held against him.

text: Naghatag sang tips ang doktor agud malikawan ang angsod nga isa ka sahi sang body odor ilabi na subong nga mainit ang pahanon.
english: The doctor gave tips to avoid angsod which is a type of body odor especially now that the weather is hot.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Elvin Tiangha, iya ginpahayag nga ang body odor amo ang ‘unpleasant smell’ nga nagahalin sa lawas sang tawo sa diin may yara sang ‘overgrowth’ sang bacteria.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Elvin Tiangha, he said that body odor is an unpleasant smell that comes from the human body where there is an overgrowth of bacteria.

text: Ang body odor ang masami nagahalin sa tiil, ilok, pribado nga bahin sang lawas, pusod, alatrasan, likod sang dulunggan kag iban pa.
english: Body odor usually comes from the feet, nose, private parts of the body, navel, back, behind the ears and others.

text: Nagpanugyan man si Tiangha sang mga pamaagi agud malikawan ang body odor sa diin kalabanan sa mga ini ang makita lang sa kusina.
english: Tiangha also suggested ways to avoid body odor, most of which are only found in the kitchen.

text: Suno kay Tiangha, nagpanguna diri amo ang apple cider vinegar nga isa sa pinaka-epektibo nga ‘deodorizer’.
english: According to Tiangha, apple cider vinegar is one of the most effective deodorizers.

text: Mahimo ini ipahid suno sa doktor sa bahin sang lawas nga may odor matapos magpaligo bangud nagabulig ini patay sang mga bacteria nga ginahalinan sang baho sa lawas.
english: According to the doctor, it can be applied to the part of the body that has odor after taking a bath because it helps kill bacteria that cause odor in the body.

text: Ikaduha nga natural remedy sang body odor amo ang Baking soda ukon cornstarch sa diin mahimo ini ipahid sa bahin sang lawas nga may baho.
english: Second natural remedy of body odor is Baking soda or cornstarch where it can be rubbed on the odorous part of the body.

text: Isa ini suno kay Tiangha sa epektibo nga pampadula sang balhas agud mapauntat ang pagdamo sang bacteria.
english: Tiangha said it is one of the most effective shampoos to stop the growth of bacteria.

text: Dugang pa ni Tiangha, ang Parsley ukon ang bisan ano nga duag green kag madahon nga utan kaangay sang balunggay kag tangkong ang pila man sa mga epektibo nga remedyo sang body odor.
english: Tiangha added that parsley or any green and leafy vegetables such as bananas and tangkong are also some of the effective remedies for body odor.

text: Ang mga duag green nga utan suno kay Tiangha ang may anti-bacterial kag anti-inflammatory.
english: Green vegetables, according to Tiangha, have anti-bacterial and anti-inflammatory properties.

text: Gin-abiso sang natungdan nga mas healthy kag epektibo kun kan-on ang utan nga raw ukon hilaw.
english: He advised that it is healthier and more effective to eat raw vegetables.

text: Ang pinakamaayo nga himuon suno sa doktor amo nga magpaligo adlaw-adlaw kag indi pagpabay-an nga magdugay ang balhas sa lawas.
english: The best thing to do, according to the doctor, is to take a bath every day and not let the sweat stay on the body for too long.

text: Gina-problema mo man bala ang imo nga sodium intake ukon ang pagkonsumo sang mga pagkaon nga may sobra nga asin para nga mas mangin masabor kag maalat?
english: Do you also have problems with your sodium intake or consuming foods with too much salt to make them more palatable and salty?

text: May yara sang makabulig sa imo paagi sa sining bag-o nga imbensyon sa Japan ukon ang pungsod nga ginalaragway nga “Living In the Future” bangud sa mga abanse sini nga teknolohiya nga mapuslan gid sang mga pumuluyo.
english: There is something that can help you through this new invention in Japan or the country that is described as “Living In the Future” because of its technological advancements that will be very useful to the citizens.

text: Ang bag-o sini ginatanyag sa publiko amo ang isa ka kutsara nga makasarang maghatag ang maalat nga sabor sa dila sang tawo bisan nga wala man sang madamo nga asin ang iya ginatimo nga pagkaon.
english: The new one offered to the public is a spoon that can give a salty taste to the human tongue even if the food he is cooking does not contain much salt.

text: Ini nga kutsara ang may yara sang rechargeable battery nga nagapaguwa sang mahina lamang nga electrical charge nga amo ang nagapaalat sa panabor sang dila.
english: Ini nga kutsara ang may yara sang rechargeable battery nga nagapaguwa sang mahina lamang nga electrical charge nga amo ang nagapaalat sa panabor sang dila.

text: Suno sa kumpaniya nga nag-imbento sini, tuyo nila nga mabuhinan ang sodium intake sang tawo agud nga mabuligan man ang ila ikaayong lawas.
english: According to the company that invented it, they aim to reduce people's sodium intake in order to help their health.

text: Kun masobrahan abi ang asin nga gina-consume sang tawo, posible ini magtuga sang mga balatian kaangay sang high blood pressure kag stroke.
english: If a person consumes too much salt, it can cause diseases such as high blood pressure and stroke.

text: Indi basta-basta ini nga kutsara bangud nagalab-ot sa P7,000 ang presyo sini.
english: This spoon is not ordinary because it costs P7,000.

text: Ang Japanese drinks giant nga Kirin Holdings ang magasugod na sa pagbaligya sini subong nga Mayo kag may limited run man sa Japanese retailer sa bulan sang Hunyo.
english: Japanese drinks giant Kirin Holdings will start selling it this May and there will also be a limited run at the Japanese retailer in June.

text: Lunes sang ginlunsar ini nga produkto nga amo man ang nagamarka sang una nga commercialisation sangsini nga teknolohiya.
english: The product was launched on Monday, which also marks the first commercialization of this technology.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, nalakip ini sa nagdaog sa Ig Nobel Prize nga amo ang nagakilala sang indi kinaandan nga sahi sang mga research sa bilog nga kalibutan.#
english: Last year, it was among the winners of the Ig Nobel Prize which recognizes unusual types of research around the world.#

text: Ginklaro sang awtoridad nga wala sang foul play sa kamatayon sang Oscar-winning actor nga si Gene Hackman kag iya asawa nga si Miss Betsy Hackman.
english: Authorities have clarified that there was no foul play in the deaths of Oscar-winning actor Gene Hackman and his wife, Miss Betsy Hackman.

text: Ini nga kumpirmasyon ang opisyal nga nagatakop sang masobra isa ka semana nga espekulasyon kun ano ang natabo sa duha antes sila nasapwan nga patay na kaupod sa ila nga ido sa ila balay sa New Mexico, USA.
english: This confirmation officially ends more than a week of speculation about what happened to the two before they were found dead with their dog at their home in New Mexico, USA.

text: Suno kay Heather Jarrell, ang chief medical examiner sa New Mexico Office of the Medical Investigator, napatay ang 95-anyos nga Hollywood actor bangud sa hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease kag ginapanan-aw nga daku nga factor diri ang Alzheimer’s disease.
english: According to Heather Jarrell, the chief medical examiner at the New Mexico Office of the Medical Investigator, the 95-year-old Hollywood actor died of hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and Alzheimer's disease is believed to be a major factor.

text: Ginpahayag nga ang rason namna sa kamatayon sang 65-anyos nga misis amo ang hantavirus, pulmonary syndrome nga daw isa ka flu-like disease nga mahimo magresulta sa kabudlay sa pagginhawa kag cardiac ukon heart failure kag lung failure.
english: The cause of death of the 65-year-old wife was said to be hantavirus, a pulmonary syndrome that is like a flu-like disease that can result in difficulty breathing and cardiac or heart failure and lung failure.

text: “The cause of death for Mr. Gene Hackman, aged 95 years, is hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, with Alzheimer’s disease as a significant contributory factor,”suno kay Jarrell.
english: “The cause of death for Mr. Gene Hackman, aged 95 years, is hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, with Alzheimer’s disease as a significant contributory factor,”according to Jarrell.

text: “The cause of death for Miss Betsy Hackman, aged 65 years, is hantavirus, pulmonary syndrome.
english: “The cause of death for Miss Betsy Hackman, aged 65 years, is hantavirus, pulmonary syndrome.

text:
The manner of death is natural.”

Nagguwa man sa test nga wala sang sign of trauma sa lawas sang duha, kag wala man sang indikasyon nga ginhiluan sila apisar nga ini ang una nagguwa sa espekulasyon sang publiko.
english:
The manner of death is natural.”

The test also showed that there were no signs of trauma on the bodies of the two, and there was no indication that they were poisoned despite this initially appearing in public speculation.

text: Base sa otoridad, posible nga Pebrero 11 pa napatay ang misis, samtang Pebrero 18 naman napatay ang actor kun basehan ang iya last activities sa balay.
english: According to the authorities, the wife may have died on February 11, while the actor died on February 18 based on his last activities at home.

text: Magluwas sa napatay nga mag-asawa, nasapwan man nga patay ang ila nga ido sa bathroom, samtang may duha ka iban pa nga healthy dogs nga yara sa balay.
english: Besides the deceased couple, their dog was also found dead in the bathroom, while there were two other healthy dogs in the house.

text: Nahibaluan nga bantog si Hackman nga duha ka beses nakadaog sa Academy Awards ukon Oscars.
english: Hackman is famous for winning the Academy Awards or Oscars twice.

text: Ini ang amo ang Best Actor award sa iya papel sa 1971 thriller nga The French Connection, kag award man sa best supporting actor sa Western film nga Unforgiven sang 1992.
english: This was the Best Actor award for his role in the 1971 thriller The French Connection, and also the award for best supporting actor in the Western film Unforgiven in 1992.

text: Natungdan niya ang masobra 100 ka mga papel sa mga pelikula antes siya nag-retiro sa industriya sa Hollywood.
english: He played more than 100 roles in films before retiring from the industry in Hollywood.

text: SUGPUNAN naton sa ini nga edisyon sang aton kolum ang nahambalan naton sa nagligad parti sa climate change, ukon ang pagbaylo-baylo san g klima sa madasig na nga paglala sini tungod sa global warming,kon pagtaas sang kalibutanon nga init.
english: In this edition of our column, we will continue what we have discussed in the past about climate change, or the change in the climate as it rapidly worsens due to global warming.

text: Sa matuod, indi kita dapat maglahog-lahog sa climate change.
english: In fact, we should not be complacent about climate change.

text: Seryoso ini nga problema.
english: This is a serious problem.

text: Tungod man gani, sa nasiling ta na, sa aton mismo kapaltahan, labi na gid sa pag-producir kag paggamit sang fossil fuel (oil, natural gas, coal) sa halos tanan naton nga pangginawi.
english: Because, as we have already said, of our own shortcomings, especially in the production and use of fossil fuels (oil, natural gas, coal) in almost all our activities.

text: Nagsugod ining problema sadtong madiskubrihan na sang tawo sadtong ika-19 ka siglo ang fossil fuel nga nangin gatong sa madasig nga hulag sang tawo.
english: This problem began when man in the 19th century discovered fossil fuels that fueled man's rapid movement.

text: Makita ini sa wala katapusan nga paghagong-hong sang mga makinarya agud maghimo sang mga bag-o nga kagamitan, pagpatuman sang madasig nga pagbyahe kag komunikasyon, kag kon ano pa nga dapat pahulagon para sa kinahanglanon kag kagustuhan sang tawo para sa ila kalibutanon nga kalipayan.
english: This is reflected in the endless hum of machinery to produce new devices, implement rapid travel and communication, and whatever else must be mobilized for human needs and desires for their worldly pleasures.

text: Ugaling lang kay, samtang nagadala ini sang kaayuhan sa pagpangabuhi kg pangginawi sang tawo, nagdala man ini sang indi maayo nga mga hitabo para sa tawo.
english: However, while it brings benefits to human life and behavior, it also brings bad events for humans.

text: Sa nahibal-an sang ulihi sang aton mga siyentipiko, nagatuga gali ang pagsunog sang fossil fuel sang daku nga problema sa palibut, labi na gid ang ginabuga sini nga carbon dioxide nga sobra-sobra sa kinahanglanon sang tawo kag sang kalibutan.
english: As our scientists later learned, the burning of fossil fuels causes serious environmental problems, especially the carbon dioxide it emits, which is more than the needs of man and the world.

text: Ang pagsunog sang fossil fuel nagatuga gali sang greenhouse gas (GHG) nga naga-trap sang init sa nawong sang kalibutan (global warming) kag, in consequence, padayon nga paggaang sini sa kalibutan nga naga-resulta sa madamo nga kalalat-an.
english: The burning of fossil fuels actually creates greenhouse gases (GHG) that trap heat on the earth's surface (global warming) and, in consequence, continue to warm the earth resulting in many disasters.

text: Katulad sang mas makahalalit nga bagyo, malapad nga pagbaha, tagtuyot (drought), pagsaka sang taob (ocean tide rise),  linog kag iban pa.
english: Such as more destructive typhoons, widespread flooding, drought, ocean tide rise, earthquakes and others.

text: Tungod sini, ang Intergovernmental  Panel on Climate Change sang United Nations (UNIPCC), nga napasakupan sang sobra 1,000 ka mga siyentipiko nagpanugyan nga kinahanglan gid ligwaton naton ang aton pag-producir (produce) kag paggamit (consume) sang enerhiya gamit ang fossil fuel agud mapanubo ang emission sang GHG kag mapalayo kita sa peligroso (safe) sini nga level.
english: As a result, the United Nations Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (UNIPCC), composed of more than 1,000 scientists, has recommended that we reduce our production and consumption of energy using fossil fuels in order to reduce GHG emissions and avoid this dangerous level.

text: Nagpaandam gani sila sang  daku nga katalagman (catastrophy) kon ang global warming magsige-sige tubtub lapaw sa two degrees Celsius kag, kon pwede lang, sa 1.5o C lang.
english: They even warned of a catastrophe if global warming continues to exceed two degrees Celsius and, if possible, only 1.5o C.

text:
***

Angot sa sining katalagman sa tawo kag mismo sa kalibutan, gintukod ang Kyoto Protocol, nga ginpirmahan sang 192 ka pungsod sadtong 1997.
english:
***

In response to this threat to mankind and the earth itself, the Kyoto Protocol was established, signed by 192 countries in 1997.

text: Ginhisugtan diri nga panubuon ang individual targets sang GHG emission sa 5.2 percent halin sa daan nga mga level sini sadtong 1990 tubtub sa lubos nga pagpatuman sa 2012.
english: It was agreed to reduce individual GHG emission targets to 5.2 percent from their old levels in 1990 until full implementation in 2012.

text: Nag-expire ang Kyoto Protocol sadtong Disyembre 31, 2012.
english: The Kyoto Protocol expired on December 31, 2012.

text: Nangin madinalag-on ini.
english: It was successful.

text: Sunu sa report sini, partikular sa kaso sang CO2 emission, nagnubo ini tubtub 12.5 percent, nga lapaw sa target nga 4.7 percent.
english: According to its report, particularly in the case of CO2 emission, it decreased to 12.5 percent, which is above the target of 4.7 percent.

text: Wala pa natalana ang ikaduha nga commitment sini.
english: Its second commitment has not yet been scheduled.

text: Ginsundan ini sang Paris Agreement nga nag-take effect sadtong Nobyembre 4, 2016 nga nagtukod sang Climate Change Fund nga mga $100 ka bilyon para ibulig sa mga less developed countries.
english: This was followed by the Paris Agreement that took effect on November 4, 2016 which established a Climate Change Fund of about $100 billion to help less developed countries.

text:
***

Bilang isa ka arkepelago sang madamo nga isla (archipelago), highly vulnerable ang Filipinas sa Climate Change, lakip na ang pagsaka sang taob (ocean tide rise) tuga sang pagtunaw sang mga yelo sa Arctic Region tungod sa Global Warming, nga madasig na nabatygan sang tanan sa kalibutan.
english:
***

As an archipelago of many islands, the Philippines is highly vulnerable to climate change, including ocean tide rise caused by the melting of ice in the Arctic Region due to global warming, which is rapidly being felt by everyone in the world.

text: Sunu sa Greenpeace Southeast Asia, ang isa ka metro ng pagsaka sang taob makapekto sa  64 sang 81 ka probinsya sang pungsod.
english: According to Greenpeace Southeast Asia, a one-meter rise in sea level will affect 64 of the country's 81 provinces.

text: Gin-predict pa gani sini, kon indi mahingagaw nga masolbar ining problema, matabunan na sang dagat ang 703 sang 1,610 ka munisipilidad nga nagasakop sang mga 700 ka milyon metro cuadrado nga kadutaan.
english: He even predicted that, if this problem is not solved quickly, the sea will cover 703 of the 1,610 municipalities covering about 700 million square meters of land.

text: Tungod sini, dapat pasanyogon gid sang gobyerno ang mga proyekto nga makasagang (adapt) kag makapanubo (reduce) sang kahalitan sini; pagpasanyog sa paggamit sang renewable energy katulad sang hydropower, wind, geothermal, biomass, electric cars kag iban pa; kag ang mga proyekto batok sa lapnagon nga baha kag pagsaka sang taob sa baybayon.
english: Therefore, the government should promote projects that can adapt and reduce its damage; promoting the use of renewable energy such as hydropower, wind, geothermal, biomass, electric cars and others; and the projects against widespread flooding and coastal tidal rise.

text: Indi ta man malipat nga ang reserba sang fossil fuel sa bug-os nga kalibutan, labi na gid sa 14 ka pungsod sang Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OEC), madasig nga nagakaubos na kag sa indi na madugay./PN
english: Let us not forget that fossil fuel reserves worldwide, especially in the 14 countries of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OEC), are rapidly depleting and will soon be depleted.

text: Ginkumpirma ni World Boxing Council (WBC) president Mauricio Sulaiman ang liwat nga pagsaka sa ring ni retired Pinoy boxer Manny Pacquiao.
english: World Boxing Council (WBC) president Mauricio Sulaiman confirmed the return of retired Pinoy boxer Manny Pacquiao to the ring.

text: Atubangon sang anay eight world division boxing champion si Mario Barrios para sa WBC welterweight title sa Hulyo.
english: The former eight world division boxing champion will face Mario Barrios for the WBC welterweight title in July.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig pa naggwa ang huring-huring nga may negosasyon sa sambuwa sang duha ka mga boksedor.
english: Last year, there were rumors that there were negotiations in the fight between the two boxers.

text: Sang Agosto 2021 pa ang ulihi nga away ni Pacquiao kun sa diin ginpierde siya ni Yordenis Ugas sang Cuba kag pila ka bulan pagkatapos sadto, iya gin-anunsyo ang pagretiro.
english: Pacquiao's last fight was in August 2021 when he was defeated by Cuba's Yordenis Ugas and a few months later, he announced his retirement.

text: Ginplano subong ni Russian President Vladimir Putin ang posibilidad sang makaangkong sang nuclear test.
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin has now planned the possibility of a nuclear test.

text: Kasunod ini sa nangin pahayag ni US President Donald Trump nga magaumpisa sila sang nuclear testing program.
english: This follows US President Donald Trump's announcement that they will start a nuclear testing program.

text: Sa speech ni Putin sa ecurity Council sang Russia nga nagabulig sila sa Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT) kag wala sang plano nga maglapas diri.
english: In his speech to Russia's ecurity council, Putin said they support the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT) and have no plans to violate it.

text: Apang, kun magpatigayon ang US kag iban pa nga pungsod nga amo ang signatories sang CTBT, mapilitan ang Russia nga magsabat diri.
english: However, if the US and other countries that are signatories to the CTBT do so, Russia will be forced to respond.

text: Ginpamangkot man niya ang mga government ministries kag pila ka mga ahensya nga magsumiter sang coordinated proposals para sa posibilidad nga pagpatigayon sang nuclear weapons testing.
english: He also asked government ministries and several agencies to submit coordinated proposals for the possibility of conducting nuclear weapons testing.

text: Nakapamahaw sang maayo kag nakalakat-lakat na si Pope Francis duha ka adlaw matapos nagpaidalom sa surgery bangud sa inflamed large colon.
english: Pope Francis had a good breakfast and was able to walk two days after undergoing surgery for an inflamed large colon.

text: Suno kay Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni, “His Holiness Pope Francis rested well during the night.
english: According to Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni, “His Holiness Pope Francis rested well during the night.

text:
This morning he had breakfast, he read some newspapers and got up to walk.”

Ginpahayag man nga maayo ang resulta sang routine check-ups sang 84 anyos nga Santo Papa.
english:
This morning he had breakfast, he read some newspapers and got up to walk.”

The 84-year-old Pope's routine check-ups were also reported to be good.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Vatican ngaa gin-admit sa ospital si Pope Francis sang Domingo sang hapon para sa scheduled operation bangud sang symptomatic diverticular stenosis sa iya colon.
english: The Vatican earlier announced why Pope Francis was admitted to the hospital on Sunday afternoon for a scheduled operation due to symptomatic diverticular stenosis in his colon.

text: Ang tatlo ka oras nga operasyon ang ginpatigayon ‘under general anaesthetic’ sa isa ka ospital sa Roma sa Italya.
english: The three-hour operation was performed under general anesthetic at a hospital in Rome, Italy.

text: Sang Lunes, ginpahayag man sang Vatican nga ang Santo Papa ang yara sa ‘good general condition, alert, and breathing spontaneously”.
english: On Monday, the Vatican also said the Pope was in ‘good general condition, alert, and breathing spontaneously’.

text: Ginapahayag nga magapabilin pa sa ospital si Pope Francis sa sulod sang isa ka semana magluwas lang kun may mga kumplikasyon.
english: Pope Francis is expected to remain in the hospital for a week unless there are complications.

text: Gindemolish na lang ang nabilin nga porsyon sang condo building sa Miami, Florida nga nagcollapse para sa safety sang mga tawo samtang nagapalapit sa Florida ang bagyo Elsa.
english: The remaining portion of a condo building in Miami, Florida that collapsed has been demolished for the safety of people as Hurricane Elsa approaches Florida.

text: Wala na sang nabilin nga tawo sa Champlain Towers South sang gin-umpisahan ang pagpalupok.
english: No one was left in Champlain Towers South when the shooting started.

text: Matandaan nga Hunyo 24 sang nagcollapse ang porsyon sang building sa diin 24 ka tawo ang patay kag 121 pa ang missing.
english: It can be recalled that on June 24, the portion of the building collapsed, killing 24 people and 121 others are missing.

text: Pagkatapos sang demolition, liwat nga nagbalik ang crew para sa pagpangita sa mga biktima.
english: After the demolition, the crew returned again for the search for the victims.

text: Nagalaum ang search and retrieval teams nga mahimo na nila makit-an ang mga nabilin nga missing.
english: Search and retrieval teams hope to find the remaining missing.

text: Una nga ginpahayag ni Mayor Charles Burkett nga may yara sang peligro nga nadala ang mga mabaskog nga hangin nga magtuga sang dugang nga peligro sa kabuhi sang tawo ilabi na sa mga search crews.
english: Earlier, Mayor Charles Burkett said there is a risk that the strong winds will cause more danger to human life especially to search crews.

text: Ang “controlled implosion” ang ginplanuhan sang maayo agud nga indi maapektuhan ang mga residente malapit sa lugar.
english: The controlled implosion was carefully planned so that residents near the area would not be affected.

text: Tubtob subong, indi sa gihapon maathag kun ano ang nangin kabangdanan sa pagcollapse sang 40 anyos nga condo building.
english: It is still unclear what caused the collapse of the 40-year-old condo building.

text: Gin-admit si Pope Francis sa isa ka ospital sa Rome, Italy para sa scheduled surgery sa iya colon.
english: Pope Francis was admitted to a hospital in Rome, Italy for scheduled surgery on his colon.

text: Suno kay Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni, nagasuprer ang 84 anyos nga Santo Papa sang “symptomatic diverticular stenosis” sa colon, isa ka condition nga mahimo rason sang recurrent abdominal pain, bloating, kag pagbag-o sa bowel habits.
english: According to Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni, the 84-year-old Pope suffers from “symptomatic diverticular stenosis” in the colon, a condition that can cause recurrent abdominal pain, bloating, and changes in bowel habits.

text: Wala pa sang maathag nga petsa kun san-o patigayunon ang operasyon sa Gemelli hospital sa Roma.
english: There is no clear date for the operation at the Gemelli hospital in Rome.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga tion nga na-admit sa ospital si Pope Francis halin sang naeleher siya sa posisyon sang 2013.
english: This is the first time Pope Francis has been admitted to the hospital since he was elected to office in 2013.

text: Duha pa ka mga lawas ang nasapwan kasunod sang nagluntad nga mudslide sa Atami City sa southwest sang Tokyo, Japan.
english: Two more bodies have been found following a mudslide in Atami City southwest of Tokyo, Japan.

text: Matandaan nga sa natabo nga mudslide, 300 ka mga balay ang kumpirmado nga apektado.
english: It can be recalled that in the mudslide, 300 houses were confirmed to be affected.

text: Padayon man nga ginapangita ang kapin 20 ka mga indibidwal nga una nga gindeklarar sang local authorities nga missing.
english: The search for more than 20 individuals who were initially declared missing by local authorities is also ongoing.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma direkta sa Japan, kumpirmado nga lunsay mga babaye ang duha ka lawas nga nasapwan.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma directly in Japan, it is confirmed that the two bodies found were both women.

text: Pahayag ni Palma, bag-o gindeklara sang mga otoridad nga patay na ang duha, ginpaidalom pa ang mga ini sa cardio kag respiratory arrest apang wala na natabangan pa.
english: Palma said that before the authorities declared the two dead, they were subjected to cardio and respiratory arrest but were not helped.

text: Sa subong, gin-alerto ang mga pumuluyo bangud may forecast nga nagagwa nga magabubo pa ang mamunog nga pag-ulan sa Atami City sa diin dako ang posibilidad sang pagluntad sang landslide.
english: Meanwhile, residents have been alerted because there is a forecast of heavy rains in Atami City where there is a high possibility of landslides.

text: Bangud sini, nagmando na si Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga sa emergency services kag militar agud maglunsyar sang rescue kag evacuation missions.
english: Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga has ordered emergency services and the military to launch rescue and evacuation missions.

text: Una naman nga nagpasalig ang Prime Minister nga ang police, fire department service, Japan Coast Guard, kag Japan Self-Defense Forces ang nagabululigay agud nga nga makaresponde sa mga apektado.
english: Earlier, the Prime Minister assured that the police, fire department service, Japan Coast Guard, and Japan Self-Defense Forces are working together to respond to the affected.

text: Nagdangat naman sa malapit sa 400 ka mga indibidwal ang ginpang-evacuate sa 10 ka evacuation centers sa Atami City.
english: Nearly 400 individuals were evacuated to 10 evacuation centers in Atami City.

text: Dako nga ang posibilidad nga hungod nga ginpangsunog ang pito ka mga simbahan sa Canada.
english: It is likely that seven churches in Canada were deliberately set on fire.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Gregorio Galido direkta sa Canada, ginapahayag nga arson attacks ukon hungod nga mga pagpangsunog ang nagakatabo sa diin roman catholic churches ang lunsay ginatarget.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Gregorio Galido directly in Canada, arson attacks or deliberate burnings are reportedly happening where Roman Catholic churches are all targeted.

text: Kadam-an sa mga apektado nga simbahan ang makit-an sa indigenous communities.
english: Most of the affected churches are located in indigenous communities.

text: Pahayag ni Galido, ini ang kasunod sang mga panawagan sa Simbahang Katolika nga magpangayo sang patawad para sa mga linibo nga bangkay kag unmarked grave nga nasapwan sa mga ginpatindugan sang residential schools nga ginadumala sang mga Simbahan.
english: Galido said this follows calls to the Catholic Church to apologize for the thousands of bodies and unmarked graves found in residential schools run by churches.

text: Ini nga residential schools ang para sa mga indigenous children sa diin humalin sang 1840s tubtob 1990s ginapahayag may nagakatabo nga ‘cultural genocide’ sa sulod sang mga eskwelahan.
english: These residential schools were for indigenous children where from the 1840s to the 1990s there was allegedly cultural genocide taking place inside the schools.

text: Ginpahayag nga sa sulod sang ginabanta 110 ka-tuig, kapin 150, 000 ka mga kabataan nga kabahin sang indigenous community ang ginapadala sa residential schools sa diin gindangutan ang mga ini sang kultura , lenggwahe, kag gina-abuso indi lamang sa pisikal nga aspeto kundi mangin sa emosyonal kag sekswal.
english: It is reported that for approximately 110 years, more than 150,000 children who are part of the indigenous community are sent to residential schools where they are deprived of culture, language, and are abused not only physically but also emotionally and sexually.

text: Tubtob subong, indi man sa gihapon mapat-od kun pila ang numero sang mga kabataan nga ginbawian sang kabuhi bangud sa malnutrition kag pila ka mga balatian bangud ginapahayag lunsay ginpangguba ang ila record.
english: Until now, it is still uncertain how many children died due to malnutrition and some diseases because their records were reportedly destroyed.

text: Dalayawon ang ginpakita sang duha ka kabataan sa Dueñas, Iloilo.
english: Two children in Dueñas, Iloilo showed a commendable performance.

text: Ini matapos nga gindala nila sa police station ang wallet nga ila nakit-an.
english: This was after they took the wallet they found to the police station.

text: Ini ang may unod nga kwarta kag mga valid IDs.
english: It contains money and valid IDs.

text: Bangud sini, nabalik sa tag-iya ang amo nga wallet kag tuman ang iya pagpasalamat sa duha ka mga bata.
english: As a result, the wallet was returned to the owner and he was very grateful to the two children.

text: Ginpa-iway anay nanday Prince William kag Prince Harry ang ila indi paghangpanay kadungan sang ika-60 nga kaadlawan sang ila iloy nga si Princess Diana.
english: Prince William and Prince Harry have put their differences aside on the occasion of their mother Princess Diana's 60th birthday.

text: Ila ginsapubliko ang estatwa sang ila iloy nga nahamtang sa garden sang anay puluy-an ni Diana sa London sa Kensington Palace.
english: They unveiled a statue of their mother in the garden of Diana's former London home at Kensington Palace.

text: Sang gin-anunsyar sang 2017 ang proyekto, naglaum ang mag utod nga makabulig ini sa mga tawo sa pag-reflect sang ila kaugalingon sa kabuhi sang ila iloy kag sa iya nga legasiya.
english: When the project was announced in 2017, the brothers hoped it would help people reflect on their mother's life and her legacy.

text: Nahibaluan nga napatay si Diana sang 1997 sa edad nga 36 anyos sa isa ka car crash.
english: Diana died in 1997 at the age of 36 in a car crash.

text: Sa pihak sang “very personal” family event sang nangin seremonya sa kaadlawan ni Diana, ang tanan nga mata ang yara sa mag-utod sa posible tension nga matabo.
english: Despite the “very personal” family event of what turned out to be Diana’s birthday ceremony, all eyes were on the brothers for possible tension.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang royal biographer nga si Robert Lacey nga magapabilin ang tension sa tunga nanday Prince William kag Prince Harry.
english: Royal biographer Robert Lacey has previously said that tensions between Prince William and Prince Harry will remain.

text: Mangin ang asawa ni William nga si Kate ang nagpahayag nga wala gid ginpakilala sa ila nanday Harry kag Meghan Markle ang ila anak ng si Lilibet Diana umpisa sang ini ang ginbun-ag sang tinalikdan nga bulan.
english: Even William's wife Kate said Harry and Meghan Markle had never introduced their daughter Lilibet Diana to them since she was born last month.

text: Mas madamo pa nga lawas ang nakit-an sang mga rescue teams gikan sa nag-collapse nga building sa Florida, USA.
english: Rescue teams have found more bodies from a collapsed building in Florida, USA.

text: Suno kay Colonel Golan Vach, head sang Israeli military unit sa search and rescue operations, ang panibag-o nga death toll ang indi anay pag-isapubliko.
english: According to Colonel Golan Vach, head of the Israeli military unit in search and rescue operations, the new death toll will not be made public.

text: Apang sa subong may yara na sang 12 nga patay kag ginalauman pa ini nga magsaka samtang wala pa nakit-an ang iban nga missing.
english: But so far there are 12 dead and it is expected to rise while others are still missing.

text: Pahayag niya, ginkamang nila ang tunnel kag nagsinggit sa pagpati nga may yara pa sang survivor sa lugar bangud portion lang sang building ang nagcollapse apang wala sang may nagsabat sa ila ukon ano man nga patimaan nga may yara pa sang buhi.
english: He said they crawled through the tunnel and shouted in the belief that there were still survivors in the area because only a portion of the building collapsed but no one answered them or any sign that there were still alive.

text: Kun agaw-atensyon ang istorya sang mga tigulang nga pursigido gihapon sa pag-eskwela apisar sang ila edad, may yara man sang baliskad nga mga kaso: mga tawo nga nagapanglakaak na ang nalab-utan sa edukasyon apisar lamharon pa lamang.
english: If the story of the elderly who are still determined to study despite their age is attention-grabbing, there are also the opposite cases: people who are already struggling have achieved education despite being young.

text: Kaangay sining isa ka dalaga sa Chicago, USA nga nagkadto sa iya graduation ceremony subong nga bulan matapos nga nakumpleto na ang iya nga doctoral degree sa edad nga 17.
english: Like this young woman in Chicago, USA who went to her graduation ceremony this month after completing her doctoral degree at the age of 17.

text: Suno kay Dorothy Jean Tillman II, na-homeschool siya umpisa sang bata pa lamang tubtub nga nagsulod siya sa kolehiyo sa edad nga 10 ka tuig.
english: According to Dorothy Jean Tillman II, she was homeschooled from childhood until she entered college at the age of 10 years.

text: Samtang ang mga kaedaran sini ang yara pa lamang sa middle school, nagpadayon si Dorothy sa pagsulod sa klase sa College of Lake County sa northern Illinois kun sa diin nagtuon siya sang psychology kag nakumpleto ang iya nga associate’s degree sang 2016.
english: While her peers were only in middle school, Dorothy continued to attend classes at the College of Lake County in northern Illinois where she studied psychology and completed her associate’s degree in 2016.

text: Nakuha man sini ang bachelor’s in humanities halin sa Excelsior College sa New York sang 2018.
english: She also earned a bachelor’s in humanities from Excelsior College in New York in 2018.

text: Sang 2020, may yara na siya sang Master of Science degree, kag isa ka tuig ang nakalidad, sa edad nga 15, nabaton siya sa Doctorate of Behavioral Health Management program sa Arizona State University.
english: By 2020, she already had a Master of Science degree, and a year later, at the age of 15, she was accepted into the Doctorate of Behavioral Health Management program at Arizona State University.

text: Sang Disyembre 2023, sa edad nga 17, madinalag-on sini nga nadepensahan ang iya dissertation nga requirement sa iya nga doctoral degree sa integrated behavioral health halin sa College of Health Solutions sa amo nga unibersidad.
english: In December 2023, at the age of 17, he successfully defended his dissertation requirement for his doctoral degree in integrated behavioral health from the College of Health Solutions at that university.

text: Sang Mayo 6, halos tanan nagalantaw sa iya sang yara na ini sa spring commencement ceremony sang buluthuan.
english: On May 6, almost everyone was watching him when he was at the school's spring commencement ceremony.

text:
Ini ang rason kun ngaa ginatawag siya sang iya mga pamilya kag abyan sa isa pa ka pangalan: “Dorothy Jeanius.”

Sa tanan nga iya nadangatan, tuman gid ang pagpasalamat ni Dorothy sa bulig sang iya nga iloy kag Lola nga amo ang nagsustiner sa iya agud mabulsa ini nga kadalag-an sa edukasyon.
english:
This is why her family and friends call her by another name: “Dorothy Jeanius.”

In all that she has achieved, Dorothy is very grateful for the help of her mother and grandmother who sustained her to achieve this success in education.

text: “I’m really just grateful that the world is my oyster, and that I’ve done so much so young.
english: “I’m really just grateful that the world is my oyster, and that I’ve done so much so young.

text:
And I have time to kind of think that through.”

Mangin ang mga manunudlo ang nagadayaw man sa dedikasyon ni Dorothy.
english:
And I have time to kind of think that through.”

Even the teachers admire Dorothy's dedication.

text: Siya ang pinakabata sa maragtas sang Arizona State University nga nakaangkon sang doctoral degree sa integrated behavioral health.
english: She is the youngest in Arizona State University history to earn a doctoral degree in integrated behavioral health.

text: “It’s a wonderful celebration … but this is still something so rare and unique.
english: “It’s a wonderful celebration … but this is still something so rare and unique.
