text: She has innovative ideas and motivation, which is wonderful, and truly, I think what is inspiring is that she embodies that meaning of being a true leader,” pahayag ni Dr. Lesley Manson, isa ka clinical associate professor sa ASU.
english: She has innovative ideas and motivation, which is wonderful, and truly, I think what is inspiring is that she embodies that meaning of being a true leader,” said Dr. Lesley Manson, a clinical associate professor at ASU.

text: Nagalaum man ini nga madamo pa ang ma-inspire ni Dorothy bangud sa iya pinasahi nga pagpalangga sa pagtuon: “That curiosity is always there, and I think all learners come with that, but it’s great to be able to see it in someone so young as well.”#
english: She also hopes that Dorothy will inspire many more with her unique love of learning: “That curiosity is always there, and I think all learners come with that, but it’s great to be able to see it in someone so young as well.”#

text: Napuno sang emosyon ang selebrasyon sang 10th wedding anniversary sang celebrity couple nga sanday Chito Miranda kag Neri Naig.
english: The celebration of the 10th wedding anniversary of celebrity couple Chito Miranda and Neri Naig was filled with emotion.

text: Ginselebrar ini paagi sa pag-renew sang ila wedding vows kun sa diin kabahin sang entourage ang ila kabataan nga sanday Pia, Miggy, kag Cash.
english: They celebrated by renewing their wedding vows where their children Pia, Miggy, and Cash were part of the entourage.

text: Disyembre 2024 pa ang orihinal gid nga anibersaryo sang ila kasal, naatrasar, apang suno sa vocalist sang Parokya ni Edgar, ang importante amo nga nadayon, kag wala man sila nagadali.
english: Their original wedding anniversary, which was scheduled for December 2024, has been delayed, but according to the vocalist of Edgar's Parish, the important thing is that it happened, and they are not in a hurry.

text: “Happy 10th anniversary, asawa ko.

Tag team partners for life.”

Tag team partners for life.”

text: Matandaan nga gindakop ang actress-entrepreneur sadtong 2024 apang nagdepensa si Chito nga endorser gid lamang ang iya asawa sa involved nga kumpaniya nga Dermacare kag gingamit lamang ang nawong sini agud nga mang-engganyo sang mga investor.
english: The actress-entrepreneur was arrested in 2024 but Chito defended that his wife was an endorser of the involved company Dermacare and used her face to lure investors.

english: Sen. Aquino acknowledged.

text: Robin Padilla nga nasakitan ini kag naglain ang iya buot sang nahibaluan nga nadala sa ginpangalanan bilang co-perpetrators sang International Criminal Court ang iya mga kaupdanan sa minority nga sanday Sen.
english: Robin Padilla said he was hurt and upset when he learned that his minority colleagues, Sen.

english: Christopher Bong Go and Sen.

english: Ronald Bato Dela Rosa.

english: The senator also said that he immediately called Go and Dela Rosa to ask what he could do because they are ready to help if needed.

text: Suno pa sa Senador, nakig-angot man ini sa minority floor leader nga si Senador Alan Peter Cayetano agud talakayon kun ano ang ila himuon, bangod sila ang una nga maapektuhan bilang minorya sa Senado.
english: The senator said he also met with minority floor leader Senator Alan Peter Cayetano to discuss what they should do, because they are the first to be affected as a minority in the Senate.

text: Nagpanawagan man si Padilla sa gobyerno, nga indi dapat tugutan sang Pilipinas ang International Criminal Court nga dumalahan ang mga Pilipino.
english: Padilla also called on the government, that the Philippines should not allow the International Criminal Court to rule the Filipinos.

text: ISA KA daku nga rason kon ngaa napierde si President Donald Trump sang nagligad nga presidential election sa United States amo ang pag-withdraw sini sa pagpasakop sang iya pungsod sa 2015 Paris Agreement on Climate Change.
english: A BIG reason why President Donald Trump lost the last presidential election in the United States was his withdrawal from his country's commitment to the 2015 Paris Agreement on Climate Change.

text: Gin-announce ni Trump ining withdrawal sa Paris Agreement sadtong Hunyo 1, 2017, isa ka tuig matapos siya magpungko bilang presidente sang United States.
english: Trump announced this withdrawal from the Paris Agreement on June 1, 2017, a year after he took office as president of the United States.

text: Nag-take effect ugaling ini sang Nobyembre 4, 2020 lang.
english: However, it took effect only on November 4, 2020.

text: Ining pag-withdraw ni Trump sa Agreement gindala sa kampanya sang Democratic Party, sa pagpanguna ni karon Presiden-elect Joe Biden upod kay Vice President-elect Kamala Harris, batok kay Republican Party President Trump kag sang iya mga kapartido.
english: This withdrawal by Trump from the Agreement was carried into the campaign of the Democratic Party, led by now President-elect Joe Biden along with Vice President-elect Kamala Harris, against the Republican Party President Trump and his allies.

text: Sa nahibal-an na, nagdaug sanday Biden kag Harris kag mapungko na sa pwesto sa palaabuton nga Enero 20, 2021.
english: As already known, Biden and Harris won and will take office on January 20, 2021.

text: Nagpahayag man si Biden nga ipabalik sini ang US sa Paris Agreement sa pagpungko na niya bilang Presidente.
english: Biden also said he would bring the US back to the Paris Agreement when he becomes President.

text: Madamo ang natingala sa sining desisyon ni Presidente Trump, nga ang ginpilit lang niya nga rason amo ang iya “America First Policy” sa pagpauswag sang pangabuhian sang iya mga pumuluyo.
english: Many were surprised by this decision of President Trump, whose only reason was his “America First Policy” to improve the lives of his people.

text: Makatilingala matuod.
english: Amazing indeed.

text: May suspetso kita ugaling nga tungod ini kay ang China, nga myembro man sang Paris Agreement, ang pinaka-vulnerable sa climate change, kag indi lang luyag ni Trump mabuligan ang kaaway nga China sa problema sini sa climate change.
english: We suspect, however, that this is because China, which is also a member of the Paris Agreement, is the most vulnerable to climate change, and Trump just doesn't want to help his enemy China with its climate change problem.

text: Sunu mismo sa Agreement, ang mga developed countries, katulad sang US, magahatag sing bulig ang Agreement halin sa Climate Change Fund sa mga developing countries nga nagalakip sang China kag India, agud mapanubo ang ila emission sang greenhouse gas (fossil fuel) nga nagapalala sang global warming, ukon init sang kalibutan, nga nangin mahaliton na sa kalibutan.
english: According to the Agreement itself, developed countries, such as the US, will provide assistance from the Climate Change Fund to developing countries, including China and India, to reduce their emissions of greenhouse gas (fossil fuel) that exacerbates global warming, or global warming, which has become harmful to the world.

text: Ipatuman ining bulig sa China kag India tubtub 2030.
english: This assistance will be implemented in China and India until 2030.

text: “Ti ngaa abe buligan ang China halin sa amot sang US kay mortal nga kaaway naton ini ang China?” ang seguro sa sulod sang huna-huna ni Trump.
english: "So why help China from the US contribution because China is our mortal enemy?" the insurance inside Trump’s mind.

text: Ining Agreement nag-take effect sadtong Nobyembre 4, 2016 sa panahon ni US President Barack Obama, kon diin nag-amot ang US sing US$3 Billion sa Climate Change Fund sini nga gin-target ang bulig nga pondo nga US$100 Billion tubtub sa katapusan sang 2020.
english: This Agreement took effect on November 4, 2016 during the term of US President Barack Obama, when the US contributed US$3 Billion to its Climate Change Fund with a target of US$100 Billion by the end of 2020.

text: Ginpirmahan ining Agreement sang 194 ka pungsod kag na-ratify sang 188 ka pungsod sang amo man nga tuig.
english: This Agreement was signed by 194 countries and ratified by 188 countries in the same year.

text:
***

Indi matuod ma-indian ang pag-away sa climate change.
english:
***

The fight against climate change is inevitable.

text: Sang sini lang gani, gin-igu ang China sang sobra nga pagbinaha nga wala pa maagyan sini sadto pa.
english: Recently, China was hit by an unprecedented flood.

text: Sang sini man gani ang Filpinas gin-igu sang typhoon Ulysses nga nagdala sang wala pareho nga pagbinaha sa Luzon nga matudlo man sa global warming.
english: At the same time, the Philippines was hit by typhoon Ulysses which brought unprecedented flooding to Luzon which can also be attributed to global warming.

text: Ang iban nga nasyon nag-report man sang kasubong nga kalamidad nga pagbaha.
english: Other countries have reported similar disastrous flooding.

text: Tungod sini, pila na ka paghugpong sang mga nasyon, katulad sang Kyoto Protocol kag ining  karon nga Paris Agreement agud ugyunan ang pagpanubo sang greenhouse effect, ukon ang pagka-trap sang init (heat) nga dala sang mga greenhouse gas (oil, natural gas, kag coal) nga ginagamit sang mga industriya.
english: As a result, several countries have joined forces, such as the Kyoto Protocol and the current Paris Agreement, to agree to reduce the greenhouse effect, or the trapping of heat caused by greenhouse gases (oil, natural gas, and coal) used by industries.

text: Ginapanugyan nila ang pag-iban sang paggamit sang mga greenhouse gas agud indi magtaas ang temperature sa two degrees Celsius, ukon tubtub gani sa 1.5 degrees Celsius lang, kag pasanyugon ang paggamit sang  renewable energy sources, katulad sang hydropower, wind, geothermal, biomass kag iban pa.
english: They recommend reducing the use of greenhouse gases to keep temperatures from rising by two degrees Celsius, or even just 1.5 degrees Celsius, and promoting the use of renewable energy sources, such as hydropower, wind, geothermal, biomass and others.

text:
***

Nagpirma ang Filipinas sa Paris Agreement sadtong 2017, although bag-o sini namatok gid si President Duterte nga magpirma diri.
english:
***

The Philippines signed the Paris Agreement in 2017, although before that President Duterte strongly opposed signing it.

text: In fact, gintawag niya ini sadtong Nobyembre 2016, pila ka bulan pagkatapos magpungko siya sa poder, nga “stupid”, “crazy” kag “absurd”.
english: In fact, he called it in November 2016, a few months after he took office, “stupid”, “crazy” and “absurd”.

text: Sang ulihi ugaling nagsugot man si Presidente Duterte nga pirmahan ini.
english: Later, however, President Duterte agreed to sign it.

text: Na-realisar na niya seguro nga ang Filipinas isa sang pinaka-vulnerable sa climate change – nagalala nga bagyo, malawakan nga baha, landslide tungod sa sobra nga ulan, pagsaka sang taob (tide rise) sa mga baybayon, tagtuyot (drought), paglupok sang mga bulkan, kag ang masami nga pagluntad sang linog.
english: He must have realized that the Philippines is one of the most vulnerable to climate change – worsening typhoons, widespread floods, landslides due to excessive rains, tide rise on the coasts, drought, volcanic eruptions, and frequent earthquakes.

text: Tungod sini, na-isip man niya seguro ang daku nga bulig nga mahatag sang Climate Change Fund sa mga pagpanikasug naton karon sa pag-mitigate kag pag-adapt sa makatulublag nga mga hitabo nga dala sang climate change./PN
english: Because of this, he must have thought of the great help that the Climate Change Fund can provide in our current efforts to mitigate and adapt to the disturbing events brought about by climate change./PN

text: Apisar limitado pa ang pagbyahe sa idalom sang community quaratine bangud sa kahangawa nga tuga sang COVID-19, may mga kahigayunan sa gihapon nga kinahanglan magpadulong sa iban nga lugar.
english: Although travel is still limited under community quarantine due to the concerns caused by COVID-19, there are still opportunities to travel to other places.

text: Indi lang pagkalimtan ang bulong kun maglingin ang ulo sang imo anak samtang nagabyahe apisar indi man malayo ang kaladto-an.
english: Don't forget the medicine if your child gets dizzy while traveling even if it's not far away.

text: Suno sa American Academy of Family Physicians , ginatawag nga motion sickness ang paglingin sang ulo sa byahe.
english: According to the American Academy of Family Physicians , travel dizziness is called motion sickness.

text: Tuga ini sang disturbance sa inner ear nga nagaapekto sa sense of balance kag equilibrium sang lawas.
english: It is caused by a disturbance in the inner ear that affects the sense of balance and equilibrium of the body.

text: Mga babaye kag bata nga naga edad duha tubtob 12 anyos ang masami nga nagabatyag sang motion sickness.
english: Women and children between the ages of two and 12 are most likely to experience motion sickness.

text: Masami man ini sa mga tawo nga nagabatyag sang migraine.
english: It is also common in people who experience migraines.

text:
Agud malikawan ang paglingin sang ulo samtang nagabyahe, yari ang panugyan sang mga eksperto;

*likawan magbasa*indi magkaon sang mamantika ukon maaslom nga pagkaon lakip na ang pag-inom sang kape*magkaon lang sang dry crackers agud nga may unod ang tyan*mag-inom sang madamo nga tubig*siguraduhon nga may bastante nga tulog antes magbyahe kag;*kun may head rest ang pulungkuan, isandig ang ulo agud nga mabuhinan ang paghulag.
english:
To avoid dizziness while traveling, here is the advice of experts;

*avoid reading*don't eat oily or spicy food including drinking coffee*only eat dry crackers to keep the stomach full*drink plenty of water*make sure to get enough sleep before traveling and;*if the seat has a head rest, lean the head back to allow movement.

text: Nag-abot na sa Florida ang anom ka team sang federal officials lakip na ang scientists, structural engineers kag geotechnical engineer agud nga i-assess ang condo building nga nagcollapse.
english: Six teams of federal officials including scientists, structural engineers and a geotechnical engineer have arrived in Florida to assess the condo building that collapsed.

text: Ang ini nga mga teams ang nagikan sa National Institude of Standards Technology (NIST) sa diin sila ang magapatigayon sang preliminary investigation sa materyales sang building, history sini, ang duta nga ginatindugan sang building kag iban pa.
english: These teams are from the National Institute of Standards Technology (NIST) where they will conduct a preliminary investigation on the materials of the building, its history, the land on which the building stands and others.

english: Democratic Florida Rep.

text: Debbie Wasserman Schultz nga mahibaluan sang NIST ang kabangdanan sang pagcollapse sang condo building.
english: Debbie Wasserman Schultz that NIST will determine the cause of the condo building collapse.

text: Suportado naman ni US President Joe Biden ang pagpatigayon sang imbestigasyon apang wala sang plano ang presidente nga magpadulong sa lugar.
english: US President Joe Biden supports the investigation but has no plans to visit the area.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa 10 ang patay kag 151 ka mga indibidwal ang nagapabilin nga missing.
english: So far, 10 people have died and 151 individuals remain missing.

english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – The controversial Ungka Flyover was opened to full capacity today, December 23.

english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

english: The controversial Ungka Flyover will be opened to the public today, December 23 — two days earlier than the initial December 25 target of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region VI.

text: Ini nga reopening ang una nga ginkumpirma ni Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office head retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos sa Bombo Radyo Iloilo sang nagligad pa nga Biyernes, kag ginpasundan pa sang kumpirmasyon ni Mayor Jerry Treñas kahapon, Disyembre 23.
english: The reopening was first confirmed by Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office head retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos to Bombo Radyo Iloilo last Friday, followed by confirmation by Mayor Jerry Treñas yesterday, December 23.

text: Pareho nga ginplastar sang duha ka mga opisyal ang komunikasyon nga ila nabaton gikan kay DPWH-Western Visayas regional director Engineer Sanny Boy Oropel.
english: Both officials laid out the communication they received from DPWH-Western Visayas regional director Engineer Sanny Boy Oropel.

text: Sa statement ni Mayor Treñas nga amo man ang chairperson sang Infrastructure Development Committee sang Regional Development Council VI, ginpahayag sini nga naka-request siya anay kay Director Oropel nga mas dasigon ang pagpabukas liwat sa flyover bangud mas pahalugon sini ang dalagan sang trapiko sa area kag mas mabuhinan ang huol sa commuters subong nga holiday season.
english: In a statement, Mayor Treñas, who is also the chairperson of the Infrastructure Development Committee of the Regional Development Council VI, said he had previously requested Director Oropel to speed up the reopening of the flyover because it will speed up the flow of traffic in the area and reduce the congestion during the holiday season.

text: Bisan maagyan na ang flyover suno sa alkalde, magapadayon ang DPWH regional office sa pag-install sang steel railings sa parapet.
english: Even after the flyover is passed, the mayor said, the DPWH regional office will continue to install steel railings on the parapet.

text: Bangud diri, naga-apelar ang alkalde sa mga motorista kag pedestrians nga maghalong kag sundon gid ang tanan nga traffic guidelines para sa safety sang tanan nga yara sa area.
english: The mayor appealed to motorists and pedestrians to be vigilant and follow all traffic guidelines for the safety of all in the area.

text: “While the flyover will be accessible starting tomorrow (Dec 23), the DPWH will continue the installation of steel railings on the parapet.
english: “While the flyover will be accessible starting tomorrow (Dec 23), the DPWH will continue the installation of steel railings on the parapet.

text: I appeal to motorists and pedestrians to remain cautious and follow all traffic guidelines for everyone’s safety.
english: I appeal to motorists and pedestrians to remain cautious and follow all traffic guidelines for everyone’s safety.

text: I thank the DPWH for heeding our request and working tirelessly to make this happen,” suno sa Dec.

text: Sa joint committee hearing sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan sang nagligad nga Disyembre 17, ginpahayag ni DPWH-Western Visayas construction division chief Ormel Santos nga padayunon sang ila opisina ang jet grouting activities tubtub pa sa Enero 2025.#
