text: Daw ano ikaw ka arte pag-abot sa luyag mo nga pagkaon?
english: How artistic are you when it comes to what you want to eat?

text: Sa India, nangin rason ini kun ngaa wala nadayon ang kasal sang magkahagugma.
english: In India, this has been the reason why the wedding of the couple did not take place.

text: Ang groom amo si Ramakant Patra, 27, gwapo kag ang importante, palangga gid niya ang iya nobya!Nagbyahe si Patra upod ang iya pamilya halin sa Keonjhar, India para sa seremonya sang iya kasal sa iya nobya sa Bandhagaon village sa Sukinda.
english: The groom was Ramakant Patra, 27, handsome and most importantly, loved his bride very much!Patra had traveled with his family from Keonjhar, India for his wedding ceremony with his bride at Bandhagaon village in Sukinda.

text: Sang nag-abot sanday Patra, syempre gin-welcome sila sang pamilya sang bride kag nagpasakop pa gani siya sa mga ritwal.
english: When Patra arrived, of course the bride’s family welcomed them and she even participated in the rituals.

text: Sang ulihi sang yara na sa dining hall, ginpangita na sang miyembro sang wedding party ang mutton curry — ang manamit nga dish nga may karne sang kanding kag may vegetables.Bangud wala nakahanda ang pamilya sang bride sang mutton curry para sa wedding feast, ginapahayag nagbinaisay ang duha ka pamilya tubtob nga naling-an si Patra kag ginkanselar na lang ang kasal.
english: Later in the dining hall, the wedding party members looked for mutton curry — a delicious dish with goat meat and vegetables. Because the bride's family did not prepare mutton curry for the wedding feast, the two families reportedly argued until Patra got distracted and the wedding was cancelled.

text: Nagbiya si Patra kag ang iya pamilya kag nagtinir sa ila paryente sa Kuhika village.
english: Patra and her family left and stayed with a relative in Kuhika village.

text: Sang ulihi, nagpakasal si Patra kag ang isa pa ka babayi sa Phulajhara antes ini liwat nagbalik sa ila nga balay sa Keonjhar.
english: Later, Patra and another woman got married in Phulajhara before she again returned to her home in Keonjhar.

text: Indi ini ang una nga tion nga may indi ordinaryo nga istorya sang kasal sa India.
english: This is not the first time there has been an unusual wedding story in India.

text: Sang nagligad lang nga bulan, sa Uttar Pradesh, India, ginkanselar man sang bride ang iya kasal matapos wala nakasabat ang iya groom sang quick math test.
english: Just last month, in Uttar Pradesh, India, a bride also called off her wedding after her groom failed a quick math test.

text: Naga-igod na ang health care system sang Indonesia kasunod sang pagtimbuok sang kaso sang COVID-19.
english: Indonesia's health care system is overwhelmed following the surge in COVID-19 cases.

text: May mga pasyente nga ginpahamtang na lang sa mga parking areas bangud indi na maakomodar sang mga ospital bangud 90% na nga okupado ang mga hospital beds.
english: Some patients were placed in parking areas because hospitals can no longer accommodate them because 90% of hospital beds are occupied.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Ginavella Limpin Cumla direkta sa Jakarta, Indonesia, may mga tents na sa gwa sang ospital nga ginpahamtang kag ini ang ginhimo nga emergency rooms para sa mga pasyente.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Ginavella Limpin Cumla directly in Jakarta, Indonesia, tents have been set up outside the hospital and these have been turned into emergency rooms for patients.

text: Mabatian mismo ang masako nga mga huni sang ambulansya nga nagapakadto-pakari sa ospital.
english: You can hear the busy sounds of ambulances coming and going to the hospital.

text: May yara man sang mga apartment nga ginhimo na subong nga quarantine facility para sa mga COVID-19 asymptomatic patients.
english: There are also apartments that have been turned into quarantine facilities for COVID-19 asymptomatic patients.

text: Ang pagtimbuok sang kaso ang ginapatihan tuga sang bag-o nga virus strain nga Delta variant nga una na-detect sa India.
english: The surge in cases is believed to be caused by a new virus strain, the Delta variant, which was first detected in India.

text: Pahayag ni Cumla, 15% sa mga natapikan sang virus subong ang lunsay mga kabataan nga naga-edad 15 anyos panubo.
english: Cumla said 15% of those infected with the virus are children under the age of 15.

text: Sa Meda, ang capital city sang North Sumatra province, naglab-ot na sa 1,800 ka mga kabataan ang na-infect sang virus lakip na ang 14 ka mga napatay.
english: In Meda, the capital city of North Sumatra province, more than 1,800 children have been infected with the virus, including 14 deaths.

text: Malapit 1,000 nga mga Indonesian health workers naman ang napatay bangud sa virus humalin sang nag-umpisa ang pandemya sa diin 401 sa nasambit nga numero ang lunsay mga doctor kag 14 sa ila ang fully vaccinated.
english: Nearly 1,000 Indonesian health workers have died of the virus since the pandemic began, of which 401 are doctors and 14 are fully vaccinated.

text: Subong nga bulan, masobra 300 nga mga vaccinated doctors kag healthcare workers sa Cental Java ang natukiban nga na-infect man sang COVID-19.
english: This month, more than 300 vaccinated doctors and healthcare workers in Central Java were also found to be infected with COVID-19.

text: Dugang pa ni Cumla, sa 270 million nga populasyon sang Indonesia, 5% pa lang ang nakabaton sang kumpleto nga bakuna batuk sa coronavirus.
english: Cumla added that of Indonesia's 270 million population, only 5% have received a complete vaccine against the coronavirus.

text: Posible nga mas ma delay pa ang pagbukas sang ekonomiya sa Ireland bangud sa panibag-o na naman nga variant sang coronavirus nga amo ang Delta variant.
english: The reopening of the economy in Ireland is likely to be further delayed due to the new variant of the coronavirus, the Delta variant.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Abraham Denosta direkta sa Ireland, sang nagtimbuok ang kaso sang COVID-19 sa nasambit nga pungsod, wala gid sang bisita ang mahimo nga makasulod sa ginatrabahuan niya nga ospital.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Abraham Denosta directly in Ireland, when the number of COVID-19 cases in the country increased, no visitors were allowed to enter the hospital where he works.

text: Apang sang naghagan-hagan na ang virus, ginpahanugutan na ang isa ka bisita sa kada pasyente sang tinalikdan lang nga semana sa diin dapat nga sundon ang minimum health protocols.
english: However, when the virus subsided, one visitor per patient was allowed last week where minimum health protocols must be followed.

text: Pahayag ni Denosta, humalin sadto, wala ginapahanugutan ang dine in services sa mga restaurants.
english: Denosta said that since then, dine in services are not allowed in restaurants.

text: Una man nga nakabaton sang bakuna ang mga healthcare workers sa Ireland sa diin Pfizer ang gintublok sa ila.
english: Healthcare workers in Ireland were also the first to receive the vaccine with Pfizer.

text: Base sa data, 1.5 million ka mga indibidwal na ang nakabaton sang first dose sang bakuna kag yara pa lang sa 500 ang makabig nga fully vaccinated.
english: Based on the data, 1.5 million individuals have already received the first dose of the vaccine and only 500 are considered fully vaccinated.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, ang Pilipinas ang ginakabig nga red country sa diin hugot nga ginasunod ang mandatory 14 day hotel quarantine kag mismo ang traveler pa ang magabayad sa hotel kag iban niya nga kinahanglanon.
english: He added that the Philippines is considered a red country where the mandatory 14 day hotel quarantine is strictly observed and the traveler himself will pay for the hotel and other necessities.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Nagpaathag ang Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) sa temporaryo nga pagpasirado sang Iloilo International Airport subong nga aga, Disyembre 22.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) has explained the temporary closure of the Iloilo International Airport this morning, December 22.

text: Suno kay Art Parreño, CAAP – Iloilo Airport terminal supervisor, nagpagwa sila sang Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) las 7:00 sang aga sa diin nagpahibalo sila nga magakaayo sila sang buho sa runway.
english: According to Art Parreño, CAAP – Iloilo Airport terminal supervisor, they issued a Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) at 7:00 am where they announced that they will repair the hole in the runway.

text: Las 11:00 sa aga, gin-lift na ang NOTAM kag ginbalik na ang byahe.
english: At 11:00 am, the NOTAM was lifted and flights were resumed.

text: “7am NOTAM was issued by CAAP for all to be informed that CAAP ILO will conduct runway repair of a small pothole.
english: “7am NOTAM was issued by CAAP for all to be informed that CAAP ILO will conduct runway repair of a small pothole.

text: 11 am the NOTAM was lifted and all flight to and from ILO Airport have resumed.
english: 11 am the NOTAM was lifted and all flight to and from ILO Airport have resumed.

text: Presently, PAL is conducting their Boarding procedures for Manila,” pahayag ni Parreño.
english: Presently, PAL is conducting their Boarding procedures for Manila,” Parreño said.

text: Isa man sa mga rason sa atrasado nga pagbalik sang byahe matapos ang pag-lift sang NOTAM amo ang pagpatigayon sang inspeksyon agud masigurado nga wala sang anuman nga mga debris sa runway nga mahimo makatuga sang aksidente.
english: One of the reasons for the delayed resumption of flights after the lifting of the NOTAM was to conduct an inspection to ensure that there were no debris on the runway that could cause an accident.

text: “After lifting of NOTAM, protocol is set for a Runway Inspections to see that it is SAFE and SECURE for flight resumption.
english: “After lifting of NOTAM, protocol is set for a Runway Inspections to see that it is SAFE and SECURE for flight resumption.

text: And that there are no FOD (or Foreign Objects and Debris) that may be left on the runway and may be accidentally ingested by the turbo engines of aircraft.
english: And that there are no FOD (or Foreign Objects and Debris) that may be left on the runway and may be accidentally ingested by the turbo engines of aircraft.

text: That’s why, it took some time to clear the flights.”
english: That’s why, it took some time to clear the flights.”

text: Nagsaka na sa apat ka tawo ang ginbawian sang kabuhi kag 159 naman ang wala pa natigayon nga marescue matapos nag-collapse nga 12- storey beachfront condo building sa Miami, Florida, sa Estados Unidos.
english: Four people have died and 159 have not been rescued after a 12-storey beachfront condo building collapsed in Miami, Florida, in the United States.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Gigi Bulnes Wolff, direkta sa Florida,35 ka mga tawo ang una nga narescue sa diin tubtob subong wala untat ang ginapatigayon nga search and rescue operation sang mga otoridad.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Gigi Bulnes Wolff, directly in Florida, 35 people were first rescued where the search and rescue operation of the authorities is still ongoing.

text: Pahayag ni Wolff, bangud sa dalagko nga superficial metals, naggamit na sang heavy machinery ang mga rescuers agud nga makuha ang mga tawo nga natampukan sang debris.
english: Wolff said that due to the large superficial metals, rescuers have already used heavy machinery to retrieve the people trapped in the debris.

text: Suno kay Wolff, ini na ang pinakadelikado nga rescue effort nga naeksperyensyahan sang mga rescuers.
english: Wolff said this is the most dangerous rescue effort the rescuers have ever experienced.

text: Samtang, hugot naman nga ginaduso ni Florida Governor Ron DeSantis ang maid-id nga imbestigasyon sa matuod nga kabangdanan sang pagkarumpag sang building.
english: Meanwhile, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis is strongly pushing for a thorough investigation into the true cause of the building's collapse.

text: Imbitaran sang 15th Sangguniang Panlalawigan ang Department of the Interior and Local Government Region 6 agud nga maklaruhan ang provincial board nahanungod sa memorandum nga nagadumili sa pagbyahe sang mga government owned vehicles kun weekend kag holiday.
english: The 15th Sangguniang Panlalawigan will invite the Department of the Interior and Local Government Region 6 to clarify the provincial board regarding the memorandum that prohibits the travel of government owned vehicles on weekends and holidays.

text: Ang DILG Memorandum Circular No.
english: The DILG Memorandum Circular No.

text: 2026-011, amo ang nagalakip sa tanan nga opisyal kag ahensya sa idalom sang DILG nga nagapaandam sa kun sin-o man ang magabayolar ang magapangatubang sang Administrative ukon Criminal liabilities santo sa existing laws, rules, kag regulations.
english: 2026-011, which includes all officials and agencies under the DILG warning that anyone who violates will face administrative or criminal liabilities according to existing laws, rules, and regulations.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Vice Governor Nathalie Ann Debuque, iya ginpahayag nga sa question hour sa 31st regular session sang Sangguninang Panlalawigan, nagpahayag ang pila ka mga board members ngaluyag nila nga maklaruhan nahanungod sa nasambit nga memorandum.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Vice Governor Nathalie Ann Debuque said that during the question hour at the 31st regular session of the Sangguninang Panlalawigan, some board members expressed their desire to clarify the memorandum.

text: Suno kay Debuque, indi gid malikawan nga kun kaisa may ara sang mga adlaw kun sa diin ginaimbitaran sila ukon may responsibilidad sila bilang isa ka public official bisan pa nga weekend ukon holiday.
english: According to Debuque, it is inevitable that sometimes there are days when they are invited or they have responsibilities as a public official whether weekend or holiday.

text: Pahayag man sang bise gobernador, mas maayo nga mapalab-ot sang DILG ang mas klaro nga pagsulundan para sa ila agud nga mas mahibal-an sang mga opisyal ang limitasyon sang nasambit nga memorandum.
english: The vice governor also said it is better for the DILG to convey clearer guidelines for them so that officials can better understand the limitations of the said memorandum.

text: Ginpaguwa sang International Criminal Court (ICC) ang “Document Containing the Charges” batok kay former President Rodrigo Duterte kaangot sa kaso sini nga ginapangatubang nga crimes against humanity.
english: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has issued the “Document Containing the Charges” against former President Rodrigo Duterte in connection with the case he is facing crimes against humanity.

text: 16 ka pahina ang report nga ginsapubliko subong nga adlaw, kag nalakip sa gindetalye amo ang sistematiko nga “common plan” agud nga pangpatyon ang ginaalegar nga mga drug suspect halin sang 2011 tubtub sang 2019.
english: The 16-page report, which was made public today, details a systematic “common plan” to kill alleged drug suspects from 2011 to 2019.

text: Sandig sa prosecution, may yara sang duha ka main hit groups nga amo ang Davao Death Squad (DDS) kag “National Network” nga amo ang ginapahayag nga nagpasangkad pa sang Davao model sa bilog nga Pilipinas sang 2016.
english: According to the prosecution, there are two main hit groups, the Davao Death Squad (DDS) and the National Network, which allegedly expanded the Davao model throughout the Philippines in 2016.

text:
Tatlo ka counts sang murder ang gin-file batok kay Duterte nga amo ang masunod:

1) Davao City (2013-2016): 19 ka mga biktima

2) High-Value Targets (2016-2017): 14 ka mga biktima

3) Barangay Ops (2016-2018): 43 murders & 2 attempted murders lakip ang tatlo ka mga kabataan.
english:
Three counts of murder were filed against Duterte as follows:

1) Davao City (2013-2016): 19 victims

2) High-Value Targets (2016-2017): 14 victims

3) Barangay Ops (2016-2018): 43 murders & 2 attempted murders including three children.

text: Ginaakusaran si Duterte nga amo ang nagdesinyo sang polisa, nagmandu sa mga hitman, kag nagpromisa nga makaluwas ang mga killer.
english: Duterte is accused of designing the policy, ordering the hitmen, and promising that the killers would get away with it.

text: Ginlaragway ini sang ICC nga “widespread and systematic attack” batok sa mga sibilyan.
english: The ICC described it as a “widespread and systematic attack” against civilians.

text: Ginhingadlan naman nga co-perpetrators ni Duterte ang duha ka incumbent senators nga sanday Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa kag Christopher Lawrence “Bong” Go.
english: Duterte named two incumbent senators, Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa and Christopher Lawrence “Bong” Go, as co-perpetrators.

text: Luwas sa ila, yara ang pangalan nanday Vicente Danao, Camilo Cascolan, Oscar Albayalde, Dante Gierran, Isidto Lapeña, Vitaliano Aguirre II, kag iban pa nga myembro sang PNP kag high-ranking officials.#
english: Besides them, there are the names of Vicente Danao, Camilo Cascolan, Oscar Albayalde, Dante Gierran, Isidto Lapeña, Vitaliano Aguirre II, and other PNP members and high-ranking officials.

text: Kun halimbawa, isa ka adlaw, may nakit-an ka nga gulpi lang nagdaku ang kuwarta sa imo nga bank account, gastuhon mo bala gihapon ini bisan indi imo?
english: For example, if one day, you saw a sudden increase in money in your bank account, would you still spend it even if it wasn't yours?

text: Amo ini ang kaso sang South African student nga si Sibongile Mani sang 2017.
english: This was the case of South African student Sibongile Mani in 2017.

text: Naga-eskwela pa lamang ini sa kolehiyo kag ginahatagan sang monthly food allowance nga P4,400 bangud nga benepisyaryo siya sang National Student Financial Aid Scheme.
english: He is still studying in college and is given a monthly food allowance of P4,400 because he is a beneficiary of the National Student Financial Aid Scheme.

text: Ginapadala sa ila ang allowance paagi sa Intellimali ukon isa ka kumpaniya nga ang specialization amo ang payment kag administration of funds.
english: The allowance is sent to them through Intellimali or a company whose specialization is payment and administration of funds.

text: Isa ka adlaw, may error nga natabo kag nagsulod sa account ni Mani ang P44 million.
english: One day, an error occurred and P44 million entered Mani's account.

text: Wala na ini sang gin-uyang nga tyempo kag gingasto na ang P2.5-million sa sulod lamang sang duha ka bulan.
english: He wasted no time and spent P2.5-million in just two months.

text: Lakip sa iya ginbakal amo ang handbags, jackets, habol, bath sheets, alcoholic drinks, kag mga sigarilyo.
english: Among his purchases were handbags, jackets, blankets, bath sheets, alcoholic drinks, and cigarettes.

text: Apang nabisto siya kag tinuig ang nakaligad, gindagdagan ini sang sentensya sang East London Regional Court sa South Africa.
english: But he was identified and years later, the sentence was increased by the East London Regional Court in South Africa.

text: Lima ka tuig ini nga pagka-preso bangud sa kaso nga theft.
english: He is serving a five-year prison sentence for theft.

text: Gin-apelar sini ang kaso kag ginhatagan na lamang sang “wholly suspended five-year sentence” apang lakip sa kondisyon amo nga indi ini dapat makasuhan sang theft kag fraud.
english: He appealed the case and was given a “wholly suspended five-year sentence” but among the conditions is that he should not be charged with theft and fraud.

text: Indi man ini pwede makaguwa sa iya hometown kun wala sang approval sang correctional services kag kinahanglan man sini magpaidalom sa three-year correctional supervision kag 576 hours community service nga wala sang compensation.
english: He is also not allowed to leave his hometown without the approval of correctional services and must also undergo three-year correctional supervision and 576 hours of community service without compensation.

text: Magluwas diri, ginmanduan man ini nga magpaidalom sa counseling.
english: He was also ordered to undergo counseling.

text: Nagpadalagan man ini anay bilang treasurer-general sang isa ka unibersidad sa South Africa apang nagdesisyon nga indi siya pagpapungkuon sa pwesto bangud sa iya nga kaso.#
english: He also ran for treasurer-general of a South African university but decided not to be removed from office because of his case.

text: NAGSUGOD ang binaisay (debate) sa Senado sa P4.5 Trillion executive budget ni Presidente Duterte para sa 2021 sadtong Miyerkoles, Nobyembre 11, 2020.
english: The debate in the Senate on President Duterte's P4.5 Trillion executive budget for 2021 began on Wednesday, November 11, 2020.

text: Una gintalakay ang proposed budget sang Dept.
english: First, the proposed budget of the Dept.

text: of Budget and Management (DBM) kag sang Department of Finance.
english: of Budget and Management (DBM) and the Department of Finance.

text: Naka-schedule man sa sina nga adlaw ang budget sang National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA), nga ginsundan na sang mga budget sang iban nga mga ahensya sa sumunod nga mga inadlaw.
english: The budget of the National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) is also scheduled for that day, followed by the budgets of other agencies in the following days.

text: Lakip na diri ang kontrobersyal nga budget sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: This includes the controversial budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: Ang pondo naman para sa COVID-19 response kag recovery interventions sang gobyerno nadala sa mga budget sang nagakalain-lain nga ahensya kon diin applicable ini.
english: The funds for the government's COVID-19 response and recovery interventions are included in the budgets of various agencies where applicable.

text: Ginsiling ni Senate President Tito Sotto nga mapirmahan na ni Presidente Duterte ang budget nga na-approve sang bicameral conference bag-o ang Paskwa, ukon Disyembre 25.
english: Senate President Tito Sotto said President Duterte will sign the budget approved by the bicameral conference before Christmas, or December 25.

text: Samtang, ginabantayan na lang naton, kag iban pa nga media outlet, kon ano gid ang i-report nga tindug sang Senado kag bicameral conference angot sa reklamo ni Senador Panfilo Lacon kag iban nga senador angot sa pagbag-o, ukon pag-amend, sang National Expenditure Program (NEP) pabor sa DPWH.
english: Meanwhile, we are waiting, and other media outlets, to see what the Senate and bicameral conference will report on the complaint of Senator Panfilo Lacon and other senators regarding the change, or amendment, of the National Expenditure Program (NEP) in favor of the DPWH.

text: Sa sini nga DPWH budget revision, nga gin-aprubahan sang Kamara sa bersyon sini sang P4.5 Trillion executive budget, ginduso sang DPWH ang pagpanubo sang allocation para sa national projects kag gindugang ini sa mga lokal nga mga proyekto.
english: In this DPWH budget revision, which was approved by the House in its version of the P4.5 Trillion executive budget, the DPWH proposed to reduce the allocation for national projects and increase it for local projects.

text: Suspetso ni Lacson nga nag-entra ang mga kongresista agud maduso ang ila kaugalingon nga mga proyekto.
english: Lacson suspects that the congressmen participated to push their own projects.

text: Para kay Lacson, ining pahito katulad ini sa paghatag sang “pork barrel” sang nagliligad nga panahon nga ginhalinan sang madamo nga corruption katulad sang kickbacks sang mga lawmakers halin sa luyag nila nga mga proyekto, substandard nga mga proyekto tungod  sa sining kickbacks, kag bisan gani sang mga ghost projects, ukon mga proyekto nga sa papel lang kag wala sing lawas.
english: According to Lacson, this scheme is like giving a “pork barrel” in the past that caused a lot of corruption such as kickbacks of lawmakers from projects they want, substandard projects because of these kickbacks, and even ghost projects, or projects that are on paper and have no body.

text: Meantime, tingnan na lang natin sa kurba kon ma-aprubahan na ang 2021 budget sang bicameral conference kag kon ano ang aksyon ni Presidente.
english: Meantime, let's just look at the curve when the 2021 budget of the bicameral conference is approved and what the President's action will be.

text:
***

Ang mga isyu sa corruption sa DPWH nakapadumdum sa aton sang Operation Performance Audit sang Iloilo City Hall Press Corps sa pagtukod mismo sini sadtong 1993 sa pagpamuno sining kolumnista, nga nangin una sini nga presidente.
english:
***

The issues of corruption in the DPWH remind us of the Operation Performance Audit of the Iloilo City Hall Press Corps in its very establishment in 1993 under the leadership of this columnist, who became its first president.

text: Maathag sa ngalan mismo sining ICHPC project amo ang good government, nga daku nga panghangkat sa kadalag-an sang Edsa Revolution kag sang pagpungko na bilang presidente ni Cory Aquino (1986-1992) kag sang mga sumunod sa iya sa idalom sang  hayahay sang Demokrasya.
english: The very name of this ICHPC project is good government, which is a major challenge to the success of the Edsa Revolution and the presidency of Cory Aquino (1986-1992) and his successors under the umbrella of democracy.

text: Ang maayo sadtong amon grupo kay gahugpong (united) kami.
english: The good thing about our group was that we were united.

text: Ginapulihan namon ang mga isyu, samtang ginatagaan man namon sing importansya ang maayo nga binuhatan sang mga opisyales sa gobyerno, labi na gid ang may mga dalagku nga katungdanan sa mga pumuluyo.
english: We replace issues, while we also give importance to the good deeds of government officials, especially those with great responsibilities to the people.

text: Ginabantayan namon kon ano oras nagaabot kag nagapauli si meyor kag mga konsehales kag kon ano na ang ila nahimo nga  accomplishment.
english: We watch what time the mayor and councilors come and go and what they have accomplished.

text: Tapos sina, ginatugdaan namon ini sa amon mga programa kag sinulatan.
english: After that, we incorporate it into our programs and writings.

text: Nangin mbungahon ini, kag nangin mas maamligon gid ang mga opisyales sa siyudad.
english: This was fruitful, and city officials became much more protective.

text: Ugaling ang amon dispabor nga mga balita kag panugdaon nag-create man sa amon sing madamo nga kaaway.
english: But our unfavorable news and suggestions also created us many enemies.

text: Ang isa namon ka radio anchor ginsaka gid sang isa ka myembro sang konseho agud tapnaon sa iya komentaryo.
english: One of our radio anchors was actually brought up by a council member to stop him for his commentary.

text: Ang iban ginpangaluyagan apang wala nagpaintu.
english: Others were attracted but did not give up.

text: Sa akon bahin, pati ang asawa ko gin-harass.
english: For my part, my wife was also harassed.

text: Ginpatawag sang isa ka konsehal kag ginpamabaan parti sa akon trabaho kag gindala pa sa komentaryo sa radyo kag TV.
english: A councilor summoned me and asked me about my work and even brought me to radio and TV commentary.

text: Sa isa gani nga pagduaw sa Cebu sang mga konsehal sang Iloilo ginpagustuhan kami atake dira sa ila conferencia.
english: Even during a visit to Cebu by the councilors of Iloilo, we were attacked at their conference.

text: Maayo lang kay ang amon mga sister radio sa Cebu nagpangapin sa amon sa kahanginan.
english: Fortunately, our sister radio stations in Cebu defended us on the air.

text: Pero okey lang ini tanan kay kabahin ina sang amon trabaho sa pagpangapin kag pagtib-ong sang kawsa para sa maayo nga pang-gobyerno.
english: But it's all okay because it's part of our job to defend and promote the cause of good governance.

text: In fact, daw wala ako kadudlaan sa akon trabaho sa media tubtub sa sining ulihi.
english: In fact, I didn't seem to have any problems with my media work until recently.

text: Nakaangkon ako sang malapit sa 30 ka libel cases.
english: I have had close to 30 libel cases.

text: Tingala lang ako kay indi man ako mapintas sang lengwahe.
english: I'm surprised because I'm not harsh with language.

text: Seguro tungod credible ako kag nagasugid sing kamatuoran.
english: Maybe because I am credible and tell the truth.

text: “Truth hurts,” siling gani sang madamo.
english: “Truth hurts,” siling gani sang madamo.

text: Sa kaupdanan ko sa lokal nga media, good luck man sa inyo adlaw-adlaw pagduso sang maayo nga pangserbisyo sang aton mga opisyales sa gobyerno./PN
english: To my colleagues in the local media, good luck in your daily efforts to promote the good service of our government officials./PN

text: Wala pa nakahibalo ang National Basketball Association (NBA) superstar nga si LeBron James kun makabalik pa ini sa liga para sa iya ika-23 nga season.
english: National Basketball Association (NBA) superstar LeBron James does not know if he will return to the league for his 23rd season.

text: Kahapon sang nadagdag na ang Lakers sa first round sang playoffs matapos nalutos sa kamot sang Minnesota Timberwolves sa Game 5, 103-96.
english: The Lakers advanced to the first round of the playoffs yesterday after losing to the Minnesota Timberwolves in Game 5, 103-96.

text: Pahayag sang basketball legend, pungkuan pa niya ang desisyon kaupod sa iya nga pamilya, kag padalman man sini kun ano kadugay pa ini magahampang.
english: The basketball legend said he will sit down with the decision with his family, and it will also determine how long he will play.

text: “I don’t know,” sabat sini.
english: “I don’t know,” it replied.

text: “I don’t have the answer to that.
english: “I don’t have the answer to that.

text:
(It’s) something I sit down with my family, my wife and my support group and kind of just talk through it and see what happens and just have a conversation with myself on how long I want to continue to play.”

40-anyos na si James kag may average nga 24.4 points, 7.8 rebounds kag 8.2 assists per game subong nga season.
english:
(It’s) something I sit down with my family, my wife and my support group and kind of just talk through it and see what happens and just have a conversation with myself on how long I want to continue to play.”

James is 40-years-old and is averaging 24.4 points, 7.8 rebounds and 8.2 assists per game this season.

text: Siya man ang all-time leader scorer sa liga kag una nga player sa maragtas sang NBA nga nakalapaw sa 50,000 career points.
english: He is also the all-time leading scorer in the league and the first player in NBA history to surpass 50,000 career points.

text: Naupdan man sini ang NBA icon nga si Michael Jordan sa record nga naka-skor sang 40 points sa edad nga 40-anyos.
english: He also joined NBA icon Michael Jordan in scoring 40 points at the age of 40.

text: Bisan sa bag-o nga mga record, ang pinaka-importante para kay James subong nga season amo nga naka-upod sini ang iya anak nga si Bronny sa court.
english: Even with the new records, the most important thing for James this season is that he was able to join his son Bronny on the court.

text: Sila ang una nga father-son duo nga nakahampang sa regular season NBA game.
english: They were the first father-son duo to play in a regular season NBA game.

text: May ginpatigayon nga price adjustments ang Department of Energy (DOE) – Oil Industry Management Bureau nga magasugod bwas, Martes, Mayo 27, alas 6 sang aga.
english: The Department of Energy (DOE) – Oil Industry Management Bureau has conducted price adjustments starting tomorrow, Tuesday, May 27, at 6 am.

text: Suno sa DOE, ang presyo sang gasolina magataas sang P0.10 kada litro, samtang maganubo naman ang presyo sang diesel sang P0.20 kada litro kag kerosene sang P0.40 kada litro.
english: According to the DOE, the price of gasoline will increase by P0.10 per liter, while the price of diesel will decrease by P0.20 per liter and kerosene by P0.40 per liter.

text: Pasikreto lang nga nagpatigayon sang test sa nuclear weapons ang China kag ang Russia.
english: China and Russia have secretly conducted nuclear weapons tests.

text: Ini ang bag-o nga alegasyon ni United States President Donald Trump.
english: This is the new allegation of United States President Donald Trump.

text: Dugang sini, indi man magpaulihi ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: In addition, the United States of America will not be left behind.

text: “Russia’s testing, and China’s testing, but they don’t talk about it,” pahayag sini sa isa ka interview.
english: “Russia’s testing, and China’s testing, but they don’t talk about it,” he said in an interview.

text: “I don’t want to be the only country that doesn’t test.
english: “I don’t want to be the only country that doesn’t test.

text: Magluwas sa Beijing kag Moscow, naga-test man suno kay Trump ang North Korea kag ang Pakistan sa ila nga arsenals.
english: Besides Beijing and Moscow, Trump said North Korea and Pakistan are also testing their arsenals.

text: Matandaan nga nag-anunsyo ang Russia nga nag-test ini sang bag-o nga nuclear-powered cruise missile nga Burevestnik kag sang nuclear-powered kag nuclear-capable nga underwater drone.
english: Russia announced that it has tested a new nuclear-powered cruise missile Burevestnik and a nuclear-powered and nuclear-capable underwater drone.

text: Ginpaklaro naman kay Trump kun nagaplano bala ang US nga mag-detonate sang nuclear weapon sa labing-una nga tion sa masobra tatlo ka dekada.
english: Trump was asked whether the US plans to detonate a nuclear weapon for the first time in more than three decades.

text:
Sabat sini: “I’m saying that we’re going to test nuclear weapons like other countries do, yes.”

Nahibaluan nga wala sang iban nga mga nasyon magluwas sa North Korea ang kilala nga naga-conduct sang nuclear detonation sa sulod na sang malawig nga dinekada.
english:
Its response: “I’m saying that we’re going to test nuclear weapons like other countries do, yes.”

It is known that no other country besides North Korea is known to have conducted nuclear detonation for decades.

text: Mangin ang Russia kag China ang wala man nagahimo sini nga tests halin sang 1990 kag 1996.
english: Even Russia and China have not been doing these tests since 1990 and 1996 respectively.

text: Apang diskumpyado diri si Trump.
english: But Trump is disappointed here.

text: Pahayag sini, “They don’t go and tell you about it.
english: It states, “They don’t go and tell you about it.

text: As powerful as they are, this is a big world.
english: As powerful as they are, this is a big world.

text: You don’t necessarily know where they’re testing… They test way underground where people don’t know exactly what’s happening with the test.
english: You don’t necessarily know where they’re testing… They test way underground where people don’t know exactly what’s happening with the test.

text:
You feel a little bit of a vibration.”

Nahibaluan nga signatory ang US halin pa sang 1996 sa Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty.
english:
You feel a little bit of a vibration.”

The US has been a signatory since 1996 to the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty.

text: Sa idalom sini, gina-ban ang atomic test explosions —pareho sa military kag sa civilian purposes.
english: Under it, atomic test explosions are banned —both for military and civilian purposes.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Ipa-summon ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ang Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) bangud sa temporaryo nga pagpasirado sang Iloilo International Airport subong nga aga, Disyembre 22.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas will summon the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) for the temporary closure of Iloilo International Airport this morning, December 22.

text: Suno sa alkalde, nagtuga ini sang dako nga huol sa mga pasahero nga nagabyahe sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang pungsod via Iloilo City.
english: According to the mayor, this has caused great inconvenience to passengers traveling to different parts of the country via Iloilo City.

text: “I will summon the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) authorities in charge of the Iloilo International Airport to explain why it was closed the entire morning.
english: “I will summon the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) authorities in charge of the Iloilo International Airport to explain why it was closed the entire morning.

text: This situation caused significant dismay and inconvenience to passengers traveling to and from various destinations across the country,” pahayag ni Treñas.
english: This situation caused significant dismay and inconvenience to passengers traveling to and from various destinations across the country,” Treñas said.

text: Ginpahayag ni Treñas nga ang airport ang ang isa ka critical gateway sa diin may dako ini nga epekto sa reputasyon kag local nga ekonomiya sa tion nga may nagakatabo nga palya.
english: Treñas said the airport is a critical gateway where it has a huge impact on the reputation and local economy in the event of a failure.

text: Ginpasigurado man sini nga may manabat sa natabo.
english: He also assured that someone will be held accountable for what happened.

text: Nagalaom man ang alkalde ini nga indi na masulit pa.
english: The mayor also hopes that this will not happen again.

text: “Ilonggos deserve better.
english: “Ilonggos deserve better.

text: The airport is a critical gateway that impacts not only our connectivity but also our local economy and reputation.
english: The airport is a critical gateway that impacts not only our connectivity but also our local economy and reputation.

text: Any disruption of this magnitude must be addressed promptly and transparently.
english: Any disruption of this magnitude must be addressed promptly and transparently.

text: I will ensure that accountability is upheld and that measures are implemented to prevent such incidents from happening again,” dugang pa sang alkalde.
english: I will ensure that accountability is upheld and that measures are implemented to prevent such incidents from happening again,” the mayor added.

text: Mas ginpahugtan pa sang Vietnam ang mga pagsulundan sa pagpakig-away batok sa COVID-19.
english: Vietnam has further tightened the rules in the fight against COVID-19.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Arly Dela Peña, direkta sa Vietnam kag tumandok sang Lanas, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo, nagmando ang mga otoridad sang Ho Chi Minh City sang 10 ka mga pagsulundan.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Arly Dela Peña, directly in Vietnam and a native of Lanas, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo, the authorities of Ho Chi Minh City have ordered 10 rules.

text: Ini ang ginlakipan sang pagsuspende sang byahe sang passenger taxis, ride-hailing taxis kag pampubliko nga bus.
english: This included the suspension of passenger taxis, ride-hailing taxis and public buses.

text: Ginban man ang pagtililipon sang masobra tatlo ka tawo sa gwa sang ulubrahan kag mga ospital sa diin ginapahanugutan lamang nga magwa ang mga tawo sa ila mga balay kun kinahanglan kag kun ‘essential’ ang katuyuan.
english: Gatherings of more than three people outside workplaces and hospitals are also banned where people are only allowed to leave their homes if necessary and for essential purposes.

text: Ginpasirado man ang pampubliko nga mga beach, amo man ang dine-in eateries humalin kagapon, Hunyo 20.
english: Public beaches were also closed, as were dine-in eateries since yesterday, June 20.

text: Apang ginapahanugutan sa gihapon ang pick-up kag delivery services.
english: However, pick-up and delivery services are still allowed.

text: Matandaan nga sang pinakauna nga semana sang Hunyo, ginsuspende ang tanan nga inbound flights sang international airport sang Vietnam halin sa abroad bangud sa COVID-19 outbreak.
english: It can be recalled that in the first week of June, all inbound flights of Vietnam's international airport from abroad were suspended due to the COVID-19 outbreak.

text: As of June 20, 2021, ginkumpirma sang Ministry of Health sang Vietnam nga may yara na sang 12,978 ka COVID-19 cases ang nasambit nga pungsod.
english: As of June 20, 2021, the Ministry of Health of Vietnam confirmed that the country has 12,978 COVID-19 cases.

text: Nagdangat sa P130-million ang gindugang ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. added P130-million.

text: para sa relief operations kasunod sang paglupok sang Bulkan Kanlaon sa Negros Island sang Disyembre 9.
english: for relief operations following the eruption of Volcano Kanlaon in Negros Island on December 9.

text: Suno kay Office of Civil Defense (OCD)-VI Director Raul Fernandez nga amo man ang chairperson sang Task Force Kanlaon, kabahin diri ang P70 million sa Quick Response Fund sang OCD.
english: Office of Civil Defense (OCD)-VI Director Raul Fernandez, who is also the chairperson of Task Force Kanlaon, said the P70 million is part of the OCD's Quick Response Fund.

text: May yara man sang P30 million para sa Canlaon City kag lain pa gid nga P30 million para sa Negros Oriental provincial government.
english: There is also P30 million for Canlaon City and another P30 million for the Negros Oriental provincial government.

text: Ini kasunod sang panawagan sang local governments sa dugang nga bulig bangud nga nagakaubos na ang ila nga disaster funds.
english: This follows the call of local governments for additional assistance as their disaster funds are running out.

text: Una na nga gin-anunsyo nga posible magapaligad gid sang Paskuwa kag Bag-ong Tuig ang apektado nga mga residente sa evacuation centers sa Negros Occidental kag Negros Oriental.
english: Earlier, it was announced that the affected residents may spend Christmas and New Year in evacuation centers in Negros Occidental and Negros Oriental.

text: Nag-request man ang Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) sang 21 ka adlaw nga monitoring sa bulkan nga nag-umpisa sang Disyembre 10, kag ang resulta sini nga monitoring amo ang maga-desisyon kun panubuon, ipabilin, ukon ipasaka pa ang alert status nga subong yara sa Level 3.
english: The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS) also requested a 21-day monitoring of the volcano that began on December 10, and the results of this monitoring will decide whether to lower, maintain, or raise the alert status that is currently at Level 3.

text: As of Dec.
english: As of Dec.

text: 20, masobra sa 10,890 ka mga pamilya ang yara sa 32 ka evacuation centers sa Region 6 (Western Visayas) kag Region 7 (Central Visayas).
english: 20, more than 10,890 families are in 32 evacuation centers in Region 6 (Western Visayas) and Region 7 (Central Visayas).

text: Magapanumpa na sa Lunes, Disyembre 23 si former Iloilo City Public Order and Safety Management Office (PSTMO) head Mr. Jeck Conlu bilang Assistant Regional Director sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) VI.
english: Former Iloilo City Public Order and Safety Management Office (PSTMO) head Mr. Jeck Conlu as Assistant Regional Director of Land Transportation Office (LTO) VI.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Conlu, iya ginkumpirma nga nabaton na niya ang imbitasyon agud nga mag-take oath bilang bag-o nga Assistant Regional Director sang LTO VI.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Conlu confirmed that he has received the invitation to take the oath as the new Assistant Regional Director of LTO VI.

text: Suno kay Conlu, magasumpa siya Central Office sa Kaupo sanday Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Jaime Bautista kag LTO Chief Assistant Secretary Atty. Vigor D. Mendoza II.
english: Conlu said he will be sworn in Central Office in Kaupo along with Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin, Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Jaime Bautista and LTO Chief Assistant Secretary Atty. Vigor D. Mendoza II.

text: Nakadependi naman kay LTO 6 Director Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan ko ano ang iya mangin katungdanan sa talatapan.
english: It depends on LTO 6 Director Atty. I asked Gaudioso what his duties would be in the office.

text: Nahibaluan nga Oktubre 1, 2024 sang nagsugod si Conlu trabaho sa amo nga talatapan kon sa diin, gin-obliga sini ang pag-release sang mga plate numbers.
english: It was learned that Conlu started working in the office on October 1, 2024 where, he obliged the release of plate numbers.

text: Halos 10 ka tuig naman nga nangin kabahin si Conlu sang Iloilo City Public Order and Safety Management Office.
english: Conlu has been part of the Iloilo City Public Order and Safety Management Office for almost 10 years.

text: Ginkilala nga “Nurse of the Year” sa Oxfordshire, United Kingdom ang Ilonggo nurse nga si Jose Ariel Lañada bangud sa iya outstanding work sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: Ilonggo nurse Jose Ariel Lañada was recognized as the “Nurse of the Year” in Oxfordshire, United Kingdom for his outstanding work in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Si Lañada ang tumandok sang Dueñas, Iloilo kag anak sang mangunguma.
english: Lañada is a native of Dueñas, Iloilo and the son of a farmer.

text: Bangud sa kapigaduhon, nagtinguha si Lañada nga maka-eskwela sa diin naggradwar ini nga Valedictorian sa Highschool kag nangin scholar sa Central Philippine University (CPU).
english: Due to poverty, Lañada tried to get an education where he graduated as Valedictorian in High School and became a scholar at the Central Philippine University (CPU).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Lañada, iya ginpahayag nga bugal niya nga mabaton ang award kag pribelilihiyo para sa iya nga masuportahan kag mabuligan ang mga health workers kag ang Filipino community sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Lañada said he is proud to receive the award and it is a privilege for him to support and help health workers and the Filipino community in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Si Lañada ang nagdaog sa National Black Asian and Minority Ethnic (BAME) Health & Care Awards.
english: Lañada won the National Black Asian and Minority Ethnic (BAME) Health & Care Awards.

text: Siya subong ang Divisional Education Lead for the Neurosciences, Orthopaedics, Trauma, Specialist Surgery, Children’s and Neonates Division of Natio nal Health Service (NHS) Foundation Trust.
english: He is currently the Divisional Education Lead for the Neurosciences, Orthopedics, Trauma, Specialist Surgery, Children’s and Neonates Division of Natio nal Health Service (NHS) Foundation Trust.

text: Magluwas sa iya nga papel sa Practice Development and Education, si Lañada ang nagaserbe man nga Presidente sang Filipino Nurses Association UK, chairman sang Filipino Community of Oxfordshire (FilCom Oxford), kag Associate Lecturer sa Oxford Brookes University.
english: In addition to her role in Practice Development and Education, Lañada also serves as President of the Filipino Nurses Association UK, chairman of the Filipino Community of Oxfordshire (FilCom Oxford), and Associate Lecturer at Oxford Brookes University.

text: Pahayag ni Lañada, nangin pagpanghangkat para sa tanan ang subong nga tuig kag bangud sa teamwork nga ginhimo nila sa bahin sang mga ospital kag sa komunidad, nagbunga ini sang maayo kag nangin madinalag-on.
english: Lañada said this year has been a challenge for everyone and thanks to the teamwork they have done on the part of the hospitals and the community, it has borne good fruit and been successful.

text: Dugang pa sang natungan, tatlo ka mga panakot ang ginagamit niya sa iya kabuhi rason nga nalab-ot niya kun ano man ang may yara siya subong — kag ini amo ang Willingness, Tenacity kag Resilience.
english: He added that he uses three spices in his life that have helped him achieve what he has now — and these are Willingness, Tenacity and Resilience.

text: Ginakabig sang United Kingdom nga isa ka daku nga kadalag-an ang pagbakuna sa masobra 40 ka milyon nga mga tawo sa una nga anum ka bulan sang COVID-19 vaccination program.
english: The United Kingdom considers vaccinating more than 40 million people in the first six months of the COVID-19 vaccination program a major achievement.

text: Santo sa isa ka pagtuon sang Public Health England, ang duha ka doses sang COVID-19 vaccines ang highly effective ukon tuman ka epektibo batok sa B.1.617.2 ukon Delta variant nga una nga natukiban sa India.
english: According to a study by Public Health England, both doses of COVID-19 vaccines are highly effective against the B.1.617.2 or Delta variant first detected in India.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Ramil Isogon direkta sa United Kingdom, nalab-ot na sang gobyerno sang amo nga pungsod ang target sini nga makatanyag sang bakuna sa ‘most vulnerable’ sa Abril 15.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Ramil Isogon directly in the United Kingdom, the government of that country has achieved its target of offering the vaccine to the 'most vulnerable' by April 15.

text: Sa subong, gina-engganyo sang health ministry ang mga mas lamharon nga mga residente nga batunon man ang COVID-19 shot.
english: In the meantime, the health ministry is encouraging younger residents to get the COVID-19 shot as well.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang pagbukas sang inoculation program sa mga nagaedad 25 anyos tubtob 29 anyos subong nga semana.
english: This follows the opening of the inoculation program for those aged 25 to 29 this week.

text: May gamay nga kahangawa ang health ministry nga balibaran sang mga bataon nga mga residente ang bakuna bangud posible panumdumon sang mga ini nga indi man sila mapatay sa COVID-19.
english: The health ministry is concerned that young residents will refuse the vaccine because they may think they will not die from COVID-19.

text: Apang paathag ni Britain’s Health Minister Matt Hancock, ang pagbakuna amo lang ang pinakamaayo kag pinaka-kritikal nga paagi agud nga matapna ang pandemya kag matapos na ang na-link diri nga deaths, infections, kag hospitalisations.
english: But Britain's Health Minister Matt Hancock explained that vaccination is the only best and most critical way to stop the pandemic and end the linked deaths, infections, and hospitalizations.

text: TAIPEI, TAIWAN – Ginlockdown ang isa ka electronics company matapos naglatnanay sa COVID-19 ang 77 ka empleyado sa Taipei, Taiwan.
english: TAIPEI, TAIWAN – An electronics company was locked down after 77 employees in Taipei, Taiwan tested positive for COVID-19.

text: Ang nasambit nga Taiwanese semiconductor supplier ang ginakabig nga leading chip testing service provider sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: The Taiwanese semiconductor supplier is considered the leading chip testing service provider in the world.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Dr. Reynand Dumala-on direkta sa Taiwan, sa 77 ka empleyado nga nagpositibo sa COVID-19 sa nasambit nga kompaniya, 73 diri ang lunsay Filipino.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Dr. Reynand Dumala-on directly in Taiwan, of the 77 employees who tested positive for COVID-19 in the said company, 73 of them are Filipinos.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang pagpaidalom sa swab test sa 7,300 tanan ka mga empleyado sang amo nga kompaniya.
english: This follows the swab test of all 7,300 employees of the company.

text: Ginpahayag ni Dumala-on nga ginpauntat na ang produksyon sang amo nga kompaniya agud nga i-disinfect ang bug-os nga working environment.
english: Dumala-on said the company's production has been stopped in order to disinfect the entire working environment.

text: Dugang sang natungdan, sa subong nakaquarantine na ang tanan nga COVID-19 positive nga mga empleyado sa diin padayon man sila nga ginaswelduhan sang kompaniya.
english: He added that all COVID-19 positive employees are now under quarantine and they are still being paid by the company.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini ang pinakauna nga Taiwanese tech supplier nga nangin tuman ka apektado ang produksyon umpisa sang nagsugod ang pandemya.
english: It is the first Taiwanese tech supplier to have its production severely affected since the pandemic began.

text: Una na nga ginpaidalom sa alert level 3 ang Taipei, Taiwan sang nagligad nga bulan sa diin posible pa ini nga palawigon tubtob Hunyo 28 bangud sa padayon nga pagsaka sang COVID-19 cases.
english: Taipei, Taiwan was first placed under alert level 3 last month and may be extended until June 28 due to the continuous increase in COVID-19 cases.

text: Patay ang 12 ka mga tawo matapos gin-igo sang magnitude 6.3 nga linog ang northern Afghanistan kaina sang aga, Nov.
english: Twelve people were killed after a magnitude 6.3 earthquake struck northern Afghanistan this morning, Nov.

text: Base sa US Geological Survey, nag-igo ang linog sa Mazar-e-Sharif, ang puluy-an sang tunga ka milyon nga mga residente.
english: According to the US Geological Survey, the quake struck Mazar-e-Sharif, home to half a million residents.

text: May kadalumon ini nga 28 kilometers kag ginmarkahan nga orange alert level nga nagakahulugan sang possible nga “significant casualties”.
english: It has a depth of 28 kilometers and is marked orange alert level which means possible “significant casualties”.

text: Ginalauman nga magataas pa ang amo nga numero samtang nagapadayon ang ginapatigayon nga rescue operations.
english: That number is expected to rise as rescue operations continue.

text: Nagbilin man ang mabaskog nga pagtay-og sang 180 ka mga tawo nga nasamaran.
english: The strong quake also left 180 people injured.

text: Suno kay Taliban spokesman sa Balkh province nga si Haji Zaid, madamo sa mga napilasan ang yara sa Sholgara district, sa southern Mazar-e-Sharif.
english: According to Taliban spokesman in Balkh province Haji Zaid, many of the wounded were in Sholgara district, in southern Mazar-e-Sharif.

text: Nakabaton ang Pinay tennis star nga si Alex Eala sang Premios Tanglaw trophy sa iya pagbisita kay Philippine Ambassador to Spain Philippe Lhuillier.
english: Pinay tennis star Alex Eala received the Premios Tanglaw trophy during his visit to Philippine Ambassador to Spain Philippe Lhuillier.

text: Ini nga award ang ginahatag sa mga Pilipino kag Spaniards nga may kontribusyon sa pagpabakod sang relasyon sa tunga sang Espanya kag Pilipinas.
english: This award is given to Filipinos and Spaniards who have contributed to strengthening relations between Spain and the Philippines.

text: “I gave her the trophy which she was not able to attend our embassy celebrations last year called Premios Tanglaw,” suno kay Lhuillier.
english: “I gave her the trophy which she was not able to attend our embassy celebrations last year called Premios Tanglaw,” according to Lhuillier.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, nahatagan man sang kaangay nga tropeo sanday Isabel Preysler, anay Senator Ed Angara, kag 12 ka iban pa.
english: Last year, similar trophies were given to Isabel Preysler, former Senator Ed Angara, and 12 others.

text: Nagapang-72 subong si Eala sa rankings sang WTA kag bag-o lang nagtakop ang kampanya sa 2025 Madrid Open kun sa diin nalutos ini sa kamot sang world no.
english: Eala is currently ranked 72nd in the WTA rankings and just finished her campaign at the 2025 Madrid Open where she lost to world no.

text: 2 kag defending champion nga si Iga Swiatek.
english: 2 and defending champion Iga Swiatek.

text: Sixth seed siya kuntani sa Catalonia Open sa Espanya, apang sa latest nga impormasyon, indi na ini magdayon sa pag-compete.
english: He was supposed to be the sixth seed at the Catalonia Open in Spain, but according to the latest information, he will not continue to compete.

text: Ginalantaw nga pasulabihon sini ang preparasyon sa Italian Open sa Mayo 6-18, kag sa French Open kun sa diin nakasulod siya sa main draw sang isa ka Grand Slam sa labing-una nga tion sa iya karera.
english: He is expected to focus on preparations for the Italian Open on May 6-18, and the French Open where he reached the main draw of a Grand Slam for the first time in his career.

text:
[Warning: Sensitive Content]

Ginbawian gid sang kabuhi ang mag-utod nga Person with Disability (PWD) matapos ginmartilyo sang ila amay sa Gingoog City sa Misamis.
english:
[Warning: Sensitive Content]

Two Person with Disability (PWD) brothers died after being hammered by their father in Gingoog City in Misamis.

text: Ang mga biktima nagaedad sang 20 kag 21 anyos.
english: The victims were 20 and 21 years old.

text: Yara lang sa sulod sang ila balay ang mag-utod sang ginhimo sang amay ang krimen.
english: The brothers were inside their house when the father committed the crime.

text: Naggwa sa imbestigasyon nga naluoy ang amay sa iya kabataan rason nga luyag niya tapuson ang ila pag-antos.
english: The investigation revealed that the father felt sorry for his children and wanted to end their suffering.

text: Ginkontra naman ini sang iban nga himata kag ginsiling nga madugay na nga wala sang kabalaka ang amay sa mag-utod.
english: Other relatives opposed this and said that the father had not cared about the brothers for a long time.

text: Yara na sa kustodiya sang otoridad ang suspek.
english: The suspect is now in police custody.

text: Ginpahayag nga gintuyo man nga utason sang amay ang iya kabuhi matapos ang ginhimo sa iya mga anak.
english: The father also reportedly tried to take his own life after what was done to his children.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

text: ILOILO CITY- Kun sa Pilipinas, negatibo ang panulukan naton sa mga tawo nga nadula sa ila husto nga paminsaron kag kun kaisa, ginapakanubo kag ginadiskriminar pa naton sila ukon indi gani ginasikway gid.
english: ILOILO CITY- In the Philippines, we have a negative view of people who are lost in their right minds and sometimes, we humiliate and discriminate against them or even reject them.

text: Apang may yara sang isa ka lugar nga sa baylo nga malain ang pagtulok, ginasimba pa nila ini kag ginapatihan nga may yara sang gahum.
english: But there is one place where instead of being looked down upon, they still worship it and believe it has power.

text: Ini amo si Topi Amma, ang ginbansagan nga misteryoso nga ‘Hat Mother’ sang Tiruvannamalai, isa ka Hindu pilgrimage city sa Tamil Nadu.
english: This is Topi Amma, nicknamed the mysterious ‘Hat Mother’ of Tiruvannamalai, a Hindu pilgrimage city in Tamil Nadu.

text: Si Amma ang ginakabig nga kontrobersiyal nga religious nga pigura bangud kun para sa iban, isa lamang ini nga babaye nga nadula sa iya husto nga paminsaron, apang para sa iban, ginakabig nila siya nga ‘siddha’, buot silingon, isa ka enlightened being nga nalab-ot na ang ginatawag nga perfection.
english: Amma is considered a controversial religious figure because to some, she is just a woman who has lost her right mind, but to others, they consider her a 'siddha', that is, an enlightened being who has reached perfection.

text: Sa mata sang iban, ginakabig nila nga balaan kag napun-an sang madalom nga kahulugan ang mga hulag ni Amma.
english: In the eyes of others, they consider Amma’s gestures holy and imbued with deep meaning.

text: Mangin ang mga tinaga nga nagakawas sa iya mga bibig ang musika para sa mga tawo nga nagapati nga gamhanan siya.
english: Let the words that come out of his lips be the music for people who believe he is powerful.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, mangin ang baso nga ginaimnan ni Topi Amma sang tubig ang ginapulot pa sang mga tawo nga nagapati sa iya.
english: In fact, even the glass from which Topi Amma drinks water is still picked up by people who believe in her.

text: Sa pihak sini, bangud sa iya maathag nga mental disability, si Topi Amma ang wala gid sang labot sa iya mga deboto kag wala gid nakahangop nga siya gali ang ginasimba bilang perpekto nga tinuga nga may tumalagsahon nga gahum.
english: Despite this, due to her obvious mental disability, Topi Amma was completely indifferent to her devotees and never understood that she was actually worshiped as the perfect being with extraordinary power.

text: MAY MGA indikasyon nga pwede na ang malapitan nga pagtinupad sang mga tawo sa publiko.
english: THERE are indications that close gatherings of people in public are now possible.

text: Gintugtan na ang mga hampang sang liga sang National Basketball Association (PBA).
english: National Basketball Association (PBA) league games have been allowed.

text: Pila na gani ka senema.
english: It's even been a few movies.

text: Ang rason?
english: The reason?

text: Tungod ang mga humalampang na-test kag na-confirm nga wala COVID-19 sa kada tion sang ila paghampang.
english: Because the players are tested and confirmed free of COVID-19 every time they play.

text: Samtang wala ka man hadlukan nga malatnan sang COVID-19 basta yara ka lang sa malayo gawa (at least isa ka metro, ukon mga 3 ka tapak) sa iban nga tawo, ukon hayop katulad sang kabog (bat) nga masuspetsuhan nga may dala sing COVID-19 virus.
english: Meanwhile, you are not afraid of getting infected with COVID-19 as long as you stay away (at least one meter, or about 3 feet) from other people, or animals such as bats that are suspected of carrying the COVID-19 virus.

text: Syempre labi na gid ang wala proteksyon nga naga-ubo, nagapangatsi, ukon nagasugilanon sing malapitan sa imo atubangan nga gahaboy sang aerosol halin sa iya pagginhawa.
english: Of course especially the unprotected one who coughs, sneezes, or talks close to your face throwing off aerosols from his breath.

text: Indi mo man makuha ang COVID-19 kon indi mo pagtandugon sang mahigko mo nga kamot ang imo ilong, baba kag mata, kag sa pagpatuman sang nagakaigu nga hygienic practice katulad sang masami nga paghugas sang kamot gamit ang habon ukon sanitizer (70 percent alcohol).
english: You cannot get COVID-19 if you do not touch your nose, mouth and eyes with dirty hands, and if you implement proper hygienic practices such as frequent hand washing with soap or sanitizer (70 percent alcohol).

text: Samtang pwede man ang malapitan nga pagtatap sang mga pasyente sang COVID-19 gamit ang personal protective equipment (PPE) sang mga health workers.
english: Meanwhile, close handling of COVID-19 patients using personal protective equipment (PPE) by health workers is also allowed.

text: Sa malip-ut nga pulong , hilway ka sa COVID-19 kon wala ka gid man sini tungod proven immune ka paagi sa blood test ukon na-confirm nga hilway sini paagi sa swab test; kag naga-amlig ka sing husto paagi sa social distancing kag husto nga hygienic practice.
english: In short, you are free from COVID-19 if you do not have it because you are proven immune by blood test or confirmed free by swab test; and you are protecting yourself properly with social distancing and proper hygienic practice.

text: Gani, pwede na seguro ang magtambong sa isa ka conference ukon pagtililipon basta nagapinungko nga may bal-ut nga pulungkuan.
english: So, it is probably possible to attend a conference or meeting as long as you are sitting with a reclining chair.

text: Amo-amo man ina sa grupo nga nagakaon sa restawran nga gaantaranay ukon may plastic divider sa tunga sang lamesa, nga ginatugutan naman sa subong.
english: The same applies to groups eating in restaurants that are separated or have a plastic divider in the middle of the table, which is now allowed.

text: Ukon diin may plastic divider sa tunga sang mga pasahero sa dyep.
english: Or where there is a plastic divider between the passengers in the jeep.

text: Pwede man gani seguro ang mga pamilya nga luyag mag-enjoy sa beach nga may kaugalingon nga cottage kag lagawan nga malayo gawa sa isa kag isa.
english: Families who want to enjoy the beach can also have their own cottage and a house that is far away from each other.

text: Kon indi gid man lubos ang aton proteksyon sa paggamit sang face mask kag face shield, nagapati man ang aton mga siyentipiko nga ang low viral load, ukon manubo nga kadamuon, sang virus nga makasulod indi man maka-infect sa aton.
english: If we are not completely protected by the use of face masks and face shields, our scientists also believe that the low viral load, or low amount, of the virus that enters will not infect us.

text: Katulad ini seguro sa lalake nga indi mkapabusong sang iya asawa tungod kulang ang kadamuon sang iya semilya.
english: It's probably like a man who can't get his wife pregnant because he doesn't have enough sperm.

text:
***

Ano naman ng masiling sang mga healh expert sa proteksyon nga mahatag sang face mask, face shield kag ang pagsugilanon sing madurop sa sarado nga lugar kon diin indi hilway ang pagwa sang hangin?
english:
***

What do health experts say about the protection that face masks, face shields and talking to each other in closed spaces where there is no free ventilation?

text: Sunu sa ila, indi basta face mask kag face shield lang ang kinahanglan, kundi ang paglikaw man sa sarado nga lugar kon diin nagasugilanon kay indi maka-eskapo palayo ang aerosol.
english: According to them, not only face masks and face shields are needed, but also to avoid closed places where they talk because the aerosol cannot escape.

text: Although, sunu sa isa ka pagtuon sa Israel, indi makalusot ang COVID-19 virus kon derecho ang pag-ubo, pagpangatsi ukon maghambal sa atubang sang face shield, makasulod man ini sa bukas nga mga kilid sini.
english: Although, according to a study in Israel, the COVID-19 virus cannot escape if you cough, sneeze or speak directly in front of the face shield, it can also enter the open sides.

text: Makasulod ini kon matoon sa kilid sang face shield nga bukas, katulad sang palibut nga pagpanggunting  sang barbero sa ulo sang iya kustomer.
english: It can enter if it touches the side of the face shield that is open, like a barber's circular haircut on his customer's head.

text: Ini nga scientific finding nagahatag rason kon ngaa ginpahanugutan nga butangan sang plastic divider sa tunga sang kada pasahero sang dyep sa Iloilo City.
english: This scientific finding gives the reason why it is allowed to put a plastic divider between each passenger of the jeep in Iloilo City.

text: Sa ina nga paagi wala sing agyan ang COVID-19 virus sa tunga sang mga pasahero.
english: That way there is no way for the COVID-19 virus to pass between passengers.

text: Well, may ordinansa sa siyudad nga nagahatag exception sa mga naga-antipara agud gamiton ini bilang sal-i sa face shield tungod sa reklamo sang mga drayber nga nagaupang ini sa ila maayo nga panan-awon samtang naga-drive, nga gin-updan naman sang pila ka pumuluyo.
english: Well, there is an ordinance in the city that gives an exception to those who wear glasses to use it as a substitute for a face shield because of the complaint of drivers that it obstructs their good vision while driving, which was accompanied by some residents.

text: Personally, mas gustuhon ko gihapon, bisan kinahanglan ko ang antipara, ang maggamit sang face shield tungod sa dugang nga proteksyon sang face shield sa akon ilong, baba kag mata.
english: Personally, I would still prefer, even if I need glasses, to use a face shield because of the added protection a face shield gives to my nose, mouth and eyes.

text: In fact, sa akon indi man problema ini kon malimpyuhan ko man lang ini sing maayo bag-o gamiton.
english: In fact, I don't think it's a problem if I clean it well before using it.

text: Of course, ang mayor kag suluseguro gid nga indi malatnan sang COVID-19 amo ang paglikaw nga indi makapalapit sa katupad nga wala proteksyon sing at least isa ka metro kay indi ka na sina malab-ut sang agsik sang iya ubo, pangatsi kag sang pagpagwa sang aerosol kon nagahambal; kag ang masami nga hygienic practice katulad sang paghugas sang kamot nga may habon ukon alcohol (70 percent)./PN
english: Of course, the main and only way to avoid getting infected with COVID-19 is to avoid approaching a neighbor without protection at least one meter because you will not be able to reach the sound of his cough, sneeze and aerosol release when talking; and frequent hygienic practice such as hand washing with soap or alcohol (70 percent)./PN

text: “The Search is On” para sa masunod nga Binibining Pilipinas queens!
english: “The Search is On” for the next Binibining Pilipinas queens!

text: Gin-anunsyo sang pageant organizers nga nagabaton na sila sang application para sa 2025 national pageant umpisa kahapon, Marso 5, kag magalawig tubtub sa Marso 21.
english: The pageant organizers announced that they are accepting applications for the 2025 national pageant starting yesterday, March 5, and will run until March 21.

text: Mahimo ma-download ang form halin sa Binibining Pilipinas website kag sarang mapasa ang na-fill out nga documents sa Binibining Pilipinas Charities, Inc.
english: The form can be downloaded from the Binibining Pilipinas website and the filled out documents can be submitted to Binibining Pilipinas Charities, Inc.

61 ka tuig na ang Binibining Pilipinas kag amo ang ginakabig nga longest-running national beauty pageant.
english:

text: Nakahimo sang pangalan ang Pilipinas bilang most successful Asian country sa Miss Universe kag Miss International pageants bangud man sa Binibining Pilipinas.
english: The Philippines has made a name for itself as the most successful Asian country in the Miss Universe and Miss International pageants because of Binibining Pilipinas.

text: Lima ang na-produce sini nga Miss International winners lakip sanday Aurora Pijuan, Melanie Marquez, Precious Lara Quigaman, Bea Rose Santiago, kag Kylie Verzosa.
english: It has produced five Miss International winners including Aurora Pijuan, Melanie Marquez, Precious Lara Quigaman, Bea Rose Santiago, and Kylie Verzosa.

text: Apat naman ang Miss Universe winners nga sanday Gloria Diaz, Margie Moran, Pia Wurtzbach, kag Catriona Gray antes ginsaylo ang national franchise sa Miss Universe Philippines nga subong ginapangunahan na sang former titleholder nga si 2013 Binibining Pilipinas Ariella Arida.
english: Four Miss Universe winners were Gloria Diaz, Margie Moran, Pia Wurtzbach, and Catriona Gray before the national franchise was transferred to Miss Universe Philippines which is now led by former titleholder 2013 Binibining Pilipinas Ariella Arida.

english: The product of Bb.

text: Pilipinas nga si Mutya Datul samtang sanday Ann Colis kag Maureen Montagne ang nagdala pauli sang The Miss Globe crowns.
english: Philippines Mutya Datul while Ann Colis and Maureen Montagne took home The Miss Globe crowns.

text: Duha naman ang Miss Intercontinental winners nga sanday Karen Gallman kag Cinderella Faye Obeñita.
english: Two Miss Intercontinental winners are Karen Gallman and Cinderella Faye Obeñita.

english: Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa and Senator Christopher Lawrence “Bong” Go are among those identified by the International Criminal Court (ICC) as CO-PERPETRATORS of former President Rodrigo Duterte for allegedly committing crimes against humanity related to the drug war.
