text: ILOILO – Emosyonal ang isa sa mga agrarian reform beneficiaries nga si Engeline Magbanua, residente sang Barangay Aldeguer, Sara, Iloilo matapos nabaton ang iya Land Title halin sa Department of Agrarian Reform subong nga adlaw.
english: ILOILO – One of the agrarian reform beneficiaries, Engeline Magbanua, resident of Barangay Aldeguer, Sara, Iloilo, was emotional after receiving her Land Title from the Department of Agrarian Reform today.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Magbanua, iya ginpahayag nga 11 ka tuig man nga hulat sang iya pamilya agud makabig nga lehitimo na ini nga nagapanag-iya sang duta.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Magbanua said his family has been waiting for 11 years to be considered legitimate owners of the land.

text: Suno sa iya, madamo man nga sakripisyo ang ila naagyan kag subong ang adlaw nga ginakalipay niya bangud may papel na nga nagapamatuod nga may titulo na ini nga nakapangalan sa iya.
english: He said they have gone through many sacrifices and today is the day he is happy because he has a paper that proves that he has a title in his name.

text: Pahayag ni Magbanua, bentaha gid nga may yara sang Ilonggo sa nasambit nga ahensya bangud gina-follow up kag gina-facilitate ang mga kinahanglanon sang mga benepisyaryo.
english: Magbanua said it is an advantage to have an Ilonggo in the agency because it follows up and facilitates the needs of the beneficiaries.

text: Nahibaluan nga si DAR Undersecretary Jesry Palmares ang isa ka Ilonggo, tumandok sang Passi City, Iloilo.
english: DAR Undersecretary Jesry Palmares is an Ilonggo, a native of Passi City, Iloilo.

text: Nagpasalig ang natungdan sa Department of Agrarian Reform nga tipigan sini sang maayo ang duta kag nagpasalamat man sa ahensya ilabi na kay President Marcos bangud sa timprano nga pamaskwa sa ila.
english: He assured the Department of Agrarian Reform that it will take good care of the land and thanked the agency especially President Marcos for the early Christmas to them.

text: Posible nga ginadayaw-dayaw gid sang China ang daku sini nga kapasidad nga iduso ang ila territorial claims sa kaiping nga mga pungsod ilabi na sa Malaysian coast.
english: It is possible that China is overstating its great capacity to push its territorial claims to neighboring countries especially on the Malaysian coast.

text: Ang Malaysia ang subong masako kag nagapangatubang pa sang pinakamalala nga coronavirus outbreak sa pungsod kag napaidalom sa growing economic pressure.
english: Malaysia is currently busy and still facing the worst coronavirus outbreak in the country and under growing economic pressure.

text: Sini nga semana, gin-summon sang foreign ministry sang Malaysia si Chinese ambassador Ouyang Yujing agud mangayo sang paathag kun ngaa may 16 ka Chinese military aircraft nga yara sa exclusive economic zone sang Malayia.
english: This week, Malaysia's foreign ministry summoned Chinese ambassador Ouyang Yujing to seek an explanation as to why there are 16 Chinese military aircraft in Malaya's exclusive economic zone.

text: Gintawag ini sang ministry nga ‘breach of Malaysian airspace and sovereignty’.
english: The ministry called it a ‘breach of Malaysian airspace and sovereignty’.

text: Ginpanginwala naman ini sang Beijing kag ginpahayag nga ang ila military planes ukon Ilyushin Il-76 kag Xian Y-20 strategic transporters ang wala nakasulod sa airspace kag nagasunod gid sa ‘freedom of overflight’ sa lugar.
english: Beijing has denied this and said its military planes or Ilyushin Il-76 and Xian Y-20 strategic transporters did not enter the airspace and strictly follow the 'freedom of overflight' in the area.

text: “This incident is more likely directed at demonstrating its new-found military power projection capabilities, contrasting with a Malaysian air force well known to be under-strength and under-resourced,” pahayag ni Collin Koh, isa ka research fellow sa S Rajaratnam School of International Studies sa Singapore.
english: “This incident is more likely directed at demonstrating its new-found military power projection capabilities, contrasting with a Malaysian air force well known to be under-strength and under-resourced,” said Collin Koh, a research fellow at the S Rajaratnam School of International Studies in Singapore.

text: Pahayag pa niya: “The Chinese might want
english: He added: “The Chinese might want

text: Hingagawon sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan nga mapasar ang Appropriations Ordinance may kaangtanan paghatag sang gratuity pay para sa Job Order workers kag Contract of Service workers sang Iloilo Provincial Government.
english: The Sangguniang Panlalawigan will seek the passage of the Appropriations Ordinance regarding the provision of gratuity pay for Job Order workers and Contract of Service workers of the Iloilo Provincial Government.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Board Member Domingo Oso, Jr., chairman sang Committee on Appropriations, iya ginpahayag nga may patigayunon sila nga special session sa Disyembre 23.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Board Member Domingo Oso, Jr., chairman of the Committee on Appropriations, said they will hold a special session on December 23.

text: Suno kay Oso, sa tion nga mapasar ang ordinansa, mahingagaw ang pag-release sini antes ang Paskwa.
english: Oso said that once the ordinance is passed, it will be released before Christmas.

text: Pahayag ni Oso, kuhaon sa savings sang probinsya ang pondo nga para sa amo nga gratuity pay.
english: Oso said the fund for the gratuity pay will be taken from the province's savings.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong nga tuig, makabaton sang tubtob P7,000 nga gratuity pay ang mga Job Order workers kag Contract of Service workers, nga mas mataas sa ila nabaton nga P5,000 sang 2023.
english: This year, Job Order workers and Contract of Service workers will receive up to P7,000 gratuity pay, which is higher than the P5,000 they received in 2023.

text: Nakadepende naman ang batunon nga gratuity pay sang workers sa kadugayon na sang iya serbisyo sa kapitolyo.
english: The gratuity pay received by the workers depends on the length of service in the capitol.

text: Kun ang worker ang employed sang masobra apat ka bulan, makabaton ini sang maximum nga P7,000.
english: If the worker is employed for more than four months, he or she will receive a maximum of P7,000.

text: Kun ang worker ang employed sang masobra tatlo ka bulan apang wala nakalab-ot sa apat ka bulan, makabaton ini sang maximum nga P6,000.
english: If the worker is employed for more than three months but less than four months, he or she will receive a maximum of P6,000.

text: Kun nakalab-ot na sang duha ka bulan apang wala nakalab-ot sa tatlo ka bulan, makabaton ini sang P5,000.
english: If it has reached two months but less than three months, it will receive P5,000.

text: Kun mas manubo sa duha ka bulan ang serbisyo, makabaton ini sang maximum nga P4,000.
english: If the service is less than two months, it will receive a maximum of P4,000.

text:
No chance to retrieve bodies as Indonesia halts deep-sea salvage of sunken submarine

Tapuson na sang Indonesia ang ginapatigayon nga retrieval operation sa 53 ka mga crew members nga napatay matapos naglugdang ang KRI Nanggala 402 military submarine sa baybayon nga sakop sang Bali.
english:
No chance to retrieve bodies as Indonesia halts deep-sea salvage of sunken submarine

Indonesia will end the ongoing retrieval operation for the 53 crew members who died after the KRI Nanggala 402 military submarine sank off the coast of Bali.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Abril, nadula ang submarine nga naka-schedule kuntani nga magpatigayon sang torpedo training exercises.
english: It was learned that in April, the submarine that was scheduled to conduct torpedo training exercises disappeared.

text: Natukiban lamang ang submarine sang isa ka underwater rescue vehicle sa diin may yara ini nga kadalumon nga 800 meter ukon 2,600 ka tapak, nagkalaguba ang pila ka bahin kag wala sang senyales nga may yara sang makasalbar.
english: The submarine was only discovered by an underwater rescue vehicle at a depth of 800 meters or 2,600 feet, with several parts damaged and no signs of rescue.

text: Gilayon nga nagbulig ang Chinese salvage ships sa pagkuha kuntani sang vessel nga naglugdang.
english: Chinese salvage ships immediately helped recover the vessel.

text: Sa statement sang Indonesian Navy, indi mahapos kag tuman ka delikado ang ila ginahimo nga pagpaninguha.
english: In a statement, the Indonesian Navy said their efforts are not easy and very dangerous.

text: Masobra isa na ka bulan nga paghimakas nila agud makakuha sang importante nga materyales sa submarine apang ang desisyon nga tapuson na ang operasyon ang nagasiling nga wala na sang tyansa nga maretrieve pa ang mga lawas sang crew members.
english: They have been struggling for more than a month to get important materials from the submarine but the decision to end the operation means there is no chance of retrieving the bodies of the crew members.

text: Natukiban sa China ang human infection sang H10N3 bird flu strain — ang labing una nga gin-report nga kaso sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: A human infection of the H10N3 bird flu strain — the first reported case worldwide — has been detected in China.

text: Suno sa National Health Commission (NHC) sang amo nga pungsod, sang Abril 28, naadmit sa ospital ang 41 anyos nga lalaki bangud nagbatyag sang hilanat, kag pagkaligad sang isa ka bulan, nadiagnose ini nga may H10N3 bird flu.
english: According to the country's National Health Commission (NHC), on April 28, the 41-year-old man was admitted to the hospital with fever, and a month later, he was diagnosed with H10N3 bird flu.

text: Suno sa NHC, estable na subong ang kondisyon sang amo nga lalaki samtang wala naman sang ‘abnormalities’ nga nakit-an sa iya nga mga naka-close contact.
english: According to the NHC, the man's condition is now stable while no abnormalities were found in his close contacts.

text: Tuman ka nubo suno sa talatapan nga maglapta ang kaangay sini nga kaso.
english: The office said the prevalence of such cases is very low.

text: Ang H10N3 ang ginapahayag low pathogenic ukon may manubo nga tsansa nga mangin malala ukon mangin tunaan sang kamatayon sa mga pispis.
english: H10N3 is said to be low pathogenic or has a low chance of becoming serious or causing death in birds.

text: Suno sa NHC, wala pa sang may una nga nareport nga human case sang H10N3 nga una nareport diin man nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: According to the NHC, there have been no previously reported human cases of H10N3 anywhere in the world.

text: Nagahingyo ang mga pulis sa Florida, USA sang bulig sang publiko agud matumod na kag madakpan kun sin-o ang nagpinalupok sang pusil sa isa ka club nga amo ang nangin rason sang kamatayon sang duha ka tawo kag nagpilas sa masobra 20 ka iban pa.
english: Police in Florida, USA are asking for the public's help to identify and arrest who opened fire at a club that killed two people and injured more than 20 others.

text: Suno kay Miami-Dade police director Alfredo Ramirez III, santo sa ila inisyal nga imbestigasyon, may isa ka puti nga sports utlity vehicle (SUV) nga nagpundo sa gwa sang El Mula Banquet Hall sa Northwest Miami-Dade kag naggwa ang tatlo ka lalaki nga may rifles kag handguns kag nagpaniro sa mga tawo nga yara sa lugar.
english: According to Miami-Dade police director Alfredo Ramirez III, based on their initial investigation, a white sports utility vehicle (SUV) stopped outside the El Mula Banquet Hall in Northwest Miami-Dade and three men came out with rifles and handguns and opened fire on people in the area.

text: Dead on the spot ang duha ka tawo samtang ginhingagaw naman dala sa lain-lain nga ospital ang ginabanta 20-25 ka tawo kun sa diin isa subong ang ginapahayag yara sa kritikal nga kondisyon.
english: Two people died on the spot while about 20-25 people were rushed to different hospitals, one of whom is said to be in critical condition.

text: Ginrentahan lang ang banquet hall kag billiards club para sa isa ka concert sang natabo ang amo nga insidente.
english: The banquet hall and billiards club were rented for a concert when the incident occurred.

text: Padayon pa subong ang imbestigasyon sa natabo nga amo ang ginapahayag sang otoridad nga isa sa pinakadaku nga mass shootings sa Florida subong nga mga tinuig.
english: The investigation into what authorities say is one of the largest mass shootings in Florida in recent years is ongoing.

text: — Reuters
english: — Reuters

text: Patay ang limang German climbers matapos ang naganap na avalanche sa Dolomite mountains ng Italy.
english: Five German climbers were killed after an avalanche in Italy's Dolomite mountains.

text: Ang mga mountaineers ay mayroong hiwalay na grupo kung saan habang tinatahak ang Cima Vertana sa Ortler Alps ng biglang tumama ang mabilis na pagbagsak ng snow.
english: The mountaineers were in a separate group where while climbing Cima Vertana in the Ortler Alps suddenly hit a rapid snowfall.

text: Magkasamang tinangay ng avalanche ang mag-ama at matapos ang ilang oras ay narekober ang kanilang katawan.
english: The father and daughter were hit by an avalanche together and after a few hours their bodies were recovered.

text: Dinadayo ng mountain climbers ang lugar at naging maganda ang lagay ng panahon subalit pinagtatakahan ng mga otoridad kung bakit sa hapon pa nagsagawa ng hiking ang mga biktima.
english: Mountain climbers visited the area and the weather was good but authorities are wondering why the victims were hiking in the afternoon.

text: Lain gid ang feeling kun ginatamyaw ikaw sa imo nga birthday.
english: It's a different feeling when you're greeted on your birthday.

text: Espesyal ini nga adlaw nga aton gid gina-selebrar ang aton nga pagkabun-ag diri sa kalibutan.
english: This is a special day when we celebrate our birth here on earth.

text: Didto sa Boston sa Massachusetts, USA, may isa ka lalaki nga naga-selebrar sang iya nga kaadlawan apang wala gid sang nagatamyaw sa iya.
english: In Boston, Massachusetts, USA, there was a man who was celebrating his birthday but no one greeted him.

text: Ini amo si Chris nga nagtapak sa edad nga 25-anyos sa amo nga adlaw.
english: This is Chris who stepped on the 25-year-old mark that day.

text: Bangud naga-isahanon kag bisan tungang-gab-i, nagtawag ini sa emergeny telephone number nga 911 nga ginatawgan lamang kuntani sa tion sang emerhensya.
english: Because he was alone and even in the middle of the night, he called the emergency telephone number 911 which was supposed to be called only in case of emergency.

text: Didto kag nagpanugid siya nga gusto niya nga may magkanta sa iya sang happy birthday.
english: There he told me that he wanted someone to sing him a happy birthday.

text: Abi sang pulis, prank lang ini kag base sa pagsulundan, istrikto gid nga ginadumilian ang amo sini nga mga joke.
english: The police thought it was a prank and based on the rules, such jokes are strictly prohibited.

text: Apang wala ini ginbalewala sang mga police officers nga sanday Israel Branco kag Franklin Ortiz.
english: But police officers Israel Branco and Franklin Ortiz did not ignore it.

text: Ginkuha nila ang address ni Chris kag nagpanuktok sa balay sini bisan kagab-ihon pa lamang.
english: They got Chris' address and knocked on his door late at night.

text: Sang ila na-verify nga kaadlawan matuod sini, ginpaguwa na sang duha ka pulis ang ila dala nga gamay nga cake, ginsindihan ang kandila, kag nagkanta sang happy birthday.
english: When they verified that it was her birthday, the two policemen brought out their small cake, lit the candle, and sang happy birthday.

text: Wala sang kaupod si Chris sang amo nga gab-i apang indi naman matakos ang iya yuhom kag kalipay bangud sa efforts sang pulis.
english: Chris was not with anyone that night but his smile and happiness were not worthy of the efforts of the police.

text: Nagkamustahanay pa sila kag nagpasalamat gid si Chris bangud nga nakumpleto gid ang iya adlaw.
english: They greeted each other and Chris was very grateful because his day was complete.

text: “Everyone has one birthday, so everyone deserves to feel special on that day,” pahayag ni Branco.
english: “Everyone has one birthday, so everyone deserves to feel special on that day,” stated Branco.

text: Ginsugid man sang isa ka pulis nga nagdala gid sila sang cake bangud nga indi siya makasaho nga magkadto sa balay sang tawo nga wala sang dala.
english: One police officer also said that they brought a cake because he could not afford to go to someone's house without one.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga ginpadaku siya sang maayo sang iya iloy, kag pat-od nga akigan gid siya sini kun mahibaluan nga nagkadto siya sa tawo nga may birthday apang wala sang dala nga regalo.#
english: He also said that his mother raised him well, and that she would be very angry if she knew that he went to the person who had a birthday but did not bring a gift.

text: Makabig nga ikaduha sa nagapanguna nga cancer death sa mga kababainhan ang colorectal cancer kag ikatatlo naman sa mga kalalakihan.
english: Colorectal cancer is the second leading cause of cancer death in women and the third in men.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Elvin Tiangha, iya ginpahayag nga ang colorectal cancer amo ang kilala nga bowel cancer, colon cancer ukon rectal cancer nga nagaapekto sa colon kag rectum.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Elvin Tiangha, he said that colorectal cancer is known as bowel cancer, colon cancer or rectal cancer that affects the colon and rectum.

text: Suno kay Tiangha, bangud sa pag-abanse sang screening techniques kag pagsangkad sang treatments kag bulong, nabuhinan na ang death rate sa colorectal cancer.
english: According to Tiangha, due to the advancement of screening techniques and the expansion of treatments and drugs, the death rate in colorectal cancer has been reduced.

text:
Pila sa mga sintomas sang nasambit nga balatian suno sa doktor amo ang masunod:

Lakip sa nasambit nga sintomas suno kay Tiangha ang mahimo magresulta sa iban nga health condition apang importante nga magpacheck-up sa doktor kun maglawig ini nga mga sintomas sang masobra apat ka semana.
english:
Some of the symptoms of the disease according to the doctor are as follows:

Among the symptoms, Tiangha said, can result in other health conditions but it is important to see a doctor if these symptoms last more than four weeks.

text: Ginpahayag sang doktor nga lakip sa mga treatment sang colorectal cancer amo ang chemotherapy.
english: The doctor said that among the treatments of colorectal cancer is chemotherapy.

text: Mahimo man suno kay Tiangha magpaidalum sa Radiation therapy ang isa ka pasyente nga may amo nga cancer agud mapunggan ang pagdamo sang cancer cells.
english: Tiangha said a patient with cancer can also undergo radiation therapy to prevent the growth of cancer cells.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ang natungdan sa publiko nga likawan ang masami nga pag-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon kag pagpanigarilyo nga mahimo magresulta sa amo nga cancer.
english: He also reminded the public to avoid frequent drinking of alcoholic beverages and smoking which can result in cancer.

text: Mas maayo suno kay Tiangha nga magkaon sang utan kag mag-ehersisyo agud makalikaw indi lamang sa cancer kundi sa madamo pa nga sahi sang balatian.
english: Tiangha said it is better to eat vegetables and exercise to avoid not only cancer but many other diseases.

text: May mixed movement sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa masunod nga semana.
english: There will be mixed movement in the price of petroleum products next week.

text:
Sandig sa apat ka adlaw nga trading sang Mean of Platts Singapore kag mga development sa international oil market, yari ang ginabanta nga adjustments suno sa Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau:

Gasoline – rollback sang P0.15 per liter ukon may pagsaka nga tubtub sa P0.30 per literDiesel – wala sang adjustment ukon may rollback nga tubtub sa P0.40 per literKerosene – rollback nga P0.20 tubtub sa P0.40 per liter

Lakip sa gin-cite nga factors sa adjustments amo ang progress sa US-Iran nuclear deal; nagatahaw nga global US-China trade tensions; dugang nga crude oil storage capacity halin sa Export Terminal sang Iran.
english:
Based on the four-day trading of the Mean of Platts Singapore and developments in the international oil market, here are the estimated adjustments according to the Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau:

Gasoline – rollback of P0.15 per liter or increase of up to P0.30 per literDiesel – no adjustment or rollback of up to P0.40 per literKerosene – rollback of P0.20 to P0.40 per liter

Among the factors cited in the adjustments were progress on the US-Iran nuclear deal; escalating global US-China trade tensions; additional crude oil storage capacity from Iran’s Export Terminal.

text: Matandaan nga sang Martes, may big-time hike man sa presyo sang gatong: P1.70 sa diesel, kag P1.20 per liter sa gasoline kag kerosene.
english: On Tuesday, there was also a big-time hike in fuel prices: P1.70 for diesel, and P1.20 per liter for gasoline and kerosene.

text: Gina-anunsyo ang final adjustment sa kada Lunes kag ginapatuman epektibo sa kada Martes.
english: The final adjustment is announced every Monday and implemented effective every Tuesday.

text: Patigayunon ang hublag-protesta sa syudad sang Iloilo sa masunod nga Myerkules, Pebrero 25, kadungan sang ika-40 nga anibersaryo sang EDSA People Power Revolution.
english: The protest will be held in Iloilo City next Wednesday, February 25, in conjunction with the 40th anniversary of the EDSA People Power Revolution.

text: Suno sa Kahublagan Kontra Kurapsyon (KKK) nga amo ang masangkad nga multi-sectoral alliance sang mga Ilonggo kontra kurapsyon, magatipon ang mga maga-upod sa protesta sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol 12:30 sa udto, kag pagasundan sang mga ambahanon kag mga speech.
english: According to the Kahublagan Kontra Kurapsyon (KKK), the broad multi-sectoral alliance of Ilonggos against corruption, the protesters will gather at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol at 12:30 pm, followed by songs and speeches.

text: 2:30 sa hapon, maga-martsa ang protesters pakadto sa St.
english: 2:30 pm, protesters will march to St.

text: Clement’s Church, kag maga-diretso sa Jaro Plaza.
english: Clement's Church, and will proceed to Jaro Plaza.

text: May naka-schedule naman nga misa sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral sa alas kuatro sa hapon.
english: A mass is scheduled at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral at 4 pm.

text: Gina-engganyo sang KKK ang maga-upod sa protesta nga magsuksok sang puti nga panapton.Sa press release sang grupo, ginsiling nga pagkatapos sang EDSA People Power Revolution sang 1986 kag EDSA 2 sang 2001, nagapabilin nga isa ka pagpanghangkat sa mga Pilipino nga gub-on ang garuk nga sistema sang pang-gobyerno nga puno sang kurapsyon.
english: The KKK encourages protesters to wear white clothing. In a press release, the group said that after the EDSA People Power Revolution in 1986 and EDSA 2 in 2001, it remains a challenge for Filipinos to overthrow the corrupt system of government that is full of corruption.

text: Bangud sining dunot nga pamulitika suno sa grupo, nagsangkad pa ang gahum sang mga dinastiya kag nagasunod ang mga kaso sang plunder.
english: Because of this corrupt politics, according to the group, the power of the dynasties has expanded and cases of plunder follow.

text: “The tradition of pillaging the public treasury continues unabated, with multi-billion peso infrastructure projects riddled with massive kickbacks and substandard results,” suno sa KKK.
english: “The tradition of pillaging the public treasury continues unabated, with multi-billion peso infrastructure projects riddled with massive kickbacks and substandard results,” according to the KKK.

text: Ginlaslasan man sini ang mahinay nga imbestigasyon sa mga ahensya sang gobyerno nga nagapakita nga may ginatabun-tabunan kag may selective accountability.
english: He also criticized the slow investigation of government agencies that showed cover-ups and selective accountability.

text: Ginapasabat sang grupo si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: The group holds President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. accountable.

text: nga amo suno sa ila ang responsable sa pork barrel system kun sa diin makabenepisyo man ang iya kaugalingon nga pamilya kag mga kaalyado sa pulitika.
english: who is said to be responsible for the pork barrel system which will also benefit his own family and political allies.

text: Magluwas diri, ginapanawagan man sang KKK nga pasabton si Vice President Sara Duterte sa iya nga pag-abuso sa confidential funds.
english: In addition, the KKK also calls for Vice President Sara Duterte to be held accountable for her abuse of confidential funds.

text: “Fully stripping political dynasties of their power and exacting accountability from thieves in government will be seemingly impossible tasks as long as the reigning King and Queen of Corruption are not held liable through all possible means for their respective roles in national scandals that rocked the nation,” kabahin sang press release sang KKK.
english: “Fully stripping political dynasties of their power and exacting accountability from thieves in government will be seemingly impossible tasks as long as the reigning King and Queen of Corruption are not held liable through all possible means for their respective roles in national scandals that rocked the nation,” part of the KKK’s press release.

text: Matandaan nga antes sini, may duha man ka nauna nga hugnat sang Trillion Peso March sa Iloilo nga gin-updan sang nagkalain-lain nga mga grupo, mga kabataan, mga propesyunal, kag mangin sang simbahan.
english: Earlier, there were two previous phases of the Trillion Peso March in Iloilo which were attended by various groups, children, professionals, and even the church.

text: Natabo ini sang Septyembre 21 kag sang Nobyembre 30 nga ang panawagan nagsentro man sa pagtapna sa kurapsyon kag pagpapreso sa mga involved sa pagpangawat sa kaban sang gobyerno.#
english: This took place on September 21 and on November 30, the call also focused on curbing corruption and imprisoning those involved in looting the government coffers.

text: Nakahimo sang three-peat victory ang Ilonggo footballers sa beach football event sa La Boracay 2025 tournament nga ginhiwat sa Boracay.
english: Ilonggo footballers made a three-peat victory in the beach football event in the La Boracay 2025 tournament held in Boracay.

text: Ang team nga ginatawag nga J3 ang ginabug-usan sang mga players nga sanday Joshua Jerome Estares, Nathaniel Boblo, Arlo Salvacion, Jefferson Descarial, June Louie Biclar, Warren Trestiza, Petar Sajko, Jarlson Derutas, kag Kenneth Lecoto.
english: The team, dubbed J3, consists of players Joshua Jerome Estares, Nathaniel Boblo, Arlo Salvacion, Jefferson Descarial, June Louie Biclar, Warren Trestiza, Petar Sajko, Jarlson Derutas, and Kenneth Lecoto.

text: Ang ila naman manager amo si Neil Jeffrey Reyes.
english: Their manager is Neil Jeffrey Reyes.

text: NABATON naton ang balita nga nagduaw ang isa ka beauty queen kag iya iloy sa balay sang akon hinablos sa Estancia agud makilala man nila ang ila mga paryente diri.
english: We have received news that a beauty queen and her mother visited my nephew's house in Estancia to meet their relatives here.

text: Ulayhon lang seguro ang pagduaw nila.
english: Their visit must have been a coincidence.

text: Nagduaw man lang sila seguro sa pila ka kilala nga nakasugid sa ila nga malapit man lang ang ginapuy-an sang akon hinablos kag iya asawa dira sa Estancia.
english: They probably visited some acquaintances who told them that my nephew and his wife lived nearby in Estancia.

text: Salamat.
english: Thank you.

text: Dungog namon nga makaduaw kamo bisan ulayhon lang kag kilalahon kami nga paryente ninyo.
english: It is an honor for you to visit us even if you are a stranger and to recognize us as your relatives.

text: Kongrats sa pagdaug mo!
english: Congrats on your win!

text:
***

Tungod naungkat naman ang isyu nga korapsyon sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), nagbalik sa aton pamensaron ang casual naton nga pakigsugilanon sa mga tulugyanan sang pila ka bidder sa government project kon paano nagdaug ang ila mga “boss”.
english:
***

Since the issue of corruption in the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) has been raised, our casual conversation with the officials of some bidders in government projects about how their “bosses” won came back to our minds.

text: “Tanan sila daug!” siling niya nga nagayomu-yomu.
english: “They all win!” he said with a smile.

text: “Paano?” pamangkot ko.
english: "How?" I asked.

text: Siling niya nga ang ginahimo sang tatlo ka bidder amo ang mag-intiendihanay kon sin-o ang padag-on.
english: He said that what the three bidders were doing was to agree on who would win.

text: Sa ina nga pag-intiendihanay, ginkasugtan kuno nila kon sin-o ang padag-on.
english: In that understanding, they allegedly agreed on who would win.

text: Ang mapierde ulian kuno sang ila gasto, kag kon pwede matagaan sila sang sub-contract sa pila ka bahin sang proyekto.
english: The loser is supposed to be reimbursed for their costs, and if possible, they will be given a sub-contract for some part of the project.

text: Gali!
english: Dig in!

text: Well, collusion, ukon illegal cooperation ini, ukon conspiracy man gani, kon tawgon.
english: Well, it's collusion, or illegal cooperation, or even conspiracy, if you call it.

text: Isa ini ka corrupt practice nga naga-resulta sa pagsukot sing sobra ukon daku nga hul-ab sa kwarta sang gobyerno kay wala sing kumpetensya nga nagakatabo.
english: This is a corrupt practice that results in overcharging or a large waste of government money because there is no competition.

text: Tsk, tsk, tsk!
english: Tsk, tsk, tsk!

text: Basi luyag pa ninyo mahibal-an ang nagakatabo nga corruption sa mga infrastructure nga project sa gobyerno?
english: Maybe you want to know more about the corruption that is happening in infrastructure projects in the government?

text: Ari ang gitudlo sa aton sang GIACC, ukon ang Global Infratructure Anti-Corruption Centre.
english: Here’s what GIACC, or the Global Infrastructure Anti-Corruption Centre, teaches us.

text: Nagakatabo ini sa identification, financing, planning and design, pre-qualification ang tendering, project execution, kag operation kag maintenance sang project.
english: This occurs in identification, financing, planning and design, pre-qualification the tendering, project execution, and operation and maintenance of the project.

text: Naga-involver man ini sang mga tulugyanan (representative) sang gobyerno (pati kongresista kag senador), project owner, funders, contractors, consulting engineers, ila associated kag subsidiary companies, agents, joint venture partners, sub-contractors kag suppliers.
english: It also involves government representatives (including congressmen and senators), project owners, funders, contractors, consulting engineers, their associated and subsidiary companies, agents, joint venture partners, sub-contractors and suppliers.

text: Madamo sila sing pahito nga ang well-trained nga investigative reporter kaya mahibal-an kag matutukan.
english: They have many tricks that a well-trained investigative reporter can detect and focus on.

text: Good luck!
english: Good luck!

text:
***

Luyag ta man koreheran ang ikatlo ka parafo (3rd paragraph) sang aton kolum sadtong Nobyembre 11, 2020, nga may titulo “Congratulations Mr. Biden, Ms. Harris”.
english:
***

We would also like to correct the third paragraph of our column of November 11, 2020, entitled “Congratulations Mr. Biden, Ms. Harris”.

text: Indi tungod sala ang impormasyon sang aton source kay masaligan man ini, kundi tungod sa sala nga mga tinaga nga nagamit naton para sa aton luyag buot silingon.
english: Not because our source's information is wrong because it is reliable, but because we have used the wrong words for what we want to say.

text: Ining ikatlo nga parafo dapat tani magsiling:  “Si FDR ang isahanon (indi pinakauna) nga presidente sang US nga nakapungko sing apat ka termino.” Sorry!
english: This third paragraph should have said:  “FDR was the only (not the first) US president to serve four terms.” Sorry!

text: Sunu sa US Constitution, sa idalom sang 22nd Amendment nga ginpasar sadtong 1951, sa Section 1.
english: According to the US Constitution, under the 22nd Amendment passed in 1951, in Section 1.

text:
“No person shall be elected to the Office of the President more than twice…”

Bag-o sini ugaling, bukas ang kahigayunan sa pagdalagan sa pagka-Presidente sang US sobra sa duha ka termino.
english:
“No person shall be elected to the Office of the President more than twice…”

Before that however, the opportunity to run for President of the US for more than two terms is open.

text: Ugaling sang si George Washington nagpungko na bilang una nga presidente, ginlimitahan niya ang iya kaugalingon sa duha lang ka 4-year term.
english: But when George Washington took office as the first president, he limited himself to two 4-year terms.

text: Halin sadto nangin “unwritten rule” na ini para sa iban nga mga presidente tubtub 1940 sang si Presidente Franklin D. Roosevelt (FDR) nagapungko na sa iya ikaduha nga termino.
english: Since then it has become an “unwritten rule” for other presidents until 1940 when President Franklin D. Roosevelt (FDR) was in his second term.

text: Nakuhaan sing tanikala ining “unwritten rule”, ugaling, tungod sa crisis nga gindulot sang The Great (Economic) Depression halin 1929 tubtub sa ulihi nga bahin sang 1930-1940, kag sang pagsulod na sang US sa 2nd World War sang ginbombahan sang Japan ang Pearl Harbor sadtong Disyembre 7, 1941.
english: This “unwritten rule”, however, was interrupted by the crisis caused by The Great (Economic) Depression from 1929 to the late 1930s-1940s, and the US entry into World War II when Japan bombed Pearl Harbor on December 17, 1944.

text: Tungod sini, natagaan sing kahigayunan si FDR agud ma-nominate sang Democratic Party para presidente sa ikatlo nga kahigayunan sa pagkilala sang iya maayo nga pagdumala sang pungsod sa sina nga mga tion.
english: As a result, FDR was given the opportunity to be nominated by the Democratic Party for president for a third time in recognition of his good governance of the country during those times.

text: Nagdaug siya diri kag sa iya ikaapat pa nga pagpadalagan.
english: He won here and on his fourth run.

text: Nagpungko bilan Presidente si FDR sadtong 1933, 1937, 1941, kag 1945.
english: FDR served as President in 1933, 1937, 1941, and 1945.

text: Ugaling wala makumpleto ni FDR ang iya ikaapat nga termino sang nagtaliwan ini sadtong Abril 12, 1945 nga dala ang balatian nga paralytic condition nga nagpabilin sa iya sa wheelchair samtang nagaserbisyo bilang presidente.
english: However, FDR did not complete his fourth term when he died on April 12, 1945 of a paralytic condition that kept him in a wheelchair while serving as president.

text: Kilala man si FDR sa iya tindug kag pagpasanyog sang “Freedom of Expression, Freedom of Worship, Freedom from Want and Freedom from Fear”.
english: FDR is also known for his stand and promotion of “Freedom of Expression, Freedom of Worship, Freedom from Want and Freedom from Fear”.

text: Angot sa “Freedom from Fear”, ginpanugyan niya nga indi dapat gamiton ang nuclear weapons sa gyera, kundi sa “peaceful means”.
english: On “Freedom from Fear”, he suggested that nuclear weapons should not be used in war, but for “peaceful means”.

text: Sang ulihi, naghisugot man gid ang mga nuclear powers, sa pagpamuno sang US kag Rusya, agud untaton ang padayon nga produksyon sang nuclear arms./PN
english: Eventually, the nuclear powers, led by the US and Russia, agreed to stop the continued production of nuclear weapons./PN

text: Luwas sa katalagman ang kapin 200 ka tawo nga sakay sang isa ka daku nga Indonesia ferry nga nagkalayo samtang nagabyahe ini padulong sa isa ka isla sa northeastern Indonesia.
english: More than 200 people aboard a large Indonesian ferry that caught fire while traveling to an island in northeastern Indonesia are safe.

text: Suno kay Wisnu Wardana, spokesperson for the sea transportation directorate general, padulong sa isla sang Limafatola kag ginabanta 15 minutos palang nga nakahalin sa Ternate sa North Maluku province ang barko nga KM Karya Indah sang gulpi lang natabo ang sunog.
english: According to Wisnu Wardana, spokesperson for the sea transportation directorate general, the ship KM Karya Indah was heading to Limafatola Island and was about 15 minutes from Ternate in North Maluku province when the fire broke out.

text: Sunod nga naglumpat ang mga pasahero kag crew sa tubig.
english: Next the passengers and crew jumped into the water.

text: Suno kay Wardana, na-rescue na ang 181 ka mga pasahero lakip na ang 22 ka kabataan kag 14 ka crew members.
english: According to Wardana, 181 passengers including 22 children and 14 crew members have been rescued.

text: Nagbulig sa rescue operation ang local fishing boats nga yara man sa amo nga dagat sang natabo ang insidente.
english: Local fishing boats that were also in the sea when the incident occurred assisted in the rescue operation.

text: Ginpahayag sang mga survivors nga halin sa engine room ang kalayo, apang padayon pa subong ang imbestigasyon agud matumod sang otoridad ang matuod nga ginhalinan sang kalayo.
english: Survivors said the fire started in the engine room, but the investigation is ongoing to determine the true cause of the fire.

text: Wala ginalauman ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: nga magpanguna si Anilao Mayor Lee Ann Debuque sa survey sa pagka-bise gobernador sang Nobyembre.
english: Anilao Mayor Lee Ann Debuque to lead the November vice governorship survey.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Governor Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga isa ka ‘good basis’ ang survey para kay Debuque ilabi na nga nagaumpisa pa lang ini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Governor Defensor said the survey is a good basis for Debuque especially since it is just beginning.

text: Suno kay Defensor, ang pamilya sang Debuque ang wala pa nakaintra sa politika sa probinsya, bisan sa district wide, apang ang survey ang nagapakita sang maayo.
english: Defensor said the Debuque family has not been involved in politics in the province, even district wide, but the survey shows good.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga kon manubo ang awareness sang isa ka tawo, indi nila gilayon makilalal-an si Mayor Debuque.
english: He also said that if a person's awareness is low, they will not immediately recognize Mayor Debuque.

text: Kumpyansa naman si Defensor nga si Debuque ang pilion sang tawo bangud siya ang young, intelligent, kag dynamic.
english: Defensor is confident that Debuque will be chosen by the people because he is young, intelligent, and dynamic.

text: Nag-file ang Pilipinas sang panibag-o nga diplomatic protest batok sa wala nagahalin nga presenya sang mga barko sang China sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The Philippines has filed a new diplomatic protest against the persistent presence of Chinese ships in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Suno sa Department of Foreign Affairs, kaundan sang protesta ang incessant deployment, prolonged presence, and illegal activities sang maritime assets kag fishing vessels sang Bejing, China sa palibot sang Pag-asa islands nga sakop sang exslusive economic zone sang Pilipinas.
english: According to the Department of Foreign Affairs, the protest includes the incessant deployment, prolonged presence, and illegal activities of maritime assets and fishing vessels of Bejing, China around the Pag-asa islands which are part of the exclusive economic zone of the Philippines.

text: Nagdemanda ang DFA sa China nga kuhaon ang ila nga vessels sa amo nga lugar bangud ang Pagasa ang ‘integral part of the Philippines’ kun sa diin may sovereignty and jurisdiction ang pungsod.
english: The DFA has demanded that China remove its vessels from the area because Pagasa is an integral part of the Philippines where the country has sovereignty and jurisdiction.

text: Santo sa Mayo 12 nga report sang National Task Force for the West Philippine Sea, kapin 300 ka Chinese vessels nga ginasuspetsahan nga maritime militia ang nagapabilin sa Kalayaan town sa Palawan.
english: According to the May 12 report of the National Task Force for the West Philippine Sea, more than 300 Chinese vessels suspected to be maritime militia remain in Kalayaan town in Palawan.

text: Mabug-at kag may-unod ang ginbuy-an nga pamangkot ni California Governor Gavin Newsom matapos ang pagkapatay sang siyam ka tawo sa rail yard sa San Jose.
english: California Governor Gavin Newsom has unleashed a heavy and meaningful question after the deaths of nine people at a rail yard in San Jose.

text: Suno sa gobernador, ano ang nagakatabo subong sa Estados Unidos?
english: According to the governor, what is happening in the United States right now?

text: Ini bangud 68 na ang narekord nga mass shootings sa pungsod sa sulod lang sang duha ka bulan base sa data sang Gun Violence Archive.
english: This is because 68 mass shootings have been recorded in the country in just two months based on data from the Gun Violence Archive.

text: Kahapon, isa ka transit worker ang nagpalupok sang armas sa diin siyam ka tawo ang patay lakip na ang gunman.
english: Yesterday, a transit worker fired a gun killing nine people including the gunman.

text: Lakip man sa siyam ka mga napatay amo ang Filipino nga si Paul Delacruz Megia, 42 anyos.
english: Among the nine dead was Filipino Paul Delacruz Megia, 42 years old.

text: Ginkilala sang California law enforcement officials ang suspek nga si Samuel James Cassidy, 57, isa ka maintenance worker.
english: California law enforcement officials identified the suspect as Samuel James Cassidy, 57, a maintenance worker.

text: Natabo ang pagpang-atake samtang nagahanda ang mga dispatchers kag maintenance workers nga magbukas ang Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority.
english: The attack happened as dispatchers and maintenance workers prepared for the Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority to open.

text: Nagmandu naman si US President Joe Biden sa Congress nga himuan sang pamaagi kun paano masolbar ang gun violence.
english: US President Joe Biden has ordered Congress to come up with a plan to address gun violence.

text: Gin-athag sang kapulisan nga wala sila nakabayluhanay sang lupok sa gunman kag nagapati ang mga ini nga mismo ang suspek ang nag-utas sang iya kabuhi.
english: Police clarified that they did not exchange fire with the gunman and they believe that the suspect himself committed suicide.

text: Nagpalab-ot na sang koordinasyon ang Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 (DPWH 6) sa Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU) may kaangtanan sa pagbukas sang Ungka Flyover sa Disyembre 23.
english: The Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 (DPWH 6) has already reached out to the Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU) regarding the opening of the Ungka Flyover on December 23.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit, iya ginpahayag nga may patigayunon nga ‘house cleaning’ sa Ungka Flyover sa Disyembre 22, isa ka preparasyon sa pagbukas sini.
english: Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit, said there will be a house cleaning at the Ungka Flyover on December 22, in preparation for its opening.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, nag-imbitar man ang DPWH 6 sang pari para sa blessing program antes buksan ini sa publiko sa iya full capacity.
english: According to Garbanzos, DPWH 6 also invited the priest for the blessing program before opening it to the public at its full capacity.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga isa ini ka maayo nga pag-abi-abi kag isa ka development sa bahin sang ila talatapan.
english: He also said that this is a good welcome and a development on the part of their office.

text: Nagapati man si Garbanzos nga ang pagbukas sang flyover ang makahatag sang mas madasig nga traffic pasulod sa Iloilo City.
english: Garbanzos also believes that the opening of the flyover will provide faster traffic into Iloilo City.

text: May yara sang duha ka mga teorya ang US intelligence community sa kun diin naghalin ang COVID-19.
english: The US intelligence community has two theories on the origin of COVID-19.

text: Una amo nga mahimo nagtuhaw lang ini gikan sa human contact sa mga infected nga sapat ukon posible nga may yara sang aksidente nga natabo sa laboratoryo nga amo ang nangin source sang global pandemic.
english: First is that it may have simply arisen from human contact with infected animals or possibly something accidental happened in the laboratory that was the source of the global pandemic.

text: Suno sa Office of the Director of National Intelligence, wala pa sang tul-id nga pahayag ang US Intelligence Community kun bala sa diin nga lugar, san-o kag kun paano naglapta ang COVID-19 virus.
english: According to the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, the US Intelligence Community has not yet made a clear statement on where, when and how the COVID-19 virus spread.

text: Wala man gintumod sang otoridad kun bala diin sa duha ang ginapatihan sang 17 ka mga ahensya nga nagabug-os sa US intelligence community.
english: The authorities did not specify which of the two is believed by the 17 agencies that make up the US intelligence community.

text: Masobra pa sa 100 ka mga kabataan ang nagapabilin nga missing matapos naglupok ang Mount Nyiragongo sa Democratic Republic of Congo sang weekend.
english: More than 100 children remain missing after Mount Nyiragongo erupted in the Democratic Republic of Congo over the weekend.

text: Suno sa report sang United Nations Children’s Emergency Fund ukon Unicef, masobra 150 ka kabataan ang naseparar sa ila nga mga pamilya bangud sang naglupok ang bulkan, nagpanic ang mga tawo rason nga gintipon sang linibo ka mga pumuluyo ang ila nga mga gamit kag nag-evacuate sa Goma City.
english: According to a report by the United Nations Children's Emergency Fund or Unicef, more than 150 children were separated from their families because when the volcano erupted, people panicked and thousands of residents gathered their belongings and evacuated to Goma City.

text: Ang iban nga mga kabataan nga nalagyo ang nagkaladula apang ang iban sa ila ang yara subong nagatinir sa center nga ginapadalagan sang Red Cross sa Goma.
english: Some of the children who fled disappeared but some of them are now staying at the center run by the Red Cross in Goma.

text: Ang Red Cross workers kag government officials ang nagabuligay agud magkilit-anay ang magpamilya.

english: He also urged the residents not to blame each other for the fire.

text: Ginatudlo ni House Committee on Public Accounts Chairperson Terry Ridon bilang “double hearsay” ang mga alegasyon nga may record sang komunikasyon sa tunga ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: House Committee on Public Accounts Chairperson Terry Ridon points to as “double hearsay” allegations that there is a record of communication between President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: kag anay Undersecretary Adrian Bersamin nga nagapakita sang ila direkta nga koneksyon sang Presidente sa mga kickback sa flood control.
english: and former Undersecretary Adrian Bersamin showing their direct Presidential connection to flood control kickbacks.

text: Si Adrian Bersamin amo ang apo ni former executive secretary Lucas Bersamin, kag amo ini ang ginatumod ni former Congressman Zaldy Co nga nagkumpirma sa iya nga nagmandu si President Marcos sang insertion sang P100 billion sa 2025 national budget.
english: Adrian Bersamin is the grandson of former executive secretary Lucas Bersamin, and this is what former Congressman Zaldy Co was referring to when he confirmed to him that President Marcos ordered the insertion of P100 billion in the 2025 national budget.

text: Suno kay Ridon, magluwas lamang kun personal nga kumpirmahon ni Bersamin ang kamatuoran sa ginaalegar nga komunikasyon nila ni Marcos, ang ini nga mga alegasyon wala sa gihapon sang balor kag indi magdugay sa korte ukon sa proseso sang impeachment.
english: According to Ridon, unless Bersamin personally confirms the truth of the alleged communication between him and Marcos, these allegations are still worthless and will not last long in court or in the impeachment process.

text: Samtang, suno naman kay ACT Teachers Party List Representative Antonio Tinio pwede nga gamiton ang record sang komunikasyon ni Marcos kag Bersamin bilang basehan sang isa pa ka posible nga impeachment complaint batok sa Presidente kun natapos na ang one-year ban sini sa Enero 2027.
english: Meanwhile, ACT Teachers Party List Representative Antonio Tinio said the record of communication between Marcos and Bersamin could be used as the basis for another possible impeachment complaint against the President when his one-year ban expires in January 2027.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni House Assistant Majority Leader Zia Alonto Adiong nga kun may ara sang nagakaigo nga ebidensya para suportahan ang mga pahayag sini, dapat mapakita sa deliberasyon sang house panel sa mga impeachment complaint batok sa Presidente.
english: House Assistant Majority Leader Zia Alonto Adiong said that if there is sufficient evidence to support his statements, it should be shown in the deliberation of the house panel on the impeachment complaints against the President.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginpanginwala sang Malacañang ang nasambit nga komunikasyon kag nagpahayag nga ang Presidente wala sang koneksyon sa anuman nga korapsyon nga nagakatabo sa gobyerno.
english: Malacañang denied the communication and said the President had no connection to any corruption in the government.

text: May tawgon kita subong nga Supermom!
english: We now have something to call Supermom!

text: Istorya ini sang isa ka 40-anyos nga iloy nga si Tamiah Brevard-Rodriguez sa NewJersey sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: This is the story of a 40-year-old mother named Tamiah Brevard-Rodriguez in New Jersey in the United States of America.

text: Sang kaagahon sang nagligad nga Abril, ginatapos na ni Tamiah ang iya PowerPoint nga gamiton sini agud depensahan ang iya dissertation nga naka-schedule sa amo nga adlaw.
english: In the early hours of last April, Tamiah was finishing up her PowerPoint she was going to use to defend her dissertation that was scheduled for that day.

text: Ini para sa iya doctorate sa Rutgers Graduate School of Education nga duha ka tuig sini nga ginbaka-bakahan kag amo na lang ini ang kulang agud maka-graduate siya kag maka-enjoy na sa summer.
english: This is for his doctorate at Rutgers Graduate School of Education that he has been working on for two years and that is all he needs to graduate and enjoy the summer.

text: Apang sang amo man nga kaagahon, indi halos mahibaluan ni Tamiah ang iya batyagon sang naglupok na ang iya panubigan kag nakahibalo siya nga mabata na gid siya!
english: But that same morning, Tamiah didn't know how to feel when her waters broke and she knew she was going to have a baby!

text: Bisan malipayon siya nga mabata na siya, indi ini malubos-lubos bangud pila ka oras na lang ang nabilin kag kinahanglan na sini depensahan ang dissertation.
english: Although she is happy that she is about to give birth, it is not complete because there are only a few hours left and she has to defend her dissertation.

text: Dali-dali sila nga nagpaospital apang wala na gid nakahingagaw sa birthing center bangud samtang yara pa lang sa salakyan, nagguwa na si baby boy nga ila ginpangalanan nga Baby Enzo.
english: They rushed to the hospital but could not get to the birthing center because while still in the car, a baby boy came out whom they named Baby Enzo.

text: Naka-settle na si Mommy Tamiah sa labor delivery room samtang nga gintawgan naman sang partner sini ang iya nga eskwelahan agud nga mangayo sang konsiderasyon kag ipostpone lang ang dissertation bangud sa pagbata ni Tamiah.
english: Mommy Tamiah is settled in the labor delivery room while her partner called her school to ask for consideration and postpone the dissertation because of Tamiah's birth.

text: Apang mismo si Tamiah na ang nagdesisyon nga indi na lang pag-ipostpone bangud basi kun ma-delay naman sa bag-o nga schedule kag maatrasar ang iya paggraduate.
english: But Tamiah herself decided not to postpone it because it might be delayed in the new schedule and delay her graduation.

text: Sa bulig sang hospital staff, gintatap anay si Baby Enzo sa nursery kag ginbutangan sang card ang puertahan agud malikawan ang interruptions.
english: With the help of hospital staff, Baby Enzo was first cared for in the nursery and a card was placed on the door to avoid interruptions.

text: Nag-ilis sang bayo ang mommy, nag-makeup, nag-atubang sa laptop kag ginpresentar ang iya nga dissertation nga nahanungod sa standards para sa black women sa kolehiyo kun sa diin mas madamo ang white nga mga tawo.
english: Mommy changed clothes, put on makeup, faced the laptop and presented her dissertation about standards for black women in college where there are more white people.

text: Isa ka oras ang presentasyon sa atubang sang 56 ka tawo, kag suno kay Tamiah, grabe man ang iya transition halin sa mommy brain pakadto sa scholar brain agud lamang matapos sini ang iya doctorate degree.
english: The presentation lasted an hour in front of 56 people, and according to Tamiah, she had to transition from mommy brain to scholar brain just to finish her doctorate degree.

text: Wala gid siya nagsala bangud sini nga summer, indi lamang si Baby Enzo ang nagdugang sa ila pamilya kundi natuman pa ang handum sini nga maka-graduate bilang doctor sa education halin sa Rutgers Graduate School of Education.#
english: She was not wrong because this summer, not only did Baby Enzo add to their family but her dream of graduating as a doctor of education from Rutgers Graduate School of Education came true.

text: Bangud sa kakulba sa coronavirus kag kakulang sang mga ospital nga makasarang sa pagtatap sa mga pasyente, nakontento na ang pila ka mga residente sa India nga magpakonsulta sa iligal nga mga clinic.
english: Due to fear of coronavirus and lack of hospitals capable of treating patients, some Indian residents are content to consult illegal clinics.

text: Sa Parsaul village, halos 60 killometros ang kalayuon halin kapital sang India nga New Delhi, isa ka Indian former hospital worker nga wala sang nagakaigu nga medical education ang reported nga nagapadalagan sang gamay kag indi lisensyado nga clinic kun sa diin nagapadulong ang mga tawo nga nabudlayan magginhawa.
english: In Parsaul village, nearly 60 kilometers from the Indian capital New Delhi, an Indian former hospital worker without proper medical education is reported to be running a small, unlicensed clinic where people with breathing difficulties go.

text: May gamay lang nga katre nga nakabutang sa lutakon nga duta; ang iban nga mga pasyente ang nagasuksok man sang face mask samtang nagahigda samtang ang iban ang nagapanabon lang sang tela ukon anuman nga panapton.
english: There was only a small bed lying on the cracked ground; some patients also wear a face mask while lying down while others just cover themselves with a cloth or any cloth.

text: Sa subong santo sa data sang health department, nagsaka na sa masobra 26.3 million ang kaso sang COVID-19 sa India — ikaduha sa pinakamataas nga rekord sa kalibutan, sunod sa Estados Unidos.
english: As of now, according to health department data, India has more than 26.3 million cases of COVID-19 — the second highest record in the world, after the United States.

text: Ang numero naman sang mga napatay ang yara na sa kapin 296,000.
english: The death toll has risen to more than 296,000.

text: — with a report from Reuters
english: — with a report from Reuters

text: Ginpatay ang kapin 20 ka miyembro sang militar kag pulis sa Myanmar matapos nga ginpwersa sulod sang mga tawo nga nagapamatok sa kudeta ang isa ka police station sa southern Shan State.
english: More than 20 members of Myanmar's military and police have been killed after anti-coup mobs forced their way into a police station in southern Shan State.

text: Suno sa reports sang independent local media, ang atake sa police station ang ginpangunahan sang People’s Defense Forces nga ginsuportahan sang local militia.
english: Suno sa reports sang independent local media, ang atake sa police station ang ginpangunahan sang People’s Defense Forces nga ginsuportahan sang local militia.

text: Suno naman sa report sang Radio Free Asia, 10 ka soldado kag apat ka pulis ang ginbawian sang kabuhi, lakip na ang deputy chief sang Moebye police station.
english: According to Radio Free Asia, 10 soldiers and four policemen were killed, including the deputy chief of Moebye police station.

text: May mga video sa Mobye kun sa diin makit-an ang nakauniporme nga security forces nga nagahamyangon samtang may mga pulis naman nga naka-blinfold kag may mga surgical mask samtang yara ang kamot sa ila likod.
english: There are videos in Mobye where uniformed security forces can be seen lying down while policemen are wearing blinfolds and surgical masks with their hands behind their backs.

text: May police vehicle man nga ginsunog.
english: A police vehicle was also set on fire.

text: Sa subong wala pa gihapon sang independent confirmation.
english: So far there is still no independent confirmation.

text: Santo sa report sang activists’ group nga Assistance Association for Political Prisoners, kapin 815 na ang napatay sa Myanmar kag 4,000 ang ginpreso umpisa sang ginpatuman ang kudeta halin sang Pebrero 1.
english: According to the report of the activists' group Assistance Association for Political Prisoners, more than 815 people have been killed in Myanmar and 4,000 have been imprisoned since the coup was implemented on February 1.

text: Isa na ka semana nga malinong, wala sang gahod sang lupok kag wala sang may mabatyagan nga pagtay-og sa Kefar Sava, Israel.
english: It has been a week of peace, no gunshots and no vibrations in Kefar Sava, Israel.

text: Ini matapos nga ginkasugtan sang Israel kag Palestine nga magpatigayon sang ceasefire kasunod sang 11 ka adlaw nga pagbalusay sang lupok.
english: This comes after Israel and Palestine agreed to hold a ceasefire following an 11-day ceasefire.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Hanah Galotera direkta sa Israel, sadto, kada las 12 sang kaagahon, may mga nagalinupad pa nga rockets.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Hanah Galotera directly in Israel, back then, every 12 o'clock in the morning, there were still rockets flying.

text: Apisar may yara sang iron dome ang Israel, indi kun kaisa malikawan nga may yara sang rocket nga nagatupa sa balay ukon sa buildings.
english: Although Israel has an iron dome, it is sometimes inevitable that there will be rockets falling on houses or buildings.

text: Nahibaluan nga naglab-ot sa masobra 240 ang patay sa Gaza tuga sang airstrikes sang Israel samtang 12 naman ang napatay sa Israel bangud sa rockets nga ginpangbuy-an sang Hamas.
english: More than 240 people have been killed in Gaza by Israeli airstrikes while 12 have been killed in Israel by rockets fired by Hamas.

text: Sa subong, ginatinguhaan sang Gazans nga mabalik sa normal ang ila pagpangabuhi sa diin nag-umpisa na ang mga otoridad sa pagpanagtag sang tents sa Gaza Strip.
english: Meanwhile, Gazans are trying to get their lives back to normal with authorities starting to distribute tents in the Gaza Strip.

text: Nagalalain kag halos indi gihapon makapati ang isa ka pamilya sa Austria bangud sa baylo nga isa, duha gid ka tiil ang madula sa ila nga himata bangud sala nga tiil ang gin-utod sang ospital sa una nga operasyon.
english: A family in Austria is still in disbelief because instead of one, two legs will be lost because the hospital cut off the wrong leg in the first operation.

text: 82 anyos na ang pasyente kag may yara sang nanari-sari nga medical condition, rason nga kinahanglan utdon ang iya wala nga tiil.
english: The patient is 82 years old and has various medical conditions, which required the amputation of his left leg.

text: Apang ang natabo, sala nga tiil ang ginbutangan sang hospital worker sang preoperative mark gani sa baylo nga wala, tuo nga tiil ang una nga gin-utod.
english: But what happened was that the hospital worker put a preoperative mark on the wrong leg so instead of the left, the right leg was amputated first.

text: Natalupangdan lang ang sala sang gin-islan na ang benda pagkaaga.
english: The mistake was only noticed when the bandage was changed the next morning.

text: Nagpangayo naman sang pasaylo ang Freistadt Clinic kag ginpahayag nga may yara na sang psychological support para sa pamilya kag sa mismo nga pasyente.
english: The Freistadt Clinic apologized and said that psychological support is already available for the family and the patient himself.

text: Ginpasa naman ang kaso sa public prosecutor sang rehiyon kag nagpasalig man ang talatapan nga himuon ang nagakaigu sa kun sin-o man nga hospital workers nga involved sa amo nga human error.
english: The case was handed over to the public prosecutor of the region and the office also assured that appropriate action will be taken against any hospital workers involved in the human error.

text: Ginpang-guba na kag ginbasura ang kapin 17,000 ka doses sang AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccines sa Malawi matapos nag-expire bangud nagpamalibad ang mga pumuluyo nga magpabakuna.
english: More than 17,000 doses of AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccines have been destroyed and discarded in Malawi after they expired because residents refused to get vaccinated.

text: Tatlo na ka batch ang nag-abot nga bakuna sa Malawi — 300,000 doses halin sa Covax vaccine sharing facility, 50,000 halin sa India kag 102,000 halin sa African Union.
english: Three batches of vaccines have arrived in Malawi — 300,000 doses from the Covax vaccine sharing facility, 50,000 from India and 102,000 from the African Union.

text: Suno kay Health Minister Kumbize Kandodo, duha ka semana kuntani ang shelf life sang bakuna nga halin sa African Union.
english: According to Health Minister Kumbize Kandodo, the vaccine from the African Union should have had a shelf life of two weeks.

text: Sa sulod sining duha ka semana, wala ini naubos tublok sa target nga mga residente bangud sang ginapahayag propaganda batok sa Astrazeneca vaccines.
english: During these two weeks, it did not run out of targeted residents because of the alleged propaganda against Astrazeneca vaccines.

text: Una diri, nagpapanaug ang mandu ang Austria, Norway, kag Denmark nga indi na paggamiton ang AstraZeneca bangud sang malaka nga kaso sang severe blood clots sa mga tawo nga nabakunahan.
english: Earlier, Austria, Norway, and Denmark issued orders not to use AstraZeneca due to rare cases of severe blood clots in vaccinated people.

text: Halin sang nag-umpisa ang vaccination sa Malawi sang Marso, kapin 300,000 pa lang ang nabakunahan — malayo pa pa sa 11 million ka tawo ukon 60% sang populasyon nga amo ang target mabakunahan antes matapos ang tuig.
english: Since vaccination began in Malawi in March, just over 300,000 people have been vaccinated — a far cry from the 11 million people or 60% of the population who are targeted to be vaccinated before the end of the year.

text: — with reports from AFP
english: — with reports from AFP

text: Handa ang Hamas — ang Palestinian militant group sa Gaza Strip nga magpatigayon sang ceasefire agreement sa militar sang Israel sa duha ka kondisyon.
english: Hamas — the Palestinian militant group in the Gaza Strip is ready to facilitate a ceasefire agreement with the Israeli military on two conditions.

text: Suno kay Dr. Basem Naim, anay Palestinian health minister nga subong pinuno na sang international relations council sang Hamas, ginpakig-angutan na niya ang tanan nila nga partido nga batunon nila ang mutual ceasefire sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas apang sa duha ka kondisyon.
english: According to Dr. Basem Naim, former Palestinian health minister who now heads Hamas' international relations council, has contacted all parties to accept a mutual ceasefire between Israel and Hamas but on two conditions.

text: Una, dapat nga untaton na sang Israeli forces ang pagpang-atake sa Al-Asqa compound kag respetuhon ang ila nga lugar.
english: First, the Israeli forces should stop attacking the Al-Asqa compound and respect their territory.

text: Ika-duha, dapat nga untatan na sang Israel ang pagpatigayon sang forced evacuation sa mga Palestinian residents sa Sheikh Jarah neighborhood.
english: Second, Israel should stop conducting forced evacuation of Palestinian residents in the Sheikh Jarah neighborhood.

text: Pahayag ni Naim, ang ini nga mga kondisyon ang naangot sa international law kag indi kondisyon nga ginalauman sang Hamas authority.
english: Naim said these conditions are linked to international law and not conditions expected by the Hamas authorities.

text: Base naman sa statement sang opisina ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, ila ginabaton ang ceasefire.
english: According to a statement from the office of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, they accept the ceasefire.

text: Gilayon man ini nga ginkumpirma sang Hamas kag Islamic kag ginpahayag nga mahimo mapatuman ang ceasefire subong nga adlaw.
english: This was also immediately confirmed by Hamas and Islamic State and said that the ceasefire could be implemented today.

text: Mabaton sang mga empleyado sang Iloilo Provincial Government ang P47,000 nga incentives subong nga Disyembre.
english: Employees of the Iloilo Provincial Government will receive P47,000 incentives this December.

text: Ini kasunod man sang pag-apruba sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan sang Appropriation Ordinance No.
english: This follows the approval of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Appropriation Ordinance No.

text: 2024-04 kag Approrpiation Ordinance No.
english: 2024-04 and Appropriation Ordinance No.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 4th District Board Member Domingo Oso Jr., Chairman sang Committee on Appropriations sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan, iya ginpahayag nga ang ordinansa ang nagahatag sang supplemental budget no.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo 4th District Board Member Domingo Oso Jr., Chairman of the Committee on Appropriations in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, said the ordinance provides for supplemental budget no.

text: 3 kag no.
english: 3 and no.

text: 4 para Productivity Enhancement Incentive nga P5,000, Collective Negotiation Agreement Incentive nga P22,000, kag Service Recognition Incentive nga P20,000.
english: 4 for Productivity Enhancement Incentive of P5,000, Collective Negotiation Agreement Incentive of P22,000, and Service Recognition Incentive of P20,000.

text: Suno kay Oso, pagapirmahan na lang niya ang ordinansa agud nga maproseso kag mapirmahan ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Oso said he will sign the ordinance so that it can be processed and signed by Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga santo sa mandato sang Department of Budget and Management (DBM), kinahanglan nga indi maglapaw sa Disyembre 31 kag dapat mahatag na sa mga empleyado ang incentives.
english: He also said that according to the mandate of the Department of Budget and Management (DBM), it is necessary not to exceed December 31 and the employees should be given the incentives.

text: Lakip naman sa makabaton sang mga insentibo amo ang opisyal sang provincial government, regular, contractual, kag casual.
english: Among those who will receive incentives are provincial government officials, regular, contractual, and casual.

text: Samtang makabaton naman sang gratuity pay ang mga job hires.
english: Meanwhile, job hires will receive gratuity pay.

text: Liwat nga naghugot sang COVID-19 measures ang Singapore agud nga mapunggan ang paglapta sang infections bangud amat-amat na naman nga nagataas ang community cases.
english: Singapore has once again tightened COVID-19 measures to curb the spread of infections as community cases are slowly increasing.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Mercy Saavedra Cacan, gin-anunsyar sang Ministry of Health sang Singapore nga ibutang sa “Phase 2 (Heightened Aler)” ang pungsod nga nag-umpisa na sang Mayo 16 tubtob Hunyo 13 sa diin ginadumilian ang pagtililipon.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Mercy Saavedra Cacan, the Ministry of Health of Singapore announced that the country will be placed in “Phase 2 (Heightened Alert)” which started from May 16 to June 13 where gatherings are prohibited.

text: Ang klase ang ginkansela anay kag ginhimo nga full home based learning matapos nga pila ka mga estudyante ang nagpositibo sa COVID-19.
english: Classes were previously canceled and converted to full home based learning after several students tested positive for COVID-19.

text: Pahayag ni Cacan, bukas man ang tanan nga resturant apang ginadumili-an ang dine-in kag para lang ini sa take out.
english: Cacan said all restaurants are open but dine-in is prohibited and only for take out.

text: Sa bahin sang COVID-19 vaccine, duha lang ka mga bakuna may yara ang Singapore — ini ang Moderna kag Pfizer BioNTech.
english: In terms of the COVID-19 vaccine, Singapore has only two vaccines — these are Moderna and Pfizer BioNTech.

text: Patay ang 23 ka mga tawo kag 11 ang nasamaran matapos masunog ang isa ka convenience store sa Sonora, Mexico, kadungan sang selebrasyon sang Tigkalalag sa pungsod.
english: Twenty-three people were killed and 11 injured after a convenience store caught fire in Sonora, Mexico, during the country's Tigkalalag celebration.

text: Suno kay Carlos Freaner, presidente sang Mexican Red Cross, lakip sa mga biktima ang 12 ka mga babayi, 5 ka lalaki, kag 6 ka mga kabataan.
english: According to Carlos Freaner, president of the Mexican Red Cross, the victims included 12 women, 5 men, and 6 children.

text: Ginpahayag nga ang nagapanguna nga rason sang ila kamatayon amo ang paghaklo sang aso.
english: The leading cause of death was reported to be smoke inhalation.

text: Ginklaro naman sang lokal nga gobyerno sang Sonora nga ang insidente indi tuyo kag wala sing kahilabtanan sa terrorist attack, base sa mga nauna nga espekulasyon.
english: The local government of Sonora clarified that the incident was not intentional and had nothing to do with a terrorist attack, based on previous speculations.

text: Padayon subong ang imbestigasyon sa matuod nga kabangdanan sang sunog.
english: The investigation into the true cause of the fire is ongoing.

text: Samtang, sa isa ka social media post, nagpalab-ot sang pagpakig-unong si Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo kag ginpasiguro ang gilayon nga bulig sang gobyerno sa mga pamilya sang mga napatay.
english: Meanwhile, in a social media post, Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo expressed her condolences and assured the government's immediate assistance to the families of the victims.

text: Ginkabos ang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala nga makahimo sang panibag-o nga upset sa ila liwat nga pagkitaay sang Polish player kag world no.
english: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala is expected to cause a new upset in their rematch with the Polish player and world no.

text: 2 nga si Iga Swiatek.
english: 2 Iga Swiatek.

text: Natabo ang rematch sa Round of 64 sa 2025 Mutua Madrid Open matapos ang natabo sa Miami Open kun sa diin ginlutos sang Pinay si Swiatek nga isa ka five-time Grand Slam champion, 6-2, 7-5.
english: The rematch took place in the Round of 64 at the 2025 Mutua Madrid Open after the Miami Open where the Filipina defeated Swiatek, a five-time Grand Slam champion, 6-2, 7-5.

text: Sa clay court sa Madrid kagab-i, Abril 24, nakuha sang 19-anyos nga si Eala ang first set, 6-4, apang napatas ini sang Polish sa 1-1 matapos nakuha ang second frame, 6-4.
english: On the clay court in Madrid last night, April 24, 19-year-old Eala won the first set, 6-4, but the Polish tied it 1-1 after winning the second frame, 6-4.

text: Nabatyagan ang pressure sa third set nga amo ang magatumod sang magadaog, kag didto na nga wala na nasustiner ni Eala ang hampang kun sa diin naglabaw ang mas eksperyensyado nga player, 6-2.
english: The pressure was felt in the third set that would determine the winner, and that's when Eala couldn't sustain the game where the more experienced player won, 6-2.

text: Bangud sa pagpalaam sa Madrid, magatutok naman ang world no.
english: Due to the farewell to Madrid, the world no.

text: 72 nga Filipino pride sa preparasyon sini sa WTA 125 Challenger Catalonia Open sa Espanya nga maga-umpisa naman sa Abril 28.
english: 72 Filipino pride in preparation for the WTA 125 Challenger Catalonia Open in Spain which will start on April 28.

text: Antes mo pakaslan ang isa ka tawo, daw ano mo ayhan ini kakilala?
english: Before you marry someone, how well do you know them?

text: Ini nga istorya ang magahatag sa leksyon sa aton nga indi magpahinali kundi dapat nga mangin mahinalungon gid sa pagpili sang tawo nga higugmaon.
english: This story will teach us not to be in a hurry but to be very careful in choosing the person to love.

text: Sa Indonesia, may 26-anyos nga lalaki nga sobra-sobra gid ang paghigugma sa babaye nga bag-o lang sini nakilala.
english: In Indonesia, a 26-year-old man was madly in love with a woman he had just met.

text: Nagkilalahay sila paagi lamang sa internet, kag sa una nila nga pagkitaay, baw, na-love-at-first-sight gid dayon ang lalaki sa babaye!
english: They met online, and at first sight, the man fell in love with the woman!

text: Masami nga may takop nga belo ang nawong sang babaye, kag ginpinsar sang lalaki nga basi mahuyaon lang ini.
english: The woman often wore a veil over her face, and the man thought that she might be shy.

text: Bangud gusto gid niya ang babaye, ginpadayon nila ang pag-date kag sang ulihi, ginhagad nga magpakasal.
english: Because he really liked the woman, they continued dating and eventually, were asked to marry.

text: Nagsugot ang babaye apang naghingyo nga indi lang pag-iparehistro ang kasal bangud nga bag-o lang napatay ang iya iloy kag madugay naman nga nangindulaan ang iya amay gani nga wala man ini sang imbitaron.
english: The woman agreed but asked not to register the marriage because her mother had just died and her father had been missing for a long time so she had no one to invite.

text: Abril 12, 2024 sang nagsugtanay sila sa secret marriage sa atubang sang isa ka religious leader sa Wangunjaya Village kun sa diin nagaistar ang lalaki.
english: April 12, 2024 when they agreed to a secret marriage in front of a religious leader in Wangunjaya Village where the man lives.

text: Apang bisan kasado na ang duha, wala pa gihapon ginakakas sang babaye ang belo, wala man ini naga-istorya sa iban nga paryente sang iya bana, kag labi sa tanan, wala sila sang honeymoon!
english: But even though the two are married, the woman still does not remove the veil, she does not talk to other relatives of her husband, and most of all, they do not have a honeymoon!

text: Isa ka semana ang nagligad pagkatapos sang kasal, indi na makaagwanta ang lalaki gani nagpangayo sang bulig sa mga paryente.
english: A week later after the wedding, the man could not take it anymore and sought help from relatives.

text: Eksakto 12 ka adlaw matapos ang ila kasal sang nadiskubrehan sini nga ang iya bride, indi gali matahum nga babaye, kundi isa man ka lalaki!
english: Exactly 12 days after their wedding, he discovered that his bride was not a beautiful woman, but a man!

text: Nakit-an man nila ang tatay sini nga amo naman ang nag-sorry sa nahimo sang iya anak.
english: They also saw his father who apologized for what his son had done.

text: Sa bulig sang mga pulis, napaako ang bride sa iya nga sala, kag nagdepensa man ini nga nahimo lamang niya ini para sa kuwarta.
english: With the help of the police, the bride was able to plead guilty, and she also defended that she had done it only for money.

text: Nagapangatubang subong ang bride sang kaso nga paglapas sa Article 378 sang Criminal Code sang Indonesia kag posible mapreso sa sulod sang apat ka tuig.
english: The bride is now facing charges of violating Article 378 of the Indonesian Criminal Code and could face up to four years in prison.

text: Nagpahanumdom naman ang Religious Affairs Office nga malikawan ini nga mga insidente kun ginahikot sang bride kag groom nga opisyal nga ipa-rehistro ang ila nga kasal.
english: The Religious Affairs Office reminded that these incidents can be avoided if the bride and groom officially register their marriage.

text: SADTONG 2018 pa nakabaton ang Presidential Anti-Corruption Commission (PACC), nga ginapangunahan ni Ginoong Dante Jimenez, sang 411 ka reklamo angot sa ginasiling nga korapsyon (corruption) sa nagakalain-lain nga departmento kag ahensya sang gobyerno.
english: Since 2018, the Presidential Anti-Corruption Commission (PACC), headed by Mr. Dante Jimenez, has received 411 complaints regarding alleged corruption in various government departments and agencies.

text: Ini nga mga reklamo nabaton sang PACC halin Marso tubtub Setyembre sang ina man nga tuig 2018.
english: These complaints were received by the PACC from March to September of the same year 2018.

text: Ang  59 sini “verifiable” nga complaints.
english: Of these, 59 were “verifiable” complaints.

text: Suportado, sunu sa PACC, sang mga dokumento, nga ang kalabananan sini ginatudlo sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: Supported, according to the PACC, by documents, most of which are pointed to the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: DPWH secretary Mark Villar nagpasalig nga aksyonan niya ining mga reklamo.
english: DPWH secretary Mark Villar assured that he will act on these complaints.

text: Angot diri, gintukod kuno ni Villar ang Task ForceAgainst Graft and Corruption (TAG) sa idalom sang Department Order 101-2020, agud imbestigaran ining reklamo sang korapsyon batok sa mga opisyales sang DPWH upod sa iban pa nga opisyales sang gobyerno.
english: In this regard, Villar allegedly established the Task ForceAgainst Graft and Corruption (TAG) under Department Order 101-2020, to investigate this complaint of corruption against DPWH officials along with other government officials.

text: Pero, diin na ang ginpasalig niya nga imbestigasyon kay tubtub subong wala man gani batia?
english: But, where is the investigation he promised because until now nothing has been heard?

text: Okey, so may ginhimo gid man si Secretary Villar parti sa mga kabulastugan dira sa DPWH.
english: Okay, so Secretary Villar did something about the corruption in the DPWH.

text: Siling niya may 30 ka contractor na ang na-blacklist.
english: He said 30 contractors have already been blacklisted.
