text: May ginapatuman man kuno ang iya upisina sang mga reporma, katulad sang Infra-Track App batok sa ghost projects paagi sa geotagging kag drone monitoring.
english: His office is also said to be implementing reforms, such as the Infra-Track App against ghost projects through geotagging and drone monitoring.

text: Subong man ang Civil Works App, nga naga-eliminar sang compliance monitoring.
english: As well as the Civil Works App, which eliminates compliance monitoring.

text: Yara man kuno ang Project and Contract Management Application or PCMA, nga centralized database nga nagapatigayon sang “real-time” updating kag nagapadasig sang analysis kag problem resolution sa project/contract level.
english: There is also said to be the Project and Contract Management Application or PCMA, which is a centralized database that facilitates “real-time” updating and speeds up analysis and problem resolution at the project/contract level.

text: Pero daw nalipatan na lang ang ining mga reklamo sa korapsyon dira sa DPWH, tubtub nga ginkwestyon ang proposed allocation sang DPWH sa 2021 National Budget sa Senate hearing sadtong Oktubre 2020.
english: But it seems that these complaints of corruption in the DPWH were forgotten, until the proposed allocation of the DPWH in the 2021 National Budget was questioned in the Senate hearing in October 2020.

text: Ginkwestyon ni Senador Panfilo Lacson ang “lumpsum appropriations” para sa DPWH.
english: Senator Panfilo Lacson questioned the “lumpsum appropriations” for the DPWH.

text: Wala seguro malipat si Lacson sa mga anomaliya angot sa pork barrel sang nagliligad nga pang-gobyerno, sa diin gintugyan sa kada congressmen kag senador ang paggasto sini sa kon diin nila luyag.
english: Lacson probably did not forget the anomalies regarding the pork barrel of the previous administration, where each congressman and senator was entrusted to spend it wherever they wanted.

text: Ang resulta, daku nga bahin sini ang nagtupa lang sa personal nga bulsa nila, nga ang iban indi gani mahibal-an kon diin pangitaon sang COA.
english: As a result, much of it fell into their personal pockets, with some not even knowing where to look for a COA.

text: Sa sining Senate budget hearing, nagpahayag si PACC commissioner Greco Belgica sadtong Oktubre 24, 2020 nga gin-otorisahan na ang PACC ni Secretary Villar agud imbestigaran ining mga reklamo sa korapsyon nga ginbaton sini sadtong Marso tubtub Setyembre 2020.
english: In this Senate budget hearing, PACC commissioner Greco Belgica said on October 24, 2020 that the PACC has been authorized by Secretary Villar to investigate these corruption complaints that it received from March to September 2020.

text: Subong lang?
english: Just now?

text: Pagkaligad lang sang duha ka tuig?
english: Just two years later?

text: Daw bao kon maglakat ba!
english: It's like a widow walking!

text: Aba, may lista gani kuno sila sang mga lawmakers (congreesmen kag/ukon senador) nga involved sa korapsyon dira sa DPWH!
english: Well, they even have a list of lawmakers (congressmen and/or senators) who are involved in corruption in the DPWH!

text: Nahimo ini seguro sining mg lawmakers sa madamo nga pahito kag paggamit sang ila impluwensya sa mga opisyales sang DPWH agud padag-on ang ila paborito nga mga contractor, nga lakip na syempre ang ila komisyon sa ilegal nga transaksyon.
english: These lawmakers have probably done this in many ways and using their influence on DPWH officials to win their favorite contractors, which includes of course their commission in illegal transactions.

text: Sunu sa Global Infrastructure Anti-Corruption Centre (GIACC), ining corrupt practices nagalakip sang “bribery, extortion, fraud, deception, collusion, cartel, abuse of power, embezzlement, trading and money laundering”.
english: According to the Global Infrastructure Anti-Corruption Center (GIACC), these corrupt practices include “bribery, extortion, fraud, deception, collusion, cartel, abuse of power, embezzlement, trading and money laundering”.

text: Tungod sini, ginpamilit ni Senador Panfilo Lacson, nga chairman sang naga-imbestigar nga Senate Committee, kag ni Senate President Tito Sotto nga ipabutyag ang ila ngalan agud pasabton sa Senate hearing.
english: Because of this, Senator Panfilo Lacson, chairman of the investigating Senate Committee, and Senate President Tito Sotto insisted that their names be revealed for accountability in the Senate hearing.

text: Namalibad si Belgica sa paghatag sang mga ngalan sining mga lamakers, kay basi ma-compromise kuno ang imbestigasyon.
english: Belgica declined to give the names of these lamakers, saying it might compromise the investigation.

text: Aba, public officials sila kag dapat lang makahibalo ang publiko sang mga akusasyon sa ila, nga kabahin sang oversight function sang Kongreso.
english: Well, they are public officials and the public should just know about the accusations against them, which is part of the oversight function of Congress.

text: Paagi sini maunahan na tapna ang ano man nga kabulustugan sang aton mga suluguon sang banwa, sa kabug-usan, bag-o idangop ang ila kaso sa husgado.
english: This will prevent any corruption of our public servants, as a whole, before their case is brought to court.

text: In fact, kon ginhingadlan gani ang anom ka partylist lawmakers kag ginpatawag (wala ugaling sila ka-attend) sa Senate hearing sadtong Nobyembre 3, 2020 sa isyu sang red-tagging, ngaa abe indi mahingadlan ining mga kasubong nila nga mga lawmakers kag ipatubang sa Senate hearing?
english: In fact, if the six partylist lawmakers were named and summoned (but they did not attend) to the Senate hearing on November 3, 2020 on the issue of red-tagging, why not name these fellow lawmakers and bring them to the Senate hearing?

text: Ano gid abe ang ila kinalain kay pareho man sila nga mga lawmakers?
english: What's the difference between them because they're both lawmakers?

text: Tsk, tsk, tsk!/PN
english: Tsk, tsk, tsk!/PN

text: Modernisasyon ang isa sa mga ginatudlo nga rason kun ngaa may overloading sa mga pampubliko nga salakyan.
english: Modernization is one of the reasons cited for overloading of public transportation.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elmer Forro, Secretary General sang Bayan Panay, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa modernisasyon, 172,000 traditional jeepneys ang nadula sa operasyon sa bilog nga pungsod kag 128,000 nalang ang padayun nga nagabyahe.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Elmer Forro, Secretary General of Bayan Panay, said that due to modernization, 172,000 traditional jeepneys have disappeared from operation nationwide and only 128,000 continue to operate.

text: Ginpakigbahin man niya nga sa siudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo, yara na lang sa masobra 1,700 ang padayun nga naga-operar nga jeep halin sa 2,500 nga numero sini.
english: He also shared that in Iloilo City and province, there are only more than 1,700 jeeps that are still operating out of 2,500.

text: Suno kay Forro, may yara lang sang 60,000 ka mga modernized jeepney ang pungsod kun sa diin kulang gid ini para sa publiko.
english: According to Forro, the country has only 60,000 modernized jeepneys which is a shortage for the public.

text: Pahayag man niya nga na-antisipar na nila nga magatuga sang public transportation crisis ang nasambit nga modernisasyon samtang nga ginaduso palang ini.
english: He said they have already anticipated that the said modernization will cause a public transportation crisis while it is still being proposed.

text: Dugang pa niya nga nagakapilitan nalang man nga magsakay ang mga pasahero sa nagaginutok nga modernized jeep bangud nga magamay lang ang nagabyahe nga pampubliko nga salakyan.
english: He added that passengers are forced to ride in crowded modernized jeeps because there are few public transportation.

text: ILOILO CITY- Target sang kamara nga maaprubahan na sa masunod nga semana ang proposed economic amendments sa konstitusyon kadungan sang pag -resume sang interpellation kag debate kahapon.
english: ILOILO CITY – The House of Representatives targets to approve the proposed economic amendments to the constitution next week with the resumption of interpellation and debate yesterday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 3rd District Representative Lorenz Defensor, vice-chair sang Committee on Constitutional Reforms sa kamara, iya ginpahayag nga santo sa timeline nga gintalana ni House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco bag-o ang adjournment sa Hunyo 5, target nga sa masunod nga semana na maaprubahan sa second reading ang Resolution of Both House No.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo 3rd District Representative Lorenz Defensor, vice-chair of the Committee on Constitutional Reforms in the House of Representatives, said that according to the timeline set by House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco before the adjournment on June 5, the target is to approve the second resolution of the House of Representatives next week.

text: Suno kay Defensor, may yara pa sang pila ka mga interpellators kag mangin siya ang may iga- propose man nga pila pa gid ka mga amendments sa resolution para sa mas maathag kag klaro nga mga probisyon.
english: According to Defensor, there are still some interpellators and he will also propose some more amendments to the resolution for clearer provisions.

text: Ginpasiguro naman sang Ilonggo nga mamalidha nga wala sang political provision kag nagasentro lang sa economic provisions ang ginaduso nga mga amendments sa konstitusyon.
english: The Ilonggo lawmaker assured that the proposed amendments to the constitution have no political provisions and focus only on economic provisions.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang nasambit nga resolusyon nagaduso nga pahanugutan ang kongreso nga magpasar sang layi nga magabukas sang ekonomiya para sa mas madamo nga foreign investments bilang kabahin sang pagtinguha nga makarecover gikan sa recession nga gintuga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The resolution proposes to allow Congress to pass legislation that will open the economy to more foreign investments as part of efforts to recover from the recession caused by the COVID-19 pandemic.

text:
Ang RBH2 naga- propose sang amendments sa economic provisions sa konstitusyon sa idalom sang Articles XII (National Patrimony and Economy), XIV (Education, Science and Technology) and XVI (General Provisions)paagi sa pagdugang sang mga tinaga nga “unless otherwise provided by law.”

Sa tion nga maaprubahan sa second kag third and final reading, ipasa ini sang kamara sa senado agud debatehan man sang mga senador ang proposed amendments.
english:
RBH2 proposes amendments to the economic provisions in the constitution under Articles XII (National Patrimony and Economy), XIV (Education, Science and Technology) and XVI (General Provisions) by adding the words “unless otherwise provided by law.”

Once approved on second and third and final reading, the chamber will forward it to the senate for senators to debate the proposed amendments.

text: Samtang, sa pahayag naman ni anay Senate President Juan Ponce Enrile nga kinahanglan sang pagbag-o sa konstitusyon agud mas mahatagan sang prayoridad ang enhancement sang armadong kusog sang Pilipinas sa tunga sang tensyon sa West Philippine Sea batok sa China, ginpahayag ni Defensor nga indi pa niya gusto ini sugilanunan.
english: Meanwhile, on the statement of former Senate President Juan Ponce Enrile that the constitution needs to be amended to give more priority to the enhancement of the Philippine armed forces amid tensions in the West Philippine Sea against China, Defensor said he does not want to talk about it.

text: Suno sa iya, unahon anay nila nga tutukan ang mga amendments sa economic provisions sa konstitusyon.
english: He said they will first focus on the amendments to the economic provisions of the constitution.

text: Para sa mamalidha, ang importante sa subong amo nga manindugan ang gobyerno kag tungdan ang obligasyon nga protihiran ang teritoryo sang Pilipinas.
english: For the lawmaker, the important thing now is that the government stands up and fulfills its obligation to protect the territory of the Philippines.

text: Malip-ot lang ang nabatyagan nga kalinong sa Israel kag Gaza City bangud liwat naman nga nagbalik ang bombahanay, pagpalupad sang rockets, kag pag-atake sang mga warplanes.
english: The calm in Israel and Gaza City was short-lived as bombing, rocket fire, and warplane attacks resumed.

text: Sa mga banwa sa West Bank, nagtipon ang grupo sang mga Palestinians lakip na ang Hamas militants agud manawagan sang mass strikes.
english: In West Bank towns, groups of Palestinians including Hamas militants gathered to call for mass strikes.

text: Suno sa Palestine Liberation Organization, ang prayoridad sang Palestinian political leadership amo nga makumbinse ang Israel nga untaton na ang pagpamatay kag pagmassacre sa mga tawo sa Gaza.
english: According to the Palestine Liberation Organization, the priority of the Palestinian political leadership is to convince Israel to stop killing and massacring people in Gaza.

text: Suno sa Gaza Ministry of Health, nagsaka na sa 213 ka tawo ang patay lakip na ang 61 ka kabataan samtag 1,400 naman ang napilasan bangud sang hitabo.
english: According to the Gaza Ministry of Health, the death toll has risen to 213, including 61 children, while 1,400 have been injured.

text: 2,500 ka Palestinians ang wala na sang balay subong samtang 52,000 ang makonsiderar nga displaced suno sa United Nations.
english: 2,500 Palestinians are now homeless while 52,000 are considered displaced, according to the United Nations.

text: 450 naman ka mga building ang naguba.
english: 450 buildings were destroyed.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Jhane Sia, tumandok sang Cavite kag subong yara sa Ashkelon, Israel, wala sila sang bomb shelter sa ila nga balay gani nga sa kilid lang siya sang pader nagapanago.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Jhane Sia, a native of Cavite and now in Ashkelon, Israel, they do not have a bomb shelter in their house so he is hiding next to the wall.

text: Suno kay Sia, halos lima ka asud-asud nga siren ang iya nga nabatian sa sulod lang sang isa ka adlaw.
english: According to Sia, she heard almost five sirens in just one day.

text: Halos isa ka semana naman nga wala siya sang tulog bangud Lunes sang nagligad nga semana nag-umpisa ang masingki nga away.
english: He has not slept for almost a week because the violent fight started on Monday last week.

text: Kahapon, sa ila nga lugar, isa ang patay kag apat ang kritikal ang kondisyon.
english: Yesterday, in their area, one person died and four were in critical condition.

text: Bangud sa nagasingki nga away sa tunga sang Israel kag militante sa Gaza, padayon man ang panawagan sang iban nga mga pungsod sang ceasefire.
english: Due to the escalating fighting between Israel and militants in Gaza, other countries continue to call for a ceasefire.

text: Lakip sa nagasuporta sa ceasefire amo sanday German Chancellor Angela Merkel kag US President Joe Biden.
english: Among those supporting the ceasefire are German Chancellor Angela Merkel and US President Joe Biden.

text: Mas ginpabudlay pa sang bagyo ang coronavirus response sa India nga subong may yara na sang masobra 25 million COVID-19 cases.
english: The typhoon has further complicated the coronavirus response in India, which now has more than 25 million COVID-19 cases.

text: Kumplikado ang health crisis sa western states sang Gujarat kag Maharashtra, mga estado nga gin-igu man sang ikaduha nga wave sang pandemya.
english: The health crisis is complicated in the western states of Gujarat and Maharashtra, states that were also hit by the second wave of the pandemic.

text: Ginapatigayon subong ang COVID-19 test sa 200,000 ka mga tawo nga gin-evacuate halin sa coastal districts sang Gujarat.
english: COVID-19 test is now being conducted on 200,000 people evacuated from the coastal districts of Gujarat.

text: Suno sa mga opisyal sa syudad sang Ahmedabad sa Gujarat, ginahitso man nga madugangan ang mga face masks para sa mga tawo nga yara subong sa shelter homes.
english: According to officials in the city of Ahmedabad in Gujarat, face masks are also being increased for people currently in shelter homes.

text: Sa subong, 25.23 million na ang COVID-19 cases sa India santo sa data sang health ministry samtang nagsaka naman sa 278,719 ang numero sang mga napatay.
english: There are currently 25.23 million COVID-19 cases in India, according to health ministry data, while the death toll has risen to 278,719.

text: Sin-o bala ang indi makibot kun i-donar lang sang isa ka tawo ang kwarta nga ginsupot niya sa iya halos bug-os nga kabuhi?
english: Who wouldn't be surprised if someone donated the money he's been saving all his life?

text: Ini man ang nabatyagan ni Mayor Katsuaki Kamiji sang Yokosuka sa Japan matapos nabaton halin sa wala nagpakilala nga tigulang ang 60 million yen ukon kapin P26.4 million nga cash.
english: Mayor Katsuaki Kamiji of Yokosuka in Japan felt the same way after receiving 60 million yen or more than P26.4 million in cash from an anonymous elderly man.

text: Ginapahayag nga personal nga nagpadulong sa city hall ang lalaki nga ginabanta nagaedad 70 tubtob 80 anyos kag ginhingyo nga ihatag sa alkalde ang backpack nga may unod nga sulat.
english: The man, believed to be in his 70s and 80s, personally went to the city hall and asked the mayor to give him the backpack containing the letter.

text: Sa sulat, nakasaad nga idonar niya ang kwarta nga naglab-ot 60 million yen.
english: In the letter, he promised to donate the money amounting to 60 million yen.

text: Ginsupot niya ang amo nga kwarta halin sang Grade One pa lang siya.
english: He had been saving the money since he was in Grade One.

text: Nagpamalibad ang lalaki nga magpakilala.
english: The man declined to identify himself.

text: Indi naman makapati kag natandog gid ang balatyagon sang alkalde bangud sang nabaton nga donasyon ilabi na sa tion sang pandemya.
english: The mayor was incredulous and touched by the donation received especially during the pandemic.

text: Santo sa report, indi bag-o sa Japan ang amo sini ka dalagku nga donasyon.
english: According to the report, such large donations are not new to Japan.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, isa ka lalaki ang nagpadulong man sa city hall sa Nara kag nagbilin sang bag nga may unod nga cash nga 30 million agud nga ibulig man sa edukasyon kag sa mga pigado.
english: Last year, a man also went to the city hall in Nara and left a bag containing cash of 30 million to help education and the poor.

text: Sang nagligad man nga tuig, may wala man nagpakilala nga tawo nga nagdonar sang five million yen in cash sa isa ka ospital sa Kobe.
english: Last year, an anonymous donor donated five million yen in cash to a hospital in Kobe.

text: Mangin mas ‘merry’ na gid ang Paskwa sang mga empleyado sang Iloilo Provincial Government bangud mabaton na subong nga Disyembre ang P47,000 nga incentives.
english: The Christmas of the employees of the Iloilo Provincial Government will be more merry because they will receive the P47,000 incentives this December.

text: Sang damlag lang, naaprubahan sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan ang Appropriation Ordinance No.
english: Recently, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan approved Appropriation Ordinance No.

text: 2024-04 kag Approrpiation Ordinance No.
english: 2024-04 and Appropriation Ordinance No.

text: 2024-05 —- ang ordinansa nga naga-authorize sang supplemental budget no.
english: 2024-05 —- the ordinance authorizing supplemental budget no.

text: 3 kag no.
english: 3 and no.

text: 4 para sa Collective Negotiation Agreement Incentive nga P22,000, Service Recognition Incentive nga P20,000 kag Productivity Enhancement Incentive nga P5,000.
english: 4 for Collective Negotiation Agreement Incentive of P22,000, Service Recognition Incentive of P20,000 and Productivity Enhancement Incentive of P5,000.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 4th District Board Member Domingo Oso Jr., Chairman sang Committee on Appropriations, iya ginpahayag nga pirmado na niya ang appropriation ordinance kag hulaton na lang ang pirma ni Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo 4th District Board Member Domingo Oso Jr., Chairman of the Committee on Appropriations, said he has already signed the appropriation ordinance and will wait for the signature of Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: agud nga mahatag na sang Provincial Treasurer.
english: so that it can be given by the Provincial Treasurer.

text: Suno kay Oso, mahatag ang incentives sa mga empleyado antes magtakop ang tuig 2024 bangud base sa guidelines sang Department of Budget and Management, kinahanglan ihatag ang incentives nga indi maglapaw sa Disyembre 31, 2024.
english: According to Oso, the incentives will be given to the employees before the end of 2024 because based on the guidelines of the Department of Budget and Management, the incentives must be given no later than December 31, 2024.

text: Base naman sa nangin pahayag sang Association of Iloilo Provincial Government Employees, P15,000 lang kuntani ang Collective Negotiation Incentive nga mabaton sang mga empleyado apang naghimo sang position paper ang mga mga employees halin sa Rep.
english: According to the Association of Iloilo Provincial Government Employees, the Collective Negotiation Incentive was supposed to be P15,000 but the employees from Rep.

text: Pedro G. Trono Memorial Hospital sa Guimbal nga nagahingyo sang dugang nga pondo.
english: Pedro G. Trono Memorial Hospital in Guimbal requesting additional funds.

text: Bangud sini, ginpakig-angotan sang gobernador ang Department of Budget and Management kag ginpaboran sang ahenya ang request sang mga empleyado rason nga gindugangan ang P15,000 sang P7,000 nga nangin P22,000.
english: The governor contacted the Department of Budget and Management and the agency approved the request of the employees, increasing the P15,000 from P7,000 to P22,000.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang makabaton sang kabug-usan nga P47,000 incentives amo ang mga regular, casual, contractual, appointive kag elective officials sang Iloilo Provincial Government.
english: It is known that the recipients of a total of P47,000 incentives are regular, casual, contractual, appointive and elective officials of the Iloilo Provincial Government.

text: Ang mga job hires kag contract of service workers naman ang magabaton sang gratuity pay.
english: Job hires and contract of service workers will receive gratuity pay.

text: Patigayunon na 8:00 subong nga aga oras sa Pilipinas ang 97th Oscars ukon ang Academy Awards nga amo ang pinakamataas nga pagkilala sa industriya sang pelikula.
english: The 97th Oscars or the Academy Awards, the highest recognition in the film industry, will be held at 8:00 this morning Philippine time.

text: Balantayan ang pila sa pinakadaku nga pangalan sa Hollywood sa star-studded kag red-carpet ceremony sa Dolby Theatre sa Ovation Hollywood sa Los Angeles, California, United States.
english: Watch some of the biggest names in Hollywood at the star-studded and red-carpet ceremony at the Dolby Theater at Ovation Hollywood in Los Angeles, California, United States.

text: Ang Emmy Award-winning television host, writer, producer, kag comedian nga si Conan O’Brien amo ang mangin host sa programa.
english: Emmy Award-winning television host, writer, producer, and comedian Conan O’Brien will host the program.

text: Sa lista sang nominees, nagapanguna ang Spanish-language French musical crime comedy film nga Emilia Pérez nga may 13 nominations; ang epic period drama film nga The Brutalist nga may 10; kag ang musical fantasy film nga Wicked nga may 10 man ka mga nominasyon lakip na ang 1st Oscar nod para kay Ariana Grande sa Best Supporting Actress.
english: Leading the list of nominees is the Spanish-language French musical crime comedy film Emilia Pérez with 13 nominations; the epic period drama film The Brutalist with 10; and the musical fantasy film Wicked which also had 10 nominations including the 1st Oscar nod for Ariana Grande for Best Supporting Actress.

text: Naga-agaway para sa Best Picture award amo ang masunod: Anora, The Brutalist, A Complete Unknown, Conclave, Dune: Part Two, Emilia Pérez, I’m Still Here, Nickel Boys, The Substance, kag Wicked.
english: Competing for the Best Picture award are the following: Anora, The Brutalist, A Complete Unknown, Conclave, Dune: Part Two, Emilia Pérez, I’m Still Here, Nickel Boys, The Substance, and Wicked.

text: Yara man sa line-up sang presenters sanday Gal Gadot, Andrew Garfield, Selena Gomez, Oprah Winfrey, Joe Alwyn, kag madamo nga iban pa nga celebrities.
english: Also in the line-up of presenters are Gal Gadot, Andrew Garfield, Selena Gomez, Oprah Winfrey, Joe Alwyn, and many other celebrities.

text: Magaabot man sa seremonya ang nakakuha sa pinakamataas nga acting awards sang nagligad nga tuig nga amo sanday Emma Stone, Robert Downey Jr., Cillian Murphy, kag Da’Vine Joy Randolph.
english: Also attending the ceremony will be last year’s top acting award winners Emma Stone, Robert Downey Jr., Cillian Murphy, and Da’Vine Joy Randolph.

text: Ang magadaog sa Oscars ang ginapili sang ginabanta 11,000 actors, producers, directors kag film craftspeople sa idalom sang Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences.
english: The winner of the Oscars is chosen by approximately 11,000 actors, producers, directors and film craftspeople under the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences.

text: Subong nga tuig, wala sang bisan isa sa 10 ka best picture contenders ang gin-shoot sa Los Angeles apisar nga ini ang ginakabig nga puluy-an sang pinakadalagku nga film companies sa masobra na isa ka siglo.
english: This year, none of the 10 best picture contenders were shot in Los Angeles despite it being considered the home of the biggest film companies for more than a century.

text: Ini nga seremonya ang isa man sa una nga pinakadaku nga hiwaton sa Los Angeles matapos ang natabo nga lapnagon nga wildfires sang Enero nga nangin rason man kun ngaa duha ka beses nga nakanselar ang Academy Awards.
english: The ceremony is also one of the first large-scale events to be held in Los Angeles since the widespread wildfires in January that also caused the Academy Awards to be canceled twice.

text: Ginalauman nga mahambalan man ang wildfires sa sini nga event, direkta man ukon paagi sa tema, kag makahatag man sang donasyon ang viewers sa programa.
english: Wildfires are also expected to be discussed at this event, either directly or through the theme, and viewers will also be able to donate to the program.

text: Nagdaug ang Pinay tennis sensation kag world no.
english: The Filipino tennis sensation and world no.

text: 72 nga si Alex Eala sa pagbukas sang iya campaign sa Madrid Open.
english: 72 Alex Eala to open his campaign at the Madrid Open.

text: In matapos siya nangibabaw batok sa Bulgarian nga si Viktoriya Tomova, sa score nga 6-3, 6-2,sa Round of 128 kahapon sa Spain.
english: In after she prevailed against Bulgarian Viktoriya Tomova, with a score of 6-3, 6-2, in the Round of 128 yesterday in Spain.

text: Si Tomova ang ranked 64 sa world rankings.
english: Tomova is ranked 64 in the world rankings.

text: Bangud sa kadalag-an, sunod nga atubangon ni Eala si Iga Swiatek sa Round of 64.
english: With the victory, Eala will next face Iga Swiatek in the Round of 64.

text: Una na nag-atubangay sanday Eala kag Swiatek sa Miami Open kun sa diin nagdaug ang Pinay batok sa world no.
english: Eala and Swiatek first faced each other at the Miami Open where the Filipina won against world no.

text: 2 sa quarterfinals sang United States tournament.
english: 2 in the quarterfinals of the United States tournament.

text: Nagapanguna sa Bagong Sinag Class of 2024 sang Philippine Military Academy ang babaye nga anak sang isa ka mangunguma.
english: The daughter of a farmer is leading the Bagong Sinag Class of 2024 of the Philippine Military Academy.

text: Ini amo si Cadet First Class Jeneth Elumba, 24, residente sang Surigao del Norte, kag ika-pito nga babaye nga PMA Class valedictorian halin sang nagsugod ang akademya sa pagbaton sang mga babaye nga kadete sang 1993.
english: This is Cadet First Class Jeneth Elumba, 24, a resident of Surigao del Norte, and the seventh female PMA Class valedictorian since the academy began accepting female cadets in 1993.

text: Siya man ang magabaton sang Presidential Saber, ang Philippine Army Saber, Joint United States Military Assistance Group (Jusmag) Saber, Australian Defense Best Overall Performance Award (Army), kag Tactics Group Award.
english: He will also receive the Presidential Saber, the Philippine Army Saber, Joint United States Military Assistance Group (Jusmag) Saber, Australian Defense Best Overall Performance Award (Army), and Tactics Group Award.

text:
Sa 278 nga myembro sang Class of 2024, pito ka mga babaye ang nalakip sa Top 10 suno sa PMA nga amo sanday:

Cyril Joy Masculino (4th place)Rosemel Dogello (5th place)Alexa Mye Balen (6th place)Giselle Tong (8th place)Danica Marie Viray (9th place), kagNeriva Binag (10th place)

Nagapangaduha si Mark Armuel Boiles, pangatlo si Kim Harold Gilo kag pang-pito si Floyd Niño Arthur Roxas sang Iloilo.
english:
Of the 278 members of the Class of 2024, seven women were included in the Top 10 according to the PMA, namely:

Cyril Joy Masculino (4th place)Rosemel Dogello (5th place)Alexa Mye Balen (6th place)Giselle Tong (8th place)Danica Marie Viray (9th place), andNeriva Binag (10th place)

Mark Armuel Boiles came second, Kim Harold Gilo came third and Floyd Niño Arthur Roxas of Iloilo came seventh.

text:
Ang lista sang topnotchers ang gin-anunsyo sa Longayban Hall, Fort General Gregorio H. Del Pilar sa Baguio City, Mayo 10, samtang ang graduation naman ang patigayunon sa Borromeo Field sa PMA sa Mayo 18.#

Photo: Screengrab from the official Facebook page of the Philippine Military Academy
english:
The list of topnotchers was announced at Longayban Hall, Fort General Gregorio H. Del Pilar in Baguio City, May 10, while the graduation will be held at Borromeo Field in PMA on May 18.#

Photo: Screengrab from the official Facebook page of the Philippine Military Academy

text: Naubos sunog kag wala gid sang may nasalbar ang isa ka iloy sa mga gamit nga gin-amat-amat bakal sini sa iya duwa ka bulan nga bata.
english: A mother was burned down and could not save any of the items she had gradually bought for her two-month-old child.

text: Ini kasunod sang natabo nga sunog sa Benedicto, Jaro kahapon.
english: This follows a fire in Benedicto, Jaro yesterday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mary Joy Lopez, iya ginpahayag nga nalakip man sa nasunog ang gintingob sini bakal nga mga diapers, wipes, duha ka kilo nga gatas, kag iban pa nga kagamitan sang ila bata nga suno pa sa iya ila gid kuntani ginsuptan sang iya partner.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mary Joy Lopez said that among the items burned were the diapers, wipes, two kilos of milk, and other belongings of their child that she said they should have taken with her partner.

text: Suno pa sa iya naubos man dala sa sunog ang ginbakal nila nga mga gamit para sa bunyag sang ila bata sa Abril kaangay sang mga souvenir para sa mga maninoy kag maninay.
english: She said the fire also destroyed the items they bought for their son's baptism in April such as souvenirs for the in-laws.

text: Sa pihak sang natabo, nagapasalamat sa gihapon ang pamilya sini nga wala sang may nasamaran ila pamilya bangud sa insidente.
english: Despite the incident, his family is still grateful that no one was injured in the incident.

text: Sa karon nagatinir sila sa evacuation center kag suno pa sa iya nga padayon sila nga ginahatagan sang bulig sang City Government.
english: They are currently staying at the evacuation center and he said they are continuing to receive assistance from the City Government.

text: Nagapasalamat man ini sa City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO), nga naghatag sa ila sang bulig kaangay sang folding beds, foam, tubig, pagkaon, kag ila mga bayo agud temporaryo nila nga magamit samtang nagapabilin ang mga ini sa evacuation center.
english: He also thanked the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO), which provided them with assistance such as folding beds, foam, water, food, and their clothes so that they can temporarily use them while they remain in the evacuation center.

text: Ginpasugtan na sang Israel military ang pagpasulod sang aid trucks kag access sa Gaza.
english: The Israeli military has allowed aid trucks and access to Gaza.

text: Apang, ginklaro sang Israel nga may yara sang paghugot sa mga humanitarian aid trucks nga magsulod sa Gaza.
english: However, Israel has made it clear that there will be a congestion on humanitarian aid trucks entering Gaza.

text: Nagapadayon nga ginadumilan nga makasulod sa Gaza ang United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA) para sa refugee sang Palestine.
english: The United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA) continues to be denied access to Gaza for Palestinian refugees.

text: May yara sang 6,000 nga mga aid trucks ang nagapila sa pihak nga border sang Gaza.
english: There are 6,000 aid trucks queuing on the other side of the Gaza border.

text: Matandaan nga makapila ka beses nga nagpanawagan ang United Nations nga dapat pahanagutan nga makahulag sang libre ang mga trucks nga may dala nga pagkaon kag bulong para sa mga biktima sa Gaza.
english: The United Nations has repeatedly called for trucks carrying food and medicine to be allowed to move freely for victims in Gaza.

text: Nakuha sang Superstar nga si Lebron James ang isa na naman nga NBA record sa edad nga 41.
english: Superstar Lebron James has set another NBA record at the age of 41.

text: Siya subong ang ginakilala nga oldest player nga nakakuha sang triple-double matapos nga ginpangunahan sini ang Los Angeles Lakers sa kadalag-an nila batok sa Dallas Mavericks.
english: He is now recognized as the oldest player to record a triple-double after leading the Los Angeles Lakers to victory over the Dallas Mavericks.

text: Nalapawan sini ang record ni Karl Malone nga 40 anyos sang nakuha man sini ang triple double para sa Lakers sa ila pagdaog kontra San Antonio Spurs sang Nobyembre 28, 2003.
english: He broke Karl Malone's record of 40 years when he also got a triple double for the Lakers in their win over the San Antonio Spurs on November 28, 2003.

text: Ang ini nga kadalag-an nakuha ni LebRon tatlo ka adlaw bag-o ang iya ika-22 nga All-Star-Game appearance.
english: LebRon earned this victory three days before his 22nd All-Star-Game appearance.

text: Bangud wala sa gihapon ang NBA scoring leader nga si Luka Doncic, gin-umpisahan ni LebRon ang hampang sang mabaskog nga 14 ka puntos sa una nga quarter kag nabalik sang Lakers ang ila nga momentum halin sa duwa ka sunod-sunod nga pagka-pierde.
english: With NBA scoring leader Luka Doncic still out, LebRon started the game with a strong 14 points in the first quarter and the Lakers regained their momentum from two consecutive losses.

text: BATUNON na gid lang naton seguro nga kabahin na sang aton pangabuhi ang COVID-19.
english: Let's just accept that COVID-19 is part of our lives.

text: In other words, daw endemic na ini, ukon unay na sa aton, nga matapna lang sing lubos paagi sa bakuna (vaccination), nga gina-develop pa tubtub karon.
english: In other words, it seems to be endemic, or already in our country, that can only be completely prevented through vaccination, which is still being developed.

text: Kag tungod wala pa madiskubrihan ang bakuna, ang mahimo ta lang, meantime, amo ang padayon nga nagakaigu nga pag-amlig batok sa COVID-19.
english: And since a vaccine has not yet been discovered, all we can do, meantime, is continue to take appropriate precautions against COVID-19.

text: Salamat kay ang igu sini sa 80 porsyento (80%) sang aton mga pumuluyo “mild” lang kag madali paayuhon.
english: Thankfully, the impact of 80 percent of our residents is mild and easily treated.

text: Kag bisan “severe” ukon “critical” pa ang igu sini, madamo gihapon ang napaayo.
english: And even if the injury is “severe” or “critical”, many have recovered.

text:
***

Pero paano bala ang mas epektibo naton nga sabat sa problema naton sa COVID-19 samtang wala pa ang bakuna?
english:
***

But how can we respond more effectively to our COVID-19 problem while there is no vaccine?

text: “Find, isolate and treat” ang kada kaso – kag sa madasig nga paagi – agud ma-break ang chain of transmission bag-o maglala, siling sang World Health Organization (WHO) sa panugyan sini nga ipatuman ang “mass testing” sa publiko nga wala sintoma apang nagadala sang COVID-19 virus.
english: "Find, isolate and treat" each case - and as quickly as possible - to break the chain of transmission before it gets worse, the World Health Organization (WHO) said in its advice to implement "mass testing" of the public who have no symptoms but carry the COVID-19 virus.

text: Ining mga infected nga wala sintoma apang pwede makalaton sa iban amo yadtong mga pre-symptomatic (infected apang nagapakita lang sintoma sa masunod pa nga inadlaw) kag ang mga asymptomatic (infected nga wala gid nagapakita sing sintoma).
english: These infected who have no symptoms but can infect others are those who are pre-symptomatic (infected but only show symptoms the next day) and those who are asymptomatic (infected who do not show symptoms at all).

text: Apang kinahanglan gid bala nga ma-testing ang tanan nga mga pumuluyo?
english: But is it really necessary to test all residents?

text: Too late na ini seguro.
english: This is probably too late.

text: Gin-admitir ni Health Secretary Duque sa isa ka miting sang Department of Health nga wala pa masuguran ang mass testing sa pungsod halin sadtong Enero tubtub Mayo 2020.
english: Health Secretary Duque admitted in a meeting of the Department of Health that mass testing has not yet started in the country from January to May 2020.

text: Nabalitaan na lang nga nakagwa na gali sa iban nga pungsod ang Covid-19 sadtong Enero.
english: It was reported that Covid-19 had already spread to other countries in January.

text: Gintudlo sini ang kakulangan sang test kits, kakulangan sang mga medical technologist, kag testing laboratories sa pungsod.
english: He pointed to the shortage of test kits, shortage of medical technologists, and testing laboratories in the country.

text: Imposible man nga mahimo ang mass testing sa tanan nga pumuluyo tungod sa daku nga kagastohanan sa pagpatuman sini sa aton mga 104 ka milyon nga mga pumuluyo.
english: It is also impossible to conduct mass testing for all citizens due to the high cost of implementing it among our 104 million citizens.

text: In fact, ang pagpatuman sang mass testing sa iban nga mga pungsod tubtub man lang gani sa diutay nga porsyento sang ila pumuluyo.
english: In fact, the implementation of mass testing in some countries is limited to a small percentage of their population.

text: Sa subong, priority lang sa Filipinas ang pag-testing sang mga health workers kag frontliners, mga COVID-19 suspect, ang gina-close contact tracing lakip ang small-cluster surveillance testing, kag ang luyag seguro mag-volunteer sa pagpa-testing.
english: Currently, priority in the Philippines is the testing of health workers and frontliners, COVID-19 suspects, close contact tracing including small-cluster surveillance testing, and those who wish to volunteer for testing.

text: Salamat kay napamatud-an man sang aton mga health experts nga malikawan ang COVID-19 bisan indi lubos pa mapatuman ang pang-kadam-an nga mass testing kag samtang wala pa ang bakuna.
english: Thankfully, our health experts have also proven that COVID-19 can be prevented even if mass testing is not fully implemented and while there is no vaccine.

text: Paagi ina sa pagpatuman sang bagay nga health measures nga ginapanugyan sang DOH katulad sang paggamit sang face mask kag face shield; masami nga paghugas sang kamot; paglikaw sang pagtandug sang mahigko nga kamot sa ilong, baba kag mata; kag ang pag-distansya sang at least isa ka metro (3 ka tapak) sa katupad.
english: This is through the implementation of appropriate health measures recommended by the DOH such as the use of face masks and face shields; frequent hand washing; avoiding touching the nose, mouth and eyes with dirty hands; and keeping a distance of at least one meter (3 feet) from the neighbor.

text:
***

In fact, kita mismo wala nagapanugyan sang pangkadam-an nga mass testing.
english:
***

In fact, we ourselves do not recommend mass testing.

text: Magahatag lang ini sing dugang nga kahadlok sa mga pumuluyo, sa lugar nga magpakalma sang ila balatyagon.
english: This will only create more fear among the residents, instead of calming their feelings.

text: Man, ang ining pangkadam-an nga mass testing nagapadasig pa sing pagsaka sa adlaw-adlaw sang mga kaso sang COVID-19.
english: Also, this mass testing is accelerating the daily increase in COVID-19 cases.

text: Indi maayo sa pensar sang tawo ang mahibal-an ang padayon kag madasig nga pagsaka sang mga kaso sang COVID-19.
english: It is not good for people to know the continuous and rapid increase in cases of COVID-19.

text: Makaapekto ini sa mental health sang tawo kag kinahanglan nga katawhay sang iya panghuna-huna.
english: It affects a person's mental health and needs peace of mind.

text: Salamat ugaling sa mga report sang mataas nga pag-recover sang mga pasyente kag ang gamay lang nga numero sang mga nagkalamatay.
english: Thanks however to reports of high recoveries of patients and a small number of deaths.

text:
***

Isa pa, sunu sa mga health experts mismo, problema man gani kon ipatuman ang pangkadam-an gid nga mass testing.
english:
***

In addition, according to health experts themselves, it is a problem to implement mass testing.

text: Sa matuod lang, wala sing perfect nga mass testing.
english: In truth, there is no such thing as perfect mass testing.

text: Wala sing medical test nga accurate gid.
english: No medical test is completely accurate.

text: Pamatuod sini ang “false negative” kag “false positive” nga test result.
english: This is evidenced by the “false negative” and “false positive” test results.

text: Sa pagdamo sining “failed result”, nagadaku man gani ang problema kon paano itadlong ang mga ini.
english: With the increase in the number of failed results, the problem of how to correct them is also growing.

text: Makapanubo man ini sang “reliability” sang test result tungod sa pagliwat-liwat sang “percent error”.
english: This can also reduce the reliability of the test result due to the repetition of percent error.

text: Mahapos makita ang problema sa may “false negative”, labi na gid kon madamo sila.
english: It is easy to see the problem with the “false negative”, especially if there are many of them.

text: Kinahanglan gid uyangan sing panahon ang dugang nga mga intervention sa ila para paniguro.
english: It is necessary to waste time on additional interventions in them to ensure.

text: Problema man ang may “false positive” labi na gid kon madamo man sila, katulad sang “unnecessary treatment” kag ang posible nga halit sa ikaayong lawas sang liwat-liwat nga mga positive screening test sa ikaayong lawas sang mga may pondo nga ginabatyag.
english: False positives are also a problem especially if there are many of them, such as unnecessary treatment and the possible health damage of repeated positive screening tests to the health of those who have the funds.

text: Indi bala?/PN
english: Isn't it?/PN

text: Madamo ang nagasiling nga mapalaron kag makahilisa ang mga tawo nga wala nagadako ukon nagatambok.
english: Many say that people who do not gain weight or gain weight are lucky and happy.

text: Ang wala nila nahibaluan, problema man ang kakulang sang bug-at ukon underweight ilabi na kun may yara sang madalom nga rason.
english: What they don't know is that being underweight is also a problem especially if there is a deep reason.

text: Gani kinahanglan man sang mga maniwang ang panglawason sang tips agud nga magdako.
english: So those who are thin also need tips to grow bigger.

text: Suno kay Katherine Zeratsky, isa ka registered kag licensed dietician, may nagkalain-lain nga rason kun ngaa maniwang, kulang sa bug-at ukon wala nagadako ang isa ka tawo.
english: According to Katherine Zeratsky, a registered and licensed dietician, there are various reasons why a person is thin, underweight or not growing.

text: Apisar makabig ang pila sa ila nga heathy, indi manigar nga may yara man ang mga ini sang problema sa ikaayong lawas.
english: Although some of them are considered healthy, there is no denying that they also have health problems.

text: Pahayag sang eksperto, kun kaisa sulundon man ini sa diin ang imo pamilya ang may yara sang maniwang nga panglawason.
english: According to the expert, sometimes it is also ideal where your family is in poor health.

text: Mahimo man tungod sa imo nga mga physical activities kun ngaa gamay ang imo nga lawas kaangay sang pagka-aktibo sa trabaho, kag tuman ka energetic.
english: It may also be because of your physical activities why your body is small such as being active at work, and very energetic.

text: Bangud sini, madasig matunaw ang calories sa imo nga lawas.
english: As a result, calories are digested quickly in your body.

text: Normal lang nga magnubo ang imo bug-at kun ikaw ang ginamasakit ukon may yara ikaw sang hilanat sa diin nagakawad-an ka sang gana nga magkaon apang dapat ka na nga magkabalaka suno sa eksperto kun gulpi na lang nagnubo ang imo nga bug-at apisar bastante kag madamo ka man magkaon.
english: It is normal to lose weight if you are sick or have a fever where you lose your appetite but you should be worried according to experts if you suddenly lose weight despite eating enough and plenty.

text: Mahimo pahayag ni Zeratsky nga may yara ka pa gid sang problema sa ikaayong lawas.
english: Zeratsky may say that you have another health problem.

text: Gani, mas maayo nga magpakonsulta gilayon sa doctor agud mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga solusyon kag atensyon.
english: Therefore, it is better to consult a doctor immediately to be given the proper solution and attention.

text: Ginpalawig pa ang lockdown sa New Delhi, ang capital sang India nga may 20 million ka mga tawo, bangud sang asud-asud nga record-high infections kag nagatimbuok nga numero sang mga patay bangud sang COVID-19.
english: The lockdown in New Delhi, India's capital of 20 million people, has been extended due to a surge in record-high infections and a rising number of deaths from COVID-19.

text:
G

in-anunsyo man sang otoridad ang kabudlay sang healthcare system bangud sang malala nga kakulangan sang oxygen kag bulong para sa mga infected nga pasyente.
english:
G

authorities also announced the difficulties faced by the healthcare system due to the severe shortage of oxygen and medicines for infected patients.

text: Sang nagligad nga 24 ka oras, ang bug-os nga pungsod sang India ang naka-record sang 349,691 fresh cases sang COVID-19 kag 2,767 ka mga patay– pinakamataas nga numero halin sang naglupok ang pandemya sa amo nga pungsod.
english: In the last 24 hours, the entire country of India has recorded 349,691 fresh cases of COVID-19 and 2,767 deaths– the highest number since the outbreak of the pandemic in that country.

text: Santo sa reports, gutok na pati ang mga patyo bangud sang spike sa death toll.
english: According to reports, even the cemeteries are crowded due to the spike in the death toll.

text: “We have decided to extend the lockdown by one week … The havoc of corona[virus] continues and there is no respite.
english: “We have decided to extend the lockdown by one week … The havoc of corona[virus] continues and there is no respite.

text: Everyone is in favor of extending the lockdown,” suno kay Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal.
english: Everyone is in favor of extending the lockdown,” Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal said.

text: Sang Lunes sang ginpatuman ang lockdown sa syudad sang New Delhi kag gindesisyunan nga palawigon sang isa pa ka semana.
english: The lockdown was imposed in the city of New Delhi on Monday and it was decided to extend it for another week.

text: “The havoc of corona(virus) continues and there is no respite.
english: “The havoc of corona(virus) continues and there is no respite.

text:
Everyone is in favor of extending the lockdown.”

Suno kay Prime Minister Narendra Modi, daw kaangay nga bagyo na ang nagalaslas sa ila nga pungsod; suno naman sa New Delhi court, indi na wave kundi tsunami ang pandemic situation sa ila nga lugar.
english:
Everyone is in favor of extending the lockdown.”

According to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the country is like a storm; according to the New Delhi court, the pandemic situation in their area is no longer a wave but a tsunami.

text: “Our spirits were high after successfully dealing with the first wave.
english: “Our spirits were high after successfully dealing with the first wave.

text: But this storm has shaken the nation,” pahayag ni Modi.Sa nagligad nga pito ka adlaw, masobra na sa duha ka milyon ka bag-o nga kaso ang narekord sa India, 58 porsyento nga mas mataas ipanggid sang nagligad nga semana.
english: But this storm has shaken the nation,” Modi said. In the past seven days, more than two million new cases have been recorded in India, 58 percent higher than last week.

text: Sa kabug-usan, ang India ang may 17,176,728 na ka mga kumpirmado nga kaso halin sang nag-umpisa ang pandemya — ikaduha sa pinakamataas sa bug-os nga kalibutan, sunod sa Estados Unidos nga may 32,792,018.
english: Overall, India has recorded 17,176,728 confirmed cases since the start of the pandemic — the second highest globally, behind the United States with 32,792,018.

text: Ginpadugangan na sang Iloilo City Government sang suga ang area sang Esplanade 3 partikular ang malapit sa Garden of Love.
english: The Iloilo City Government has already increased the lighting in the area of ​​Esplanade 3 particularly near the Garden of Love.

text: Ini kasunod sang pila ka insidente kun sa diin may nakit-an nga mga indibidwal nga nagahimo sang kamala-malahan sa madulom kag masiot nga bahin sang Esplanade.
english: This follows several incidents where individuals were seen committing crimes in the dark and narrow part of the Esplanade.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga magluwas sa suga, may gindeploy nga dugang nga greeng uards agud magbantay sa palibot.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Jerry Treñas said that besides the lights, additional green wards have been deployed to monitor the environment.

text: Matandaan nga sang damlag lang, naaktuhan gid sang isa ka street sweeper ang duha ka mga indibidwal nga lunsay lalaki nga nagahimo sang sekswal nga aktibidad.
english: Recently, a street sweeper caught two individuals, both men, engaging in sexual activity.

text: Mangin dako ang kinalain sang ika-95 nga kaadlawan ni Queen Elizabeth II sa Abril 21 kun ipaanggid sang mga tinalikdan nga mga tinuig nga buhi pa ang iya bana nga si Prince Philip.
english: Queen Elizabeth II's 95th birthday on April 21 will be a big difference from previous years when her husband Prince Philip was still alive.

text: Kun sadto, may yara sang mga panibag-o nga pictures nga ginasapubliko ang reyna kag iban pa myembro sang royal family sa adlaw sang ila birthday, apang sa subong nga tuig, wala sang picture nga may ipaguwa sa publiko.
english: In the past, there were new pictures of the queen and other members of the royal family being released on their birthday, but this year, no pictures will be released to the public.

text: May yara man sang mga ekspekulasyon nga nagaguwa nga si Prince Harry nga nagbalik sa United Kingdom bangud nagtambong sa lubong sang iya lolo, ang maga-extend pa sang iya nga pagtinir kaupod ang royal family tubtob matapos ang birthay ni Queen Elizabeth.
english: There are also speculations that Prince Harry, who returned to the United Kingdom to attend his grandfather's funeral, will extend his stay with the royal family until after Queen Elizabeth's birthday.

text: Magluwas sa pagtaliwan ni Prince Philip, isa man sa mga rason ang COVID-19 pandemic sa pagbag-o sang birthday celebration sang reyna subong nga tuig.
english: Besides the death of Prince Philip, the COVID-19 pandemic was also one of the reasons for the change of the queen's birthday celebration this year.

text: Ang “Trooping the Colour” — isa ka event kada tuig nga ginasaulog kada Hunyo bilang selebrasyon sa kaadlawan ni Queen Elizabeth sa diin ang highlight amo ang pagtililipon sang royal family sa balcony sang Buckingham Palace — ang kanselado man sa sulod sang duha na ka tuig bangud sa pandemya.
english: “Trooping the Colour” — an annual event celebrated each June in celebration of Queen Elizabeth’s birthday in which the highlight is a gathering of the royal family on the balcony of Buckingham Palace — has also been canceled for two years due to the pandemic.

text: Tanan nga tawo nga naga-edad 16 anyos pataas sa Estados Unidos ang eligible na para sa COVID-19 vaccination.
english: All people age 16 and older in the United States are now eligible for COVID-19 vaccination.

text: Santu sa rekomendasyon sang US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) , ang mga tawo nga naga edad 16 anyos pataas nga may yara sang medical conditions kag komplikasyon amo ang gina-una sa pagpabakuna.
english: According to the recommendations of the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), people aged 16 years and older with medical conditions and complications are given priority for vaccination.

text: Mayorya sa mga US states ang nagpasangkad na sang ila COVID-19 vaccine rollouts sa mga tawo nga nalakip sa nasambit nga age group.
english: Most US states have already expanded their COVID-19 vaccine rollouts to people in this age group.

text: Ang Alaska ang una nga estado nga nagpanubo sang ila statewide eligibility sa edad nga 16 anyos kag ginsundan sang Georgia, Texas kag California.
english: Alaska was the first state to lower its statewide eligibility to age 16 followed by Georgia, Texas and California.

text: Nahibaluan nga masobra tunga na sa mga taga Estados Unidos ang nakabataon sang una nga dose sang COVID-19 vaccine.
english: More than half of Americans have received the first dose of the COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Mahimo na makagwa sa ila balay ang mga tawo sa Israel bisan wala sang suksok nga face mask.
english: People in Israel can now leave their homes without wearing a face mask.

text: Ini ang kabahin sang pagbalik sang pungsod sa normal nga sitwasyon sa bulig sang mass-vaccination batok sa COVID-19.
english: This is part of the country's return to normalcy with the help of mass-vaccination against COVID-19.

text: Sa subong 81% na sang mga residente ukon mga tawo nga nagaedad 16 anyos pasaka ang nakabaton na sang duha ka dose sang Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine sa Israel rason nga nagnubo naman ang numero sang mga tawo nga ginadala sa ospital.
english: Currently, 81% of residents or people aged 16 years and above have received two doses of the Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine in Israel, reducing the number of people being taken to hospital.

text: Apisar sini, limitado sa gihapon ang pagpasulod sa mga foreigners.
english: However, the entry of foreigners is still limited.

text: Ginamanduan sa gihapon ang tanan nga Israelis nga magpaidalom sa self-isolation kun sila ang halin sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: All Israelis are still ordered to undergo self-isolation if they are from abroad.

text: Suno kay Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, nagapanguna subong ang Israel sa tanan nga pungsod sa kalibutan kun pagtapna sang virus ang pagahambalan; apang indi ini rason agud magkumpyansa bangud posible pa nga magbalik ini.
english: According to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel is now leading all countries in the world when it comes to preventing the virus; but this is not a reason to be confident as it is still possible that it will return.

text: Pilason ang 97 ka tawo matapos madiskaril ang train sa syudad sang Toukh, north of Cairo sa Egypt.
english: Ninety-seven people were injured after a train derailed in the city of Toukh, north of Cairo in Egypt.

text: Suno sa health ministry sang pungsod, wala sang reported nga napatay kasunod sang insidente kun sa diin nag-awas gid sa riles ang lawas sang train.
english: According to the country's health ministry, no deaths were reported following the incident in which the body of the train spilled off the tracks.

text: Kun basehan naman ang report sang duha ka security sources kag isa ka local media, may mga patay na sa amo nga aksidente apang as of press time, wala pa sang opisyal nga kumpirmasyon.
english: Based on reports from two security sources and a local media, there have been deaths in the accident but as of press time, there is no official confirmation.

text: Masobra 50 ka mga ambulansya ang gindeploy sang Ministry of Health agud maluwas ang tanan nga nagkalapilasan sa amo nga train crash.
english: More than 50 ambulances were deployed by the Ministry of Health to rescue all the injured in the train crash.

text: Ginpahayag naman sang Egyptian Railways Authority nga ginaimbestigaran pa subong ang rason sang train accident.
english: The Egyptian Railways Authority said the cause of the train accident is still under investigation.

text: Ang train ang naghalin sa Cairo kag padulong na kuntani sa Mansoura.
english: The train was leaving Cairo and was bound for Mansoura.

text: Suno naman kay health ministry spokesman Khaled Megahed, menor ang pilas nga naangkon sang kalabanan nga mga biktima kag gamay lang ang yara sa kritikal nga kondisyon.
english: Health ministry spokesman Khaled Megahed said most of the victims sustained minor injuries and few were in critical condition.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga major train accident nga natabo sa Egypt sa sulod lang sang isa ka bulan.
english: This is the third major train accident to occur in Egypt in just one month.

text: Matandaan nga 32 ka tawo ang patay kag 165 ang pilason sang nagligad nga bulan sang nagbungguanay ang duha ka train sa Tahta district sa Upper Egypt governorate sang Sohag.#
english: It can be recalled that 32 people were killed and 165 injured last month when two trains collided in the Tahta district of the Upper Egypt governorate of Sohag.

text: ILOILO – Ginpakakas ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: ILOILO – Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: ang iya intelligence fund balor P20 million.
english: his intelligence fund is worth P20 million.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, ang intelligence fund ang ginapahanugutan sa executive budget.
english: In fact, the intelligence fund is allowed in the executive budget.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 4th District Board Member Domingo Oso Jr., Chairman sang Committee on Appropriations sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan, iya ginpahayag nga may yara na sang hingyo ang gobernador sadto pa lang nga i-transfer na lang sa donations ang iya intelligence fund.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo 4th District Board Member Domingo Oso Jr., Chairman of the Committee on Appropriations of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, said the governor has already requested that his intelligence fund be transferred to donations.

text: Suno kay Oso, sa intelligence fund ginakuha ang assistance para sa peace and order kag indi ini strikto sa mga dokumento nga ginapasa.
english: According to Oso, the assistance for peace and order is taken from the intelligence fund and it is not strict on the documents submitted.

text: Aopang kun donation pahayag sang Board Member, nagakinahanglan ang gid ang specific document ukon requirements ang mga benepisyaryo.
english: However, if it is a donation, the Board Member said, the beneficiaries need specific documents or requirements.

text: Nahibaluan nga kahapon, Disyembre 17, gin-aprubahan sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan ang 2025 budget nga P4,849,438,886 nga General Fund kag P1,127,641,541 para sa Local Economic Enterprise.
english: Yesterday, December 17, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan approved the 2025 budget of P4,849,438,886 for the General Fund and P1,127,641,541 for the Local Economic Enterprise.

text: TEXAS, USA – Temporaryo nga ginpauntat sang health officials ang COVID-19 Vaccination gamit ang single-dose Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine sa mga pumuluyo sa Texas, USA.
english: TEXAS, USA – Health officials have temporarily suspended COVID-19 vaccination using the single-dose Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine for residents in Texas, USA.

text: Ini matapos nakaeksperyensya sang “rare kag severe nga sahi sang blood clot” ukon pagsulong sang dugo ang anom ka babaye matapos ginbakunahan sang nasambit nga bakuna batok sa COVID-19.
english: This is after six women experienced a “rare and severe type of blood clot” after being vaccinated with the COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Santo sa advisory nga ginpagwa sang Centers for Disease Control and Prevention sang pungsod, wala pa sang pat-od nga petsa kun tubtob san-o magalawig ang pagsuspende sang Vaccination gamit ang Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine.
english: According to the advisory issued by the country's Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, there is no definite date on how long the suspension of vaccination with the Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine will last.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Rufino ‘Pinoy Gonzales’ direkta sa Texas, isa ini sa pinakadako nga pagpanghangkat sa mga dalagko nga retail pharmacies nga nagahulat kuntani sang kapin two-thirds nga supply sang amo nga bakuna sa sini nga semana.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Rufino 'Pinoy Gonzales' directly in Texas, this is one of the biggest challenges for the large retail pharmacies that were expecting more than two-thirds of the supply of the vaccine this week.

text: Ginpahayag ni Gonzales nga apisar sini, ang single-dose Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine ang mas ginapili sang kadam-an sa ila pungsod kun ipaanggid sa mga vaccines nga ginmanufacture sang Pfizer kag Moderna.
english: Gonzales said that despite this, the single-dose Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine is preferred by the majority in their country compared to the vaccines manufactured by Pfizer and Moderna.

text: Masobra katunga naman sa populasyon sang mga senior citizen sa nasambit nga pungsod ang nabakunahan na gamit ang Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine.
english: More than half of the population of senior citizens in the country has been vaccinated with the Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Sa subong suno kay Gonzales, magapangatubang na naman ang Texas sang vaccine hesitancy sang mga tawo sa diin posible nga madamo na ang nagakahangawa nga magpabakuna.
english: Now, Gonzales said, Texas will again face vaccine hesitancy among the people where it is possible that many are worried about getting vaccinated.

text: Nahibaluan nga santo sa Texas Department of State Health Services, kapin 500,000 ka doses sang Johnson & Johnson vaccine ang gin-administer sang Texas.
english: According to the Texas Department of State Health Services, more than 500,000 doses of the Johnson & Johnson vaccine have been administered in Texas.

text: Kapin 7 million ka-tawo naman sa Estados Unidos ang nabakunahan na batok sa COVID-19 gamit ang bakuna nga himo sang Johnson & Johnson.
english: More than 7 million people in the United States have been vaccinated against COVID-19 with the Johnson & Johnson vaccine.

text: Mas maduagon pa gid ang kabuhi sang isa ka tawo kun siya ang nagahigugma.
english: A person's life is more successful when he loves.

text: Amo man ini ang ginapatihan sang isa ka 100-anyos nga war veteran nga natalana nga magpakasal sa iya nga 96-anyos nga sweetheart sa masunod nga bulan!
english: This is also what a 100-year-old war veteran who is set to marry his 96-year-old sweetheart next month believes!

text: Love story ini nanday US Air Force veteran Harold Terens kag ang soon-to-be bride nga si Jeanne Swerlin.
english: This is the love story of US Air Force veteran Harold Terens and soon-to-be bride Jeanne Swerlin.

text: Handa na sila sa seremonya sang kasal nga hiwaton sa France nga amo man ang lugar kun sa diin nagpangalagad si Terens sang World War II.
english: They are ready for the wedding ceremony to be held in France, the same place where Terens served during World War II.

text: Sa Hunyo 6 ukon duha ka adlaw antes ang ila nga kasal, pasidunggan man si Terens kadungan sang komemorasyon sang 80th anniversary sang D-Day landings sa Normandy, ang maragtason nga allied operation nga amo ang nagpalain sa dalagan sang gyera sang amo nga tyempo.
english: On June 6 or two days before their wedding, Terens will also be honored in conjunction with the commemoration of the 80th anniversary of the D-Day landings in Normandy, the historic allied operation that turned the tide of the war at the time.

text: Magabayluhanay naman sang vows ang duha sa Carentan-les-Marais nga malapit sa kadagatan kun sa diin linibo anay ka soldado ang nagtabok kag napatay sang amo nga adlaw sang 1944.
english: The two will exchange vows in Carentan-les-Marais, near the sea where thousands of soldiers crossed and died on that day in 1944.

text: Apisar sa iya edad subong, preska pa sa paminsaron ni Terens ang mga hitabo sang naga-edad pa lamang siya sang 18-anyos, ang tyempo nga ginbombahan sang Japan ang US Navy base sa Pearl Harbor.
english: Despite his age now, Terens still remembers the events of his 18th birthday, when Japan bombed the US Navy base at Pearl Harbor.

text: Kaangay sa iban nga bataon nga mga Amerikano, nagpa-enlist man ini kag sa edad nga 20, eksperto na ini sa Morse code kag nagsakay sa barko pakadto sa England kun sa diin na-assign siya sa squadron sang apat ka P-47 Thunderbolt fighters.
english: Like other young Americans, he enlisted and at the age of 20, he became an expert in Morse code and sailed to England where he was assigned to a squadron of four P-47 Thunderbolt fighters.

text: Siya ang responsable sa ground-to-air communication.
english: He is responsible for ground-to-air communication.

text: Nadulaan ang ila company sang 60 ka mga eroplano kadungan ang Normandy operation kag pagkatapos sina, nagboluntaryo si Terens nga magbyahe sa rehiyon sa northern France agud magbulig nga mapasakay ang German prisoners of war kag mahilway ang Allied troops pa-England.
english: Their company lost 60 aircraft during the Normandy operation and after that, Terens volunteered to travel to the region in northern France to help embark German prisoners of war and free Allied troops to England.

text: Pagkatapos sang gyera, nagpakasal na siya sa iya kahagugma nga si Thelma.
english: After the war, he married his sweetheart, Thelma.

text: Naglawig sang pito ka dekada ang ila pag-asawahay sa Florida kag nagbunga ang ila paghigugmaanay sang tatlo ka mga kabataan.
english: Their Florida marriage lasted seven decades and their love affair produced three children.

text: Sang 2018, napatay na si Thelma rason nga tuman naman ang kasubo ni Terens kag halos indi gid mauntat ang iya kahidlaw sa iya nga asawa.
english: In 2018, Thelma died and Terens was very sad and almost never stopped missing his wife.

text: Nahatagan lamang ini sang preska nga panugod sang 2021 sang ginpakilala siya sang iya abyan kay Jeanne Swerlin nga isa man ka balo kaangay niya.
english: It was only given a fresh start in 2021 when a friend introduced her to Jeanne Swerlin who was also a widow like her.

text: Indi kaangay sa iban nga lovers, wala sang kilig sa ila una nga pagkit-anay, apang bangud sa dalayon nga pagkit-anay kag date, halos indi na sila maseparar sa isa kag isa.
english: Unlike other lovers, there is no excitement at their first meeting, but because of the constant meetings and dates, they are almost inseparable from each other.

text: Pareho na nga excited ang duha nga maka-“I Do” kun sa diin ang apo pa mismo ni Terens ang magakanta sang “I Will Always Love You”.
english: Both are excited to be able to “I Do” where Terens’ own grandson will sing “I Will Always Love You”.

text: Sa edad nga 100, ginpahayag sang military veteran nga wala na siya sang iban pa nga mapangayo pa: “I got it all.
english: At the age of 100, the military veteran said he has nothing more to ask for: “I got it all.

text:

english:
I’m probably the luckiest guy in the world.”#

text: IRONIC, ukon taliwas, ang ginhimo ni Lieutenant General Antonio Parlade Jr., spokesman sang National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC), sa pagdampig sa Demokrasya kontra Komunismo sa iya pamahog sa mga artista nga sanday Liza Soberano, Angel Locsin kag Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray.
english: IRONIC, or vice versa, was the action of Lieutenant General Antonio Parlade Jr., spokesman of the National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC), in siding with Democracy against Communism in his threat to artists Liza Soberano, Angel Locsin and Miss Universe Catriona Gray 2018.

text: Tungod sini, dapat mag-apology gid si Parlade sa pagpamahog niya sa tatlo ka artista.
english: Because of this, Parlade should apologize for threatening the three artists.

text: Bisan na lang sa pag-respeto sa mataas nga pagkilala sa ila sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Even in respect of the high recognition of them by the people.

text: Partikular sa akusasyon kay Soberano, ang nahibal-an ta amo nga nangin bisita siya sa isa ka interview sa internet (webcast) sang isa ka youth group sang Gabriela angot, for one, sa rape joke kontra sa iya sang isa ka netizen, nga ginpasakaan na niya sing kaso.
english: Particularly in the accusation against Soberano, what we know is that he was a guest in an internet interview (webcast) of a youth group of Gabriela regarding, for one, the rape joke against him by a netizen, which he has already filed a case.

text: Ano ang malain dira kay bisita man lang siya sang grupo?
english: What's wrong with that because he's just a guest of the group?

text: Indi man siya myembro.
english: He's not a member either.

text: Natabuan lang ugaling nga gina-akusaran ini nga grupo ni Parlade nga provider sang pila ka myembro sang NPA.
english: Coincidentally, however, Parlade's group is accused of providing some NPA members.

text: Si Presidente Duterte gani nakipag-interview man upod sa presidente sang Communist China, bisan indi man siya Komunista (sunu sa iya), kundi Sosyalista lang.
english: President Duterte even interviewed the president of Communist China, even though he is not a Communist (according to him), but a Socialist.

text:
***

Nagagwa gani nga si Parlade pa ang indi-Demokratiko sing panghuna-huna kag panggawi sa iya asta batok sa tatlo ka artista.
english:
***

It turns out that Parlade is the most undemocratic in his thinking and behavior even against the three artists.

text: Ang iya metodo sa paglaygay kon ano ang maayo nga himuon sang tatlo amo ang pamahog sa kabuhi nila kag sa kalinong sang ila pamilya.
english: His method of advising the three was a threat to their lives and the peace of their family.

text: Ginpakita man niya ang iya “simplistic reasoning” nga tungod nakita ka sa isa ka grupo nga kontra sang gobyerno kaupod ka na sa grupo nga ina.
english: He also showed his “simplistic reasoning” that because you are seen in a group that is against the government you are already in that group.

text: Authoritarian (Kinamunista kon hambalon pa sang iban) ina nga pamatasan, indi maki-Demokrasya!
english: Authoritarian (Communist if some say) that behavior, not democratic!

text: Pamahog ang pamaagi sang authoritarian nga gobyerno agud mag-tener sa poder.
english: Threats are the authoritarian government's way of staying in power.

text: Indi man sila luyag makigbais sa mga pumuluyo kay ang tindug sini, katulad sang Communist Party, human na nga indi masuay.
english: They also do not want to argue with the people because its position, like the Communist Party, is made indisputable.

text: Tani makilala ini ni Gen.
english: I hope Gen.

text: Parlade kag mahibal-an ang matuod gid nga pagka-Demokratiko sa iya panggawi.
english: Parlade and know the true Democracy in his behavior.

text: Ang pamahog sa tatlo ka artista isa man ka paglabag sa ila kinamatarong sa “Free Speech, Expression, or the Press…” nga gina-proteksyunan sang Sec.
english: The threat to the three artists is also a violation of their right to “Free Speech, Expression, or the Press…” protected by Sec.

text: 4 sang Bill of Rights.
english: 4 of the Bill of Rights.

text: “No law shall be passed abridging (them)…,” siling gani sini.
english: “No law shall be passed abridging (them)…,” it even said.

text: Dapat man magtuon si Parlade sing dugang sa subject: “Critical Thinking” agud indi lang magpatu-pato.
english: Parlade should also study more in the subject: “Critical Thinking” so as not to just pretend.

text:
In fact, laygay gani ni Defense Secretary Delfin Lorenzana sa iya: “Kon wala ka sing ebidensya maayo pa maghipos ka na lang.”

Sa Demokrasya ginasunod naton ang Rule of Law nga ginapatuman sang aton Constitution nga ginbalay sang aton mga pumuluyo, kag indi lang ang luyag sang gobyerno.
english:
In fact, Defense Secretary Delfin Lorenzana even advised him: “If you don't have evidence, it's better to keep quiet.”

In Democracy we follow the Rule of Law enforced by our Constitution framed by our people, and not just what the government wants.

text: Sa Demokrasya, ang mga desisyon ginagamitan sing tul-id nga panghuna-huna (indi simplistic reasoning), katulad sang paghusga sa isa ka tawo paagi sa Due Process sa diin ang isa ka ginapabangdan maagi anay sa matul-id nga procedure halin sa pagka-suspetsado pakadto sa fair trial tubtub mahusgaran siya sang isa ka competent judge.
english: In a democracy, decisions are made using simple reasoning, such as judging a person through Due Process where a defendant goes through the proper procedure from suspect to fair trial until he is judged by a competent judge.

text: Unlike ini sa authoritarian nga gobyerno.
english: It is unlike authoritarian government.

text: Gapahapos lang ini paagi sa “simplistic reasoning” nga kon kis-a sandig lang sa sugid nga wala sing masaligan nga ebidensya.
english: This is facilitated by simplistic reasoning that is sometimes based on rumors without reliable evidence.

text: Tungod sini, ordinaryo lang ang mahusgahan sing kasal-anan tungod sa hinisaay sa poder ukon “prejudice”, ukon kontra nga panghuna-huna.
english: Because of this, it is common to be convicted of a power struggle or “prejudice”, or an opposing view.

text:
***

Mas malala pa gani ining ginhimo ni Parlade sangsa Martial Law ni Marcos.
english:
***

Parlade's actions are even worse than Marcos' Martial Law.

text: Samtang halata na ni Marcos kon ano ang huyog sang mga leftist, wala gid si Marcos namahog nga mapatay ukon patyon sila sa ila pagtililipon.
english: While Marcos was aware of the leftists' tendencies, Marcos never threatened to kill or kill them at their meetings.

text: Ginsunod niya ang paagi Demokratiko sa ila, bisan pa gani yara sa iya ang poder sang gahum militar, agud makakalap sang ebidensya kontra sa ila agud maakusaran sa korte.
english: He followed the Democratic way with them, even though he had the power of military power, to gather evidence against them to prosecute in court.

text: Ako sadto masami man gaupod sa pagtililipon sang mga progresibo nga mga grupo sa “common cause” sang mga pumuluyo batok sa diktadurya ni Marcos, katulad sang Bayan Panay, Gabriela kag LFS, apang bisan pamahog nga dakpon ako sang militar ukon habuyan sing granada ang amon pagtililipon wala ina namon maagyan.
english: I used to often attend meetings of progressive groups in the “common cause” of the people against the Marcos dictatorship, such as Bayan Panay, Gabriela and LFS, but even threats to arrest me or throw grenades at our meetings did not happen.

text: Kaupod ko sadto sa grupo si Atty. Oligario Santisteban (+), ang Tsirman sang Bayan Panay, si Atty. Rodolfo Cabado,  si Atty. Neri Duremdes (retirado na nga hwes), si Jory Porquia (presidente sang LFS), kag iban pa.
english: I was in the group with Atty. Oligario Santisteban (+), the Chairman of Bayan Panay, Atty. Rodolfo Cabado,  Atty. Neri Duremdes (retired judge), Jory Porquia (LFS president), and others.

text: Sang ulihi, nag-upod na ako sa UNIDO, political party ni Doy Laurel vs Marcos, kag sa grupo sang Solidarity sang mga pari kag madre batok kay Marcos./PN
english: Later, I joined UNIDO, the political party of Doy Laurel vs Marcos, and the Solidarity group of priests and nuns against Marcos./PN

text: Pinayagan na ng Israel military ang pagpasok ng aid trucks at acces sa Gaza.
english: The Israeli military has allowed aid trucks to enter Gaza.

text: Subalit paglilinaw ng Israel na mayroong bahagyang paghigpit nila sa mga humanitarian aid trucks na pumasok sa Gaza.
english: Israel, however, clarified that there will be some restrictions on humanitarian aid trucks entering Gaza.

text: Nanatiling binawalang makapasok sa Gaza ang United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA) para sa refugee ng Palestine.
english: The United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA) remains banned from entering Gaza for Palestinian refugees.

text: Mayroong 6,000 na mga aid trucks ang nakahimpil sa kabilang border ng Gaza.
english: There are about 6,000 aid trucks stationed across the Gaza border.

text: Magugunitang makailang ulit na nanawagan ang United Nations na dapat ay payagan ng makagalaw ng libre ang mga trucks na may dalang pagkain at gamot para sa mga biktima sa Gaza.
english: The United Nations has repeatedly called for trucks carrying food and medicine to be allowed to move freely for victims in Gaza.

text: Ginrason sang lalaki nga nagbakol sa ido tubtob mapatay nga gin-ihian siya sang sapat.
english: The man who beat the dog to death claimed the animal had urinated on him.

text: Natabo ang pagpatay sa American Bully nga si “Axel” sa Sandanga, Mountain Province.
english: The killing of American Bully “Axel” took place in Sandanga, Mountain Province.

text: Suno sa pahayag ni Sandanga Mayor Robert Wanawan, ginsiling sang suspek nga malain ang pagpati nila kun ginaihian sang ido ang isa ka tawo.
english: According to Sandanga Mayor Robert Wanawan, the suspect said they believe it is bad when a dog urinates on a person.

text: Nakuhaan sang video ang iya paghanot sa ido gamit ang matig-a nga kahoy.
english: He was caught on video beating the dog with a hard stick.

text: Nakadalagan pa ang ido apang ginlagas pa gid ini sang suspek.
english: The dog ran away but the suspect chased it.

text: Napasakaan na sang reklamo nga may kaangtanan sa animal cruelty ang suspek.
english: A complaint of animal cruelty has been filed against the suspect.

text: Nagapati ang Malacañang nga indi dapat pagtawgon nga mahina ang mga kabataan sa subong nga henarasyon bangud sila ang paglaum sang pungsod.
english: Malacañang believes that the children of the present generation should not be called weak because they are the hope of the country.
