text: Ini ang nangin sabat ni Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro nahanungod sa pahayag ni Senator Robin Padilla sang gintawag sini nga mahina ang kabataan sa subong nga henerasyon kag suno pa sa senador nga indi uso ang ginatawag nga ”depression” sang tyempo sini.
english: This was the response of Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro regarding the statement of Senator Robin Padilla when he called the children of the current generation weak and the senator said that the so-called "depression" is not fashionable in his time.

text: Suno pa kay Castro dapat nga magapabilin sa tagipuson sang mga tawo ang nangin leksyon ni Dr. Jose Rizal nga ang mga kabataan ang paglaum sang Pilipinas.
english: Castro said the lessons of Dr. Jose Rizal that children are the hope of the Philippines.

text: Ginpunto man sini nga amo sini ang rason kun ngaa ginapakamaayo ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: He also pointed out that this is the reason why President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: ang mga programa para sa edukasyon kag ikaayong lawas sang mga kabataan.
english: the programs for children’s education and health.

text:
Sa matandaan nga sang nagligad nga mga inadlaw, ginlaragway ni Padilla ang mga kabataan sa subong nga henrasyon bilang mahina kag sang ila tyempo indi pa uso ang tinaga nga ”depression.”

Ginbuy-an ini ni Padilla nga pahayag sa hearing sang Senate Committee on Public Information and Mass Media nahanungod sa Children’s Safety in Social Media Act.
english:
It can be recalled that in recent days, Padilla described the children of the current generation as weak and in their time the word ”depression” was not yet in vogue.

Padilla made the remarks during a hearing of the Senate Committee on Public Information and Mass Media on the Children's Safety in Social Media Act.

text: Ginpamaayo sang Pag-IBIG Fund ang ila Multi-Purpose Loan (MPL) agud mas daku na ang mahimo nga mahulam sang mga miyembro, mas mabuhin ang kinahanglan nga hulog antes mag-qualify, kag mas madamo sang pili-an nga repayment terms.
english: The Pag-IBIG Fund has improved its Multi-Purpose Loan (MPL) so that members can borrow more, reduce the required down payment before qualifying, and have more choices of repayment terms.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Domingo Jacinto, Jr., Vice President sang PAG-IBIG Fund, iya ginpahayag nga sa idalum sang ginpAayo nga Pag-IBIG MPL, mahimo na nga makahulam ang mga miyembro sang tubtob 90% sang ila kabug-osan nga Pag-IBIG Regular Savings—mas mataas ini sang 12.5% kumpara sa una nga 80%.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Domingo Jacinto, Jr., Vice President of the PAG-IBIG Fund, said that under the improved Pag-IBIG MPL, members can now borrow up to 90% of their total Pag-IBIG Regular Savings—12.5% ​​higher than the previous 80%.

text: Para sa mga miyembro nga naga-dugang kag naga-upgrade sang ila regular savings, posible pa gid nga magdaku ang ila mahimo nga mahulam bangud nakabase ini sa ila savings.
english: For members who increase and upgrade their regular savings, it is even possible to grow what they can borrow because it is based on their savings.

text: Sa kabug-usan, mas daku ang mahimo nila nga ma-loan halin sa MPL para sa ila mga kinahanglanon.
english: Overall, they can borrow more from MPL for their needs.

text: Suno kay Jacinto, ini nga mga pagbago—mas daku nga loan kag mas dasig nga eligibility—ipatuman man sa iban nga Short-Term Loan programs sang Pag-IBIG pareho sang Health and Education Loan Programs (HELPS) kag Calamity Loan.
english: According to Jacinto, these changes—larger loan and faster eligibility—will also be implemented in other Short-Term Loan programs of Pag-IBIG such as Health and Education Loan Programs (HELPS) and Calamity Loan.

text: Luwas sa mas daku nga loan amount, ginpaubos man ang kinahanglan nga panahon para magin eligible ang isa ka miyembro.
english: In addition to the larger loan amount, the time required for a member to be eligible has also been reduced.

text: Sa idalum sang ginbag-o nga programa, pwede na maka-loan ang mga aktibo nga miyembro nga may 12 ka bulan nga hulog sa Pag-IBIG—mas dasig ini kumpara sa anay nga requirement nga 24 ka bulan.
english: Under the revised program, active members with 12 months of down payment in Pag-IBIG can now borrow—faster than the previous requirement of 24 months.

text: Tungod sini, mas madamo nga miyembro ang mas temprano nga makabenepisyo sa pondo para sa ila nga kinahanglanon.
english: As a result, more members will be able to benefit from funding for their needs sooner.

text: Samtang, ang mga miyembro nga may yara na sang existing loan halin sa daan nga guidelines mahimo gihapon mag-apply liwat sa enhanced MPL kon kinahanglan nila sang dugang nga cash bangud sang mas mataas nga loan entitlement.
english: Meanwhile, members who already have an existing loan from the old guidelines can still reapply for the enhanced MPL if they need more cash due to the higher loan entitlement.

text: Ang mga ini nga pagbago mangin available umpisa Mayo 16.
english: These changes will be available starting May 16.

text: Kaupod man sa mga pagbago sa Pag-IBIG MPL amo ang bag-o nga one-year repayment term bilang dugang nga opsyon sa existing nga two kag three-year terms.
english: Also among the changes to the Pag-IBIG MPL is the new one-year repayment term as an additional option to the existing two and three-year terms.

text: Nagahatag ini sang dugang nga flexibility sa mga miyembro agud mas mapasadya nila ang ila bayad sa loan suno sa ila financial capacity.
english: This gives more flexibility to members so they can better customize their loan repayments according to their financial capacity.

text: Mahimo mag-atubangay liwat ang world no.
english: The world no.

text: 72 nga si Alex Eala kag ang world no.
english: 72 Alex Eala and world no.

text: 2 nga si Iga Swiatek sa ila pagpasakop sa Madrid Open sa Caja Magica sa Espanya.
english: 2 Iga Swiatek in their participation in the Madrid Open at Caja Magica in Spain.

text: Base sa resulta sang draw, nagtuon ang Pinay tennis star sa bracket kun sa diin yara man ang Polish player kun sa diin awtomatiko na ini nga nag-abante sa Round of 64.
english: Based on the result of the draw, the Filipino tennis star studied in the bracket where the Polish player was also where he automatically advanced to the Round of 64.

text: Matandaan nga nagkit-anay man ang duha sa Miami Open kun sa diin nahimo sang 19-anyos nga Filipina ang daku nga upset sa quarterfinals.
english: The two also met at the Miami Open where the 19-year-old Filipina caused a huge upset in the quarterfinals.

text: Apang antes ang ila posible nga rematch, kinahanglan anay nga lutuson ni Eala ang world no.
english: But before their potential rematch, Eala will first have to defeat the world no.

text: 64 nga si Viktoriya Tomova sang Bulgaria sa Round of 128 5:00 karon sa hapon, oras sa Pilipinas.
english: 64 Viktoriya Tomova of Bulgaria in the Round of 128 5:00 pm Philippine time.

text: 30-anyos ang edad sang top player sang Bulgaria nga nakapang-46 anay sa WTA ranking sang 2024 matapos nakasulod sa second round sang French Open kag US Open.
english: The Bulgarian top player, who previously ranked 46th in the WTA rankings in 2024 after reaching the second round of the French Open and US Open, is 30 years old.

text: Ini nga veteran player ang may WTA 125 title sa idalom sang iya belt nga amo ang 2023 Chicago Challenger, kag nakadaog man sang 18 ITF titles.
english: This veteran player has 125 WTA titles under her belt which is the 2023 Chicago Challenger, and has also won 18 ITF titles.

text: Ang iya pinakamaayo nga resulta subong nga tuig amo ang quarterfinal finish sa WTA 250 Transylvania Open sa Cluj-Napoca, Romania sang Pebrero; samtang ang pinakadalayawon naman nga nahimo ni Eala amo ang semifinal finish sa Miami kun sa diin napierde sini ang tatlo ka Grand Slam champions.
english: Her best result this year was a quarterfinal finish at the WTA 250 Transylvania Open in Cluj-Napoca, Romania in February; while Eala's most impressive achievement was the semifinal finish in Miami where he defeated three Grand Slam champions.

text: Nangin top seed man si Eala sa Oeiras Ladies Open sa Portugal sa nagligad nga semana nga amo ang pamuno sang iya clay court season, apang nalutos ini sa Round of 16 sa kamot ni Panna Udvardy sang Hungary.
english: Eala was also the top seed at the Oeiras Ladies Open in Portugal last week which was the start of her clay court season, but she lost in the Round of 16 at the hands of Panna Udvardy of Hungary.

text: Nag-issue sang emotional tributes sanday Prince William kag Harry sa ila nga lolo nga si Prince Philip nga nagtaliwan sa edad nga 99 anyos.
english: Prince William and Harry issued emotional tributes to their grandfather Prince Philip who died at the age of 99.

text: Liwat nga nag-updanay ang duha ka mga apo ni Philip matapos ang ginakaulamiran nga kontrobersiya sang British Royal Family tuhoy sa ginaalegar racism.
english: Philip's two grandchildren have reunited after the British Royal Family's well-known controversy over alleged racism.

text: Ang pagpadulong ni Harry sa Britanya ang labing una nga kahigayunan humalin sang siya kag tiayon nga si Meghan ang nagbiya sa ila tagsa ka mga royal duties kag nag-istar sa North America.
english: Harry's visit to Britain is the first time since he and wife Meghan left their respective royal duties and settled in North America.

text: Gintawag ni Harry ang iya lolo nga “a man of service, honor and great humor”.
english: Harry called his grandfather “a man of service, honor and great humour”.

text: Nagpasalamat man ini kay Prince Philip bangud sa serbisyo kag dedikasyon sini.
english: He also thanked Prince Philip for his service and dedication.

text: Sa subong, magapabilin anay si Prince Harry sa Frogmore Cottage sa Windsor, England bilang kabahin sang coronavirus protocols antes magtambong sa haya sang ila lolo.
english: For now, Prince Harry will stay at Frogmore Cottage in Windsor, England as part of coronavirus protocols before attending their grandfather's funeral.

text: Samtang suno naman sa anak ni Prince Philip nga si Prince Andrew, apisar nga kilala ang iya iloy nga si Queen Elizabeth II nga mabakod kag wala gid nagareklamo, makit-an nila nga tuman ini nga naapektuhan sa pagtaliwan sang iya bana nga ginkilala bilang “grandfather of the nation”.
english: Meanwhile, Prince Philip's son, Prince Andrew, said that although his mother, Queen Elizabeth II, is known to be strong and never complains, they see that she is deeply affected by the death of her husband, who is known as the “grandfather of the nation”.

text: Nagapangduha-duha si Pavia, Iloilo Sangguniang Bayan Member Roy Gorriceta nga mabuksan sa full capacity ang Ungka Flyover sa Disyembre 25, 2024.
english: Pavia, Iloilo Sangguniang Bayan Member Roy Gorriceta is skeptical that the Ungka Flyover will be opened to full capacity on December 25, 2024.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay SB Gorriceta, iya ginpahayag nga kun bisitahan mo ang area ukon ang flyover, madamo pa sang dapat nga ulubrahon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, SB Gorriceta said that if you visit the area or the flyover, there are still many things to do.

text: Suno kay Gorriceta, ini na ang ika-anom nga promisa sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 nga buksan ang flyover tubtob nakalab-ot subong nga 2024.
english: According to Gorriceta, this is the sixth promise of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 to open the flyover until 2024.

text: Gin-ako man sini nga nakapoy na sila nga mga opisyal ang magbaton sang basol kag nakapoy naman sang hala ka sabat sa mga reklamo sang motorista.
english: He also admitted that they are tired of officials taking the blame and tired of responding to motorists' complaints.

text: Wala man mapunggan ni Gorriceta nga ipabutyag nga gainit na ang ila ulo sa liwat-liwat nga promisa sang DPWH.
english: Gorriceta also said that they are already angry with the repeated promises of the DPWH.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini sa talatapan nga ubrahon nila ang ila responsibilidad bangud bilang opisyal, ubrahon man nila ang nagakadapat nga tikang.
english: He also called on the office to do their responsibility because as officials, they will also do the appropriate steps.

text: Nagpaathag naman ang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 nga kahapon lang nila nabaton ang sulat.
english: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 explained that they received the letter yesterday.

text: Suno kay Engineer Ormel Santos, Representative sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga madamo sila sang gintambongan nga meeting kahapon nga adlaw rason man nga wala sila nakatambong sang session.
english: According to Engineer Ormel Santos, Representative of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6, he said they attended many meetings yesterday which is why they did not attend the session.

text: Apang, nagpasalig man ini nga makakadto ang ila talatapan sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan agud diskusyonan ang flyover.
english: However, he also assured that their office will go to the Sangguniang Panlalawigan to discuss the flyover.

text: Nagalaum naman si Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar nga indi na masulit pa ang natabo.
english: Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar hopes that the incident will not happen again.

text: Ginmanduan man sini SB Gorriceta nga kon matabo nga indi makatambong liwat ang DPWH 6, maghimo na lang sa resolusyon nga naga-request sang transfer sang DPWH Officer agud nga masuportahan sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan.
english: He also instructed SB Gorriceta that if it happens that DPWH 6 cannot attend again, just make a resolution requesting the transfer of the DPWH Officer so that it can be supported by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan.

text: Nagpamahog si Cambodia Prime Minister Hun Sen nga pangpresuhon ang mga nagalapas sa quarantine protocols sa ila pungsod.
english: Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Sen has threatened to imprison those who violate quarantine protocols in his country.

text: Ginpaandaman man niya ang mga civil servants nga madulaan sila sang trabaho kun indi sila magpabakuna batok sa COVID-19.
english: He also warned civil servants that they will lose their jobs if they do not get vaccinated against COVID-19.

text: Ini ang iya nangin mga pahayag samtang padayon nga nagatimbuok ang kaso sang COVID-19 sa Cambodia kun sa diin masobra sa 1,000 infections ang narekord sa magkasunod nga adlaw.
english: He made the remarks as the number of COVID-19 cases in Cambodia continues to rise with more than 1,000 infections recorded in consecutive days.

text: Aminado ang prime minister sang iya kontrobersyal kag harsh nga warning nga ipaidalom sa quick trial kag pagkapreso ang mga nagalapas sa quarantine protocols.
english: The prime minister acknowledged his controversial and harsh warning that those who violate quarantine protocols will be subjected to quick trial and imprisonment.

text: Suno sa iya, mabaton niya nga tawgon siya nga diktador, apang pat-od man nga dayawon siya bangud sang iya pagproteher sa iya mga pumuluyo.
english: He said he could accept being called a dictator, but he would also certainly be praised for protecting his people.

text: Sa subong, ang Cambodia ang nagpasar na sang hagna kun sa diin nakasaad nga tubtob 20 ka tuig ang pagapreso sa mapamatud-an nga guilty sa pag-violate sang COVID-19 rules.
english: Cambodia has already passed a bill that stipulates up to 20 years in prison for those found guilty of violating COVID-19 rules.

text: Gin-anunsyo ni Queen Elizabeth II ang pagtaliwan sang iya ”beloved” nga bana kag ginlaragway ang iya nabatyagan nga ”deep sorrow” santo sa statement nga ginpagwa sang Buckingham palace.
english: Queen Elizabeth II announced the death of her "beloved" husband and described her feelings of "deep sorrow" in a statement issued by Buckingham Palace.

text: Bilang kabahin sang Royal Family, ginsuportahan ni Prince Philip ang rolyo sang Queen pinaagi sa pagpanguna sa madamo nga organisations kag pag-attend sa mga event kaupod ang iya asawa.
english: As part of the Royal Family, Prince Philip supported the Queen's role by leading many organizations and attending events with his wife.

text: Apang paano bala nagkilalahay ang Royal Couple kag diin nag-umpisa ang ila love story?
english: But how did the Royal Couple meet and where did their love story begin?

text:
Yari ang mga dapat mo mahibaluan:

Pag-abot sa mga istorya sa paghigugma, isa sa mala-fairytale love story ang iya nanday Queen Elizabeth nga nahulog ang buot sa iya ginakabig nga ‘Knight in shining armor’ nga si Prince Philip sang Greece kag Denmark.
english:
Here’s what you need to know:

When it comes to love stories, one of the fairytale-like love stories is that of Queen Elizabeth who fell in love with her perceived ‘Knight in shining armour’ Prince Philip of Greece and Denmark.

text: Ang love story nanday Prince Philip kag Queen Elizabeth ang nag-umpisa sang 1930’s sang ang duke ang nangin isa ka cadet sa Britannia Royal Naval College sa Dartmouth.
english: Prince Philip and Queen Elizabeth’s love story dates back to the 1930’s when the duke was a cadet at the Britannia Royal Naval College in Dartmouth.

text: Sang summer sang 1939, nakilala ni Prince Philip ang 13 anyos nga si Princess Elizabeth.
english: In the summer of 1939, Prince Philip met the 13 year old Princess Elizabeth.

text: Si Philip, ang lima ka-tuig nga magulang kay Elizabeth, kag ginhatagan sang katungdanan sang amo nga tion, nga mangin escort sa lamharon nga sanday princess Elizabeth kag utod niya nga si Margaret samtang nagatour sa nasambit nga college ang ila ginikanan nga sanday King George VI kag Queen Elizabeth.
english: Philip, who was five years older than Elizabeth, was given the task of being an escort to the young princess Elizabeth and her sister Margaret while their parents, King George VI and Queen Elizabeth, toured the college.

text: Suno sa governess ni Princess Elizabeth nga si Marion Crawford, ang mala ‘viking’ nga kagwapuhon, blonde nga buhok kag blue nga mga mata ni Prince Philip ang nakacapture sa tagipusuon sang prinsesa.
english: According to Princess Elizabeth's governess, Marion Crawford, Prince Philip's viking-like handsomeness, blonde hair and blue eyes captured the princess' heart.

text: Pahayag ni Crawford, nagablush ang nawong sang prinsesa sang nakaupod niya sa isa ka meal si Prince Philip.
english: Crawford said the princess's face was blushing when she had a meal with Prince Philip.

text: Ang duha ang nagbaylohanay man sang mga sulat sa sulod sang pila ka-tuig samtang nagaserbe si Philip bilang isa sa mga first lieutenants sa Royal Navy.
english: The two also exchanged letters for several years while Philip served as one of the first lieutenants in the Royal Navy.

text: Naimbitahan man si Philip nga magtinir sa Royal Family sa pila ka mga okasyon sa diin tuman nga nahamuot sa iya si princess Elizabeth.
english: Philip was also invited to stay with the Royal Family on several occasions where Princess Elizabeth was very pleased with him.

text: Matapos ang Christmas visit ni Prince Philip sang 1943, nagbutang si Elizabeth sang picture ni Philip sa iya naval uniform sa iya nga dressing table.
english: After Prince Philip's Christmas visit in 1943, Elizabeth put a picture of Philip in his naval uniform on her dressing table.

text: Ang relasyon sa tunga sang duha ang nagpadayon sa pagdalom matapos ang gyera sa diin ang prinsesa ang ginapahayag nga nagahiguma na kay Prince Philip.
english: The relationship between the two continued to deepen after the war with the princess reportedly in love with Prince Philip.

text: Summer sang 1946, pila ka-tuig ang nagligad matapos ang ila una nga pagkit-anay sang nagdesisyon ang duha nga dal-on sa next level ang ila relasyon sa diin naglisensya si Philip sa amay ni Elizabeth nga si King George VI sang engagement.
english: In the summer of 1946, a few years after their first meeting, the two decided to take their relationship to the next level where Philip asked Elizabeth's father, King George VI, for an engagement.

text: SAN-O GINPAKASLAN NI PRINCE PHILIP SI QUEEN ELIZABETH?
english: WHEN DID PRINCE PHILIP MARRIED QUEEN ELIZABETH?

text: Bag-o ma-anunsyo sa publiko ang engagement, kinahanglan ni Prince Philip sang bag-o nga nationality.
english: Before the engagement can be publicly announced, Prince Philip needs a new nationality.

text: Ang dugo ni Prince Philip ang isa ka Danish royal bangod nga ginrecruit sang Greeks ang iya lolo nga isa ka Danish prince, agud mangin ila hari sang 19th century kag may yara man ini German kag English royalty sa iya heritage.
english: Prince Philip's blood is a Danish royal because the Greeks recruited his grandfather, a Danish prince, to be their king in the 19th century and he also has German and English royalty in his heritage.

text: Walo ka-tuig matapos ang gyera sang 1947, ginpakaslan ni Philip si Elizabeth kag ginbayaan niya ang iya Greek citizenship and church kag nangin British, Anglican kag royal duke.
english: Eight years after the war in 1947, Philip married Elizabeth and renounced his Greek citizenship and church and became a British, Anglican and royal duke.

text: Ang Greek prince nangin si Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh, sa iya kasal , titulo nga ginhimo sang amay ni Elizabeth nga si King George VI.
english: The Greek prince became Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh, at his wedding , a title coined by Elizabeth’s father King George VI.

text: Fast forward sa pagkamatay ni Prince Philip sang Abril 9, 2021, 74 ka-tuig na nga nangin kasal ang Royal Couple, may apat ka kabataan, walo ka mga apo kag 10 ka great-grandchildren.
english: Fast forward to Prince Philip’s death on April 9, 2021, the Royal Couple have been married for 74 years, have four children, eight grandchildren and 10 great-grandchildren.

text: Magkaupod nga ginlibot ni Prince Philip kag Queen Elizabeth ang bilog nga kalibutan, halin sa Australia padulong sa America, Africa kag India, kag madamo pa.
english: Together Prince Philip and Queen Elizabeth traveled the world, from Australia to the Americas, Africa and India, and more.

text: Ginsaluhan ni Philip kag Elizabeth ang hugot nga commitment sa ila mga katungdanan kag may lakip nga kalipay, nangin kaupod man nila ang isa kag isa sa pagpamag-an sang kabug-aton sang kabuhi sa publiko.
english: Philip and Elizabeth shared a strong commitment to their duties and with joy, they also became each other's companions in lightening the burden of public life.

text: Sa pribado, ang nangin sweet endearment ni Prince Philip kay Queen Elizabeth amo ang ‘Lilibet’, ‘Darling’ ukon ‘Sausage’ sa diin tuman ang enjoy sang duha sa tion nga magsalo sang pagkaon sa lamesa.
english: In private, Prince Philip's sweet endearment to Queen Elizabeth is 'Lilibet', 'Darling' or 'Sausage' where the two enjoy eating at the table.

text: Wala gin-deny sang pulis nga nahulogan sang debris sa Ungka Flyover sa Pavia, Iloilo nga naglain gid ang iya buot bangud daw kaangay nga ginapaguwa nga butigon siya kasunod sang insidente.
english: The policeman who was hit by debris on the Ungka Flyover in Pavia, Iloilo did not deny that he was very upset because it seemed that he was being exposed as a liar following the incident.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Staff Sergeant Frank Sanchez, Police Officer nga na-assign sa Police Regional Office (PRO) 6, iya ginpahayag nga samtang nagapatuman sila sang traffic jam sa Ungka Flyover, may nagtupad sila nga naga-angkasanay nga mag-asawa sakay sa motor, samtang sa piyak sini ang isa ka awto, kon sa diin, sa amo nga tion, gulpi lang nga may nagdulahog sa iya nga helmet.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Staff Sergeant Frank Sanchez, Police Officer assigned to the Police Regional Office (PRO) 6, said that while they were implementing a traffic jam on the Ungka Flyover, they saw a couple riding a motorcycle next to them, while a car was riding next to them. played with his helmet.

text: Suno kay Sanchez, bangud sa tuman ka todo ang impact, abi niya ginsumbag siya ukon may nag-tripping sa iya.
english: According to Sanchez, because of the impact, he thought he was hit or someone tripped him.

text: Nakit-an man sini ang mga pudpod sang debris kon sa diin, nawas-ag pa sang natupa sa dalan.
english: He also found pieces of debris that had been scattered when they fell on the road.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga gilayon siya naglibot agud nga magsaka sa flyover agud man komprantahon ang kontraktor.
english: He also said that he immediately went around to climb the flyover to confront the contractor.

text: Ginpamangkot man sini kon sa diin ang safety engineer sang proyekto agud kontani nga maistorya apang ang sabat sang trabahador amo ang naglakat ang ila engineer.
english: He also asked where the safety engineer of the project was to talk to him but the worker replied that their engineer had left.

text: Nagdesisyon na lang ang pulis nga magpadulong sa Pavia Municipal Police Station agud nag magpa-blotter sa natabo nga insidente.
english: The police decided to go to the Pavia Municipal Police Station to file a blotter of the incident.

text: Nagpanidugan man si Sanchez nga ang iya presensya sa session ang pagpakita sang kinamatarong para sa mga motorista nga nabiktima kag nadagdagan man sang mga debris sang Ungka Flyover.
english: Sanchez also insisted that his presence in the session was to demonstrate the rights of motorists who were victimized and added to the debris of the Ungka Flyover.

text: Gin-ako sang Anti-squatting and Illegal Structures Unit (ASIS-U) nga wala na nagpamalabag ang kampo sang Team Sulong Gugma kasunod sang ila nga pagkakas sang tarpaulins sa Brgy.
english: The Anti-squatting and Illegal Structures Unit (ASIS-U) admitted that the Team Sulong Gugma camp did not obstruct following their removal of tarpaulins in Brgy.

text: San Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: San Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Love Joy Hosenilla, head sang Anti-squatting and Illegal Structures Unit (ASIS-U), iya ginpahayag nga nagkoordinar sila sa caretaker sang building kon sa diin, nangin matawhay ang ila nga pagbaklas sang tarpaulin.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Love Joy Hosenilla, head of the Anti-squatting and Illegal Structures Unit (ASIS-U), said they coordinated with the caretaker of the building where, they were able to remove the tarpaulin smoothly.

text: Wala naman naglapaw sa 20-minutos ang ila nga pagpangkakas sang amo nga tarpaulin.
english: It did not take them more than 20 minutes to remove the tarpaulin.

text: Suno kay Hosenilla, nabaton sang abogado sang Team Sulong Gugma kahapon nga adlaw ang notice sang Office of the Building Official (OBO) antes sila nga nagpatigayon sang tikang.
english: Hosenilla said the lawyer of Team Sulong Gugma received the notice from the Office of the Building Official (OBO) yesterday before they took action.

text: Nag-request man ang talatapan sang bulig paagi sa boom truck halin sa City Engineering Office agud mas masulhay ang pagkakas sang streamer.
english: The office also requested assistance through a boom truck from the City Engineering Office to facilitate the removal of the streamer.

text: Nag-upod ang Australia sa mga pungsod nga temporaryo nga nag-untat sa paggamit sang AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine sa mga naga-edad 50 anyos panubo bangud sa kahangawa nga mahimo ini magtuga sang blood clots.
english: Australia has joined countries that have temporarily stopped using the AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine in those aged 50 and under over concerns it could cause blood clots.

text: Suno kay Prime Minister Scot Morrison, indi na pagbakunahan pa sang AstraZeneca ang mga tawo nga naga-edad 50 anyos panubo magluwas lang kun nakabaton na ini sang first dose kag wala man sang may nabatyagan nga malala nga epekto.
english: According to Prime Minister Scot Morrison, AstraZeneca will no longer vaccinate people under the age of 50 unless they have received the first dose and have not experienced any serious side effects.

text: Ang Australia ang isa sa mga pungsod sa bilog nga kalibutan nga nangin madinalag-on sa pagpugong sa paglapta sang COVID-19.
english: Australia is one of the countries in the world that has been successful in preventing the spread of COVID-19.

text: May yara lamang sang 30,000 COVID-19 cases ang pungsod kag 1,000 deaths sa 25 ka milyon nga populasyon nga may yara ang Australia kag wala naman sila sang community transmission.
english: The country has only 30,000 COVID-19 cases and 1,000 deaths out of a population of 25 million that Australia has and they have no community transmission.

text: Duha ang kritikal sang ginluthang sang isa ka U.S. Navy hospital corpsman nga sang ulihi naluthangan-patay man sang isa ka katapo sang militar sa Maryland, USA.
english: Two were critically shot by a U.S. Navy hospital corpsman who was later shot dead by a member of the military in Maryland, USA.

text: Ang una nga insidente ang natabo sa commercial park nga Riverside Tech Park sa Frederick, Maryland.
english: The first incident occurred at the commercial park Riverside Tech Park in Frederick, Maryland.

text: Lunsay lalaki ang duha ka mga biktima.
english: Both victims were male.

text: Suno kay Frederick Police Chief Jason Lando, ginatinguhaan pa subong sang mga pulis nga maangot-angot ang natabo sa insidente kag kun ano gid ang rason sang shooting incident.
english: According to Frederick Police Chief Jason Lando, police are still trying to link what happened to the incident and what exactly caused the shooting incident.

text: Gindala sa Shock Trauma Center sa University of Maryland Medical System sa Baltimore ang mga biktima kag padayon nga ginabulong bangud sa kritikal nga kondisyon.
english: The victims were taken to the Shock Trauma Center at the University of Maryland Medical System in Baltimore and are being treated in critical condition.

text: Pagkatapos sang una nga shooting incident, ang ginaalegar nga gunman ang nagpadulong sa Fort Detrick Army base kun sa diin siya ginluthang sang isa military personnel nga amo ang gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: After the first shooting incident, the alleged gunman went to the Fort Detrick Army base where he was shot by a military personnel which led to his death.

text: Padayon pa subong ang imbestigasyon sang mga pulis.
english: Police are still investigating the incident.

text: DAKU nga bugal sang Iloilo kag sang Western Visayas ang pagdaug ni Miss Rabiya Occeña Mateo sang Balasan, Iloilo  bilang Miss Universe Philippines 2020.
english: Miss Rabiya Occeña Mateo of Balasan, Iloilo has won the title of Miss Universe Philippines 2020.

text: Pangaduha na ini siya nga Ilongga nga Miss Universe Philippines.
english: She is the second Ilongga to become Miss Universe Philippines.

text: Una si Louise Aurelio Vail sang Arevalo, Iloilo City sadtong 1965.
english: First was Louise Aurelio Vail of Arevalo, Iloilo City in 1965.

text: Sulod sa Top 15 ini siya sa Miss Universe Pageant sa Miami Beach, Florida.
english: She was in the Top 15 at the Miss Universe Pageant in Miami Beach, Florida.

text: Indi man kita malipat nga ang Miss Philippines una nga ginkilala sa katauhan sang Queen of Manila Carnival sadto, sunu sa historian nga si Atty. Rex Salvilla (+) sa iya “Book 6: Interesting Facts about Western Visayas”.
english: We must not forget that Miss Philippines was first recognized in the Queen of Manila Carnival, according to historian Atty. Rex Salvilla (+) in his “Book 6: Interesting Facts about Western Visayas”.

text: Si Atty. Salvilla presidente sadto sang Iloilo Historical Association kag Western Visayas Historical Foundation, Inc.
english: Atty. Salvilla, former president of the Iloilo Historical Association and Western Visayas Historical Foundation, Inc.

text: Isa man siya ka accredited speaker sa lokal nga kasaysayan sang Philippine Centennial Commission kag National Commission on Culture and Arts.
english: He is also an accredited speaker on local history of the Philippine Centennial Commission and the National Commission on Culture and Arts.

text: Ginkilala nga Miss Philippines ang Queen of Manila Carnival tungod nagaisahanon sa kadaku ini nga beauty contest sang mga maanyag nga mga lin-ay sa pungsod.
english: The Queen of Manila Carnival is known as Miss Philippines because it is the only beauty contest in the country.

text: Una ini ginhiwat sadtong Pebrero 1908.
english: It was first held in February 1908.

text: Tungod sini, matudlo naton ang pila pa ka Ilongga bilang dugang nga Miss Philippines – nga sa karon na-categorize sa Binibining Pilipinas, Miss Universe Philippines, Miss International Philippines, Miss World Philippines, kag kon ano pa nga titulo.
english: Because of this, we can point out some more Ilonggas as additional Miss Philippines – which is currently categorized into Binibining Pilipinas, Miss Universe Philippines, Miss International Philippines, Miss World Philippines, and whatever other titles.

text: Isa sa ila amo si Purificacion “Pura” Villanueva, ang una nga Miss Philippines, nga bugal sang Arevalo, Siyudad sang Iloilo kag sang aton rehiyon nga Western Visayas.
english: One of them is Purificacion “Pura” Villanueva, the first Miss Philippines, the pride of Arevalo, Iloilo City and our region of Western Visayas.

text: Ginkoronahan siya bilang Queen of Manila Carnival sadtong 1907.
english: She was crowned Queen of Manila Carnival in 1907.

text: Manunulat siya kag tagdampig sang mga kababaehan sang iya panahon, katulad, sa karon, ni Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Elisa Magnayon Gray.
english: She was a writer and advocate for women of her time, such as, today, Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Elisa Magnayon Gray.

text: Nagsunod ang iya anak nga si Maria Villanueva Kalaw Katigbak, ang “Queen of the Orient of the Manila Carnival” sadtong 1931.
english: His daughter Maria Villanueva Kalaw Katigbak, the “Queen of the Orient of the Manila Carnival” in 1931, followed.

text: Isa man siya ka manunulat, katulad sang iya iloy, nga nangin senador sang pungsod sadtong 1961-1967.
english: She was also a writer, like her mother, who was a senator of the country from 1961-1967.

text: Sumunod si Mercedes M. Montilla bilang 1936 Queen of Manila Carnival.
english: Mercedes M. Montilla followed as the 1936 Queen of Manila Carnival.

text: Tumandok siya sang Sipalay, Negros Occidental kon diin nangin alkalde siya sa sulod sang tatlo ka termino.
english: He is a native of Sipalay, Negros Occidental where he served as mayor for three terms.

text:
Ang iban pa nga beauty queens halin sa Western Visayas galakip kanday:

* Aurora Pijuan, 1970 Miss International; Binibining Pilipinas- International 1969 Margaret Rose “Binky” Orbe Montinola, Top 15; Emma Ruth Yulo, 1969 Miss Queen of the Pacific, 2nd Runner-Up; Dolly Ascalon, Bb.
english:
Other beauty queens from Western Visayas include:

* Aurora Pijuan, 1970 Miss International; Miss Philippines- International 1969 Margaret Rose “Binky” Orbe Montinola, Top 15; Emma Ruth Yulo, 1969 Miss Queen of the Pacific, 2nd Runner-Up; Dolly Ascalon, Bb.

text: Pilipinas-International 1976; Geraldine Edith “Pebbles” Asis, Bb.
english: Philippines-International 1976; Geraldine Edith “Pebbles” Asis, Bb.

text:
Pilipinas-Universe 1987, semi-finalist;

* Philippine Centennial Queen 1998 Carmela Arcolas; Bb.
english:
Pilipinas-Universe 1987, semi-finalist;

* Philippine Centennial Queen 1998 Carmela Arcolas; Bb.

text: Pilipinas-Universe 1998 Jennifer Barrientos; Bb.
english: Pilipinas-Universe 1998 Jennifer Barrientos; Bb.

text: Pilipinas-Universe 1991 Anjanette Palencia Abayari; kag Siobhan Salvilla Cox , 2004 Miss New Zealand-Philippines.
english: Pilipinas-Universe 1991 Anjanette Palencia Abayari; and Siobhan Salvilla Cox , 2004 Miss New Zealand-Philippines.

text:
***

Sa iya pagdaug, ginpangunahan ni Rabiya ang 45 pa ka contestants sa isa ka maduagon nga coronation night sadtong Oktubre 25, 2020 sa Baguio Country Club.
english:
***

With her victory, Rabiya led 45 other contestants in a victorious coronation night on October 25, 2020 at the Baguio Country Club.

text: Natawo sia sadtong 1996, nga ang ngalan nagakahulugan “Princess” ukon “Queen” sa tinaga nga Muslim.
english: She was born in 1996, with the name meaning “Princess” or “Queen” in the Muslim word.

text: Anak siya sang isa ka Muslim Indian-American doctor nga naghigugma sa isa ka Ilongga nga taga-Balasan, Iloilo.
english: She is the daughter of a Muslim Indian-American doctor who fell in love with an Ilongga from Balasan, Iloilo.

text: Sang magdaug siya bilang Miss Iloilo 2020 angot sa pag-selebrar sang Iloilo Dinagyang, ginhingadlan man siya dayon nga Miss Iloilo Universe 2020 bilang pambato na sa Miss Universe Philippines 2020.
english: When she won as Miss Iloilo 2020 in connection with the celebration of Iloilo Dinagyang, she was also named Miss Iloilo Universe 2020 as a candidate for Miss Universe Philippines 2020.

text: Nagtapos si Rabiya nga cum laude sa kurso nga Bachelor of Science in Physical Therapy sa Iloilo Doctors College.
english: Rabiya graduated cum laude with a Bachelor of Science in Physical Therapy from Iloilo Doctors College.

text: Nagatrabaho siya subong bilang lecturer kag review coordinator sa SRG Manila Review Center.
english: He is currently working as a lecturer and review coordinator at SRG Manila Review Center.

text:
***

Indi ko seguro paryente si Miss Rabiya Mateo bisan pareho kami sing apelyido tungod wala man ako sing nahibal-an sa ila pamilya halin sadto.
english:
***

I don't think Miss Rabiya Mateo is related to me even though we have the same surname because I don't know anything about their family since then.

text: Kon paryente man, basi malayo na kaayo lapaw sa pakatlo, nga ginakilala namon nga suod gihapon sa amon.
english: If it is a relative, it may be too far beyond the third, which we recognize as still close to us.

text: Pero nasaktan gid ako sa akusasyon sang isa ka kandidata nga wala nagdaug.
english: But I was really hurt by the accusation of a candidate who didn’t win.

text: Kesyo nagdinaya si Rabiya.
english: Rabiya allegedly cheated.

text: Ginbuligan siya kuno sang kon sin-o agud makabentaha sa iban.
english: He was allegedly helped by someone to gain an advantage over others.

text: Gintagaan siya kuno sini sang mga kwestyon in advance para ma-preparahan niya sing maayo.
english: He allegedly gave her questions in advance so she could prepare well.

text: Imposible!
english: Impossible!

text: Aba, kag namahog pa nga may ibulgar siya!
english: Oh, and he even threatened to expose something!

text: Sang ano?!
english: Of what?!

text: Basi nalipat ka nga maalam (cum laude) si Rabiya kag kaya niya sabton ang ano man nga kwestyon sing mas maayo sa imo.
english: Maybe you forgot that Rabiya is smart (cum laude) and can answer any question better than you.

text: Silingon mo indi ka lang makabaton sing kapierdihan.
english: Say you just can’t take a loss.

text: Bad loser ka!
english: Bad loser you!

text: Ang mga Ilonggo mabuot, pero masakit man kon mangagat, katulad ni Miriam Defensor nga idolo ni Rabiya, gani kwidaw maghimu-himo ka lang sing istorya!
english: Ilonggos are kind, but they also hurt when they bite, like Miriam Defensor, Rabiya's idol, so don't just make up stories!

text: Basi magbalik pa ina sa imo./PN
english: Maybe it will come back to you./PN

text: Ginlutos sang Minnesota Timberwolves si LeBron James kag ang Los Angeles Lakers, 117-95, sa opisyal nga pag-umpisa sang National Basketball Association (NBA) Western Conference playoff series.
english: The Minnesota Timberwolves defeated LeBron James and the Los Angeles Lakers, 117-95, to officially kick off the National Basketball Association (NBA) Western Conference playoff series.

text: Nanguna sa Wolves si Jaden McDaniels nga may 25 points samtang may 22 points naman ang young superstar nga si Anthony Edwards.
english: Jaden McDaniels led the Wolves with 25 points while young superstar Anthony Edwards had 22 points.

text: Sa Lakers, may 37 puntos si Luka Doncic sa iya una nga post-season game kaupod sa Los Angeles; samtang, si LeBron naman nga nagalagas sa iya ikalima nga titulo sa iya ika-22 nga season sa liga ang nagdugang sang 19 points matapos wala gid naka-skor sa first quarter.
english: With the Lakers, Luka Doncic had 37 points in his first post-season game with Los Angeles; meanwhile, LeBron, who is chasing his fifth title in his 22nd season in the league, added 19 points after going scoreless in the first quarter.

text: Ang Lakers amo lamang ang isahanon nga home team nga nalutos sa imbukada nga adlaw sa first-round action sa playoffs.
english: The Lakers are the only home team to lose on opening day in first-round action in the playoffs.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nalutsan naman sang Denver Nuggets ang Los Angeles Clippers, 112-110, paagi sa overtime didto sa Denver.
english: Meanwhile, the Denver Nuggets beat the Los Angeles Clippers, 112-110, in overtime in Denver.

text: Nanguna ang Reigning NBA Most Valuable Player nga si Nikola Jokic nga may 29 points kag Aaron Gordon nga may 25 points agud mapanas ang temprano nga 15-pt deficit sa hampang.
english: Reigning NBA Most Valuable Player Nikola Jokic led the way with 29 points and Aaron Gordon with 25 points to erase an early 15-pt deficit in the game.

text: Daog naman ang New York Knicks paagi sa pagbubo sang 40 puntos sa fourth quarter sa hampang sini batok sa Detroit Pistons sa Madison Square Garde.
english: The New York Knicks won by pouring 40 points in the fourth quarter against the Detroit Pistons at Madison Square Garden.

text: Nagtakop ang hampang, 123-112.
english: The game ended, 123-112.

text: Samtang, malayo naman ang antad sang Indiana Pacers sa ila hampang batok kay two-time NBA MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo kag Milwaukee Bucks nga nagtapos sa 117-98.
english: Meanwhile, the Indiana Pacers were far from two-time NBA MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo and the Milwaukee Bucks, who finished 117-98.

text: Daw ano kalawig ang imo masikad-sikad antes mangampo ang imo nga mga tiil?
english: How long can you walk before your feet give out?

text: Kilalahon ta ang isa ka cyclist halin sa Kashmir, India nga amo ang nag-guba sang isa ka Guinness World Record paagi sa pagbisekleta sang 2,000 ka milya halin sa pinaka-naaminhan sang India tubtob sa pinakanabagatnan sa sulod lang sang 8 ka adlaw, 1 ka oras, kag 37 minutos.
english: Let’s meet a cyclist from Kashmir, India who broke a Guinness World Record by cycling 2,000 miles from the northernmost point of India to the southernmost point in just 8 days, 1 hour, and 37 minutes.

text: Ang siklista amo si Adil Teli, 23, tumandok sang Kashmir.
english: The cyclist was identified as Adil Teli, 23, a native of Kashmir.

text: Naghalin siya sa Kashmir sang Marso 22 kag walo ka adlaw ang nakaligad, nag-abot siya sa Kanyakumari, banwa sa southern tip sang India.
english: He left Kashmir on March 22 and eight days later, he arrived in Kanyakumari, town at the southern tip of India.

text: Ang 8 ka adlaw, 1 ka oras kag 37 minutos nga rekord ni Teli ang nagpierde sa September 2020 nga rekord ni Om Hitendra Mahajan sang ginkumpleto niya ang amo nga journey sa amo man nga lugar sa sulod sang 8 ka adlaw, 7 ka oras kag 38 minutos.
english: Teli’s 8 days, 1 hour and 37 minutes record beat Om Hitendra Mahajan’s September 2020 record when he completed the same journey in the same place in 8 days, 7 hours and 38 minutes.

text: Ginakalipay sang Team Pabalhas nga amo ang developer sang Dinagyang Festival ticket website nga mahimo na nga mabakal ang tickets online.
english: Team Pabalhas, the developer of the Dinagyang Festival ticket website, is pleased that tickets can now be purchased online.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jeffrey Natividad, sang Team Pabalhas Developer, iya ginpahayag nga ang innovation nga ila nahimo ang para sa tagsa ka mga Ilonggo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jeffrey Natividad, of Team Pabalhas Developer, said that the innovation they have done is for every Ilonggo.

text: Suno kay Natividad, nagsugod ang baligyaanay nila sang ticket online sa isa ka sport event sang Iloilo City.
english: According to Natividad, they started selling tickets online at a sport event in Iloilo City.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga isa ini ka kahigayonan agud makahatag sang convenience sa mga Ilonggo.
english: He also said that this is an opportunity to provide convenience to Ilonggos.

text: May mga indibidwal naman ang nakabakal na sang ticket online.
english: Some individuals have already bought tickets online.

text: Gin-ako ni Janiuay Sangguniang Bayan Member Atty. Mayen Mar Gulmatico nga ginkakibot niya ang pagtudlo-tudlo sa iya ni Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office-OIC Jojo De Paula.
english: Janiuay admitted Sangguniang Bayan Member Atty. Mayen Mar Gulmatico said he was surprised by the pointing out of him by Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office-OIC Jojo De Paula.

text: Ini kasunod man sang ila pagsabtanay sa ginpatigayon nga budget hearing para sa Fiscal Year 2025 sang Janiuay.
english: This follows their agreement during the budget hearing for Fiscal Year 2025 of Janiuay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Gulmatico, iya ginpahayag nga posible na-trigger gid si De Paula sa iya nangin pamangkot rason nga nagsaligbat ini samtang nagapadayona ang hearing.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Gulmatico, he said that De Paula may have been triggered by his question and refused while the hearing continued.

text: Ginpanginwala man sini nga ginapulitika niya ang budget hearing bangud masami na niya nga ginapamangkot ang mga palamangkutanon kon may budget hearing.
english: He also denied that he was politicizing the budget hearing because he often asked questions when there was a budget hearing.

text: Suno kay Gulmatico, bilang parte sang legislative body, kinamatarong niya nga magpamangkot kag i-representar ang mga tawo.
english: According to Gulmatico, as part of the legislative body, it is his right to ask questions and represent the people.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga nagsiling pa siya kay de Paula nga hulaton ang iya nga turno antes nga magsabat kon sa diin, makapila man ka beses nga ginsaway ni Vice Mayor Corel Hannah Locsin-Yap.
english: He also explained that he told de Paula to wait for his turn before responding where, Vice Mayor Corel Hannah Locsin-Yap repeatedly reprimanded him.

text: Sang ulihe, gin-declare ni SB Member James Adelantar nga out of order si De Paula kag ginpaboran ini sang mga kaupdanan niya nga konsehal.
english: Later, SB Member James Adelantar declared De Paula out of order and his fellow councilors favored him.

text: Labi pa nga ginpabaskog ang kalakasan sa eastern Myanmar paagi sa paglunsar sang militar sang bag-o nga mga air attacks.
english: The military has further intensified the violence in eastern Myanmar by launching new air attacks.

text: Ang military air strikes ukon mga pagpang-atake ang rason kun ngaa linibo ka tawo halin sa Karen ethnic minority ang nagtinguha nga makatabok sa border kag makapalagyo padulong sa Thailand.
english: The military air strikes are the reason why thousands of people from the Karen ethnic minority tried to cross the border and flee to Thailand.

text: Una naman nga nagpanginwala ang prime minister sang Thailand nga ginpwersa nila nga pabalikon sa Myanmar ang mga refugees bangud ginapahayag nga nagbalik sila sa ila pungsod santo sa ila kaugalingon nga kagustuhan.
english: Earlier, Thailand's prime minister denied that they forced the refugees back to Myanmar because they allegedly returned to their country of their own free will.

text: Apang wala man lang nagatawhay ang sitwasyon sa Myamar.
english: But the situation in Myanmar is not calming down.

text: Ginkumpirma mi Saw Taw Nee, head sang foreign affairs department sang Karen National Union ukon ang political body nga nagatiglawas sang Karen minority, nga duha ka bag-o nga raids sang Martes ang nagbilin sang anum ka patay sa sibilyan kag 11 ang pilason.
english: We confirmed Saw Taw Nee, head of the foreign affairs department of the Karen National Union or the political body representing the Karen minority, that two recent raids on Tuesday left six civilians dead and 11 injured.

text: May kaangtanan diri nagpahayag si Thai Prime Minister Prayuth Chan-ocha nga handa ang pungsod Thailand ang amumahon ang sin-o man nga nagapalagyo halin sa mga pagpang-atake sa Myanmar.
english: In this regard, Thai Prime Minister Prayuth Chan-ocha said that Thailand is ready to take care of anyone fleeing from the attacks in Myanmar.

text: Sa subong, masobra na sa 500 ang patay sa Myanmar kasunod sang ginpatuman nga kudeta sang Pebrero 1.
english: So far, more than 500 people have died in Myanmar following the February 1 coup.

text: (Photos are from AP)
english: (Photos are from AP)

text: Gin-athag ni Janiuay, Iloilo Sangguniang Bayan Member James Adelantar nga nagsugod ang masingki nga pagsabtanay sa budget hearing para sa Fiscal Year 2025 sang Janiuay sang nagsabat si Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office-OIC Jojo De Paula kay Sangguniang Bayan Member Atty. Mayen Mar Gulmatico samtang nagapadayon ang hearing.
english: Janiuay, Iloilo Sangguniang Bayan Member James Adelantar explained that the violent argument in the budget hearing for Fiscal Year 2025 of Janiuay began when Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office-OIC Jojo De Paula responded to Sangguniang Bayan Member Atty. Mayen Mar Gulmatico while the hearing continues.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay SB Adelantar, iya ginpahayag nga una nga ginsaway si De Paula ni Vice Mayor Corel Hannah Locsin-Yap nga indi magsaligbat samtang wala man ini gina-istorya ukon ginapamangkot.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, SB Adelantar said De Paula was first reprimanded by Vice Mayor Corel Hannah Locsin-Yap not to interrupt while he was not talked to or asked.

text: Suno kay Adelantar, ini man ang nangin rason ko ngaa nagpaandam siya nga i-declare ini out of order kun mapadayon pa sang saligbat si De Paula.
english: According to Adelantar, this is also the reason why he warned to declare it out of order if De Paula continues to criticize.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang ginpamangkot lamang ni Gulmatico kon ngaa kinahanglan nga maglisensya gid sa utod ni De Paula kon maggamit sang mga heavy equipment.
english: He also said that Gulmatico only asked why De Paula's brother had to get a license when using heavy equipment.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga ang punto lamang ni Gulmatico sa iya pagpamangkot amo agud masabat ang mga palamangkutanon man sang pila ka mga punong barangay kon sila ang nagagamit sang heavy equipment.
english: He also explained that the only point of Gulmatico in his question was to answer the questions of some barangay captains if they are using heavy equipment.

text: Ginklaro man ni Adelantar nga wala gid sang labot si De Paula sa deliberation nga natabo bangud nagtambong lang ini bangud man sa ang masunod nga diskusyonan, ang budget sang iya opisina.
english: Adelantar also clarified that De Paula had nothing to do with the deliberation that took place because he only attended because of the next discussion, the budget of his office.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang hearing ang may tuyo nga diskusyonan ang proposed budget sang Office of the Municipal Engineer sang Janiuay, Iloilo.
english: The hearing was aimed at discussing the proposed budget of the Office of the Municipal Engineer of Janiuay, Iloilo.

text: Kumpletuhon anay sang United Kingdom ang pagbakuna sa ila adult population antes maghatag sang bakuna sa iban nga mga pungsod.
english: The United Kingdom will complete vaccination of its adult population before offering the vaccine to other countries.

text: Masobra na sa 30 million ka Britons ang nakabaton sang una nga dose sang COVID-19 vaccine.
english: More than 30 million Britons have received the first dose of the COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Target sang otoridad sa amo nga pungsod nga maubos bakuna ang tanan nga adult sa katapusan nga bahin sang Hulyo.
english: Authorities in the country target to have all adults vaccinated by the end of July.

text: Apang ang problema subong amo nga may iban nga pungsod sa European Union nga may mahinay nga vaccination rollout.
english: But the problem now is that there are other countries in the European Union that have had a slow vaccination rollout.

text: Suno naman kay British business minister Kwasi Kwarteng, handa man sila nga magkooperar kag magbulig sa iban nga pungsod kag indi magkumpetensya sa iban nga mga lugar.
english: British business minister Kwasi Kwarteng said they are also ready to cooperate and help other countries and not compete in other areas.

text: Apang sa pamangkot kun mabuligan sang UK ang kaiping nga lugar nga Ireland, ginpahayag ni Kwarteng nga kun may surplus vaccine doses, mahimo gid sila nga makashare.
english: But when asked if the UK could help neighboring Ireland, Kwarteng said that if there were surplus vaccine doses, they could share.

text: Apang sa subong suno sa iya, wala pa sang surplus kag madamo pa sila sang dapat nga bakunahan.
english: But for now, he said, there is no surplus and they still have a lot to vaccinate.

text: Gin-anunsyar ni Pope Francis ang plano nga buhinan ang sweldo sang mga cardinal kag pari.
english: Pope Francis has announced plans to cut the salaries of cardinals and priests.

text: Ini ang kabahin sang padayon nga pagpanikasog sang Santo Papa agud nga ibutang sa insakto ang finances sang Holy See kag makakinot.
english: This is part of the Pope's ongoing efforts to put the Holy See's finances in order and save money.

text: Ang Holy See amo ang pangalan nga ginhatag sa gobyerno sang Roman Church Catholic nga ginapamunuan sang Santo Papa bilang obispo sang Roma.
english: The Holy See is the name given to the government of the Roman Catholic Church headed by the Pope as bishop of Rome.

text: Sa Abril 1 mangin epektibo ang pagbuhin sang 10 percent sa mga sweldo sang Cardinals samtang 3 percent naman ang buhin sa paycheck sang mga kaparian.
english: On April 1, a 10 percent cut in Cardinals' salaries will take effect while a 3 percent cut in priests' paychecks will take effect.

text: Ang mga sweldo naman sang department heads kag secretaries sang dicasteries ang buhinan sang 8 percent.
english: The salaries of department heads and secretaries of dicasteries will be reduced by 8 percent.

text: Katuyuan sang pagbuhin sang mga sweldo amo ang malikawan nga madulaan sang trabaho ang iban nga mga cardinal kag pari bangud sa epekto sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The purpose of the salary cuts is to prevent other cardinals and priests from losing their jobs due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ginalauman na sang Holy See nga magadangat sa 50 million euro ukon P2.8 billion ang madula sa ila subong nga tuig bangud sa pandemya.
english: The Holy See expects to lose 50 million euros or P2.8 billion this year due to the pandemic.

text: Humalin sang nangin Santo Papa si Francis sang 2013, gintinguhaan na niya nga mabutang sa insakto ang kwarta sang Holy See agud nga may yara sang accountability kag transparency sa Vatican.
english: Since Francis became Pope in 2013, he has tried to put the Holy See's money in order so that there is accountability and transparency in the Vatican.

text: 15 ka mga tawo ang patay kag kapin 400 ang nagapabilin nga missing bangud sang lapnagon nga sunog nga nagluntad sa Rohingya refugee camp sa Bangladesh.
english: 15 people have been killed and more than 400 remain missing in a widespread fire that broke out in a Rohingya refugee camp in Bangladesh.

text: Suno kay Johannes Van der Klaauw, Deputy Humanitarian Coordinator sa idalom sang United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees, masobra man sa 550 ang pilason sa amo nga sunog kag 45,000 ka tawo ang nadulaan sang puluy-an.
english: According to Johannes Van der Klaauw, Deputy Humanitarian Coordinator under the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees, more than 550 people were injured in the fire and 45,000 people were displaced.

text: Padayon pa subong nga ginaimbestigaran sang mga opisyal sa Bangladesh kun ano ang rason sa natabo nga makamamatay nga sunog.
english: Officials in Bangladesh are still investigating the cause of the deadly fire.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-umpisa ang kalayo sa Balukhali camp malapit sa southeastern town sang Cox’s Bazar sang Lunes sang gab-i kag ginapahayag anum ka oras ang ginlawig sang sunog antes ini nadeklarar nga under control.
english: The fire broke out in the Balukhali camp near the southeastern town of Cox's Bazar on Monday night and reportedly lasted six hours before it was declared under control.

text: Bilog nga gab-i man nga nakit-an nga nagaaso ang pila ka bahin sang amo nga kampo.
english: Parts of the camp were also seen smoking throughout the night.

text: Suno naman sa Ministry of Disaster Management and Relief, 40,000 huts sa amo nga kampo ang naubos lamon sang kalayo.
english: According to the Ministry of Disaster Management and Relief, 40,000 huts in the camp were destroyed by the fire.

text: Duha man ka mayor nga ospital sang International Organization for Migration (IOM) kag Turkish government ang nahalitan.
english: Two major hospitals of the International Organization for Migration (IOM) and the Turkish government were also damaged.

text: Ginkasal ang 80-anyos nga si Batangas Governor Hermilando Mandanas sa abogada nga si Atty. Angelica Chua sa Basilica of the Immaculate Conception Batangas, Myerkules, Mayo 8.
english: 80-year-old Batangas Governor Hermilando Mandanas was married to lawyer Atty. Angelica Chua at the Basilica of the Immaculate Conception Batangas, Wednesday, May 8.

text: “I came here not only of my own free will, but full of love,” kabahin sang wedding vow sang gobernador sa iya bride.
english: “I came here not only of my own free will, but full of love,” part of the governor's wedding vow to his bride.

text: Ginapahayag nga malapit 50-anyos ang agwat sang ila nga edad.
english: They are reportedly close to 50 years apart in age.

text:
“I am ready whether it is going to be for better or for worse, for richer or for poorer, til death do us part, exclusive.”

Sa vow naman ni Chua, ginsiling sini nga ginhagad siya ni Mandanas nga mag-date sang Valentine’s Day.
english:
“I am ready whether it is going to be for better or for worse, for richer or for poorer, til death do us part, exclusive.”

In his vow, Chua said Mandanas invited him on a date on Valentine's Day.

text: “I thank you for having the courage to ask me to be your valentine and for choosing to spend the rest of your life with me,” pahayag sini.
english: “I thank you for having the courage to ask me to be your valentine and for choosing to spend the rest of your life with me,” it said.

text: Emosyonal man si Chua sang ginpaathag sini kun ngaa nagpasugot siya nga makasal sa gobernador.
english: Chua was also emotional when she explained why she agreed to marry the governor.

text: “I’ve had my heart broken so many times that I guarded up and raised my standards so high, so high no one was supposed to reach it so I won’t get hurt again, until you came.
english: “I’ve had my heart broken so many times that I guarded up and raised my standards so high, so high no one was supposed to reach it so I won’t get hurt again, until you came.

text: You showed me that I deserved to be loved and respected, that with you, I can put my guard down,” pahayag sini.
english: You showed me that I deserved to be loved and respected, that with you, I can put my guard down,” she said.

text: Ginpatigayon ang reception sang kasal sa atubang sang provincial capitol.
english: The wedding reception was held in front of the provincial capitol.

text: Sandig sa reports, nagsugod sa pag-date ang duha subong lamang nga tuig nga malapit duha ka tuig kasunod sang kamatayon sang anay asawa ni Mandanas nga si Anakalusugan Party-list nominee Regina Reyes.
english: According to reports, the two started dating this year, nearly two years after the death of Mandanas' ex-wife, Anakalusugan Party-list nominee Regina Reyes.

text: Lakip sa mga nagtambong sa kasal amo sanday President Bongbong Marcos, First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, Former President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo, House Speaker Rep.
english: Among those attending the wedding were President Bongbong Marcos, First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, Former President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo, House Speaker Rep.

text: Martin Romualdez, kag iban pa.
english: Martin Romualdez, and others.

text: KON bala mapatay kita ukon indi, indi ina ginabaisan pa.
english: WHETHER we die or not is not up for debate.

text: Given na ina kag indi na ginapuisan pa.
english: That's a given and not anymore.

text:
Kamatuoran na ina nga indi masikway samtang ang tawo, taw o.

Kon may isyu man dira, sa tatlo seguro ka mayor nga bagay: San-o bala matabo inang kamatayon?
english:
That is a fact that cannot be denied while man is man.

If there is an issue, it is probably in three main things: When will that death occur?

text: Ano ang kabangdanan sinang kamatayon?
english: What was the cause of that death?

text: Kag, paano ini malikawan, kon malikawan pa?
english: And, how can it be avoided, if at all?

text: Syempre, wala sang isa sa aton ang luyag anay mapatay, luas kon suicidal ka tungod desperado ka sa pangabuhi ukon tungod sa indi mabaton nga kapaslawan sa relasyon, ukon nakahanda ka na gid man agud magpahuway sa bagay mo na nga katigulangon.
english: Of course, none of us want to die first, unless you are suicidal because you are desperate for life or because of an unacceptable failure in a relationship, or you are ready to retire in your old age.

text: Kon pamangkuton kita kon san-o naton luyag mapatay, laban-laban ang sabat: Indi anay!
english: When asked when we would like to die, the answer is often: Not yet!

text: Sa madamo nga rason.
english: For many reasons.

text: Katulad sang bata pa ako; matahum bisan magamo pa ining kalibutan; may matahum nga handom pa ako nga luyag matuman; indi ko pa mapabay-an ang mga masakiton ko nga mga ginikanan; luyag ko anay ma-experyensyahan ang maka-pamilya; kag kon ano pa.
english: Like when I was a kid; beautiful even though this world is chaotic; I still have a beautiful dream that I want to fulfill; I can't let go of my sick parents yet; I wanted to experience the family first; and whatnot.

text: Kon sa ano nga kabangdanan nga maabot na inang tion, ina ang indi naton mapihu.
english: For what reason that time will come, we cannot be sure.

text: Sa pakot-pakot lang seguro kay ang Ginuo lang ang lubos sina kahibalo.
english: It's probably just a guess because only the Lord knows that.

text: Masiling ka basi tungod sa high blood, heart failure, ukon sa ano pa nga ginabatyag, gali mapatay ka man lang sa tetanus nga tuga sang tunok sang salingsing sang kawayan.
english: You might say that because of high blood pressure, heart failure, or some other illness, you will die of tetanus caused by the thorns of bamboo shoots.

text: Posible man sa aksidente, sa malain nga tuyu sang isig-katawo, sa tion sang pagtuman sang obligasyon sa banwa bilang pulis ukon soldado, sa pag-risgo sing kabuhi agud maluas sa peligro ang mahal sa kabuhi, ukon tungod man sa hinali nga pag-atake sang bag-o nga balatian katulad sang COVID-19.
english: It is also possible by accident, by the malicious intent of a fellow human being, during the performance of obligations to the city as a policeman or soldier, by risking one's life to save a loved one from danger, or by a sudden attack of a new disease such as COVID-19.

text:
***

Sa kaso sang COVID-19, nga amo gid ang ginapaligban sang bug-os nga kalibutan sa subong, paano bala naton malikawan ang ma-infect sini, kag kon ma-infect na nga maluas kita sa makamamatay sini nga pag-atake?
english:
***

In the case of COVID-19, which is the world's concern right now, how can we avoid being infected, and once infected, be saved from this deadly attack?

text: Una sa tanan, dapat nahibal-an naton kon daw ano kapintas ining COVID-19.
english: First of all, we should know how cruel this COVID-19 is.

text: Sunu sa pagtuon kag findings sang mga siyentipiko, “rare”, ukon sa malaka, nga madutlan sini ang mga kabataan.
english: According to studies and findings of scientists, it is “rare”, or rare, for children to be infected.

text: Sa kabug-usan sang populasyon, “mild” lang ang igu sini sa 80 porsyento sang mga infected.
english: Of the total population, 80 percent of those infected are mildly affected.

text: In other words madale ini mapaayo sa 80 percent ka infected.
english: In other words it is easy to cure in 80 percent of infected.

text: Pwede na ang supportive care kag home quarantine diri agud indi ka man makalaton sa iban nga myembro sang pamilya.
english: Supportive care and home quarantine are available here so that you do not infect other family members.

text: Kinse porsyento (15 percent) sang pasyente “moderate” lang ang igu sang COVID-19, nga mapaayo man sa ospital paagi sa therapeutic remedies nga basi indi naman gani kinahanglan ang respiratory machine para maghalog ang pagginhawa.
english: Fifteen percent of patients have only moderate COVID-19 infections, which can be treated in hospital with therapeutic remedies that may not even require a respiratory machine to breathe.

text: Ang five percent sa pasyente amo ang “serious” ukon “critical” ang sitwasyon, nga kinahanglan ang seryoso nga pagtatap sa pasyente, nga basi kinahanglan pa i-rekomenda ang pagtughong sang convalescent blood plasma kag dugang nga drugs agud mapaayo ang kahimtangan.
english: Five percent of the patients are in “serious” or “critical” condition, requiring serious care, which may require transfusion of convalescent blood plasma and additional drugs to improve the condition.

text: Sa masami, ginaigu sini ang mga may pondo na nga daan nga balatian katulad sang high blood, heart failure, diabetes, asthma kag iban pa.
english: Often, it affects those with pre-existing diseases such as high blood, heart failure, diabetes, asthma and others.

text:
***

In fact, kon hambalan ang medical record sang mga pasyente, ang COVID-19 indi gid man “alarming” gid base sa death rate, ukon pagkamatay, sang mga pasyente.
english:
***

In fact, when it comes to the medical records of the patients, COVID-19 is not really “alarming” based on the death rate, or mortality, of the patients.

text: Sa Estados Unidos, sa Uropa kag bisan sa China, ang nagakapatay sa COVID-19 mga 2-3 percent lang sang populasyon.
english: In the United States, in Europe and even in China, COVID-19 mortality is only about 2-3 percent of the population.

text: Ang ulihi nga data diri sa Filipinas sadtong Oktubre 20, 2020, sunu sa Department of Health, nagapakita nga may 360,775 na kita ka kaso, kag ang napatay naglab-ut na sa 6,670, ukon 1.8 percent sang populasyon.
english: The latest data here in the Philippines on October 20, 2020, according to the Department of Health, shows that we have 360,775 cases, and the death toll has reached 6,670, or 1.8 percent of the population.

text: That means duha sang infected ang posible mapatay sa 100 sa ila!
english: That means two of the infected are likely to die out of 100 of them!

text: Apang sa teoriya, ukon sa papel, lang ini.
english: But it is only in theory, or on paper.

text: Sa aktwal posible wala man gani sing mapatay sa ila kon ang tanan nga 100 husto lang ang paghalong, labi na gid ikaw nga nagahalong gid sing husto sunu sa panugyan nga health protocols sang DOH.
english: In fact, it is possible that none of them will die if all 100 are properly precautionary, especially you who are properly precautionary according to the recommended health protocols of the DOH.

text: In other words, base sa sining theoretical probability, 98 ka porsyento nga indi ka mabiktima sang COVID-19 kag two percent lang ang posibilidad nga maigu ka sini.
english: In other words, based on this theoretical probability, you have a 98 percent chance of not becoming a victim of COVID-19 and only a two percent chance of getting it.

text: Basi wala pa gani sa sining 100 ang maigu tungod sa husto nga paghalong.
english: Maybe not even 100 of these will be hit because of proper precautions.

text: Tungod sini, sa mga nagahalong gid kag sa ila pamilya, wala man gid sing daku nga kabalak-an kon maggwa kag magpauli basta ginatuman lang ang health protocols.
english: Therefore, for those who are very careful and their families, there is nothing to worry about when going out and returning home as long as the health protocols are followed.

text: Siling gani sang isa ka doktor, daw may bakuna ka lang kon nagahalong ka sing husto./PN
english: One doctor even said that you can only have the vaccine if you take the right precautions./PN

text: Nanawagan si Pangulong Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. called for

text: sa mga kasaping bansa ng Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) na bigyang-prayoridad ang ganap na pagpapanumbalik ng dispute settlement mechanism ng World Trade Organization (WTO), na ilang taon nang hindi ganap na gumagana.
english: to the neighboring countries of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) that the full priority is the full restoration of the dispute settlement mechanism of the World Trade Organization (WTO), which has not been fully functioning for several years.

text: Sa kanyang talumpati sa APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting sa Gyeongju, South Korea nitong Biyernes, binigyang-diin ni Marcos na ang kawalan ng epektibong mekanismo upang maresolba ang mga alitan sa pandaigdigang kalakalan ay naglalagay sa mga maliliit na ekonomiya sa alanganin.
english: In his speech at the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in Gyeongju, South Korea on Friday, Marcos stressed that the lack of an effective mechanism to resolve global trade disputes is putting small economies at risk.

text: “Nanawagan ang Pilipinas sa mga ekonomiya na bigyang-prayoridad ang ganap na pagpapanumbalik ng dispute settlement mechanism at Appellate Body ng World Trade Organization,” ayon kay Marcos.
english: “The Philippines calls on economies to give priority to the full restoration of the dispute settlement mechanism and Appellate Body of the World Trade Organization,” Marcos said.

text: “Kung walang gumaganang mekanismo sa pagresolba ng mga alitan sa kalakalan, ang mga maliliit na ekonomiya ay malalagay sa kawalan.
english: “Without a functioning mechanism to resolve trade disputes, small economies will be at a disadvantage.

text:
Para sa amin, ang mga patakaran ay isang makapangyarihang pantay na sandata.”

Simula noong 2019, hindi na aktibo ang Appellate Body ng WTO matapos hadlangan ng Estados Unidos, sa ilalim ng administrasyon ni dating Pangulong Donald Trump, ang pagtatalaga ng mga bagong hukom.
english:
For us, the rules are a powerful equal weapon.”

Since 2019, the WTO Appellate Body has been inactive after the United States, under the administration of former President Donald Trump, blocked the appointment of new judges.

text: Iginiit noon ng Washington na mayroong “judicial overreach” o labis na pagpapalawak ng kapangyarihan ang naturang lupon.
english: Washington has insisted that the board has judicial overreach.

text: Bunga nito, nanatiling bahagyang gumagana lamang ang sistema ng WTO sa pagresolba ng mga sigalot sa kalakalan, dahilan upang bilyon-bilyong dolyar na halaga ng mga kaso sa pandaigdigang kalakalan ay hindi maresolba.
english: As a result, the WTO system remains partially functional in resolving trade disputes, leaving billions of dollars worth of international trade cases unresolved.

text: Bilang pansamantalang solusyon, dose-dosenang kasapi ng WTO ang bumuo ng Multi-Party Interim Appeal Arbitration Arrangement (MPIA) upang tugunan ang mga isyu habang hindi pa naibabalik ang Appellate Body.
english: As an interim solution, dozens of WTO members formed a Multi-Party Interim Appeal Arbitration Arrangement (MPIA) to address the issues while the Appellate Body is not restored.

text: Ang United Kingdom ang pinakabagong bansang sumali sa nasabing mekanismo, ayon sa ulat ng Reuters noong Hunyo.
english: The United Kingdom is the latest country to join the mechanism, according to a Reuters report in June.

text: Sa parehong pulong, nanawagan din si Marcos sa mga pinuno ng APEC na patatagin ang ugnayan at tiwala sa isa’t isa upang mapanatili ang lakas at kahalagahan ng organisasyon.
english: In the same vein, Marcos also called on APEC leaders to strengthen ties and mutual trust in order to maintain the strength and importance of the organization.

text: “Huwag nating kalimutan ang ating layunin, ang magdala ng paglago, pagiging inklusibo, at pagpapanatili sa ating rehiyon, gayundin ang mga pangunahing prinsipyo ng pagiging bukas, di-pagkiling, at transparency,” ani ng Pangulo.
english: “Let us not forget our goal, to bring prosperity, inclusivity, and sustainability to our region, as well as the basic principles of openness, impartiality, and transparency,” the President said.

text: Gamiton sang Central Elections Committee sang Israel ang mga drones agud nga mag-monitor gikan sa kahawaan sa 751 ka mga special polling stations.
english: Israel's Central Elections Committee will use drones to conduct aerial monitoring at 751 special polling stations.

text: Ang Israeli legislative election ang pagahiwaton sa Marso 23 agud nga mag-eleher sang 120 ka mga myembro sang 24th Knesset.
english: The Israeli legislative election will be held on March 23 to elect 120 members of the 24th Knesset.

text: Ang Knesset ang isa ka unicameral national legislature sang pungsod.
english: The Knesset is the country's unicameral national legislature.

text: Bilang legislative branch sang Israeli government, ang Knesset amo ang nagapasar sang tanan nga layi kag naga-eleher sang presidente kag prime minister.
english: As the legislative branch of the Israeli government, the Knesset passes all laws and elects the president and prime minister.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Julie Ann Siasat direkta sa Israel, kun makit-an sang drones ang linya sang mga botante nga tuman ka laba, ang mga voters ang sayluhon sa iban nga mga special polling stations agud malikawan ang ginutok sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Julie Ann Siasat directly in Israel, if the drones find the line of voters too long, the voters will be moved to other special polling stations to avoid crowding in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Agud nga mahagan-hagan ang linya sa mga special polling stations, apat ka mga polling station ang itukod sa Ben-Gurion Airport para sa mga returning Israelis nga magaboto.
english: To ease the lines at special polling stations, four polling stations will be set up at Ben-Gurion Airport for returning Israelis to vote.

text: Samtang may yara man sang mga protesters pahayag ni Siasat nga nagapatigayon sang hublag protesta batuk kay Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu bangud sa graft kag pagdumala sini sang coronavirus pandemic.
english: Meanwhile, there are also protesters, Siasat said, who are conducting a protest movement against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for his graft and management of the coronavirus pandemic.

text: May yara sang mga protesters sa guwa sang balay sang prime minister sa Jerusalem kag may pa gid sa guwa sang private home sini sa coastal area sang Caesaria.
english: There were protesters outside the prime minister's house in Jerusalem and another outside his private home in the coastal area of ​​Caesaria.

text: Regular na nga nagahiwat sang hublag protesta ang mga demonstrador batuk kay Netanyahu sa diin ginamanduan nila ini nga magresign kasunod sang mga kaso nga bribery, fraud kag breach of trust nga ginapangatubang sang prime minister.
english: Demonstrators have been holding regular protests against Netanyahu demanding his resignation following the charges of bribery, fraud and breach of trust facing the prime minister.

text: Nahibaluan nga pinasahi subong ang eleksyon sa Israel bangud sa labing una nga kahigayunan, ang unlimited rule ni Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sa “nationalist camp” ang ginhangkangat sang pihak nga grupo, indi lamang sang isa ka kasumpong kundi duha — ini amo sanday Gideon Sa’ar sang New Hope Party kag Naftali Bennett sang Yamina.
english: It is known that the elections in Israel are unique because for the first time, the unlimited rule of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in the “nationalist camp” has been challenged by the other group, not only by one opponent but two — these are Gideon Sa’ar of the New Hope Party and Naftali Bennett of Yamina.

text: Makaalarma ang pagsaka sang numero sang mga patay sa Myanmar bangud sa nagalala nga mga hublag-protesta batok sa militar.
english: The death toll in Myanmar is alarmingly rising due to escalating anti-military protests.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Atty. Jobert Pahilga direkta sa Myanmar, nagdangat na sa masobra isa ka gatos ang numero sang mga ginbawian sang kabuhi kag ginabanta nagsaka na sa 2,700 ang numero sang mga gin-aresto halin sang ginpatuman ang kudeta.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Atty. Jobert Pahilga directly in Myanmar, the number of deaths has reached more than 100 and the number of arrests is estimated to have risen to 2,700 since the coup was implemented.

text: Sang Dominggo, 38 ang reported nga napatay kag dinosena ang napilasan sa isa sa pinakamakamamatay nga adlaw sang kalakasan halin sang gin-angkon sang militar ang gahom sang Pebrero 1.
english: On Sunday, 38 were reportedly killed and dozens injured in one of the deadliest days of violence since the military seized power on 1 February.

text: Sa protesta sa isa ka lugar sa Yangon, naggamit ang mga pulis sang live rounds, tear gas kag stun grenades agud atakehon ang mga nagaprotesta.
english: At a protest in one area of ​​Yangon, police used live rounds, tear gas and stun grenades to attack protesters.

text: Ginapahayag nga nagpangluthang ang mga security forces halin sang pasado las 9:00 sa aga kag naglawig tubtob sa kagab-ihon.
english: The security forces reportedly opened fire from around 9:00 am and lasted until late at night.

text: Ginapahayag ginluthang man sang mga militar ang protesters nga nagmartsa sa Mandalay, Myingyan kag Aunglan.
english: The military also reportedly shot protesters who marched in Mandalay, Myingyan and Aunglan.

text: Pila sa mga nagaprotesta sa Hlaing Tharyar sang Yangon City suno kay Pahilga ang armado sang kahoy kag kutsilyo.
english: Some of the protesters in Hlaing Tharyar in Yangon City, Pahilga said, were armed with sticks and knives.

text: Gindeklara man sang military junta ang martial law sa probinsya sang Yangon matapos gin-atake sang protesters ang pila ka negosyo sang Chinese.
english: The military junta also declared martial law in Yangon province after protesters attacked several Chinese businesses.

text: Ini bangud suno kay Pahilga, nagapati ang protesters nga suportado sang mga Chinese ang militar.
