english: This is because, according to Pahilga, the protesters believe that the Chinese support the military.

text: Madamo suno kay Pahilga sang factory nga ginapanag-iyahan sang China ang lunsay ginsunog kag ginpangguba sang mga nagahublag-protesta.
english: Pahilga said many Chinese-owned factories were burned and destroyed by the protesters.

text: Ginpahayag ni Atty. Pahilga nga samtang nagadugay, nangin tuman ka ‘madugo’ na ang mga nagakatabo sa pungsod Myanmar sa diin kada adlaw, madamo sang makalahangawa nga balita.
english: Atty. Let's say that as time goes on, things in Myanmar have become very 'bloody' where every day, there are many shocking news.

text: Sa subong suno sa natungdan, ginshutdown sang militar ang mobile internet connection sa bug-os nga pungsod kag gin-utod ang kuryente sa pila ka mga lugar.
english: Currently, he said, the military has shutdown the mobile internet connection nationwide and cut off electricity in some areas.

text: Ipaidalom sa Zona Rosa ukon Red Zone ang katunga sang pungsod Italy bangud sa padayon nga pagsaka sang COVID-19 cases.
english: Half of Italy will be placed under Zona Rosa or Red Zone due to the continuous increase in COVID-19 cases.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Gabina Sumagpao direkta sa Rome, Italy, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa pagsulod sang Variant sang COVID-19 nagikan sa United Kingdom sa Italy, nadesisyunan sang Gobyerno ang istrikto nga pagpatuman sang health protocols sa diin temporaryo nga dumilian ang paggwa sa balay magluwas sa mga health official.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Gabina Sumagpao directly in Rome, Italy, she said that due to the entry of the Variant of COVID-19 from the United Kingdom in Italy, the Government has decided to strictly implement health protocols where temporarily prohibit leaving the house except for health officials.

text: Ginalauman suno kay Sumagpao nga mapadali man sang Gobyerno ang Vaccination roll out sa pungsod agud mapadali ang pagkontrol sang COVID-19 ilabi na nga may nagsulod na nga iban pa nga variant sang COVID-19.
english: Sumagpao said the Government is also expected to expedite the vaccination roll out in the country to facilitate the control of COVID-19 especially as other variants of COVID-19 have already entered.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, ipaidalom man sa kabilugan nga lockdown ang pungsod Italy umpisa Abril 3 tubtob 5 kasunod sang Holy Week agud malikawan ang pagdugok sang mga tawo.
english: He added that Italy will also be placed under a general lockdown from April 3 to 5 following Holy Week to avoid crowds.

text: Makabig nga isa ka ‘once in a lifetime’ ang eksperyensya sang mga Pinoy sa Rome, Italy sa pagtambong sa misa kasunod sang selebrasyon sang ika-500 nga anibersaryo sang Kristiyanismo sa Pilipinas nga ginpangunahan ni Pope Francis.
english: The experience of Filipinos in Rome, Italy to attend the mass following the celebration of the 500th anniversary of Christianity in the Philippines led by Pope Francis was a once in a lifetime experience.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Reverend Father John Tadifa direkta sa Rome, Italy, iya ginpahayag nga ginbanta masobra 100 ang Pinoy nga nagtambong sa St.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Reverend Father John Tadifa said that more than 100 Filipinos attended St.

text: Peter’s Square nga amo ang isa ka daku nga plaza sa atubang sang St.
english: Peter's Square which is a large plaza in front of St. Peter's Basilica.

text: Peter’s Basilica.
english: Peter’s Basilica.

text: Hugot man nga ginpatuman suno sa iya ang istrikto nga physical distancing kag iban pa nga minimum health protocols.
english: He said strict physical distancing and other minimum health protocols were also strictly enforced.

text: Suno kay Tadifa, paagi sa widescreens nga ginpahamtang sa piazza sa gwa sang basilica, makabig nga maswerte sila nga mga Pinoy bangud live nila nga nasaksihan ang misa.
english: According to Tadifa, through the widescreens installed in the piazza outside the basilica, they are considered lucky Filipinos because they witnessed the mass live.

text:
FRONTLINERS SA PAGTUO

Ang mga Pinoy ang ginakabig nga frontliner sa patag sang pagtuo sa Rome, Italy.
english:
FRONTLINERS IN FAITH

Filipinos are considered the frontliners in the field of faith in Rome, Italy.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Reverend Father Ricky Gente, direkta sa Rome, Italy, iya ginpahayag nga isa siya sa mga nag-organize agud makatipon ang mga Pinoy nga magatambong sa misa ni Pope Francis kasunod sang 500th nga anibersaryo sang Kristyanismo sa St.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Reverend Father Ricky Gente, directly in Rome, Italy, said he was one of the organizers to gather Filipinos to attend Pope Francis' mass following the 500th anniversary of Christianity in St.

text: Peter’s Basilica.
english: Peter’s Basilica.

text: Suno kay Gente, tuman ang iya kalipay bangud mahapos nga matipon ang mga Pinoy bangud sa mag-an kag masinadyahon nga personalidad.
english: According to Gente, he is very happy because it is easy to gather Filipinos because of his friendly and cheerful personality.

text: Pinaagi sa paghugpong nila suno sa natungdan, nangin isa ka makahulugan nga ila personal nga nasaksihan ang nasambit nga misa sagwa sang Vatican .
english: Through their unity, he said, it became a meaningful experience for them to personally witness the said mass outside the Vatican.

text: Ginpahayag sang natungdan nga ang may mga ticket lamang ang nakasulod sa Vatican.
english: He said only those with tickets were allowed to enter the Vatican.

text: Apang ang wala naman sang ticket ang nakalantaw live sang misa pinaagi sa mga widescreen.
english: But those who did not have tickets were able to watch the mass live through widescreens.

text: 100% na nga nagbukas ang mga negosyo sa Texas, USA, ginbasura na ang mandato sa pagsuksok sang face mask, ginpahalugan ang mga restrictions… apang indi tanan ang naghugyaw sa sini nga mga pagsulundan.
english: Businesses in Texas, USA have reopened 100%, the mandate to wear face masks has been lifted, restrictions have been eased... but not everyone is happy with these rules.

text: Marso 10 sang gintapos ni Governor Greg Abbott ang statewide mask mandate sa Texas, ang estado sa Estados Unidos kun sa diin napatay ang 43,000 ka mga tawo bangud sang coronavirus infections.
english: On March 10, Governor Greg Abbott ended the statewide mask mandate in Texas, the US state where 43,000 people have died from coronavirus infections.

text: Apisar madamo ang literal nga nakaginhawa sang maayo bangud sang ginbag-o nga pagsulundan, ang bag-o nga executive order sang gobernador ang gilayon nga nakaangkon sang pagpakamalaot kag kahangawa gikan sa iban nga mga government officials.
english: Although many literally breathed a sigh of relief because of the changed rules, the governor's new executive order immediately drew condemnation and concern from other government officials.

text: Mangin si President Joe Biden ang nagpahayag nga ‘big mistake’ ukon daku nga sala ang pagkakas sang mask mandate.
english: Even President Joe Biden said it was a 'big mistake' to lift the mask mandate.

text: Apat sa mga coronavirus medical advisers ni Abott ang nagpahayag nga wala sila ginkonsulta antes ang pagpatuman sang bag-o nga mandate.
english: Four of Abott’s coronavirus medical advisers said they were not consulted before the implementation of the new mandate.

text: Nagwangal ang mga health officials ilabi na bangud 7.1% pa lang sang kapin 30 million ka residente sa Texas ang nakakumpleto sang ila vaccination suno sa data sang Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
english: Health officials are concerned, especially since only 7.1% of the more than 30 million residents in Texas have completed their vaccination, according to data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

text: Nagaagunto man ang magagmay nga mga negosyo bangud wala nakahibalo ang mga tag-iya kun sa diin sila malugar.
english: Small businesses are also suffering because the owners do not know where to locate them.

text: May mga business owners nga nag-require sa gihapon sang face mask; kag kun may magreklamo, wala sila ginaserbehan sang pagkaon.
english: Some business owners still require face masks; and if anyone complains, they are not served food.

text: Bilang balos, ginapahog sang mga kustomer ang mga tag-iya nga ireport sa Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency.
english: In return, the customers threaten the owners to report to the Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency.

text: Apisar sini tanan, suno kay Bombo International Correpondent Rufino ‘Pinoy’ Gonzales direkta sa Texas, USA, kumpiyansa si Abbott kag ang iya mga kaalyado nga indi na magtimbuok ang COVID-19 cases.
english: Despite all this, according to Bombo International Correspondent Rufino 'Pinoy' Gonzales directly in Texas, USA, Abbott and his allies are confident that the number of COVID-19 cases will not increase.

text: Sa statement nga ginpagwa sang nagligad nga semana, nagpahayag si Abbott nga matuod nga may yara pa sang coronavirus apang indi na kinahanglan ang ini nga mga mandato bangud sang numero sang recoveries, vaccinations, reduced hospitalizations, kag safe practices sang Texans.
english: In a statement released last week, Abbott said it is true that there is still coronavirus but that these mandates are no longer necessary because of the number of recoveries, vaccinations, reduced hospitalizations, and safe practices of Texans.

text: Bangud sini suno kay Gonzales, nagagutok subong ang mga hotels kag resorts bangud sa tuman ka damo nga reservations — butang nga ginakabig sang kalabanan nga ‘new normal’ matapos ang halos isa ka tuig nga pagpangapa-kapa bangud sang pandemya.
english: Because of this, Gonzales said, hotels and resorts are now overcrowded due to too many reservations — something that most people consider the 'new normal' after almost a year of lockdown due to the pandemic.

text: Magatutok na ang 19-anyos nga Pinay tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa preparasyon sini sa Madrid Open sa Espanya nga natalana nga mag-umpisa sa masunod nga semana.
english: 19-year-old Filipino tennis star Alex Eala will now focus on his preparations for the Madrid Open in Spain which is scheduled to start next week.

text: Ini matapos temprano nga nagtakop ang kampanya sini sa Oeiras Ladies Open sa Portugal bangud nalutos sa Round of 16.
english: This comes after her campaign ended early at the Oeiras Ladies Open in Portugal after losing in the Round of 16.

text: Nakuha sang kasumpong ni Eala nga si Panna Udvardy sang Hungary ang kadalag-an paagi sa pagdominar sa top seed sa straight sets, 7-6, 6-4.
english: Eala’s opponent Panna Udvardy of Hungary earned the win by dominating the top seed in straight sets, 7-6, 6-4.

text: Nahibaluan nga ika-137 si Udvardy sa WTA rankings samtang ika-72 naman si Eala.
english: Udvardy is ranked 137th in the WTA rankings while Eala is ranked 72nd.

text: Antes sini, daog si Eala sa imbukada ukon sa Round of 32 batok kay Anouk Koevermans sang The Netherlands.
english: Earlier, Eala won the opening or Round of 32 against Anouk Koevermans of The Netherlands.

text: Sa doubles naman, nalutos man ang Pinay kag partner sini nga si Katie Volynets sa Round of 16 sa kamot sang Americans nga sanday Christina Rosca kag Carmen Corley.
english: In doubles, the Filipina and her partner Katie Volynets were also defeated in the Round of 16 by Americans Christina Rosca and Carmen Corley.

text: Ang tournament sa Portugal amo ang una nga sabak ni Eala sa hampang matapos ang impresibo nga performance sa Miami Open nga nagpasaka sang iya ranking sa Top 100.
english: The tournament in Portugal was Eala’s first stab at the game after an impressive performance at the Miami Open that boosted his Top 100 ranking.

text: Untaton anay sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang pagpatuman sang maximum suggested retail price (SRP) sa karne sang baboy.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) will temporarily suspend the implementation of the maximum suggested retail price (SRP) for pork.

text: Ini bangud bisan Marso pa ginpatuman ang MSRP, nagapalangkalakaak sa gihapon ang presyo sini sa mga mercado kag nagalaoy sa gihapon ang mga bumalakal ilabi na sa Metro Manila.
english: This is because even though the MSRP was implemented in March, the price is still rising in the markets and buyers are still complaining especially in Metro Manila.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Undersecretary for livestock Constante Palabrica, ipaiway anay ang implementasyon sini gani nga lauman man sang publiko nga may revision nga iga-anunsyo ang DA.
english: Agriculture Undersecretary for livestock Constante Palabrica said the implementation of the DA will be postponed so that the public can expect a revision to be announced.

text: Nahibaluan nga as of May 2, manubo sa singko porsyento ang compliance ukon ang pagsunod sang mga retailer sa max SRP.
english: As of May 2, retailers' compliance with the max SRP is less than five percent.

text: Nagsarurot ini halin sa Abril 1 nga compliance santo sa monitoring sang Agribusiness and Marketing Assistance Service.
english: This has increased since April 1 in compliance based on monitoring by the Agribusiness and Marketing Assistance Service.

text: Marso 10 sang ginpatuman ang max SRP kun sa diin ang pork shoulder ang yara sa P350 per kilo, samtang ang pork belly naman ang nagalab-ot sa P380.
english: The max SRP was implemented on March 10 where pork shoulder is at P350 per kilo, while pork belly is at P380.

text: Ginpasigurado man sang natungdan nga bastante ang pork supplies apisar sang resulta sang African swine fever outbreaks sa local supply.
english: He also assured that pork supplies are sufficient despite the results of African swine fever outbreaks in local supply.

text: Nagapanawagan ang ahensya sa producers, traders kag retailers nga magbulig sa pag-solbar sa mataas nga retail price sang karne sang baboy.
english: The agency is calling on producers, traders and retailers to help solve the high retail price of pork.

text: ILOILO CITY- Subong nga adlaw, ipakilala ko sa imo ang isa ka hari halin sa isa ka nasyon apang sang nagpadulong ini sa iban nga pungsod, ang trabaho sini isa ka hardinero.
english: ILOILO CITY- Today, I will introduce you to a king from one country but when he went to another country, his job was a gardener.

text: Ini amo si Eric Manu, hari sang isa ka tribu sa West Africa.
english: This is Eric Manu, king of a West African tribe.

text: Nagpadulong ini sa Canada agud magtrabaho kag ang iya ginsudlan amo ang pagka- hardinero.
english: He went to Canada to work and became a gardener.

text: Suno kay Manu, nagtrabaho ini sa Canada agud magtipon sang kwarta kag mga supply para sa iya village.
english: Manu says he worked in Canada to save money and supplies for his village.

text: Nagapati siya nga ang isa ka maayo nga hari ang nagapakita sang pagkamapainubuson kag pagpalangga sa iya mga nasakupan.
english: He believes that a good king shows humility and love for his subjects.

text: Si Manu ang padayon nga nagatrabaho sa Canada agud makatipon naman sang kwarta para sa pag-improve sang healthcare sang iya mga pumuluyo.
english: Manu continues to work in Canada to raise money to improve the healthcare of his people.

text: Ngaa bala may nagakapatay sa bangungot?
english: Why does anyone die in a nightmare?

text: Suno kay Dr. Patrick Gerard Moral, eksperto sa sleep medicine, ang bangungot ang ginatawag man nga “sudden unexplained nocturnal death syndrome” sa medical terms.
english: According to Dr. Patrick Gerard Moral, expert in sleep medicine, nightmares are also called “sudden unexplained nocturnal death syndrome” in medical terms.

text: Masami ang bangungot ma eksperyensyahan sang mga lalaki ukon mga yara sa younger age group.
english: Nightmares are often experienced by men or those in the younger age group.

text: Mahimo man nga bangud sa pancreatitis ang pagbangungot sang tawo bangud sa tuman nga pag-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: Pancreatitis can also be caused by a person's nightmares due to excessive consumption of alcoholic beverages.

text: Indi lamang toxic sa atay ang alcoholic drinks kundi mangin sa pancreas nga nagatuga sang pagkaguba sini.
english: Alcoholic drinks are not only toxic to the liver but also to the pancreas causing it to break down.

text: Apang may yara sang tatlo ka mga factors nga makonsidera nga kabangdanan sang pagbangungot.
english: But there are three factors that can be considered to cause nightmares.

text: Una, kun may yara sang problema sa istruktura ang imo tagipusuon.
english: First, if there is a structural problem with your heart.

text: Ika-duha, may environmental/social stressor ukon tuman nga kakapoy, makahalanusbo nga emosyon kag may manubo nga potassium.
english: Second, there is an environmental/social stressor or extreme fatigue, distressing emotions and low potassium.

text: Kag ang ika-tatlo, kun may yara ikaw sang abnormal nga pagpitik sang tagipusuon samtang ikaw ang tulog.
english: And the third, if you have an abnormal heartbeat while you are asleep.

text: Kun ma eksperyensyahan ang tatlo ka mga factors nga ini, mahimo pahayag sang eksperto nga mag-untat ang pagpitik sang tagipusuon kag ikaw ang mabangungot.
english: If you experience these three factors, the expert may say that the heart stops beating and you have a nightmare.

text: MATUOD, daku nga kaayuhan ang mahimo sang “localization” sang mga pulis sa ila trabaho sa pagpatuman sang peace and order kag pag-away batok sa krimen kon ma-assign sila mismo sa diin, ukon malapit dira nga lugar, nagapuyo ang ila pamilya.
english: TRUE, the localization of police officers in their work of enforcing peace and order and fighting crime can do much good if they are assigned right where, or nearby, their families live.

text: In fact, luyag gid ipatuman ni PNP Chief, Police General Camilo Coscolan, ining pag-localize sang mga pulis, nga ginapatuman sang Republic Act No.
english: In fact, PNP Chief, Police General Camilo Coscolan, wants to implement this localization of policemen, which is implemented by Republic Act No.

text: 8551, labi na gid kay may duha na lang siya ka bulan bag-o mag-retire.
english: 8551, especially since he has only two months before retirement.

text: “Ang pag-assign sang isa ka pulis sa kon diin nagapuyo ang iya pamilya, ukon malapit dira, magahatag sa iya sang lubos nga pagkilala sang iya katungdanan dira sa ila lugar indi lang sang iya mga superior kundi sang iya mismo ka-pumuluyo dira,” paathag gani niya.
english: “Assigning a police officer to where his family lives, or nearby, will give him full recognition of his duty in their area not only by his superiors but by his own fellow citizens there,” he explained.

text: Ang luyag i-localize ni PNP Chief Coscolan sa karon amo ang mga pulis nga may ranggo halin sa Patrolman/Woman tubtub Police Executive Master Sergeant nga ma-assign sa siyudad kag/ukon lugar sang pagpuyo, ukon sa pinakalapit nga munisipyo, probinsya ukon rehiyon nga ginapuy-an.
english: PNP Chief Coscolan wants to localize policemen with ranks from Patrolman/Woman to Police Executive Master Sergeant to be assigned to the city and/or place of residence, or to the nearest municipality, province or region of residence.

text:
***

Partikular sa pag-upod sang mag-asawa, ukon ka-love partner, kag sang ila mga kabataan, syempre daku nga bentaha ang makaupod ang imo pamilya sa matag-adlaw.
english:
***

Particularly in the company of a couple, or love partner, and their children, of course it is a great advantage to be with your family on a daily basis.

text: Indi ka na kinahanglan magkabalaka sing daku kon ano ang ginahimo sang asawa mo ukon bana, ukon sang mga kabataan, tungod may personal ka nga ihibalo sa nagakatabo sa adlaw-adlaw.
english: You don’t have to worry so much about what your wife or husband is doing, or what the kids are doing, because you have personal knowledge of what’s going on every day.

text:
***

In fact, kon may problema nga dapat kabalak-an gid amo ang inyo paghilayuay tungod sang trabaho.
english:
***

In fact, if there is a problem that should be of real concern is your separation because of work.

text: Matuod, sa gapalanggaanay kag gakilala sang sinumpaan “’til death do us part” ang “distance makes the heart grow fonder”, ukon, sa aton pa, may init sang kahidlaw nga dala ang kada tion nga wala ang isa.
english: True, for those who love each other and know the oath “’til death do us part” the “distance makes the heart grow fonder”, or, in other words, there is a warmth of longing that comes with each moment without the other.

text: Pero, human as we are, posible man makadulot sing problema ang paghilayuay, kapin pa kay ang paghilayuay indi lang sa distansya pisikal kundi sa distansya man sang balatyagon nga matabo, hungod man ukon indi.
english: However, human as we are, separation can also cause problems, especially since separation is not only a physical distance but also an emotional distance that can occur, whether intentionally or not.

text: May ara gid man nga matapok ang balatyagon kag madale masulay sang kamingaw, nga nahibal-an lang nila ang malain sang magtupa na sa ila, nga sa ulihi mahinulsulan lang nila sa bilangguan kag dalhon sa walay tupong nga kahuy-anan.
english: There are those who are so sensitive and easily tempted by loneliness, that they only know evil when it comes upon them, that they will later regret it in prison and be brought to incomparable shame.

text: Paandam gani sang isa ka psychologist: May “patient” kag “impatient” love!
english: One psychologist even warned: There is “patient” and “impatient” love!

text: Ang “patient” love makaantos kag makapabilin nga “faithful” sa pinalangga bisan pa sa kakulangan sini; samtang ang “impatient”, katulad sang tipo “romantic” ang ugali, madale madala ini sang ganoy sang tauhanon nga balatyagon kon indi dayon mabulong ang kahidlaw.
english: “Patient” love can suffer and remain “faithful” to the beloved despite its shortcomings; while the “impatient”, like the type “romantic” in temperament, is easily carried away by the ganoy of human feelings if the longing is not immediately cured.

text: Tungod gani sini, masami nagapaniguro gid ang nagatrabaho sa mga international ship (seafarer) nga may malawig nga kontrata.
english: Because of this, those who work on international ships (seafarers) with long contracts are often very careful.

text: Ginahimo ini sang lalake paagi sa pagbilin sang iya asawa ukon ka-love partner sa iya ginikanan ukon paupdan ini sa balay sing isa ka masaligan.
english: The man does this by leaving his wife or love partner with her parents or by having a trusted person accompany her home.

text: May mga kaso ugaling gihapon sang pagkahuyang sang asawa ukon bana bisan pa sa todo pagbantay sa nahilayu.
english: However, there are still cases of weakness of the wife or husband despite the care of the distance.

text: Tungod gani sa “impatient” love!
english: Because of “impatient” love!

text: So, may kasohay man gihapon kon magdakpanay na sang kalokohan.
english: So, there is still a fight when it comes to catching each other's nonsense.

text: “Ang madugay nga paghilayuay makadulot man sing problema,” paathag gani sining psychologist, gani ginapanugyan sini ang “limited” kag indi gid man madugay nga paghilayuay agud mapabilin ang higot sang pagpalanggaanay.
english: “Prolonged separation can also cause problems,” explains this psychologist, so she recommends “limited” and not very long separation to maintain the bond of love.

text: By the  way, sa masami, nagakatabo ang pagbulagay sang mag-asawa sa mga pungsod nga gina-ordinaryo lang ang diborsyo.
english: By the way, separation often occurs in countries where divorce is commonplace.

text:
***

May maathag nga ebidensya ang kabuhi sang madamo nga nga Overseas Filipino Workers (OFW) nga ginapalayag sa programa sa radyo, TV kag social media ni Raffy Tulfo.
english:
***

There is clear evidence of the lives of many Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) broadcast on Raffy Tulfo's radio, TV and social media programs.

text: Tungod sa paghilayuay, pisikal man ukon tungod sa makasasala nga kahidlaw sa tauhanon nga balatyagon, madamo sining OFW nga mga  pamilya ang nawasak.
english: Because of separation, whether physical or because of sinful longing for human feelings, many of these OFW families have been destroyed.

text: Ginbulong nila ang ila paghilayuay sing kahidlaw sa iban paagi sa pakig-angot sa iban nga lalake ukon babaye paagi sa text, video chat kag pagpakighirup sa kasubong nga OFW, ukon bisan gani diri sa pungsod, tubtub nahulog sila sa indi bagay nga relasyon, kag napabay-an na bisan ang ila obligasyon sa ila mga kabataan.
english: They cured their separation with longing for others by communicating with other men or women through text, video chat and dating fellow OFWs, or even here in the country, until they fell into an inappropriate relationship, and even neglected their obligations to their children.

text: Sang maghilibalo, nag-atubang sila sang kaso nga adulteryo kag concubinage ukon pakigpuyo sa iban, ukon lubos na nga pagbulagay nga ang mga biktima ang wala kasal-anan kag makaluluoy nga mga kabataan.
english: When they found out, they faced charges of adultery and concubinage or cohabitation, or complete separation with the victims being innocent and pitiful children.

text: Syempre nagakatabo man ini sa kaso sang mga pulis kag soldado, kag iban pa, sa ila relasyon sa asawa ukon bana samtang gahilayuay tungod sang ila trabaho, nga mabuligan bulong sang “localization”./PN
english: Of course this also happens in the case of policemen and soldiers, and others, in their relationship with their wives or husbands while separated because of their work, which can be helped by localization.

text: Gin-ako sang pamunuan sang Barangay Benedicto, Jaro, Iloilo City nga wala sila sang mahatag nga pinansyal nga bulig sa mga pumuluyo nga nadala sa sunog nga nadala kahapon sang hapon, Pebrero 16.
english: The government of Barangay Benedicto, Jaro, Iloilo City admitted that they have no financial assistance to the residents who were affected by the fire that broke out yesterday afternoon, February 16.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo PB Abelardo Salting Jr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo PB Abelardo Salting Jr.

text: Punong Barangay sang nasambit nga lugar nga wala sang nagakaigo nga pondo ang barangay agud makahatag sang cash assistance sa mga pumuluyo nga apektado.
english: Punong Barangay of the said area that the barangay does not have adequate funds to provide cash assistance to the affected residents.

text: Apisar sini naghatag naman sang inisyal nga bulig ang City Social Development Office Iloilo City lakip na ang folding beds, foam, kitchen kits kag hygiene kits para sa mga naapektuhan nga residente.
english: However, the City Social Development Office Iloilo City provided initial assistance including folding beds, foam, kitchen kits and hygiene kits for the affected residents.

text: May patigayunon man nga emergency meeting ang mga opisyal sang barangay agud istoryahan ang dugang nga tikang kag posible nga mga bulig nga mahatag pa gid sa mga pumuluyo nga apektado sang insidente.
english: Barangay officials will also hold an emergency meeting to discuss further steps and possible assistance to be provided to the residents affected by the incident.

text: Nahibaluan nga naglab-ot sa masobra P600,000 ang halit nga ginbilin sang sunog nga nagluntad sa Brgy.
english: It was learned that more than P600,000 worth of damage was caused by the fire that broke out in Brgy.

text: Benedicto.
english: Benedict.

text: Base sa datos sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Iloilo City Station, 52 tanan ka balay ang ginlamon sang kalayo kun sa diin 4 ang partially damage kag 48 ang totally damaged.
english: Based on the data of the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Iloilo City Station, 52 houses were engulfed in the fire with 4 partially damaged and 48 totally damaged.

text: 249 indibidwal naman ang apektado sang sunog nga nagapabilin sa karon sa Multipurpose Building sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: 249 individuals were affected by the fire which is currently in the Multipurpose Building of the said barangay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fire Superintendent Melanie Habawel City Fire Marshall sang Iloilo City Fire Station, iya ginpahayag nga base sa ila inisyal nga imbestigasyon, electrical in nature ang ginalantaw nga ginhalinan sang sunog sa isa ka balay kun sa diin human sa concrete kag light materials ini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Fire Superintendent Melanie Habawel City Fire Marshall of the Iloilo City Fire Station said that based on their initial investigation, electrical in nature is believed to be the cause of the fire in a house made of concrete and light materials.

text: Suno kay Fire Superintendent Habawel, nahibaluan nga wala sang tawo ang balay nga ginhalinan sang sunog.
english: According to Fire Superintendent Habawel, it was learned that the house where the fire broke out was empty.

text: Pahayag pa niya, wala sang casualties nga narekord apang may ara sang ginrespondehan nga mga indibidwal nga naglain ang pamatyag, napilasan kag minor burns.
english: He said no casualties were recorded but there were individuals who were unwell, injured and minor burns.

text: Gindugang pa ni Fire Superintendent Habawel, nagapadayon pa sa gihapon ang ila imbestigasyon sa nagluntad nga sunog sa nasambit nga barangay.
english: Fire Superintendent Habawel added that they are still investigating the fire that occurred in the said barangay.

text: Maragtason ini nga adlaw, Marso 14, para sa mga Pilipino sa Pilipinas kag sa luwas sang pungsod — adlaw nga pangunahan ni Pope Francis ang misa sang selebrasyon sang ika-500 nga anibersaryo sang Kristiyanismo sa Pilipinas.
english: This day, March 14, is historic for Filipinos in the Philippines and abroad — the day Pope Francis will lead the mass of the celebration of the 500th anniversary of Christianity in the Philippines.

text: Ang misa ang patigayunon sa Altar of the Chair sa Saint Peter’s Basilica 10:00 sa aga sa Rome, Italy (kag 5:00 sa hapon ang oras diri sa Pilipinas).
english: The mass will be held at the Altar of the Chair in Saint Peter's Basilica at 10:00 am in Rome, Italy (and 5:00 pm in the Philippines).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Reverend Father John Tadifa direkta sa Rome, Italy, iya ginpahayag nga limitado lang ang makatambong sa St.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Reverend Father John Tadifa directly in Rome, Italy, said that only a limited number of people will be able to attend St.

text: Peter’s Square, isa ka daku nga plaza sa atubang sang St.
english: Peter’s Square, a large plaza in front of St.

text: Peter’s Basilica, bangud istrikto nga pagasundon ang physical distancing kag iban pa nga minimum health protocols.
english: Peter’s Basilica, as physical distancing and other minimum health protocols will be strictly observed.

text: Sarang malantaw sang mga tumuluo ang misa paagi sa widescreens nga ibutang sa piazza sa gwa sang basilica.
english: The faithful can watch the mass through widescreens placed in the piazza outside the basilica.

text: Santo sa briefer nga ginprovide sang Catholic website nga Dominus Est, 100 ka mga tawo ang pahanugutan sa sulod sang Altar of the Chair of Saint Peter.
english: According to a briefer provided by the Catholic website Dominus Est, 100 people will be allowed inside the Altar of the Chair of Saint Peter.

text: 10 lang ka celebrants ang mahimo makaupod sa Santo Papa.
english: Only 10 celebrants may accompany the Pope.

text: Lakip diri si Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, prefect of the Congregation for the Evangelization of Peoples kag anay archbishop of Manila, kag amo man si Cardinal Angelo De Donatis, ang vicar sang Santo Papa para sa Roma.
english: They include Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, prefect of the Congregation for the Evangelization of Peoples and former archbishop of Manila, as well as Cardinal Angelo De Donatis, the Pope's vicar for Rome.

text: Sa patigayunon nga misa, tatlo ka lenggwahe ang gamiton nga amo ang Italian, English, kag Filipino.
english: The mass will be held in three languages, namely Italian, English, and Filipino.

text: May pila ka mga ambahanon nga mahimo maamba sa Cebuano.
english: There are several songs that can be sung in Cebuano.

text: Ang opening hymn amo ang ‘Gozos’ ukon mas kilala nga Bato Balani sa Gugma, isa ka bantog nga devotional song para sa Santo Niño de Cebu; samtang, closing hymn naman ang ‘Maria, Rayna sa Pilipinas’ nga isa man ka Cebuano hymn.
english: The opening hymn is ‘Gozos’ or better known as Bato Balani sa Gugma, a famous devotional song for the Santo Niño de Cebu; meanwhile, the closing hymn is 'Maria, Queen of the Philippines' which is also a Cebuano hymn.

text: Magatokar man bilang recessional hymn ang ‘We Give Our Yes’, ang official theme song sang ika-500 nga anibersaryo sang Kristyanismo sa Pilipinas.
english: 'We Give Our Yes', the official theme song of the 500th anniversary of Christianity in the Philippines, will also be played as a recessional anthem.

text: Apisar indi pa subong maathag kun pila gid ka mga Pilipino ang magatipon sa St.
english: Although it is not yet clear how many Filipinos will gather in St.

text: Peter’s Square, nagakalangkag na si Father Tadifa kag ang Pontificio Collegio Filippino sa Via Aurelia, Rome, Italy bangud mismo ang Santo Papa ang magapanguna sa aktibidad.
english: Peter’s Square, Father Tadifa and the Pontifical College Filippino in Via Aurelia, Rome, Italy are excited because the Pope himself will lead the activity.

text: Indi ini ang una nga bes nga magapanguna si Pope Francis sang misa para sa mga Pilipino.
english: This is not the first time Pope Francis will lead a mass for Filipinos.

text: Sang 2019, si Pope Francis ang naghimo man sang maragtas bilang labing una nga Santo Papa nga nagpanguna sang Simbang Gabi Mass para sa Filipino community sa Rome.
english: In 2019, Pope Francis also made history as the first Pope to lead a Simbang Gabi Mass for the Filipino community in Rome.

text: Magluwas diri, makabig man nga swerte ang Filipino Community bangud napahanugutan pa ang selebrasyon antes ang lockdown nga ipatuman sa Lunes, Marso 15, bangud sang third wave sang coronavirus infections.
english: In addition, the Filipino community is also considered lucky because the celebration was allowed before the lockdown that will be implemented on Monday, March 15, due to the third wave of coronavirus infections.

text: Ginalauman man nga ang misa sang Santo Papa ang panguna lamang sang quincentennial celebrations sa Rome.
english: The Pope's mass is also expected to be the first of the quincentennial celebrations in Rome.

text: Sa Abril 4, ginalauman nga pangunahan ni Cardinal Tagle ang Easter Sunday Mass para sa Filipino community sa Santa Maria Maggiore Basilica sa Rome.
english: On April 4, Cardinal Tagle is expected to preside over the Easter Sunday Mass for the Filipino community at the Santa Maria Maggiore Basilica in Rome.

text: Para naman kay Reverend Father Tadifa, ang selebrasyon ang pahanumdom man sa mga tumuluo sang daku nga responsinbilidad kag mga hangkat sa pagpanglakaton bilang mga Kristiyano.
english: For Reverend Father Tadifa, the celebration is also a reminder to the faithful of the great responsibility and challenges of the journey as Christians.

text: May kaangtanan sini, ang Bombo Radyo Philippines magadul-ong sining makasaysayan nga selebrasyon sang misa nga pagahiwaton sa St.
english: In this regard, Bombo Radyo Philippines will broadcast this historic mass celebration to be held at St.

text: Peter’s Basilica sa Vatican City, Italy.
english: Peter’s Basilica in Vatican City, Italy.

text: Sarang ini nga malantaw sa Facebook Live sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo.
english: It can be watched on Facebook Live of Bombo Radyo Iloilo.

text: Magadul-ong man sang live reports angut sa kahiwatan ang mga Bombo International Correspondents direkta sa Rome, Italy kag sa Vatican City.
english: Bombo International Correspondents will also deliver live reports on the event directly from Rome, Italy and Vatican City.

text: Eksklusibo man nga mabatian ang ambahanon nga “Called to Share”, ang gindihon nga Exclusive Original Song sang Bombo Radyo Philippines sa okasyon sang 500 Years of Christianity sa Pilipinas.
english: The song “Called to Share”, the Exclusive Original Song of Bombo Radyo Philippines on the occasion of 500 Years of Christianity in the Philippines, will also be exclusively heard.

text: Trending subong sa social media ang video sang isa ka Black American nga ginsinggitan kag ginpahog ang isa ka Pinoy sa sulod sang tren sa Amerika matapos masal-an nga Chinese.
english: Trending now on social media is a video of a Black American who shouted and threatened a Filipino inside a train in the United States after being mistaken for Chinese.

text: Ang nasambit nga Pinoy amo si Bombo International Correspondent Alex Vidal, direkta sa New York.
english: The Filipino is Bombo International Correspondent Alex Vidal, live in New York.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Vidal, iya ginpahayag nga nagapungko siya sa tren sang gintulok siya sang masakit sang wala ginpangalanan nga black American kag didto na gin-insulto kag ginsinggitan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Vidal said he was sitting on the train when an unnamed black American looked at him painfully and insulted and shouted at him.

text: Suno kay Vidal, sa pihak sang kakulba niya bangud sa posibilidad nga pintasan siya sang nasambit nga Amerikano, nagpabilin siya nga kalmado kag ginkuhaan sang video ang ginahimo sini.
english: According to Vidal, despite his nervousness about the possibility of being raped by the American, he remained calm and took a video of what he was doing.

text: Nagpasalamat naman si Vidal bangud wala sang malain nga natabo sa iya.
english: Vidal said he was grateful that nothing bad happened to him.

text: Nagahatag man ini pahanumdom suno kay Vidal sa iban nga Asyano nga maghalong kag magpangaman bangud sa lapnagon nga diskriminasyon ilabi na sa mga Asian American.
english: Vidal said it also serves as a reminder to other Asians to be careful and cautious because of the widespread discrimination especially against Asian Americans.

text: Magluwas diri, madamo na suno kay Vidal sang nagakatabo nga krimen batok sa mga Asian American nga iya man personal nga nakit-an sa diin ginamulay kag ginasakit ang mga ini, ilabi na ang mga asyano nga nagakasal-an Chinese kaangay niya.
english: Besides, Vidal said there are many crimes against Asian Americans that he personally witnessed where they are ridiculed and hurt, especially Asians who marry Chinese like him.

text: Una na nga ginkondenar ni President Joe Biden ang diskriminasyon sa Asian Americans sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic sa iya pinakauna nga national address.
english: President Joe Biden previously condemned discrimination against Asian Americans amid the COVID-19 pandemic in his first national address.

text: Suno kay Biden, nagakadapat nga nagabuligay ang mga Americans, apang baliskad ini sa realidad sa diin madamo sang krimen nga nagaluntad batok sa Asian Americans.
english: Biden said Americans should be working together, but this is the opposite of the reality where there are many crimes against Asian Americans.

text: Lakip sa masami nga naeksperyensyahan sang mga asyano amo ang pagpang-atake, harrassment kag pagbasol bangud sa COVID-19.
english: Among the most common experiences of Asians are attacks, harassment and blaming because of COVID-19.

text: “At this very moment, so many of them, our fellow Americans, are on the front lines of this pandemic trying to save lives and still — still are forced to live in fear for their lives just walking down streets in America,” he said.
english: “At this very moment, so many of them, our fellow Americans, are on the front lines of this pandemic trying to save lives and still — still are forced to live in fear for their lives just walking down streets in America,” he said.

text: “It’s wrong, it’s un-American, and it must stop,” pahayag ni Biden.
english: “It’s wrong, it’s un-American, and it must stop,” Biden said.

text: Samtang, sang Enero nag pirma na si Biden sang memorandum nga nagapakamalaot sang diskriminasyon sa Asian American kag Pacific Islander community sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: Meanwhile, in January Biden signed a memorandum condemning discrimination against the Asian American and Pacific Islander community amid the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Nangin matam-is ang bunga sang pagpangabudlay sang isa ka iloy matapos dungan nga nakapasar ang iya duha ka mga anak sa September 2024 Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – The fruits of a mother's hard work were sweet after her two children passed the September 2024 Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers simultaneously.

text: Ini amo sanday Britzel Mae Escobañez Enrico kag Leila Jennifer Enrico sang Damires, New Lucena, Iloilo.
english: They are Britzel Mae Escobañez Enrico and Leila Jennifer Enrico of Damires, New Lucena, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Emros Enrico, iloy nanday Britzel Mae kag Leila Jennifer, iya ginpahayag nga sa lamrahon pa nga edad, nagbusong ini sa diin ang iya bana ang wala sang permanente nga trabaho.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Emros Enrico, mother of Britzel Mae and Leila Jennifer, said she became pregnant at a young age and her husband did not have a permanent job.

text: Nag-angkon naman ini sang lima ka mga anak kag agud masustentuhan ang mga ini, nagdesisyon ini nga magpadulong sa Singapore, apang sa ulihi, nagpauli man sa Pilipinas bangud sa problema sa ikaayong lawas.
english: She had five children and to support them, she decided to go to Singapore, but later returned to the Philippines due to health problems.

text: Nangin dako naman nga pagpanghangkat kay Britzel Mae ang pagbusong sini sang yara pa lang ini sa Grade 11 sa edad nga 17 anyos.
english: Britzel Mae's pregnancy when she was in Grade 11 at the age of 17 was a big challenge for Britzel Mae.

text: Apang nagapasalamat ini bangud wala ini ginpabay-an sang iya mga ginikanan sa diin ang iya iloy mismo ang nagbantay sa iya anak agud makatapos ini sa pagtuon.
english: But he is grateful that his parents did not abandon him where his mother herself looked after her son so that he could finish his studies.

text: Suno naman kay Leila Jennifer, madamo sang mga nagpakanubo sa ila bangud sa natabo sa iya magulang sa diin ginpromisa sini nga indi gid ini magbusong sa lamharon nga edad.
english: According to Leila Jennifer, many people belittled them because of what happened to her sister where she promised that she would never get pregnant at a young age.

text: Sa baylo nga madulaan sang paglaom, nagpaninguha ini, sa diin nakatapos ini bilang Cum Laude.
english: Instead of losing hope, she persevered, graduating Cum Laude.

text: Tuman naman ang ila kalipay matapos nga dungan sila nga nakapasar sang iya magulang sa pasinawan.
english: They were very happy after they passed the exam together with his brother.

text: “𝘕𝘦𝘷𝘦𝘳 𝘨𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘶𝘱 𝘰𝘯 𝘺𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘥𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘮𝘴.
english: “Wow 𝘨𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘶𝘱 𝘰𝘯 𝘺𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘥𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘮𝘴.

text: 𝘕𝘦𝘷𝘦𝘳 𝘭𝘰𝘴𝘦 𝘩𝘰𝘱𝘦.
english: 𝘕𝘦𝘷𝘦𝘳 𝘭𝘰𝘴𝘦 𝘩𝘰𝘱𝘦.

text:
𝘕𝘰 𝘥𝘪𝘴𝘢𝘣𝘪𝘭𝘪𝘵𝘺 𝘯𝘰𝘳 𝘪𝘭𝘭𝘯𝘦𝘴𝘴 𝘯𝘰𝘳 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘣𝘭𝘦𝘮 𝘤𝘢𝘯 𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘥𝘦𝘳 𝘢 𝘥𝘦𝘵𝘦𝘳𝘮𝘪𝘯𝘦𝘥 𝘱𝘦𝘳𝘴𝘰𝘯 𝘪𝘯 𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘲𝘶𝘦𝘴𝘵 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘦𝘹𝘤𝘦𝘭𝘭𝘦𝘯𝘤𝘦.𝘊𝘭𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘰 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘓𝘰𝘳𝘥 𝘣𝘦𝘤𝘢𝘶𝘴𝘦 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘓𝘰𝘳𝘥 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘨𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘺𝘰𝘶 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘨𝘵𝘩 𝘸𝘩𝘦𝘯 𝘢𝘭𝘭 𝘰𝘧 𝘺𝘰𝘶𝘳𝘴 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘨𝘵𝘩 𝘪𝘴 𝘨𝘰𝘯𝘦.”

Ini ang pinakagamhanan nga mga tinaga sang isa ka Person with Disability (PWD) nga sa pihak sang iya kondisyon, nagmadinalag-on sa iya nga handom.
english:
𝘕𝘰 𝘥𝘪𝘴𝘢𝘣𝘪𝘭𝘪𝘵𝘺 𝘯𝘰𝘳 𝘪𝘭𝘭𝘯𝘦𝘴𝘴 𝘯𝘰 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘣𝘭𝘦𝘮 𝘤𝘢𝘯 𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘥𝘦𝘳 𝘢 𝘥𝘦𝘵𝘦𝘳𝘮𝘯𝘯 𝘱𝘦𝘳𝘴𝘰𝘯 𝘪𝘯 𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘲𝘶𝘦𝘴𝘵 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘦𝘹𝘤𝘦𝘭𝘭𝘦𝘯𝘤𝘦.𝘊𝘭𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘰 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘓𝘰𝘳 𝘣𝘦𝘤𝘢𝘶𝘴𝘦 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘓𝘰𝘳𝘥 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘨𝘪𝘷𝘦𝘦𝘶 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘨𝘵𝘩 𝘸𝘩𝘦𝘯 𝘢𝘭𝘭 𝘰𝘧 𝘺𝘰𝘴 𝘴𝘵𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘨𝘵𝘩 𝘪𝘴 𝘨𝘰𝘯𝘦.”

These are the most powerful words of a Person with Disability (PWD) who, despite his condition, succeeded in his dream.

text: Siya si Atty. John Marvin Marañon, ang Leganesnon nga isa sa mga nakapasar sa bag-o gid lamang ginpagwa nga resulta sang December 2024 Bar Examinations.
english: He is Atty. John Marvin Marañon, the Leganesnon who was one of those who passed the recently released results of the December 2024 Bar Examinations.

text: Si Marañon, kaangay sang iban man nga mga indibidwal nga luyag nga mangin abogado, ang may pinasahi kag ekstraordinaryo man nga istorya sang handom, pagtilaw, paglaum, kag pagmadinalag-on.
english: Marañon, like other individuals who want to become lawyers, has a unique and extraordinary story of dreams, trials, hopes, and success.

text: Antes siya nalakip sa 3,962 nga nakapasar gikan sa 10,490 nga examinees, siya ang isa sa madamo nga mga abogado subong nga indi lahog-lahog ang inagihan.
english: Before he was among the 3,962 who passed out of 10,490 examinees, he was one of the many lawyers today whose experience was not easy.

text: Sa programa nga Good Morning Philippines sa Bombo Radyo Iloilo, eksklusibo nga ginpakigbahin ni Marañon ang iya istorya.
english: In the program Good Morning Philippines on Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Marañon exclusively shared his story.

text:
HANDOM

Bata pa lamang si Marañon, masami na siya ginahambalan sang mga tawo sa iya palibot nga kun magdako siya, masunod gid ini sa tapak sang iya amay nga isa man ka abogado.
english:
DESIRE

When Marañon was young, people around him often told him that when he grew up, he would follow in the footsteps of his father, who is also a lawyer.

text: “Kinder pa lang ko, gintulod na sang  mga ginikanan ko nga mangin abogado ako.
english: “Since kindergarten, my parents have pushed me to become a lawyer.

text: Gin-instill nila sa mind ko nga ma-attorney ako,” suno kay Marañon.
english: They instilled in my mind that I would become an attorney,” Marañon said.

text: Apisar nga nurse ang iya iloy, wala man ini gin-engganyo ang iya anak nga magkuha sang amo nga kurso bangud ang iya nga iloy mismo ang nagapati man nga bagay gid ang iya anak nga mangin mananabang.
english: Although her mother is a nurse, she did not encourage her son to take the course because her mother herself believed that her son was suitable to be a helper.

text: Nag-eskwela si Marañon sang elementarya kag sekondarya sa Central Philippine University (CPU) kag nagtapos sang iya kolehiyo sa St.
english: Marañon attended elementary and secondary school at the Central Philippine University (CPU) and graduated from St.

text: Vincent’s College Incorporated sa kurso nga Bachelor of Science in Accountancy.
english: Vincent’s College Incorporated in the Bachelor of Science in Accountancy course.

text: Sang 2017, matapos nag-gradwar sa kolehiyo, nag-enrol siya sa law school sa CPU.
english: In 2017, after graduating from college, she enrolled in law school at CPU.

text: Suno kay Marañon, sang amo nga tion, wala na ini sang iban pa nga direksyon nga luyag usuyon kundi ang dalan padulong sa pagka-abogado.
english: According to Marañon, at that time, he had no other direction to pursue but the path to becoming a lawyer.

text:
PAG-ABOT SANG PAGTILAW

Sang tuig 2018, sa tunga sang wala nagapakunaw sini nga determinasyon kag dedikasyon sa iya pagtuon, isa ka wala ginalauman nga hitabo ang nagpaalimunaw sa iya naumpisahan nga handom.
english:
COMING THE TEST

In 2018, in the midst of this unwavering determination and dedication to his studies, an unexpected event put an end to his dream.

text: Nakaangkon siya sang avascular necrosis nga posible resulta sang pagkabalda niya sadto sang natumba siya samtang nagahampang sang basketball.
english: He suffered avascular necrosis that may have been the result of a previous injury when he fell while playing basketball.

text: Base sa Johns Hopkins Medicine, ang avascular necrosis amo ang balatian nga resulta sang temporaryo ukon permanente nga pagkadula sang blood supply sa tul-an.
english: Based on Johns Hopkins Medicine, avascular necrosis is the disease that results from a temporary or permanent loss of blood supply to the bone.

text: Kun ang blood supply mag-untat, nagakapatay ang bone tissue kag naga-collapse ini.
english: When the blood supply stops, the bone tissue dies and collapses.

text: Suno kay John Marvin,bisan ang pagpungko ang indi niya masarangan gani naapektuhan ang iya pagtuon.
english: According to John Marvin, he can't even sit down and his studies are affected.

text: Naglab-ot ini nga nangin bedridden siya sa sulod sang isa ka tuig.
english: It got to the point where she was bedridden for a year.

text: Ini ang nagbag-o sang iya direksyon sa kabuhi bangud napilitan siya nga mag-untat sa iya pag-eskwela kag gindumdom nga didto na lang kutob ang iya handom kag ang iya kabuhi.
english: This changed the direction of his life as he was forced to drop out of school and remembered that his dream and his life ended there.

text: “New Year sadto sang 2018, while nagaselebrar ang iban, ako ya nagasininggit sa kasakit.
english: “It was New Year in 2018, while others were celebrating, I was screaming in pain.

text: Bisan ang hangin, bisan ang slightest touch, nagasakit gid ang lawas ko,” pahayag ni John.
english: Bisan ang hangin, bisan ang slightest touch, nagasakit gid ang lawas ko,” pahayag ni John.

text: Sa sulod sang isa ka tuig nga bedridden ini, tuman nga kaluoy ang nabatyagan ni Marañon sa iya kaugalingon.
english: During the year she was bedridden, Marañon felt so sorry for herself.

text:
PAG-ATUBANG SA BALATIAN

Samtang ginaantos ang iya balatian, nangin kahigayunan man ini para kay Marañon nga mas labi pa nga maapresyar niya ang iya pamilya.
english:
DEALING WITH ILLNESS

While suffering from his illness, it also became an opportunity for Marañon to appreciate his family even more.

text: “Ang mother ko gid ang number one nga grabe gid ang iya sacrifices sa akon.
english: “My mother is the number one who made a lot of sacrifices for me.

text: Ang father ko ara man.Didto kami gatulog isa lang kami ka kwarto,” pahayag niya.
english: My father is also there. We sleep there in the same room,” he said.

text: Suno sa iya, nagbakod pa gid ang relasyon sang iya pamilya kag mangin sang ila kaparyentehan nga nagabulig sa iya.
english: She said the relationship between her family and their relatives who help her has become stronger.

text: Pahayag ni John, kaangay nga nagbalik ini sa iya pagkabata nga ginapaliguan siya sang iya iloy, ginapailisan, ginapakaon, kag ginapainom sang bulong.
english: John said it was like going back to his childhood when his mother bathed him, changed him, fed him, and gave him medicine.

text: Suno pa sa iya, nagamit gid sang iya iloy ang iya propesyon bilang nurse, indi sa iban nga tawo, kundi sa kaugalingon nga anak.
english: She said her mother used her profession as a nurse, not for other people, but for her own son.

text: Ang pag-unong sang iya pamilya sa tunga sang iya kabudlay ang naghatag sang paglaum kay John nga buligan ang iya kaugalingon nga makarekober.
english: The support of his family in the midst of his ordeal gave John hope to help himself recover.

text: Isa man sa pinakamaayo nga butang nga dulot sang amo nga pagtilaw sa iya kabuhi amo nga mas napalapit ang iya relasyon sa Diyos.
english: One of the best things that this trial brought to his life was that he drew closer to God.

text: “Ang Ginuo lang gid ginakaptan mo, nga daw wala-wala ka na gid bala.Dara ka na gid lang makapit sa iya eh.Ginpa-experience niya sa akon nga sa Iya lang gid ko makapangayo bulig,” pahayag niya.
english: "You're just holding on to the Lord, as if you're nothing. You're just holding on to Him. He made me experience that I can only ask Him for help," he said.

text:
PAGPADAYON KAG NABUHI NGA PAGLAUM

Tuig 2020 sang naglupok ang pandemya bangud sa COVID-19 outbreak, apisar nga madulom nga bahin ini sang kabuhi sang mga tawo sa bilog nga kalibutan, naghatag naman ini sang kasanag kay John nga magbalik sa pag-eskwela.
english:
PERSISTENCE AND LIVED HOPE

In 2020, when the pandemic broke out due to the COVID-19 outbreak, although it was a dark part of people's lives around the world, it gave John the light to return to school.

text: Suno sa iya, sang ginpatuman ang online classes, gin-engganyo ini sang mga tawo nga padayunon ang iya pagkuha sang law.
english: He said that when online classes were implemented, people encouraged him to continue his law studies.

text: Diri nahatagan siya sang ikaduha nga kahigayunan para sa iya handom gani samtang yara lang ini sa iya hiligdaan, balik- estudyante ini paagi sa pag-attend sa virtual class.
english: Here he was given a second chance for his dream so while it was just in his bed, he was back- student by attending virtual class.

text: Sang 2022, sa amat-amat nga pagbalik sang tanan sa normal, nagatambong ini sa limited in-person classes samtang may ginauyatan nga walker agud suportahan ang iya paglakat sa sulod sang eskwelahan.
english: In 2022, with everything slowly returning to normal, she was attending limited in-person classes while holding a walker to support her walking around the school.

text: Gin-ako niya nga tuman ka budlay ang iya sitwasyon sang amo nga tion.
english: He admitted that he was in a very difficult situation at the time.

text: “I need to accept the fact gid sa mind ko that I can never be the usual law student,” suno kay Marañon.
english: “I need to accept the fact in my mind that I can never be the usual law student,” Marañon said.

text: Apang natigayon nga matapos ni John ang pag-eskwela sa law school.
english: But John managed to finish law school.

text:
KATUMANAN SANG HANDOM

Nagkuha sang bar exam si Marañon sang Septyembre 8, 11 kag 15 kag indi manegar nga nangin pagpanghangkat man ini sa iya bangud sa iya kondisyon.
english:
DREAM FULFILLMENT

Marañon took the bar exam on September 8, 11 and 15 and there is no denying that it was also a challenge for him because of his condition.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, ginpaiway anay niya ang natalana kuntani nga hip replacement surgery para lang madayon ang pagkuha niya sang pasinawan.
english: In fact, he postponed his scheduled hip replacement surgery just to continue taking the exam.

text: Samtang nagakuha sang exam, mangin siya ang wala man naglaum nga makapasar siya.
english: While taking the exam, he will be the one who did not expect to pass.

text: Sang gin-release na ang resulta sang Disyembre kag nakit-an ang iya pangalan sa mga passers, indi matungkad ang nabatyagan nga kalipay ni John.
english: When the December results were released and his name appeared among the passers, John was overjoyed.

text: “May miracle gid para sa akon nga gin-allow ako sang Ginuo nga makapasar.
english: “There was a miracle for me that the Lord allowed me to pass.

text: Praise God for that,” ang mapinasalamaton nga pahayag niya.
english: Praise God for that,” he said gratefully.

text:
REALISASYON

Subong nga isa na ka abogado si Marañon, luyag sini anay nga makompleto ang iya recovery sa iya kondisyon.
english:
REALIZATION

Now that Marañon is a lawyer, he wants to complete his recovery from his condition.

text: Suno sa iya, gamiton man niya ang iya propesyon subong agud maghatag sang inspirasyon sa iban nga bisan may kasablagan sa lawas, indi ini dapat mangin upang agud magtinguha kag mahatagan sang katumanan ang mga butang nga luyag lab-uton.
english: He said he will also use his current profession to inspire others that even with a physical disability, it should not be an obstacle to strive and achieve the things they want to achieve.

text: “Never give up on your dreams.
english: “Never give up on your dreams.

text: Never lose hope because no disability can put you down or can hinder a determined person to quest for excellence,” panugyan niya sa iban nga PWDs nga may handom.
english: Never lose hope because no disability can put you down or can hinder a determined person to quest for excellence,” he advised other PWDs who have dreams.

text: “Cling to the Lord because the Lord will give you the strength when all of your strength is gone,” dugang sini sa interview sa Good Morning Philippines sa Bombo Radyo Iloilo.
english: “Cling to the Lord because the Lord will give you the strength when all of your strength is gone,” he added in an interview with Good Morning Philippines on Bombo Radyo Iloilo.

text: Makabaton na sang COVID-19 vaccines ang mga naga-edad 16 anyos pataas sa Alaska — ang labing una nga estado sa America nga nagkakas sang eligibility requirements sa mahimo mabakunahan.
english: COVID-19 vaccines will now be available to those 16 and older in Alaska — the first state in the United States to remove eligibility requirements for those who can be vaccinated.

text: Gin-anunsyar mismo ni Republican Governor Mike Dunleavy ang panibag-o nga pagsulundan para sa 730,000 ka mga pumuluyo.
english: Republican Governor Mike Dunleavy himself announced the new rules for 730,000 residents.

text: Masobra isa na ka quarter sang mga Alaskans ukon masobra 25% sang populasyon ang nakabaton na sang isa ka shot sang bakuna.
english: More than a quarter of Alaskans or more than 25% of the population have already received a shot of the vaccine.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang COVID-19 vaccines nga gindevelop sang Moderna kag Johnson & Johnson ang aprubado lang sa mga tawo nga naga edad 18 pataas apang sa mga pamatan-on, mahimo sila makabaton sang Pfizer vaccine.
english: It is known that the COVID-19 vaccines developed by Moderna and Johnson & Johnson are only approved for people aged 18 and above but for young people, they can receive the Pfizer vaccine.

text: Nagalaum si Dunleavy nga mas madamo pa nga mga lugar ukon pungsod ang maka-umpisa na sang pagpang bakuna agud mabuhi liwat ang industriya sang turismo samtang nagahilapit na ang summer.
english: Dunleavy hopes that more areas or countries can start vaccinations to revive the tourism industry as summer approaches.

text: Sa subong, masobra 123 million doses sang COVID-19 vaccines na ang nahatag sa United States sa diin 93.7 million shots na ang nabakuna.
english: So far, more than 123 million doses of COVID-19 vaccines have been administered in the United States with 93.7 million shots administered.

text: Viral subong sa social media ang makatalandog-balatyagon nga ginhimo sang isa ka madre nga pagluhod sa atubang sang pulis kag militar sa Myanmar samtang nagapakitluoy nga indi pagdalahigon ang mga kabataan sa pinatyanay kag kinagamo sa amo nga pungsod.
english: A nun's touching gesture of kneeling before the police and military in Myanmar while pleading not to involve children in the killings and unrest in the country is now viral on social media.

text: Isa ka majority-Buddhist country ang Myanmar gani gindayaw sang kadam-an nga tawo ang ginhimo sang Catholic nun nga si Sister Ann Rose Nu Tawng.
english: Myanmar is a majority-Buddhist country so many people praised the actions of Catholic nun Sister Ann Rose Nu Tawng.

text: Suno kay Sister Ann, nagluhod siya kag nag-apelar sa armado nga pulis kag militar nga indi pagluthangon kag indi pag-i-torture ang mga kabataan, kag sa baylo, siya na lang ang patyon.
english: According to Sister Ann, she knelt down and appealed to the armed police and military not to shoot and torture the children, and instead, to kill her.

text: Yara sa gihapon ang Myanmar sa tunga sang tuman ka lapnagon nga hublag-protesta kag kinagamo matapos ginpatuman ang kudeta sang nagligad nga Pebrero 1.
english: Myanmar is still in the midst of widespread protests and unrest after the coup was implemented on February 1.

text: May kaangtanan diri, naggwa man ang mga protesters sa dalanon sa Myitkyina, capital sang Kachin state, samtang nagasuksok sang matig-a nga mga kalo kag nagabitbit sang mga taming.
english: In this regard, protesters also took to the streets in Myitkyina, capital of Kachin state, while wearing hard hats and carrying shields.

text: San amo nga adlaw suno kay Sister Anne, nagsunod man ang mga pulis kag gintinguhaan sang mga madre nga tabugon sila.
english: That day, Sister Anne said, the police followed and the nuns tried to chase them away.

text: Sunod nga ginlagas sang mga pulis ang bataon nga mga protesters gani nga wala na sang nahimo si Sister Anne kundi ang magluhod sa atubang sang mga pulis.
english: The police next chased the young protesters so that Sister Anne had no choice but to kneel before the police.

text: Pila ka segundos ang nagligad, nagpangluthang ang pulis gani nagdinalagan ang mga kabataan.
english: A few seconds later, the policeman opened fire and the children ran away.

text: Suno kay Sister Anne, nakit-an niya ang naigu sa ulo ang isa ka lalaki kag sunod amo ang paggamit sang pulis sang tear gas.
english: According to Sister Anne, she saw a man hit in the head and then the police used tear gas.

text: Sa amo nga protesta, ginkumpirma sang rescue team nga duha ka lalaki ang naluthangan-patay apang wala sang kumpirmasyon kun live rounds ukon rubber bullets ang gingamit.
english: During the protest, the rescue team confirmed that two men were shot dead but there was no confirmation whether live rounds or rubber bullets were used.

text: Sa subong, santo sa record sang Assistance Association for Political Prisoners monitoring group, masobra na sa 60 ka tawo ang napatay sa Myanmar bangud sang ginapatigayon nga hublag protesta batok sa militar kag ginpatuman nga kudeta.
english: So far, according to the records of the Assistance Association for Political Prisoners monitoring group, more than 60 people have been killed in Myanmar due to the ongoing protest movement against the military and the coup.

text: Mahimo na makatipon-tipon nga wala sang ginasuksok nga face mask kag wala sang ginasunod nga physical distancing ang mga tawo nga may yara na sang COVID-19 full vaccination sa Estados Unidos.
english: People who are fully vaccinated against COVID-19 in the United States can now gather without wearing face masks and without observing physical distancing.

text: Ini ang nakasaad sa guidelines nga ginpagwa sang US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).
english: This is in accordance with the guidelines issued by the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

text: Suno kay CDC Director Dr Rochelle Walensky, katuyuan sang gin-release nga guidelines nga makabalik na ang mga tawo sa ordinaryo nga mga hilikuton nga luyag nila himuon.
english: According to CDC Director Dr. Rochelle Walensky, the purpose of the released guidelines is to get people back to the ordinary activities they want to do.

text:
Sa amo man nga guidelines, ginapahanugutan na ang mga tawo nga nakakumpleto patublok sang COVID-19 vaccine nga himuon ang mga masunod:

Good news man ini para sa mga nakapabakuna nga mga Lolo kag Lola.
english:
Under the same guidelines, people who have completed the COVID-19 vaccine are now allowed to do the following:

This is also good news for vaccinated Grandparents.

text: Ini bangud, apisar wala sang mask kag physical distancing, pwede na nila mabisita ang wala nabakunahan nga mga apo kag kabataan SA KONDISYON nga wala sang myembro sang pamilya ang may risgo sa malala nga COVID-19 infection.
english: This is because, despite the absence of masks and physical distancing, they can visit unvaccinated grandchildren and children PROVIDED that no family member is at risk of severe COVID-19 infection.

text: Sa subong, santo sa report sang CDC, kapin 9 percent na sang US population ukon 30 million ka tawo ang nakakumpleto na sang vaccination.
english: Currently, according to the CDC report, more than 9 percent of the US population or 30 million people have completed vaccination.

text: Naglab-ot sa tatlo ka truck ang nakuha sang City Environment and Natural Resources (CENRO) nga mga basura sa palibot sang city proper kasunod sang tatlo ka separado nga mga aktibidad sang nagligad nga adlaw.
english: The City Environment and Natural Resources (CENRO) seized three trucks of garbage around the city proper following three separate activities yesterday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Niel Ravena, Head sang Iloilo City Environment and Natural Resources, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa sunod-sunod man nga mga kahiwatan, insigida nga ginmanduan sini ang mga personnel sang talatapan nga limpyohan ang mga dalan ilabi na ang JM Basa Street, City Proper kag Provincial Capitol.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Niel Ravena, Head of Iloilo City Environment and Natural Resources, said that due to the successive activities, he immediately ordered the personnel of the office to clean the roads especially JM Basa Street, City Proper and Provincial Capitol.

text: Suno kay Ravena, isa gid ka truck ang gin-deploy sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol agud nga maghakot sang mga natipon nga basura sa lugar.
english: According to Ravena, a truck was deployed at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol to pick up the garbage collected in the area.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nagpadala man ang talatapan sang water tanker agud nga mag-flushing sa mga dalan agud nga indi ini mangin madanlog para sa mga motorista.
english: He also said that the office also sent a water tanker to flush the roads so that it will not be slippery for motorists.

text: Mas madamo naman ang natipon nga basura halin sa provincial capitol kon ikumpara sa mga natipon sang CENRO sa city proper.
english: More garbage was collected from the provincial capitol compared to that collected by CENRO in the city proper.

text: Magahatag ang Covax sang 14.4 million COVID-19 vaccine doses sa 31 ka mga pungsod sa masunod nga semana.
english: Covax will distribute 14.4 million COVID-19 vaccine doses to 31 countries next week.

text: Ini ang ginpahayag sang World Health Orgaization kadungan sang pagpaandam sa publiko nga indi pag-uyangan ang paglaom nga mahatag sang bakuna.
english: The World Health Organization said this while warning the public not to waste hope that the vaccine will be available.

text: Sini nga semana, kabug-usan nga 20 million doses sang bakuna ang natigayon na nga mapadala sang Covax global vaccine-sharing facility sa 20 ka mga pungsod.
english: This week, a total of 20 million doses of the vaccine have been shipped by the Covax global vaccine-sharing facility to 20 countries.

text: Apang suno kay WHO emergencies director Mihael Ryan, nagakabalaka ang organisasyon nga mahimo magsaka pa ang mga kaso sang COVID-19 sa pagdumdom sang tawo nga ang pagpatigayon sang vaccine roll-out ang nagakahulugan nga tapos naman ang krisis.
english: But according to WHO emergencies director Mihael Ryan, the organization is concerned that COVID-19 cases could rise if people think that the vaccine roll-out means the crisis is over.

text: Indi nagakadapat pahayag niya nga buy-an na ang mga restrictions.
english: He said the restrictions should not be lifted.

text: Gindayaw naman ni WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus ang una nga semana sang Covax roll-out.
english: WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus praised the first week of the Covax roll-out.

text: Nag-abot na sa probinsya sang Cebu ang 35,000 ka bag sang well-milled rice halin sa National Food Authority (NFA) bilang kabahin sang pilot testing sang P20 kada kilo nga bugas nga programa sang gobyerno.
english: 35,000 bags of well-milled rice from the National Food Authority (NFA) have arrived in Cebu province as part of the pilot testing of the government's P20 per kilo rice program.

text: Suno sa Department of Agriculture (DA) nag-umpisa na sang Lunes ang pag-unload sang shipment sang NFA rice nga halin sa bodega sang ahensya sa Mindoro.
english: According to the Department of Agriculture (DA), the unloading of the shipment of NFA rice from the agency's warehouse in Mindoro began on Monday.

text: Ang nasambit nga 35,000 ka bag sang NFA rice isa lamang ka kabahin sang kabug-osan nga 600,000 ka bag nga gin-order ni Cebu Governor Gwendolyn Garcia para sa programa sa probinsya nga magahatag sang NFA rice sa presyo nga P20 kada kilo.
english: The 35,000 bags of NFA rice are only part of the total 600,000 bags ordered by Cebu Governor Gwendolyn Garcia for the provincial program that will provide NFA rice at a price of P20 per kilo.

text: Nagpasakop man sa subsidized rice initiative ang mga probinsya sang Bohol, Siquijor, kag Southern Leyte.
english: The provinces of Bohol, Siquijor, and Southern Leyte also joined the subsidized rice initiative.

text: Ang apat ka probinsya may kabug-osan nga inisyal nga order nga 673,000 ka bag sang 50-kilo nga bugas para sa pilot test nga magalawig tubtob Disyembre.
english: The four provinces have a total initial order of 673,000 bags of 50-kilo rice for the pilot test that will run until December.

text: Amo ini ang paglaragway ni South Korean Pres.
english: This is how South Korean Pres.

text: Lee Jae-Myung sa relasyon sang Pilipinas kag South Korea.
english: Lee Jae-Myung on Philippine-South Korea relations.

text: Sa iya opeing remarks sa bilateral meeting nila ni Pres.
english: In his opening remarks at the bilateral meeting with Pres.

text: Bongbong Marcos, ginsambit ni lee ang pagpadala sang kontribusyon kag sakripiso sang mga Pilipino nga suldado nga nakig-away sang Korean War.
english: Bongbong Marcos, Lee mentioned the sending of contributions and sacrifices of Filipino soldiers who fought in the Korean War.

text: “Our two countries have maintained a very close relationship of cooperation and support, and I hope that through your visit, we will be able to take that to another level,” pahayag ni Lee.
english: “Our two countries have maintained a very close relationship of cooperation and support, and I hope that through your visit, we will be able to take that to another level,” stated Lee.

text: “Next year, the Philippines will chair the ASEAN summits, and I see a real opportunity for us to promote a rules-based order, a more secure and more prosperous region,” sabat naman ni Pres.
english: “Next year, the Philippines will chair the ASEAN summits, and I see a real opportunity for us to promote a rules-based order, a more secure and more prosperous region,” Pres.

text: Marcos Jr.
english: Marcos Jr.

text: Nagmando si Mayor Raisa Treñas nga pagatutukan sang Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO), kaupod ang Task Force BADJAO kag City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) ang mga naga-baligya kag naga-panghalit sang mga salakyan sa mga stoplight sa syudad ilabi na sa Diversion Road, Madurriao, Iloilo City.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas ordered that the Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO), together with Task Force BADJAO and City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) will focus on those who sell and damage vehicles at stoplights in the city especially in Diversion Road, Madurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga-Goprzal, spokesperson ni Mayor Raisa Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga nagmando ang alkalde nga i-identify ang mga kabataan kag kag kun sa diin ang mga ini nagapuyo agud mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga interbensyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga-Goprzal, spokesperson of Mayor Raisa Treñas, said the mayor ordered the identification of the children and where they live so that they can be given appropriate intervention.

text: Ini kasunod sang reklamo nga ginreport matapos gin-kuritan sang isa ka menor de edad ang salakyan sang isa ka motorista bangud wala ini nagbakal sa iya ginabaligya.
english: Ini kasunod sang reklamo nga ginreport matapos gin-kuritan sang isa ka menor de edad ang salakyan sang isa ka motorista bangud wala ini nagbakal sa iya ginabaligya.

text: Suno sa reklamo, nagamit ang bata sang tanzan sa pagkurit sa salakyan.
english: According to the complaint, the child used the tanzan to draw on the vehicle.

text: May iban man nga ginreport nga naga-baligya sa tunga sang dalan, nga ginakabig delikado bangud posible ini makaluntad sa disgrasya kun sa diin kalabanan sa ila amo ang mga menor de edad nga nagapang-ayo-ayo.
english: There are also others reported to be selling in the middle of the road, which is considered dangerous because it can lead to accidents where most of them are minors who are begging.

text: Gintap man sang syudad ang nagkalain-lain nga ahensya lakip ang POSMO kag Task Force BADJAO agud mag-deploy sang personnel sa lugar kun sa diin masami ini nagaktabo.
english: The city also tapped various agencies including POSMO and Task Force BADJAO to deploy personnel in the area where this often happens.

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw may ara sang na-rescue ang CSWDO nga mga kabataan nga anom ka mga menor de eded kag ginturn-over naman ini sa tagsa nila ka mga barangay.
english: Last day, the CSWDO rescued six minors and turned them over to their respective barangays.

text: MAS MABASKUG sa tawo ang handom nga mag-“take” sang “calculated risk” agud matigayon ang iya pangabuhian sangsa mawad-an na gid sing trabaho, labi na gid sa sining panahon sang COVID-19.
english: THE desire to take calculated risks to earn a living is stronger than the desire to lose one's job, especially in this time of COVID-19.

text:
Natural sa mga ginikanan nga mag-risgo sang ila kaugalingon, bisan gani ihalad pa ang ila kabuhi, para pangapinan ang kaayuhan kag agud indi magutman ang ila mga palangga nga

mga kabataan.
english:
It is natural for parents to risk themselves, even sacrifice their lives, to protect the welfare and to prevent their loved ones from starving

children.

text: Para sa ila, ang solusyon indi ang mga teoriya, katulad sang Keynesian Economics, nga kon kis-a palpak man gani sa indi bagay nga mga sitwasyon.
english: For them, the solution is not theories, such as Keynesian Economics, which sometimes fail even in the wrong situations.

text: Mas maayo para sa ila ang praktikal kag madasig nga mga solusyon nga direkta makabulig sa mga pumuluyo, agud mapunggan ang paghagmak na sang aton ekonomiya.
english: They prefer practical and quick solutions that will directly help the people, to prevent the collapse of our economy.

text: Tungod sini, mabaskug gid ang pag-alungay sang aton mga ginikanan nga tugtan sila nga makagwa agud makapangita sing trabaho – indi lang agud makakita sini kundi tani mabuligan man sang gobyerno – sa sining panahon sang mapintas nga COVID-19.
english: Because of this, our parents are very eager to be allowed to go out to find a job – not only to find it but also to be helped by the government – ​​in this time of cruel COVID-19.

text: In fact, nagabulig gid man ang gobyerno.
english: In fact, the government is helping.

text: Maluag na gawa ang mga restriction sang gobyerno sa panghulag sang mga pumuluyo para sa oportunidad nga makakita sing palangitan-an, nga may pagpangamlig man ang gobyerno para sa ila batok sa COVID-19.
english: The government has already loosened restrictions on the movement of citizens for the opportunity to earn a living, with the government also protecting them against COVID-19.

text: May ginapatuman gani nga minimum health standard agud maamligan ang luyag magtrabaho sa gwa, basta indi lang magpasaway.
english: There is even a minimum health standard to protect those who want to work outside, as long as they don't get disciplined.

text: Kalakip sa bulig nga ginahatag na sang gobyerno amo ang paghatag sang Social Amelioration Program (SAP) subsidy sang Dept.
english: Among the assistance already provided by the government is the provision of Social Amelioration Program (SAP) subsidy by the Dept.

text: of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) kag ang bulig sang Dept.
english: of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) and the assistance of the Dept.

text: of Labor and Employment (DOLE) sa mga na-layoff nga trabahador katulad sang cash-for-work.
english: of Labor and Employment (DOLE) to laid off workers such as cash-for-work.

text: Ginabuligan man sini ang mga negosyo agud makabangon katulad sang paghatag sang may low-interest nga mga loan.
english: It also helps businesses to recover such as providing low-interest loans.

text: Ang problema ugaling diri kay ang mga loan pabug-at man sa mga negosyo.
english: The problem here, however, is that loans are also a burden on businesses.

text: Dugang pa ang padayon man nga kuha sang gobyerno sang mga buhis batok sa ila mga non-earning nga assets labi na gid ang mga nagsara na sang ila negosyo.
english: In addition, the government continues to collect taxes against their non-earning assets especially those that have already closed their businesses.

text: Padayon man sa pagkuha sa ila sang business tax kag iban pa nga balayran – bisan sa ila kulabos na nga kahimtangan – nga ginagamit sang gobyerno agud tustusan ang SAP subsidy kag cash-for-work.
english: They also continue to be charged business tax and other fees – even in their poor condition – that the government uses to finance the SAP subsidy and cash-for-work.

text: Sa amo ina nga kahimtangan, paano pa abe makatibawas ang aton mga negosyo agud bisan na lang ma-maintain ang ila survival?
english: In such a situation, how can our businesses survive to even maintain their survival?

text: Sige ang ila pagbayad sang buhis sa mga non-earning assets kag ang padayon man pagkuha sang gobyerno sang buhis sa nagahikahos nila nga mga negosyo?
english: They keep paying taxes on non-earning assets and the government continues to collect taxes on their operating businesses?

text: Of course, kon wala pa sila nakapanira!
english: Of course, if they haven't already!

text: Ano abe kon buligan naton ang mga negosyo nga makabangon paagi sa pagpamag-an sang ila problema paagi sa tax cuts agud ma-save nila sa padayon nga kabuhi nila kag sang ila mga trabador nga tani indi ma-layoff kag sa gihapon makabulig sa ila mga pamilya?
english: What if we help businesses recover by easing their problems through tax cuts so that they can save the lives of themselves and their workers who would not be laid off and still help their families?

text: Kag ayhan makahatag pa gihapon sila sang 13th month pay sa ila sa tion sang Paskwa!
english: And maybe they can still give them a 13th month pay in time for Christmas!

text: Ano abe kon pasugtan ta man ang mga negosyante sa private sector sa pagpatuman sang pay cut sa ila casual employees agud mapadayon ang ila trabaho sa lugar nga pahalinon ang iban sa ila?
english: What if we allow private sector businesses to implement pay cuts to their casual employees to keep their jobs instead of laying off some of them?

text: Ginahimo man gani ini sang siyudad sa kaso sang mga government casuals paagi sa pag-iban P100 sa ila tag-adlaw nga sweldo.
english: The city is even doing this in the case of government casuals by deducting P100 from their daily salary.

text:
***

Indi dapat magsalig lang ang gobyerno sa makuha nga mga buhis sa negosyo.
english:
***

The government should not rely solely on the collection of business taxes.

text: Pwede man ini makautang sa mga bangko sang gobyerno agud gamiton sa paghatag sang SAP subsidy kag cash-for-work nga indi madugangan pa ang problem sang mga negosyante sing wala patawad nga buhis.
english: It can also borrow from government banks to be used to provide SAP subsidies and cash-for-work without adding to the problem of entrepreneurs with unforgiven taxes.
