text: Daku man ang mabulig sa aton ekonomiya ang padayon na nga pagbukas sang mga negosyo nga may paandam ang gobyerno sa paghalong sa ikaayong lawas sang mga pumuluyo sa ila mga patakaran sa pagtatap sang mga kustomer agud ini sila indi man mahadlukan sa pagsuporta sa ila.
english: The continued opening of businesses with the government's warning to take care of the health of the people in their customer service policies will also help our economy.

text: In fact, ang mabungahon nga pag-operar sang mga negosyo makabulig man sa pagpasanyog sang ila aktibidades sa produksyon kag pamakal kag pagbaligya sang ila mga produkto kag serbisyo, nga mahimo sang mga pumuluyo tungod sa ayuda nga galastuhon sang gobyerno kag kaugalingon nila nga mga palangitan-an halin sa private sector.
english: In fact, the efficient operation of businesses can also help to improve their production activities and the purchase and sale of their products and services, which the people can do thanks to the assistance spent by the government and their own resources from the private sector.

text: Sa sini nga sitwasyon, ang mga negosyo indi lang maka-survive kundi makabulig pa sa pagpasanyog sang aton ekonomiya, sa kabug-usan.
english: In this situation, businesses can not only survive but also help boost our economy, as a whole.

text: Indi bala?/PN
english: Isn't it?/PN

text: Pagsakit sang ulo, tuman nga pagka-uhaw, pagpanghina kag pagkalipong ang pila ka mga patimaan sang heat stroke.
english: Headache, extreme thirst, weakness and dizziness are some of the signs of heat stroke.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Elvin Tiangha, iya ginpahayag nga ang heat stroke amo ang ginakabig nga malala nga balatian sa diin tuman kataas ang temperatura sang lawas sang isa ka tawo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Elvin Tiangha, he said that heat stroke is considered a serious disease where a person's body temperature is too high.

text: Mataas ang posibilidad nga mag-angkon sang heat stroke ang isa ka tawo kun nagatinir ini sa tuman kainit nga lugar nga nagaresulta sa dehydration.
english: A person is more likely to develop heat stroke if he or she stays in a very hot place that results in dehydration.

text: Suno kay Dr. Tiangha, kun nagadangat na sa 40°C ang hilanat sang isa ka tawo, nagadasig ang heart beat, nagakombulsyon, kag nagadiliryo, mahimo ini nga magresulta sa heat stroke.
english: According to Dr. For example, when a person's fever reaches 40°C, increased heart rate, convulsions, and dizziness, it can result in heat stroke.

text:
Agud makalikaw sa heat stroke, nagakadapat nga:

Ginpahayag ni Tiangha nga mas maayo nga mag-ehersisyo kun aga sa diin indi pa tuman ka init.
english:
To prevent heat stroke, you should:

Tiangha said it is better to exercise in the morning when it is not too hot.

text: Panugyan sang doktor, dal-on gilayon sa ospital ang isa ka-tawo nga ginapatihan naheat stroke.
english: The doctor advised that a person suspected of having a heat stroke should be taken to the hospital immediately.

text: Imagine kun yara ikaw sa eroplano nga may sakay man gali nga man-og!
english: Imagine being on a plane with a snake on board!

text: Indi man delikado ang tanan nga man-og, apang may mga tawo abi nga naga-panic gid dayon kun makakita sini kag nagatuga sang komosyon.
english: Not all snakes are dangerous, but some people panic when they see them and cause a commotion.

text: Sa Miami International Airport sa Florida, isa ka pasahero ang nagtuyo nga dal-on ang iya nga man-og sa iya byahe.
english: At Miami International Airport in Florida, a passenger tried to bring his snake on his flight.

text: Agud nga mahimo ini, ginsulod niya ini sa gamay nga pouch kag ginbutang sa iya nga delargo.
english: To do this, he put it in a small pouch and put it on his delargo.

text: Apang wala gid naswertehan ang lalaki bangud wala nakalusot sa Transportation Security Administration (TSA) officials ang iya nga animal friends bangud nakit-an ang mga ini pag-abot sa security checkpoint.
english: However, the man was not lucky because his animal friends did not escape from the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) officials because they were found when they arrived at the security checkpoint.

text: Sunod nga nagpakig-angot ang otoridad sa US Customs and Border Protection kag sa Miami Dade Police Department agud nga matatapan ang amo nga bagay.
english: The authorities subsequently contacted US Customs and Border Protection and the Miami Dade Police Department to resolve the matter.

text: Ginpadala man ang mga man-og sa Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission.
english: The snakes were also sent to the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission.

text: Ginpaathag naman sang US Department of Transportation nga ang federal kag state governments ang nagapatuman sang istrikto nga restrictions sa pagbyahe sang buhi nga mga sapat kag kada airline ang may yara man sang company policy kun paano ini ma-handle sang maayo kun sila ang yara sa transportasyon.
english: The US Department of Transportation explained that the federal and state governments implement strict restrictions on the travel of live animals and each airline also has a company policy on how to handle them properly when they are in transport.

text: Indi ini ang una nga bes nga may nagtuyo nga magpalusot sang sapat bangud may yara man anay sang nagdala sang 4-foot boa constrictor para sa “emotional support” samtang isa naman ang nagbitbit sang orange nga kuring sa luggage apang palareho nga wala ginpasugtan sang paluparan.
english: This is not the first time that someone tried to smuggle an animal because someone brought a 4-foot boa constrictor for emotional support while another carried an orange cat in luggage but both were not allowed by the airport.

text: Apisar nagapanguna ang Israel sa kadam-an sa mga pungsod sa kalibutan bangud sang madasig nga vaccination drive, wala nagakumpiyansa ang otoridad kag naga-todo diskarte sa gihapon agud makumbinse ang bug-os nga populasyon nga magpabakuna batok sa COVD-19.
english: Although Israel leads most countries in the world because of the rapid vaccination drive, the authorities are not confident and are still trying to convince the entire population to get vaccinated against COVD-19.

text: Sa duha ka vaccination centers sa syudad sang Tel Aviv sa amo nga pungsod, nag-partner ang gobyerno sa local restaurants agud magtanyag sang libre nga pagkaon agud maganahan man ang mga tawo nga i-avail ang bakuna.
english: At two vaccination centers in the city of Tel Aviv in the country, the government partnered with local restaurants to offer free food to encourage people to avail of the vaccine.

text: May pizza, filo pastry, dessert, kag kape nga sarang ma-enjoy ang mga nagapabakuna.
english: Pizza, filo pastry, dessert, and coffee will be available for those getting vaccinated to enjoy.

text: May yara man sang Israeli bar nga nagserbe nga COVID-19 vaccination clinic nga nagtanyag man sang free non-alcoholic drinks sa mga nakapabakuna na.
english: There was also an Israeli bar that served as a COVID-19 vaccination clinic that also offered free non-alcoholic drinks to those who had already been vaccinated.

text: Magluwas diri, sang Pebrero 21, ginrelease man ang ginatawag nga vaccine passport.
english: In addition, on February 21, the so-called vaccine passport was also released.

text: Ang mga tawo nga may yara na sang full vaccination ang mahimo maka-download sang application nga naga-display sang ila green pass.
english: People who are already fully vaccinated can download an application that displays their green pass.

text: Ang green pass amo ang ginapakita sa otoridad agud makasulod ang isa ka tawo sa gyms, hotels, swimming pools, concerts, places of worship, restaurants, kag bars.
english: A green pass is what is shown to the authorities to allow a person to enter gyms, hotels, swimming pools, concerts, places of worship, restaurants, and bars.

text: Ini nga mga estratehiya ang ginhimo ilabi na para sa mga kabataan nga amo ang posible nagapangalag-ag pa sa pag-avail sang dose sang COVID-19 vaccine bangud sa pagpati nga indi man sila prone sa delikado nga coronavirus complications.
english: These strategies are designed especially for children who may be hesitant to avail of a dose of COVID-19 vaccine because they believe they are not prone to dangerous coronavirus complications.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Archie Enriquez direkta sa Israel, masobra na sa katunga sang populasyon sang bug-os nga Israel ang nakabaton sang ila doses.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Archie Enriquez directly in Israel, more than half of the population of the entire Israeli population has received their doses.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, subong man nga semana, 500 ka mga tawo nga may complete vaccination ang napahanugutan na nga makadugok sa football stadium sa Tel Aviv agud makasaksi sa first of four concerts nga gin-organisa sang gobyerno.
english: In fact, this week, 500 fully vaccinated people have already been allowed to flock to the football stadium in Tel Aviv to witness the first of four concerts organized by the government.

text: Matandaan nga nag-umpisa ang vaccination campaign sa amo nga pungsod sang nagligad nga Disyembre 20, 2020 gamit ang BioNTech-Pfizer mRNA vaccine.
english: The vaccination campaign in the country began on December 20, 2020 using the BioNTech-Pfizer mRNA vaccine.

text: Sa subong, ang mga estratehiya sang Israel ilabi na ang green pass scheme amo ang ginakabig ‘closely-watched’ bilang ehemplo sa iban nga mga pungsod agud mabuksan man ukon mapabangon ang ila tagsa ka ekonomiya.
english: Currently, Israel's strategies, especially the green pass scheme, are being closely watched as an example to other countries to open up or revive their respective economies.

text: Lakip sa makabaton sang Service Recognition Incentive (SRI) nga P20,000 ang mga manunudlo nga nagatrabaho sa gobyerno.
english: Among those who will receive the Service Recognition Incentive (SRI) of P20,000 are teachers working in the government.

text: Ini pagkatapos nga gin-aprubahan ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: This is after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. approved the

text: ang Administrative Order No.
english: Administrative Order No.

text: 27 sang Disyembre 12, 2024.
english: 27 of December 12, 2024.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Ma.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Ma.

text: Luz De Los Reyes, Schools Division Superintendent, Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga ang P20,000 nga mabaton sang mga manunudlo ang may 20% nga tax deduction.
english: Luz De Los Reyes, Schools Division Superintendent, Iloilo City, said the P20,000 that teachers will receive will have a 20% tax deduction.

text: Suno kay De Los Reyes, sang nagligad nga tuig, P18,000 lang ang ila nabaton kon sa diin, ginbuhinan man sang tax, apang may mga yara man sang non-taxable.
english: According to De Los Reyes, last year, they received only P18,000 which was tax deducted, but there were also non-taxable.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga luwas sa Service Recognition Incentive (SRI), makabaton man sang P5,000 Productivity Enhancement Incentive ang mga manunudlo.
english: He also said that besides the Service Recognition Incentive (SRI), teachers will also receive a P5,000 Productivity Enhancement Incentive.

text: Nahibaluan nga lakip sa makabaton sang bente-mil nga incentive ang Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) sa idalum sang Department of National Defense, kag uniformed personnel sang Philippine National Police, Bureau of Fire Protection, kag Bureau of Jail Management and Penology sa idalum sang Department of the Interior and Local Government, the Bureau of Corrections under the Department of Justice, the Philippine Coast Guard sa idalom sang Department of Transportation, kag ang National Mapping and Resource Information Authority sa idalom sang Department of Environment and Natural Resources.
english: Among those who will receive the 20,000 incentive are the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) under the Department of National Defense, and uniformed personnel of the Philippine National Police, Bureau of Fire Protection, and Bureau of Jail Management and Penology under the Department of the Interior and Local Government, the Bureau of Corrections. Justice, the Philippine Coast Guard under the Department of Transportation, and the National Mapping and Resource Information Authority under the Department of Environment and Natural Resources.

text:
Imbestigahan sang US Justice Department ang mataas nga kaso sang pagpang-atake sa Asian Americans umpisa sang gintawag ni anay President Donald Trump ang COVID-19 bilang “China virus.”

Suno kay Pamela Karlan, principal deputy assistant attorney general for the Civil Rights Division, nagapangatubang subong ang Estados Unidos sang indi patas nga mga pagpanghangkat.
english:
The US Justice Department will investigate the high number of cases of attacks on Asian Americans since former President Donald Trump called COVID-19 the “China virus.”

According to Pamela Karlan, principal deputy assistant attorney general for the Civil Rights Division, the United States currently faces unequal challenges.

text: Nagapakig-angot na ang iya opisina sa Federal Bureau of Investigation, federal prosecutors kag local police agud nga i-evaluate ang mga hate crimes.
english: His office is already working with the Federal Bureau of Investigation, federal prosecutors and local police to evaluate hate crimes.

text: Pahayag naman ni Acting Deputy Attorney General John Carlin, wala nila gina-tolerate ang ano man nga sahi sang domestic terrorism ukon hate-based violent extremism sa diin ini ang ila tinguhaan nga matapos na.
english: Acting Deputy Attorney General John Carlin said they do not tolerate any form of domestic terrorism or hate-based violent extremism and they will try to end it.

text: Humalin sang Marso 2020 tubtob Disyembre sang tinalikdan nga tuig, may yara sang masobra 2,800 nga mga reported incidents sang anti-Asian hate incidents sa Estados Unidos.
english: From March 2020 to December of last year, there were more than 2,800 reported incidents of anti-Asian hate incidents in the United States.

text: Ang verbal harassment naman ang may yara sang masobra 70 percent nga mga insidente kag masobra 8 percent ang involved sa physical assaults.
english: Verbal harassment accounted for more than 70 percent of incidents and more than 8 percent involved physical assaults.

text: Indi magduha-duha nga kakson kag utdon sang Iloilo City Engineers Office ang linya sang kable sang telecommunications company kon indi nila ini mahimos sa mga poste sa syudad.
english: The Iloilo City Engineers Office will not hesitate to remove and cut the cable line of the telecommunications company if they cannot fix it on the poles in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Joel Gerasmia, Head sang Task Force Public Utilities Group of Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga padayon ang monitoring sang ila talatapan sa mga telco companies kon sa diin, amat-amat na man sila nagahulag.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Joel Gerasmia, Head of the Task Force Public Utilities Group of Iloilo, said his office continues to monitor the telco companies where they are slowly moving.

text: Nagpaandam man ang natungdan nga ubrahon nila ang nagakadapat nga himuon kon mag-abot sa Lunes nga wala sa gihapon naubos panghimos sang telco ang ila mga linya nga nagakabod sa gihapon sa poste.
english: He also warned that they will do what they should do if by Monday the telco has not finished repairing their lines that are still hanging from the poles.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga indi rason ang calle real market night agud indi matuman sang mga telco ang amo nga tikang.
english: He also said that the calle real market night is not a reason for the telcos not to implement the move.

text: Suno kay Gerasmia, “no mercy” ang ila ipatuman batok sa telco companies kon hinali nga wala sila sa gihapon sang may ginhimo sa ginhatag nga deadline.
english: Gerasmia said they will implement “no mercy” against telco companies if they suddenly fail to do anything by the deadline.

text: Kon balikan, ginhatagan sang deadline ni Mayor Jerry Treñas tubtob December 16 ang mga telcos nga mahimus ang ila linya.
english: Mayor Jerry Treñas gave the telcos a deadline of December 16 to repair their lines.

text: Madumduman nga may yara sang ordinansa ang syudad nga nagamando sang underground cabling sa bahin sa JM Basa Street.
english: It can be recalled that the city has an ordinance that mandates underground cabling in the area of ​​JM Basa Street.

text: Nakatalana naman isunod ang bahin sang Diversion sa underground cabling.
english: The Diversion is scheduled to follow the underground cabling.

text: TEXAS, USA – Ginakulang sa suplay sa pagkaon kag tubig ang mga residente sa Texas sa Estados Unidos.
english: TEXAS, USA – Residents of Texas in the United States are facing food and water shortages.

text: Ini ang kasunod winter storm kag pagnubo sang temperatura nga nagresulta sang power outage ukon pagkadula sang kuryente sa sulod sang pila ka adlaw.
english: This follows a winter storm and a drop in temperatures that resulted in power outages or loss of electricity for several days.

text: Naapektuhan man sini ang pila ka mga building nga gintugyan para sa mga tawo nga homeless ukon wala sang kaugalingon nga balay sa estado.
english: It also affected some buildings that were handed over for people who are homeless or do not have their own house in the state.

text: Nagakahangawa naman ang gobyerno bangud nagsaka sa kapin anom ang numero sang mga napatay nga homeless bangud sa natabo nga winter storm.
english: The government is concerned that the number of homeless deaths due to the winter storm has risen to more than six.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Pinoy Gonzales direkta sa Houston, Texas, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong amat-amat naman nga nagabalik ang suplay sang kuryente.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Pinoy Gonzales directly in Houston, Texas, he said that the power supply is now slowly returning.

text: Apang dako naman nga problema ang pagpangita sang kalan-on kag tubig bangud wala sang truck nga nakadul-ong sang suplay.
english: However, finding food and water is a big problem because no truck has been able to deliver supplies.

text: Nagpakig-angot ang Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO) sa City Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) kag sa City Engineering Office agud nga masulosyonan ang mga suga sa Iloilo Esplanade 3.
english: The Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO) liaised with the City Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) and the City Engineering Office to resolve the lights on Iloilo Esplanade 3.

text: Ini kasunod man sang may natukiban ang green guard sang Garden of Love sang duha ka mga lalaki nga nagahimo sang kamala-malahan.
english: This is after the green guard of the Garden of Love discovered two men doing something wrong.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: PCOL.
english: PCOL.

text: Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Public Order and Safety Management Office, iya ginpahayag nga nakapadala na ang talatapan sang sulat sa nasambit nga mga opisina agud nga mapabutangan sang dugang nga suga ang idalom sang Jalandoni Bridge bangud tuman gid ka dulom.
english: Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Public Order and Safety Management Office, said the office has already sent a letter to the said offices to install additional lights under the Jalandoni Bridge because it is very dark.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, butangan man ang pila ka porsyon sang Esplanade 3 kag pagalimpyohan ang mga madabong nga hilamon agud nga indi na mahukmungan sang mga indibidwal.
english: According to Garbanzos, some portions of Esplanade 3 will also be cleared and the weeds will be cleared so that individuals will no longer be able to enjoy themselves.

text: Nagpasalig man ang natungdan nga mahawanan ang mga masi-ok nga bahin sang lugar agud nga malikawan nga masulit pa ang hitabo.
english: He also assured that the narrow parts of the area will be cleared to avoid a repeat of the incident.

text: Napuno sang kasanag kag kasadya ang ginpatigayon nga Opening of Lights & Fireworks Display sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol.
english: The Opening of Lights & Fireworks Display at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol was filled with light and joy.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., iya ginpahayag nga ang desinyo sang lights subong ang para sa tagsa ka pamilya nga Ilonggo ilabi na sa mga kabataan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr. said the design of the lights is for every Ilonggo family especially the children.

text: Gin-abi-abi man sang gobernador si Department of Education (DEPED) Secretary Sonny Angara nga nagserbe nga guest of honor sang kahiwatan.
english: The governor also welcomed Department of Education (DEPED) Secretary Sonny Angara who served as the guest of honor of the event.

text: Suno kay Defensor, indi lamang ang lokal nga komunidad ang nakakita sang desinyo bangud, ginabantayan man ini sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: According to Defensor, not only the local community saw the design because, it is also being watched all over the world.

text: Nahibaluan nga naglab-ot sa P4,010,046 ang balor sang Christmas lights and decorations ang ginpahamtang sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol subong nga tuig.
english: It is known that P4,010,046 worth of Christmas lights and decorations were placed at the Iloilo Provincial Capitol this year.

text: MYANMAR – Nagapadayon ang ginbansagan nga People Power sa pungsod Myanmar batok sa militar agud pauntaton na ang mga ini sa paggamit sang gahom kag kontrol sa pungsod.
english: MYANMAR – The so-called People Power in Myanmar continues against the military to stop them from using power and control in the country.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Atty. Jobert Pahilga direkta sa Myanmar, lapnagon ang nationally-coordinated protest action sa bilog nga pungsod sa diin indi magnubo sa lima ka milyon ang nagpasakop sa hublag-protesta.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Atty. Jobert Pahilga directly in Myanmar, the nationally-coordinated protest action will spread throughout the country where at least five million people have joined the protest movement.

text: Suno kay Pahilga, lunsay ginsirado ang tanan nga baligyaan, mga bangko, merkado, restaurant, kag establisemento komersyal.
english: According to Pahilga, all shops, banks, markets, restaurants, and commercial establishments were closed.

text: Suno sa iya, nagapanguna sa pagprotesta amo ang mga pamatan-on, mga young professionals, government officials kag mangin ang mga monghe.
english: He said the protesters were led by the youth, young professionals, government officials and even monks.

text: Dugang niya, makapila na magpahanumdom ang gobyerno sa publiko nga indi na magprotesta bangud dako ang posibilidad nga madamo sang mapatay sang militar apang wala nagapapugong ang mga tawo.
english: He added that the government has repeatedly reminded the public not to protest because there is a high possibility that many people will be killed by the military but people are not restraining themselves.

text: Sa subong indi pa mapat-od kun san-o mauntat ang mga pagprotesta.
english: It is not yet clear when the protests will end.

text: Gintuad man ni Pahilga nga bukas man ang embassy sa tion nga magpauli ang mga foreign nationals sa ila tagsa ka pungsod bangud sa magamo nga protesta adlaw-adlaw.
english: Pahilga also acknowledged that the embassy is also open when foreign nationals return to their respective countries due to the daily protests.

text: Matandaan nga nagpanawagan man si United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres sa militar sang Myanmar nga untaton na ang paggamit sang pwersa kag hilwayon ang ila mga ginpangdakop.
english: It can be recalled that United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres also called on the Myanmar military to stop using force and release their detainees.

text: Bangkay na sang nasapwan ang isa ka lalaki sa pavilion sa plaza sang Leganes, Iloilo.
english: A man was found dead in a pavilion in the plaza of Leganes, Iloilo.

text: Suno sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, ang biktima nakasuksok sang blue nga bayo kag itom nga dilargo.
english: According to initial investigation, the victim was wearing a blue shirt and black dilargo.

text: Nasapwan na lang ini nga nagabarikutot samtang ang iya lawas may mga hanog kag ginapahayag man nga may pilas sa ulo.
english: He was found lying on the floor with bruises on his body and a head injury.

text: May nakita man nga dugo malapit sa lugar kun sa diin ini nasapwan.
english: Blood was also found near the area where it was found.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barnagay Paul Jaen Kraft, Punong Barnagay sang nasambit nga lugar, iya ginpahayag nga ang biktima kagab-i nga ngalibot-libot sa lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barnagay Paul Jaen Kraft, Punong Barnagay of the said area, said the victim was walking around the area last night.

text: Samtang suno naman kay Pcapt.
english: Meanwhile, according to Pcapt.

text: General Enrique Robles, hepe sang Leganes Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga may yara sang apat tubtob lima ka mga suspek nga posible may kahilabtanan sa krimen.
english: General Enrique Robles, chief of the Leganes Municipal Police Station, said there are four to five suspects who may be involved in the crime.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad agud makilala ang biktima kag madakpan ang mga responsable sa natabo nga krimen.
english: Authorities are still investigating to identify the victim and arrest those responsible for the crime.

text: Nagguwa sa duha ka Israeli studies nga ang COVID-19 vaccine sang Pfizer ang makapanubo sang tyansa nga maglaton ang virus.
english: Two Israeli studies have found that Pfizer's COVID-19 vaccine can reduce the chances of contracting the virus.

text: Sa pagtuon sang Health Ministry sang Israel, natukiban sa data analysis nga ang Pfizer vaccine nga gindevelop sang BioNTech sang Germany ang makapanubo sang infection lakip na ang asymptomatic cases sa 89.4% kag sa symptomatic cases sa 93.7%.
english: In a study by Israel's Health Ministry, data analysis found that the Pfizer vaccine developed by BioNTech of Germany can reduce infection including asymptomatic cases to 89.4% and symptomatic cases to 93.7%.

text: Nagpamalibad naman nga magkomento ang Pfizer tuhoy diri.
english: Pfizer declined to comment on the matter.

text: Sa separado naman nga pagtuon sang Sheba Medical Center nga ginpublish sang The Lancet medical journal, natukiban nga sa 7,214 ka mga hospital staff nga nakabaton sang first dose sang Enero, may yara sang 85% nga pagnubo sa mga symptomatic COVID-19 sa sulod sang 15 tubtob 28 ka adlaw.
english: A separate study by Sheba Medical Center published in The Lancet medical journal found that of the 7,214 hospital staff who received the first dose in January, there was an 85% reduction in symptomatic COVID-19 cases within 15 to 28 days.

text: Suno kay Michal Linial, professor sang molecular biology and bioinformatics sa Hebrew University sa Jerusalem, ang mga resulta nga nagguwa ang makabig na nga dako nga tikang padulong sa sabat sa isa nga pinaka-importante nga pamangkot sa pag-away batuk sa pandemya.
english: According to Michal Linial, professor of molecular biology and bioinformatics at the Hebrew University in Jerusalem, the results are considered a big step towards answering one of the most important questions in the fight against the pandemic.

text: Apang santu sa mga vaccine developers, madamo pa nga mga pagtuon kag pagpanalawsaw ang kinahanglanon agud makahimo sang definitive conclusion.
english: But according to the vaccine developers, more studies and research are needed to make a definitive conclusion.

text: Nangibabaw ang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa opening round sang 2025 Oeiras Ladies Open sa Portugal, kahapon.
english: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala won the opening round of the 2025 Oeiras Ladies Open in Portugal yesterday.

text: Ginpierde ni Eala si Anouk Koevermans sang Netherlands sa score nga 6-3, 6-4.
english: Eala defeated Anouk Koevermans of the Netherlands 6-3, 6-4.

text: Kabahin sang cast sang Hollywood movie nga ginabidahan ni Nicole Kidman si Bombo International Correspondent Dee Donasco.
english: Bombo International Correspondent Dee Donasco is part of the cast of the Hollywood movie starring Nicole Kidman.

text: Ini amo ang pelikula nga Holland nga isa ka thriller film nga nasentro sa istorya sang isa ka manunudlo sa Michigan nga may yara sang makabig picture-perfect life apang sang ulihi, isa ka sekreto ang ila nga nadiskubrehan, isa ka murder mystery.
english: This is the movie Holland which is a thriller film that centers on the story of a teacher in Michigan who has what can be considered a picture-perfect life but eventually, they discover a secret, a murder mystery.

text: Si Donasco ang nagaisahanon nga Ilongga kag Pinay nga parte sang pelikula.
english: Donasco is the only Ilongga and Filipina in the film.

text: Natalana naman ang screening sang pelikula sa Marso 27 kun sa diin ang premier sini ang patigayunon sa Austin, Texas sa isa ka film festival.
english: The film is scheduled to be screened on March 27 with its premiere in Austin, Texas at a film festival.

text: INDI naton dapat isalig ang aton pagpati sa mga pakot-pakot lang ukon sugid-sugid nga indi mapamatud-an sa sining aton padayon nga away batok sa COVID-19.
english: We should NOT rely on rumors or rumors that cannot be proven in our ongoing fight against COVID-19.

text: “Dangerous” inang basta kon ano lang ang aton patihan.
english: That's “dangerous” no matter what we believe.

text: Una sa tanan, perhwisyo ini nga daku sa aton pagpangabuhi kon sala ang aton pagpati.
english: First of all, it is a great loss to our lives if we believe wrongly.

text: Ikaduha, kon mamung-an kita, kag mapabay-an ang aton ginabatyag, sobra pa ini nga makamamatay sangsa flu – tatlo sa isa ang pwede mapatay sang COVID-19 kontra flu!
english: Second, if we are discouraged, and neglect our feelings, it is more deadly than the flu – three to one can die from COVID-19 versus the flu!

text: In fact, bisan sa una pa lang nga suspetso nga posible nalatnan kita, dayon kita sina i-quarantine sang gobyerno tubtub maseguro nga wala kita sining balatian sa sulod sang 14 ka adlaw nga pagpanilag.
english: In fact, even at the first suspicion that we may be infected, the government will immediately quarantine us until we are sure that we are free of this disease within 14 days of observation.

text: Man ang COVID-19 may batasan nga latnan ka bag-o magpakita sing sintoma (pre-symptomatic) sa una nga duha ka adlaw tubtub 14 ka adlaw, ukon wala gid gapakita sing sintoma (asymptomatic).
english: COVID-19 also has a tendency to be transmitted pre-symptomatic for the first two to 14 days, or asymptomatic.

text: Kag kon mapamatud-an nga infected kita, ma-ospital na kita kag daku gid ina nga libug pati na sang aton pamilya.
english: And if we are proven infected, we will be hospitalized and that will be a big concern for our families.

text: In other words, posible nga kita tanan may COVID-19 nga nagahulat lang nga madiskubrihan.
english: In other words, it is possible that we all have COVID-19 just waiting to be discovered.

text: Gani dapat lang nga sundon ang panugyan sang health authorities agud mapatuman ang minimum health standards sa aton pangginawi agud malikawan ini.
english: Therefore, we should follow the advice of the health authorities to implement the minimum health standards in our behavior to avoid this.

text: Ining minimum health standards galakip sang paggamit sang face mask (lakip ang face shield sa karon), physical/social distancing nga isa tubtub duha ka metro, kag masami nga hand hygiene gamit ang tubig kag habon ukon indi gani sang sanitizer (70 percent alcohol) agud mapaseguro nga indi naton matandug sang mahigko nga kamot ang aton ilong, baba kag mata nga maagyan sang virus pasulod sa aton lawas.
english: These minimum health standards include the use of face masks (including face shields now), physical/social distancing of one to two meters, and frequent hand hygiene using water and soap or even sanitizer (70 percent alcohol) to ensure that we do not touch our nose, mouth and eyes with dirty hands to pass the virus into our bodies.

text:
***

Ang malain kay madamo gihapon sang aton pumuluyo ang wala nagatuman sining sugo sang health authorities.
english:
***

Unfortunately, many of our residents still do not comply with this order of the health authorities.

text: Either tungod lain ang ila ginapatihan ukon gapakabal lang.
english: Either because they believe differently or just being stupid.

text: Kag ina bisan may mga kasuguan ukon ordinansa pa kita nga nagapataw sing penalidad sa mga naga-violate sining minimum health standards.
english: And that's even though we have laws or ordinances that impose penalties on those who violate these minimum health standards.

text: Isa sang ordinansa sa siyudad sang Iloilo nagapataw sing penalidad nga P500 sa naga-violate kag mas mataas pa sa liwat nga pag-violate.
english: One of the ordinances in Iloilo City imposes a penalty of P500 for violators and higher for repeat violations.

text: Apang daw sa wala lang sa bungog sang iban.
english: But it seems that it is not in the ears of others.

text: Ayhan tungod gamay lang ini nga penalidad para sa ila nga may kwarta ukon mapasensyahan lang anay kon madakpan sang mga compliance officer sang siyudad kag sang barangay.
english: Perhaps because it is a small penalty for those who have money or just be patient if caught by the compliance officers of the city and the barangay.

text: Tungod sini, gaplano sa karon ang konseho sang siyudad sa pagpataas san penalidad sa mga maga-violate.
english: Because of this, the city council is now planning to increase the penalties for violators.

text: Apang gapati kita nga wala ini igu kon pasapayan man lang ang pagpatuman sini.
english: But we believe that it is not enough if its implementation is neglected.

text: Ang pamatuod amo nga bisan diin lang madamo gihapon ang naga-violate.
english: The proof is that there are still many violators everywhere.

text: Isa ka rason kay wala man sing nagalibut nga mga compliant officer kag tubtub lang sa pagsaway, kag kon madakpan daw mga ilaga ini sila nga nagagwa “if the cat is away.” Ano abe kon butangan ta sing duha ka tanod sa kada sityo nga gabulos-bulos sa paglibut-libut kag tuod-tuod nga nagapatuman sang ordinansa?
english: One reason is that there are no compliance officers around and only reprimand, and when caught they are like rats that come out “if the cat is away.” What if we put two tanods in each sityo who take turns patrolling and actually enforcing the ordinance?

text:
***

Of course, may yara man gihapon nga ignorante parti sa sining minimum health standards ukon gapilit gid sang ila kaugalingon nga pagpati ukon paghangop.
english:
***

Of course, there are still those who are ignorant about these minimum health standards or insist on their own beliefs or understanding.

text: Ejemplo lang sang sining pagka-ignorante sang duha ka drayber sang dyep.
english: This is just an example of the ignorance of the two jeepney drivers.

text: Sunu sa sugid sa aton sang isa ka kakilala nga pasahero, nagalalaway gid ining isa ka drayber sa pagsugid sang kon ano sa kapareho nga drayber nga halos isa lang ka dangaw ang antad.
english: According to an acquaintance of the passenger, this one driver was spitting to tell something to the other driver who was almost a yard away.

text: Kag gaatubang pa sa naulihi!
english: And still facing the latter!

text: Ginsaway siya sang pasahero nga nagapungko sa front seat kay bukas ang iya face mask samtang nagasugilanon sa isa nga nagagwa man ang ilong sa face mask.
english: The passenger sitting in the front seat reprimanded him for wearing his face mask open while talking to someone whose nose was also coming out of the face mask.

text: Aba, daw maakig pa siya.
english: Well, he seems to be angry.

text: Siling niya nagainom siya kuno sing kape kag indi kinahanglan ang face mask.
english: He says he drinks coffee and doesn't need a face mask.

text: Gahambal malapit sa kaatubang nga drayber?
english: Talking near the other driver?

text:
Nagdugang man ang kaupod nga drayber sa pagsiling: “Wala ina siya COVID, wala man siya sintoma …”

Wala sila kahibalo nga basi asymptomatic ukon sa tion nga pre-symptomatic ang isa, ukon duha gid gani sila, kag dala na nila ang COVD-19 virus.
english:
The fellow driver added: “He doesn't have COVID, he doesn't have any symptoms …”

They don't know that one, or two of them, may be asymptomatic or pre-symptomatic, and they are carrying the COVD-19 virus.

text: Kag tungod sina kinahanglan gid ipatuman ang minimum health standards nga wala sing exception.
english: And because of that, minimum health standards must be implemented without exception.

text: Naghipos na gid lang ang pasahero nga nagalungo-lungo na gid lang sang iya ulo sa pagka-ignorante sang duha.
english: The passenger was silent, shaking his head at the ignorance of the two.

text: Tani ipasulod naton sa aton ulo ang indi magpa-alam-alam kag isalig ang pagpatuman sining minimum health standards sa aton syensya kag mga health expert./PN
english: Let's get it into our heads not to be foolish and entrust the implementation of these minimum health standards to our science and health experts./PN

text: Natural lang para sa iloy nga ulikdan kag paminsaron pirme ang buasdamlag sang iya anak — pati na ang pagpangasawa sini ukon kun kay sin-o ayhan ini nga babaye magatupa.
english: It's only natural for a mother to worry about her daughter's future — including her marriage or who she might marry.

text: Kun naga-nobyahanay na gani sila, ginausisa gid sang iloy kun maayo man ayhan ang batasan sang babaye kag kun maayo ang impluwensya nga dala sini.
english: Even when they are dating, the mother checks to see if the woman's behavior is good and if the influence she brings is good.

text: Apang may indi basta-basta nga mga kaso sang isa ka iloy kun sa diin sa sobra sini nga panumdom sa asawahon sang iya anak, nasarangan sini nga mang-agaw sang bata sang iban!
english: But there are not easy cases of a mother where in her excessive thoughts of her son's wife, she is able to snatch someone else's child!

text: Ini amo ang Chinese nga babaye nga si Yang nga may yara sang 27-anyos nga anak nga lalaki.
english: This is Chinese woman Yang who has a 27-year-old son.

text: Isa ka adlaw sang Pebrero 2023, nagbisita siya sa Liupanshui City sa probinsya sang Guizhou kun sa diin nakit-an sini ang 11 -anyos nga bata nga babaye.
english: One day in February 2023, he visited Liupanshui City in Guizhou province where he found an 11 -year-old girl.

text: Kumbinsido si Yang nga mangin maayo nga asawa ang bata sa iya anak nga lalaki KUN mapadako lang ini sang maayo.
english: Yang was convinced that the child would make a good wife to her son IF she could only be raised properly.

text: Gani wala na ini sang huya-huya pa kag nag-ayo sa mga ginikanan sang bata kun pwede niya ini ma-adopt.
english: So he had no more shame and asked the child's parents if he could adopt him.

text: Wala nagpasugot ang Tatay, gani nga nagpauli na lang si Yang, apang wala pa didto natapos ang iya nga plano.
english: Dad didn't agree, so Yang went home, but that wasn't the end of his plan.

text: Nagbalik si Yang sa amo nga syudad kaupod na mismo ang iya 27-anyos nga anak nga lalaki kag sang nahibaluan nila nga wala sang kaupod ang bata sa balay, ila ini ginkuha kag gindala sa ila nga balay.
english: Nagbalik si Yang sa amo nga syudad kaupod na mismo ang iya 27-anyos nga anak nga lalaki kag sang nahibaluan nila nga wala sang kaupod ang bata sa balay, ila ini ginkuha kag gindala sa ila nga balay.

text: Anum ka adlaw ang nagligad, gin-aresto si Yang kag apat ka adlaw ang makaligad sina, nagsungka man ang iya anak nga lalaki.
english: Six days later, Yang was arrested and four days after that, his son also surrendered.

text: Ginsentensyahan ang duha sang pagka-preso kun sa diin duha ka tuig para kay Yang kag pito ka bulan naman para sa anak sini bangud sa child abduction.
english: The two were sentenced to two years in prison for Yang and seven months for his son for child abduction.

text: Gin-apelar pa nila ang desisyon apang sang nagligad lamang nga bulan, ginpalig-on pa sang Appeals Court ang nauna nga desisyon sang korte kag ginpatuman gid ang sentensya.
english: They appealed the decision but just last month, the Appeals Court upheld the court's previous decision and carried out the sentence.

text: Tuman naman ang kaugot sang iban bangud nga kalip-ot lang sang tion nga mapreso ang duha apisar nga daku nga krimen ang ila nahimo nga isa ka child trafficking.
english: Others were angry that the two were imprisoned for a short time despite committing a serious crime of child trafficking.
